title: Systems Engineer - Database Platform
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3><strong> Available Locations: Austin, New York, San Francisco, Canada, Remote</strong></h3> <h3><strong>About the Team</strong></h3> <p>We manage an internal, multi-region PostgreSQL platform that enables engineers to rapidly build, deploy, and operate services. Our mission is to provide a highly available, stable, and self-service platform with clear operational visibility. As a Systems Engineer, you will collaborate with database engineers, developers, and infrastructure teams to evolve our database architecture and automation. You will be instrumental in scaling our PostgreSQL infrastructure and enhancing database reliability. If you are passionate about PostgreSQL, automation, reliability, and database tooling, let's connect!</p> <p><strong>Role Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Build, deploy, and manage PostgreSQL database clusters in production environments. </li> <li>Develop and maintain database tooling for automation, monitoring and performance tuning.</li> <li>Implement high availability, backup and disaster recovery solutions. </li> <li>Work closely with Infrastructure and Applications teams to integrate database tools. </li> <li>Implement proactive solutions using observability tools to monitor database health. </li> <li>Optimize database performance, indexing strategies, and query tuning. </li> </ul> <p><strong>Role Requirements (Must-Have Skills)</strong></p> <p><strong>Must-Have Skills</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience with building, scaling, and managing large-scale multi-tenant PostgreSQL database clusters, encompassing high availability failover, and disaster recovery strategies.</li> <li>Experience with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Ansible or Salt) .</li> <li>Experience in scripting languages (Python, Bash) for automation. </li> <li>Experience building and maintaining database tooling for automation and monitoring.</li> <li>Experience with containerization technologies like Docker and Kubernetes.</li> <li>Experience optimizing database performance and query tuning.</li> <li>Experience with alerting and monitoring tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, and Kibana.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Nice-to-Have Skills</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience developing software in Go, Ruby or C/C++</li> <li>Contributions to PostgreSQL or relevant open-source projects.</li> <li>Expertise in database schema migrations and automation using tools like Flyway, Liquibase or goose. </li> <li>Experience with connection pooling solutions such as PgBouncer, HAProxy.</li> <li>Experience with non-relational data stores such as Distributed & time-series databases (ex. Cassandra, Timescale) and key-value stores (eg., Redis) </li> </ul> <h2>Compensation</h2> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <ul> <li>For Bay Area based hires: Estimated annual salary of $157,000 - $196,000</li> <li><span data-sheets-root="1">For New York based hires: Estimated annual salary of $150,000 - $187,000 </span></li> </ul> <h3>Equity</h3> <p>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.</p> <h3>Benefits</h3> <p>Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family.  Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun!  The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.</p> <h3>Health & Welfare Benefits</h3> <ul> <li>Medical/Rx Insurance</li> <li>Dental Insurance</li> <li>Vision Insurance</li> <li>Flexible Spending Accounts</li> <li>Commuter Spending Accounts</li> <li>Fertility & Family Forming Benefits</li> <li>On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program</li> <li>Global Travel Medical Insurance</li> </ul> <h3>Financial Benefits</h3> <ul> <li>Short and Long Term Disability Insurance</li> <li>Life & Accident Insurance</li> <li>401(k) Retirement Savings Plan</li> <li>Employee Stock Participation Plan</li> </ul> <h3>Time Off</h3> <ul> <li>Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave</li> <li>Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>

title: E-Commerce Integration Specialist (m/w/d)
description: Rügamer & Steiner entwickelt E-Mail-Marketing für Online-Shops. Damit unser Team für einen neuen Kunden loslegen kann, müssen Shop und Klaviyo sauber zusammenspielen. Du übernimmst diese Anbindung, klärst technische Fragen direkt mit dem Kunden und seiner Shopagentur und prüfst, ob alles für den Start bereit ist. Was du übernimmst • Du bindest Kundenshops an Klaviyo an, richtest die Integration ein und prüfst, ob die benötigten Daten und Shop-Ereignisse ankommen. • Du führst technische Onboarding-Termine. Du erklärst, welche Zugänge oder Änderungen nötig sind, und hältst die offenen Punkte bis zur Übergabe nach. • Du gehst Fehlern in bestehenden Anbindungen nach, etwa wenn Bestellereignisse fehlen oder eine Schnittstelle nicht mehr zuverlässig läuft. Bei Änderungen am Live-Shop planst du die Prüfung mit ein. • Du arbeitest eng mit dem Account Management zusammen. Das Team weiß von dir, was bereits funktioniert, was noch offen ist und wann es mit der Übergabe rechnen kann. • Wenn sich ein technischer Schritt bei mehreren Kunden wiederholt, kannst du ein Skript, ein internes Tool oder ein Plugin bauen, das die Arbeit beim nächsten Onboarding vereinfacht. So startest du Du lernst unsere Klaviyo-Setups und die Onboarding-Checkliste an konkreten Kundenfällen kennen. Schritt für Schritt übernimmst du technische Termine und eigene Anbindungen. Nach drei Monaten ist das Ziel, dass du ein Standard-Onboarding vom ersten technischen Kundentermin bis zur geprüften Übergabe selbstständig durchführst. Was du mitbringst • Du hast schon selbst eine Integration eingerichtet, einen technischen Fehler behoben oder ein funktionierendes Projekt mit KI-Agenten umgesetzt. Erfahrung mit laufenden E-Commerce-Shops ist ein Plus. • Du kannst mit KI-Agenten arbeiten und programmieren. Du zerlegst technische Aufgaben in Schritte, prüfst den erzeugten Code und testest, ob die Lösung funktioniert. • Du kannst nachvollziehen, wie Daten zwischen Shop und angebundenen Systemen fließen. Du findest dich in APIs, Shop-Apps und technischen Einstellungen wie DNS zurecht. • Du kannst erklären, wie du eine Änderung an einem laufenden Shop vorbereitest, prüfst und bei Bedarf zurücknimmst. • Du kannst technische Probleme im Kundengespräch verständlich erklären und mit Kunden und Agenturen konkrete nächste Schritte vereinbaren. • Erfahrung mit Shopware, Magento oder ähnlich komplexen Shop-Setups ist besonders interessant. Klaviyo-Erfahrung ist willkommen. Unsere Abläufe lernst du bei uns kennen. Was dich erwartet Du bekommst früh eigene Kundenfälle und entscheidest bei Standardanbindungen selbst, wie du sie umsetzt. Du arbeitest mit unterschiedlichen Shopsystemen und siehst direkt, was deine Arbeit beim Kunden verändert. Wenn du merkst, dass ein eigenes Tool einen wiederkehrenden Engpass löst, kannst du es bauen und in den nächsten Onboardings einsetzen. Rahmenbedingungen • Düsseldorf, fünf Tage pro Woche vor Ort • Vollzeit mit 40 Stunden pro Woche, Festanstellung • 50.000–100.000 € brutto pro Jahr, je nach Erfahrung und Entwicklung in der Rolle Bewirb dich Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und ein kurzes Beispiel für eine Shop-Integration, einen technischen Fehler, den du gelöst hast, oder ein Projekt, das du mit KI-Agenten umgesetzt hast. Welche Systeme oder Tools hast du genutzt, was hast du selbst übernommen und wie hast du das Ergebnis geprüft? Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Social Media & Campaign Manager (m/w/d)
description: Über Cell Labs Wir bauen humanoide Systeme: Full Stack, von Hardware und Elektronik über Software bis zur Fertigung, alles in-house in Berlin. Bei Cell Labs verschieben wir die Grenze dessen, was Robotik leisten kann. Unser Ziel ist klar: Systeme bauen, die Menschen stärken statt sie zu ersetzen. Unsere Technologie ist bereits bei führenden Industriekunden und Partnern im Einsatz. Jetzt steht unser eigenes Produkt kurz vor dem Launch. Die leise Phase ist vorbei. Wir suchen Menschen, die früh dabei sein wollen, Verantwortung übernehmen und das bauen, worüber andere nur reden. Ort: Berlin · Start: Ab sofort · Arbeitsmodell: Vor Ort · Anstellung : Vollzeit Deine Aufgaben Content-Produktion: Du produzierst Shorts, Reels und Posts für LinkedIn, Instagram und YouTube, vor und hinter der Kamera. Vom ersten Konzept über den Dreh bis zum fertigen Schnitt. Social-Media-Redaktion: Du verantwortest unseren Redaktionsplan und entscheidest, welches Thema auf welchem Kanal läuft. Du machst aus einem Engineering-Fortschritt einen LinkedIn-Post, aus einem Testlauf ein Video und aus einem Meilenstein einen Moment, über den geredet wird. Community Management: Du sichtest Kommentare und Nachrichten, antwortest im Tagesgeschäft und erkennst, wann ein Thema an das Team oder die Gründer:innen geflaggt werden muss. Kampagnen & Launch: Du setzt Kampagnen operativ um, insbesondere die Kommunikation rund um unseren Produktlaunch: von Teasern über Content vor Ort bis zum Recap. Mit Creator:innen und Partnern arbeitest du dabei eng zusammen. Founder-Content: Du recherchierst Themen und schreibst Entwürfe für LinkedIn-Beiträge, die unsere Gründer:innen aus ihrer eigenen Perspektive veröffentlichen. Du entwickelst eigene Formate aus unserem Material: Unser Videograf kümmert sich um Dokumentation und aufwendige Produktionen. Du machst daraus eigene Formate, schneidest Snippets und organisierst kleinere Drehs selbst. Reporting: Du misst Reichweite, Engagement und Profilbesuche, wertest aus, was funktioniert, und bringst die Erkenntnisse in den nächsten Redaktionsplan ein. Brand Consistency: Gemeinsam mit unserem Brand & Communications Lead bringst du unsere Markenstrategie in die tägliche Content-Arbeit. Du sorgst dafür, dass unsere Marke über alle Kanäle hinweg wiedererkennbar bleibt. Das bringst Du mit Erfahrung: Mindestens zwei Jahre im Social Media Management oder in der Content Creation, in einer Agentur, einem Startup, einem In-house-Team oder als Freelancer:in. Du hast mindestens eine Kampagne eigenständig umgesetzt und kannst zeigen, was dabei herauskam. Vor und hinter der Kamera: Du stehst gerne selbst vor der Kamera und drehst und schneidest Shorts eigenständig, zum Beispiel in Premiere, CapCut oder DaVinci Resolve. Redaktion und Konzept: Du denkst in Formaten und Serien, schreibst gute Texte und weißt, wie sich ein Thema auf LinkedIn, Instagram und YouTube jeweils anders erzählt. Produktion: Kleinere Drehs organisierst du selbst, von der Location über das Equipment bis zur Abstimmung mit allen Beteiligten. Neugier: Interesse an komplexen Technologien und die Motivation, tief in die Robotik einzutauchen und technische Zusammenhänge verständlich zu machen. Zahlen: Du kennst die Analytics der Plattformen und leitest daraus ab, was du als Nächstes anders machst. Sprachen: Deutsch und Englisch fließend. Das bieten wir Dir Deine Arbeit ist das, was die Welt von uns sieht: Feeds, Launch, Event. Fast alles, was die Öffentlichkeit von unseren Robotern mitbekommt, geht über deinen Tisch. Alles unter einem Dach: Büro, Werkstatt und Teststände liegen im selben Gebäude in Kreuzberg. Wenn du den Roboter in Aktion filmen willst, ist der Engineer ein paar Schritte entfernt, ganz ohne Ticket. Room to Fail & Grow: Bezahlte Lernzeit mit persönlichem Budget für Kurse, Konferenzen und die Tools, die du brauchst. Du bekommst Raum, neue Formate auszuprobieren, und begleitest einen Launch, den bisher kaum jemand gesehen hat. Benefits: Ein Leistungspaket, das du dir selbst zusammenstellst und das Mobilität, Gesundheit, Ernährung oder Fitness abdeckt. Dazu gibt’s einen zusätzlichen bezahlten freien Tag im Jahr für ehrenamtliches Engagement oder ein Projekt, das dir am Herzen liegt. Bewerbung Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und Links zu Content, den du selbst produziert hast, idealerweise eine Kampagne oder Serie, die du von der Idee bis zur Veröffentlichung umgesetzt hast. Dazu ein paar Zeilen: Was war das Ziel, was hast du gemacht, was kam dabei heraus? Ein Anschreiben brauchen wir nicht. Der Prozess: Intro Call, Deep Dive in deine bisherige Arbeit, Besuch bei uns mit einer kleinen Content-Aufgabe, Angebot. Wir bauen Roboter für alle, deshalb wollen wir ein Team, das das abbildet. Wir stellen nach Fähigkeiten ein und freuen uns ausdrücklich über Bewerbungen von Menschen, die in Social Media und Tech unterrepräsentiert sind. Wenn du nicht jeden Punkt erfüllst, aber denkst, das ist dein Job: bewirb dich. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Brand Manager Biodermal
description: Karo Healthcare, a dynamic and growing personal-care retail company, is all about making smart choices for everyday healthcare. With a wide-ranging portfolio across seven categories including medical products, we own and sell over 80 brands in about 90 countries. Our portfolio includes such brands as E45, Pevaryl, Lamisil, Nutravita, Decubal and many others. Our core belief in empowering people to make intelligent health decisions drives our growth strategy, blending organic expansion and M&A. Join us at Karo Healthcare on our exciting journey. We're currently looking for a Senior Brand Manager – Biodermal for our office in Rotterdam , Netherlands . What's in it for you? Ready to take ownership of an iconic skincare brand and make a real commercial impact? This is your opportunity to shape the future of Biodermal in the Netherlands, combining brand strategy, innovation and hands-on execution in a fast-moving, entrepreneurial environment. You'll have the freedom to turn consumer insights into bold ideas, drive profitable growth and collaborate with international teams to bring exciting innovations to market. With real ownership, high visibility and plenty of room to develop, this is a role where your ideas can make a difference. What you'll be doing Shape the brand strategy: Partner with the Marketing Manager to develop Biodermal's three-year strategy and translate it into ambitious, commercially focused annual brand plans for the Netherlands. Own brand performance: Manage the brand P&L, marketing budgets and A&P investment, identifying opportunities to accelerate profitable growth and maximise ROI. Champion the consumer: Turn consumer, shopper and market insights into compelling brand propositions, campaigns and growth opportunities. Bring innovation to life: Collaborate with Global Skincare Portfolio and Innovation teams to launch relevant new products and renovations, from concept through to in-market execution. Drive impactful brand activation: Lead integrated marketing campaigns across digital, media, content, retail and e-commerce, ensuring a consistent and distinctive brand experience. Win in the market: Partner with Sales, Shopper Marketing and e-commerce teams to strengthen brand visibility, distribution, customer engagement and conversion. Stay ahead of the competition: Monitor category trends, competitor activity and campaign performance, translating insights into clear commercial actions. Make things happen: Lead cross-functional projects with internal stakeholders and external agencies, ensuring effective execution, regulatory compliance and measurable results. Requirements 5+ years of brand marketing experience , ideally within FMCG, consumer healthcare, beauty, personal care or skincare. A degree in Marketing, Business or a related field, or equivalent experience. Proven experience developing and executing integrated brand strategies and marketing plans , with clear commercial results. Strong commercial acumen, including hands-on experience with P&L ownership, budget management and brand performance analysis . Experience bringing product innovation or renovation to market, from strategic planning through to launch. A solid understanding of modern brand building across digital marketing, e-commerce, retail, media and consumer activation . A consumer-first mindset, with the ability to turn market insights and data into actionable growth opportunities. Strong stakeholder management skills, with experience leading agencies and collaborating across commercial and international teams. A proactive, entrepreneurial approach, comfortable taking ownership, challenging ideas and delivering results in a fast-paced environment. Strong Microsoft Office skills and an interest in leveraging AI and new technologies to improve ways of working. Fluency in Dutch and English , both written and spoken. Benefits Opportunity to create, grow, and encourage. Apart from a competitive salary package, there are plenty of growth opportunities to support your personal ambitions. Flexible working arrangements and a healthy work-life balance. Responsibility for exciting and challenging projects with a direct, visible impact on our customers and the industry. A positive working environment within an international, collaborative and motivated team. An entrepreneurial, start-up spirit combined with the opportunities and resources of a large international organisation with strong values. Karo Healthcare has a Diverse & Inclusive environment. We are looking for qualified candidates irrespective of gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, ethnicity, race, religion, national origin, disability or age. title: Regional Compliance Senior Manager
description: <p><strong>Company Profile</strong></p> <p>nLighten is a European platform of distributed edge data centers, designed to meet the growing demand for AI, 5G, and hybrid cloud deployments. As a rapidly expanding provider, we offer scalable colocation hubs and best-in-class energy solutions across Europe. Our innovative and sustainable approach to digital infrastructure ensures reliability, efficiency, and future-ready solutions for our clients. nLighten’s current footprint is 34 data centers in 7 European countries, with the ambition to grow to 100 sites during the next 3-4 years.</p> <p><strong>Learn more about us: </strong><a href="http://www.nlighten.com"><strong>www.nlighten.com</strong></a><br><br></p> <p><strong>About the Role</strong></p> <p>We are seeking an <strong>Regional Compliance Senior Manager</strong> to lead and optimize the operational performance of our data centers in the UK. In this role, you will be working on a 70-30 model. Wherein 70% of your responsibility will be to support your region maintain compliance to nLighten policies and to relevant Operational regulation (including but not limited to Environment, Health & Safety, Security, Data Privacy). While 30% of your role will be involved in managing nLighten level compliance projects given you a holistic view of the compliance footprint and ability to make a difference at a global company level. You will play a key role in shaping the future of our compliance as we expand our footprint. <br><br><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead compliance effort of multiple data centers across UK ensuring high level of policy and regulatory adherence on continuous basis.</li> <li>Act as a subject matter expert for topics related to EHS (Environment, Health & Safety) for nLighten.</li> <li>Own and manage compliance projects at nLighten level (including but not limited to; process/policy definition and rollout, compliance training, KPI definition and tracking, etc.).</li> <li>Closely track audit findings for the region and work with relevant stakeholders to encourage timely closure.</li> <li>Perform planned and adhoc internal checks/audits on various operational subjects including EHS, Security and Business Continuity.</li> <li>Perform need based and regular compliance training for in scope staff.</li> <li>Perform EHS incident investigations and enable the team to identify root cause and remedial action.</li> <li>Oversee energy and environment compliance effort for the region and in certain cases for nLighten.</li> <li>Collaborate with leadership and cross-functional teams to align regional compliance with business strategy.</li> <li>Play a key role in scaling compliance maturity to support the company’s ambitious growth plans.</li> <li>Perform cross-region internal audits as planned.</li> <li>Enforce the nLighten Safe-to-Work process (PPM, RAMS, MOP, Change Request, Permit to Work) at every site.</li> <li>Provide guidance to regional Operations on EHS and any other compliance related budget plan.</li> <li>Support with external audits as a SME (Subject Matter Expert) for EHS and other compliance related topics. This includes certification and/or customer audits.</li> <li>Work with the wider compliance team to deliver a standard approach and overall improvement strategy for compliance.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Performance Metrics</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Audit Finding Closure with Target timeline:</strong> Maintaining high compliance status across all managed datacentres.</li> <li><strong>Subject Matter Expertise:</strong> Managing queries relevant to EHS for nLighten and for the datacentres in scope.</li> <li><strong>Coaching:</strong> Growth and performance of site technicians and regional managers on compliance topics.</li> <li><strong>Process Improvements:</strong> Identification and definition of new governance and compliance frameworks.</li> <li><strong>Training and Rollout Management: </strong>Enable site Ops to comply with all key processes and maintain a safe and secure working environment<strong>.</strong></li> <li><strong>Customer:</strong> Support with compliance related audits and customer queries across the region.</li> </ul> <p><br><strong>What We’re Looking For</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>5+ years of experience in environmental, health, and safety programs </strong>in a datacentre or a manufacturing or construction environment.</li> <li>Sound knowledge of <strong>safety standards and regulations in the UK</strong>, sustainability best practices, and ISO 14001 and 45001 certification requirements.</li> <li>Experience of <strong>performing internal audits</strong> OR qualification as a Lead Auditor.</li> <li>Certification in <strong>NEBOSH, ASP, or CSP</strong> is a plus.</li> <li><strong>Datacentre experience</strong> is a plus.</li> <li>Experience working with <strong>ISMS (Information Security Management System)</strong> and with certifications such as ISO27001, PCI-DSS, ISAE3402 SOC1, SOC2, etc.</li> <li>Willingness to travel across our European locations (maximum 10% of time)</li> <li>IT or technical degree preferred. Degree in law is a plus.</li> <li>Strong <strong>stakeholder management skills</strong>, with the ability to engage at all levels.</li> <li>Excellent communication skills and a <strong>people-focused cross stakeholder approach</strong>.</li> <li>Fluency in English.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Why Join Us?</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead a high-impact role in a <strong>rapidly expanding digital infrastructure company</strong>.</li> <li>Shape the <strong>future of operations</strong> in emerging markets across Europe.</li> <li>Work in a dynamic, innovative environment with significant growth potential.</li> <li>Join a company that values <strong>sustainability, efficiency, and cutting-edge solutions</strong>.<br><br></li> </ul> <p><strong>Apply now</strong> and be part of our journey toward a more connected, efficient, and sustainable digital future.<br><br></p> <p><strong><em>Background Check & Screening</em></strong><br><em>All selected candidates will undergo a background check to ensure a safe workplace, protect company assets, and comply with regulations.</em></p> <p><strong><em>Diversity & Inclusion Statement</em></strong><em><br>nLighten is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace, and we encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds. Even if you do not meet every requirement listed, we welcome your application. We particularly encourage women and individuals from underrepresented groups to apply.</em></p> <p> </p> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Regional Field Marketing Manager, EMEA Commercial
description: <h2><strong>Who we are</strong></h2> <h3><strong>About Stripe</strong></h3> <p>Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.</p> <h3><strong>About the team</strong></h3> <p>Our EMEA Marketing team is a dynamic, fast-growing group that loves turning customers into enthusiastic Stripe advocates. We work hand-in-hand with our Sales team to build demand, help users get the most out of our products, and craft marketing plans that truly resonate with local audiences.</p> <p>We have a lot still to build, and we’re tackling it as a diverse, international team that thrives on collaboration, bold innovation, and genuine curiosity. If you love to learn and want to make a meaningful impact, we’d love to have you join us.</p> <h3><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h3> <p>As a senior individual contributor, you’ll align regional and global marketing teams around shared priorities for EMEA Velocity, secure investment to deliver them, and balance global strategy with regional needs. You’ll directly lead high-priority initiatives across the region.</p> <p> </p> <p>You’ll shape how Stripe grows its Velocity segment across EMEA, with a particular focus on winning and expanding relationships with priority commercial accounts. You’ll combine regional strategy with hands-on field marketing, building programs that generate demand and accelerate pipeline across different markets.</p> <p>As the primary marketing partner on the EMEA Velocity leadership team, you’ll own the regional marketing strategy and investment plan. You’ll work closely with Sales leadership to identify the biggest opportunities across markets, decide where marketing can make the greatest difference, and turn those priorities into measurable business results.</p> <p> </p> <p>You’ll lead account-based programs, executive engagement, and market-relevant campaigns for priority commercial accounts, bringing together regional and global teams to deliver them. Your programs will engage senior decision makers and operational leaders on reducing developer complexity, improving conversion, and increasing the return on their financial infrastructure. You’ll also partner with Demand Generation on scaled digital demand campaigns and programs, connecting those efforts with regional business priorities.</p> <p> </p> <p>As a senior individual contributor, you’ll lead through influence across markets and teams, aligning Sales, Demand Generation, Product Marketing, and Global Campaigns around a shared plan. You’ll balance regional priorities with local customer needs, use results to guide investment, and build approaches that can scale across EMEA. You’ll help shape the marketing approach and directly lead the initiatives where regional context and ownership matter most.</p> <h3><strong>Responsibilities</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Define and own the integrated marketing strategy for the Velocity segment across EMEA, turning business goals, market dynamics, customer needs, and competitors into clear priorities.</li> <li>Partner with regional Sales and Sales Development (SDR) leadership to set shared priorities, take part in pipeline reviews, and steer marketing investments.</li> <li>Build full-funnel campaigns around the problems businesses are trying to solve, such as taking payments online, growing recurring revenue, and getting paid faster.</li> <li>Lead high-touch field marketing, targeted account-based programs, and executive events, including dinners and roadshows, for priority commercial accounts. Partner with Demand Generation on scaled digital demand campaigns and programs, connecting those programs with regional Sales priorities.</li> <li> </li> <li>Co-market with the SaaS Platforms and Partner teams to reach merchants through the software they already use.</li> <li>Build Stripe’s brand with these businesses through customer stories, executive engagement, and industry initiatives, and lead the programs yourself where local context and senior ownership matter most.</li> <li>Own the regional marketing budget and use pipeline generation, pipeline progression, priority-account engagement, and ROI to guide investment. Partner with relevant teams to measure contributions to product adoption and customer advocacy, and use results to prioritise, scale, or change programs.</li> <li>Bring regional and global teams (including Demand Generation, Product Marketing, and Global Campaigns) together to deliver the plan, and adapt global strategy to local buyer expectations, regulation, and the competitive landscape.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Who you are</strong></h3> <p>You’re an experienced B2B marketing leader who has owned an integrated marketing strategy across a country, region, or comparably broad portfolio. You can set clear direction, make clear commercial trade-offs, and partner credibly with senior Sales and go-to-market (GTM) leaders—all while staying close enough to execution to turn strategy into measurable business results. </p> <p> </p> <p>We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements for the role. If you meet them, we encourage you to apply. Preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.</p> <h3><strong>Minimum requirements</strong></h3> <ul> <li>10+ years of B2B marketing experience, including ownership of integrated marketing strategy and budget for a region or broad portfolio in tech.</li> <li>GTM business partnering: Proven track record partnering with senior Sales and GTM leaders to turn commercial targets into marketing plans and investment decisions.</li> <li>Scaled and high-touch marketing: Experience running both scaled digital demand and high-touch account-based marketing for larger prospects.</li> <li>Commercial accountability: Success generating pipeline, accelerating deal velocity, and managing multi-program budgets tied to clear ROI.</li> <li>Cross-functional leadership: Demonstrated ability to align regional and global teams (Demand Generation, Product Marketing, and Communications) without direct authority.</li> <li>Strategy and hands-on delivery: Comfort moving between multi-quarter planning and delivering key initiatives yourself.</li> <li>Executive communication: Strong written and verbal skills, with the ability to explain technical products in business terms and present recommendations to leadership.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Preferred qualifications</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Domain knowledge: Experience in payments, fintech, embedded finance, ecommerce, or high-growth B2B SaaS.</li> <li>Ecosystem and platform GTM: Experience marketing to software platforms, SaaS businesses, marketplaces, or building joint co-marketing programs with technology and ecosystem partners.</li> <li>Positioning & localization: Proven ability to take category or business-model positioning and translate it into regional and local-market programs.</li> <li>Executive advocacy: A track record of building customer advocacy and influence strategies with senior commercial stakeholders (Founders, CEOs, and CFOs).</li> <li>Builder mindset: Comfort building marketing approaches where the playbook, tooling, or route to impact is still taking shape.</li> </ul> Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Stage Consultant Stratégie, Transformation & E-learning
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About WPP Media</strong></p> <p>WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. </p> <p>WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.</p> <p>For more information, visit <a href="wppmedia.com">wppmedia.com</a>.</p></div><p><em>Dans un souci de clarté et d’accessibilité, nous avons choisi de ne pas utiliser l’écriture inclusive dans nos communications. WPP Media est fermement engagé en faveur de la diversité : nous valorisons l'inclusion et l'égalité, en considérant tous les candidats sans distinction d'identité de genre, d'origine ethnique ou de religion. Tous nos postes sont également ouverts aux personnes en situation de handicap.</em></p> <p><em> </em></p> <p><strong>A propos de WPP Media :</strong></p> <p><strong><em>WPP est le partenaire de confiance des plus grandes marques mondiales pour assurer leur croissance. </em></strong>Nous réunissons une intelligence média de pointe, une créativité de classe mondiale, une production de nouvelle génération, des solutions pour transformer le marketing à l’ère de l’IA et un conseil stratégique d’expert au sein d’une seule compagnie. <br>Propulsés par des talents exceptionnels et WPP Open, notre plateforme de marketing agentique, nous déployons l’IA à grande échelle pour aider nos clients à naviguer dans un monde en pleines mutations et à optimiser leurs investissements marketing. <br>Pour plus d’informations, visitez <a href="http://www.wpp.com/">www.wpp.com</a>.</p> <p>WPP Media est le collectif média global de WPP. Dans un monde où les médias sont omniprésents nous regroupons la meilleure plateforme, les meilleurs talents et les meilleurs partenaires pour développer les solutions les plus innovantes, offrant une croissance inégalée à nos clients. Pour plus d'informations, visitez <a href="https://www.wppmedia.com/">wppmedia.com</a>.</p> <p>Chez WPP Media, nous croyons en la puissance de notre culture et de nos collaborateurs. C'est grâce à cette synergie que nous parvenons à créer des expériences véritablement exceptionnelles, tant pour nos clients que pour nos équipes internes. Pour réussir dans ce poste, il est fondamental d'incarner les valeurs essentielles qui unissent WPP et WPP Media :</p> <ul> <li>Être <strong>Extraordinaire</strong> en favorisant un leadership collectif qui inspire une créativité véritablement transformationnelle.</li> <li>Créer un environnement <strong>Ouvert</strong> en trouvant l'équilibre parfait entre l'épanouissement de nos collaborateurs et la satisfaction de nos clients, le tout fondé sur une confiance mutuelle.</li> <li>Diriger avec <strong>Optimisme</strong> en stimulant activement la croissance et le développement pour mobiliser l'ensemble de notre organisation.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Le contexte</strong> :</p> <p>Rejoignez WPP Consulting, une équipe à taille humaine dédiée au conseil stratégique, à la transformation des organisations et au développement de dispositifs de formation innovants.</p> <p>Vous interviendrez sur des problématiques business variés auprès de clients leaders dans les secteurs des médias, du divertissement et de la communication.</p> <p>Pleinement intégré à l'équipe, vous participerez aux différentes étapes des missions de conseil, du cadrage stratégique à la mise en œuvre opérationnelle, avec une autonomie et des responsabilités progressives.</p> <p><strong><br>Vos missions :</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Conseil, recherche & analyse :</strong> analyser des problématiques business, réaliser des benchmarks, des études de marché et des analyses afin d’identifier les principaux enseignements et contribuer à formuler des recommandations.<br><br></li> <li><strong>Entretiens & ateliers :</strong> préparer et participer aux échanges avec les clients et experts métiers, puis structurer et synthétiser les enseignements.<br><br></li> <li><strong>Production de livrables :</strong> concevoir des présentations de conseil claires et impactantes, en travaillant la structuration, le storytelling et la visualisation des données.<br><br></li> <li><strong>Transformation & accompagnement client :</strong> contribuer à la conception et au déploiement de projets de transformation et de formation, en lien avec les différentes parties prenantes. <br><br></li> </ul> <p><strong>Compétences requises :</strong></p> <p>Votre Expérience :</p> <ul> <li><strong>Formation :</strong> Etudiant en Master 1 ou Master 2 (Bac+4/5) en école de commerce, école d'ingénieurs, IEP ou université, avec une spécialisation en stratégie, management, économie ou marketing.</li> <li><strong>Expérience précédente :</strong> Une première expérience en conseil, stratégie, analyse business ou gestion de projet est appréciée.</li> <li><strong>Secteur :</strong> Intérêt marqué pour les problématiques de transformation, les enjeux business et les secteurs des médias, du divertissement et de la communication.</li> </ul> <p>Vos Compétences Techniques :</p> <ul> <li><strong>Langues :</strong> Bon niveau d'anglais B2/C1 (lecture de documentation et production de livrables destinés à des interlocuteurs internationaux).</li> <li><strong>Bureautique/Outils :</strong> Excellente maîtrise de PowerPoint (structuration d'idées, storytelling, réalisation de slides de conseil) et bonne aisance sur Excel (sensibilité aux chiffres, analyse de données).</li> <li><strong>Recherche & Analyse & IA :</strong> capacité à rechercher, croiser et synthétiser l’information, avec une appétence pour les outils d’IA et un regard critique.</li> </ul> <p>Vos Qualités Humaines :</p> <ul> <li><strong>Esprit analytique & curiosité :</strong> capacité à comprendre rapidement des problématiques complexes, questionner l’information et en dégager les enjeux clés.</li> <li><strong>Autonomie & proactivité :</strong> capacité à avancer de manière autonome, anticiper les prochaines étapes et être force de proposition.</li> <li><strong>Rigueur & organisation :</strong> capacité à gérer plusieurs sujets en parallèle et à produire des livrables de qualité.</li> <li><strong>Posture conseil & relationnel :</strong> aisance à l’oral comme à l’écrit et capacité à interagir avec des interlocuteurs variés et exigeants.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>La vie chez WPP Media et ses avantages</strong></p> <p>Notre engagement à façonner l'avenir des médias se manifeste par un soutien actif au développement professionnel de nos talents, les aidant à atteindre leur plein potentiel. Cette démarche s'accompagne d'une vision responsable dans nos stratégies d'investissement médiatique, reflétant ainsi notre double priorité : valoriser nos collaborateurs tout en adoptant des pratiques durables dans notre secteur. Les collaborateurs de WPP Media ont un accès privilégié aux réseaux internationaux de WPP Media et WPP, leur permettant de développer leurs passions, d'étendre leur réseau professionnel et de rester à la pointe des innovations en marketing et publicité.</p> <p>Nous disposons de ressources vastes et variées au service de nos collaborateurs, notre entreprise cultive activement l'inclusion des talents de tous horizons. Les réussites et expertises des équipes sont régulièrement mises en lumière lors d'événements fédérateurs qui ponctuent également les moments clés de l'année, renforçant ainsi notre culture d'entreprise collaborative et diversifiée.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Ce que nous offrons :</strong></p> <ul> <li>Une <strong>expérience professionnelle unique</strong> au sein d'une compagnie média renommée, où vous pourrez acquérir des compétences précieuses et développer votre réseau professionnel.</li> <li>L'opportunité de travailler avec des <strong>clients de premier plan</strong> et de contribuer à la création de campagnes publicitaires de grande envergure.</li> <li>Un <strong>accompagnement personnalisé</strong> pour tous les Padawans (stagiaires/alternants chez WPP Media) de votre intégration à votre départ … ou pas !</li> <li><strong>Des déjeuners, cafés, afterworks</strong> ainsi que différents évènements qui rythmeront votre année chez nous.</li> <li>Un <strong>campus</strong> à Levallois-Perret qui rassemble toutes les agences WPP (WPP Media et ses sœurs) au terminus de la ligne 3 !</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Process de recrutement</strong></p> <ul> <li>Entretien avec l’équipe recrutement : Un premier pré-entretien téléphonique de 5mn, puis un entretien de 30mn en visio-conférence par un membre de notre équipe recrutement. Cela nous permettra de mieux connaître vos compétences et votre expérience, et vous donnera l'occasion de poser des questions sur le poste et l'entreprise.</li> <li>Entretien opérationnel : Pour évaluer l'adéquation de vos compétences et de votre profil par rapport aux exigences du poste.</li> <li>Étude de cas : Une étude de cas vous sera proposée afin d’évaluer vos compétences techniques liées au poste. Une restitution vous sera proposée.</li> </ul> <p>Nous nous engageons à rendre ce process aussi rapide et efficace que possible, et à maintenir une communication ouverte et transparente tout au long du process.</p> <p> </p> <p>WPP Media garantit l'égalité des chances et considère tous les candidats sans discrimination ni considération de caractéristiques particulières. Nous nous engageons à cultiver un environnement de respect où chacun se sent à sa place et bénéficie des mêmes opportunités d'évolution professionnelle.</p> <p>Consultez notre politique de confidentialité pour tout savoir sur la protection de vos données <a href="https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy">politique de confidentialité</a>.</p> <p>Bien que nous étudiions toutes les candidatures reçues, nous ne contactons que les personnes sélectionnées pour un entretien.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p></p> <p><span class="TextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8" lang="EN-CA" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8">Please read our <a href="https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy#:~:text=WPP%20Media%20Privacy%20Notice%20for%20Recruitment">Privacy Notice</a></span></span

title: Forward Deployed Researcher (Robot Learning)
description: Accelerating embodied AGI. The next ten years of AI will not be won in software. They will be won in the physical world: in factories, hospitals, kitchens, fields, and homes. The companies that own that data will own the century. microagi is building it. We are a data research and deployment lab. Atlas captures the manual work inside Europe’s industrial champions, trains foundation models on it, and deploys the right robot onto the floor, with no teleoperation and no interruption to the line. Shift records how physical work actually happens and turns it into training-ready data. We were founded by former Formula 1 engineers from Red Bull Racing and Mercedes, together with a researcher from the Alan Turing Institute. Our $55M seed round, the largest in German history, was led by Hummingbird with Northzone, LocalGlobe, Village Global, and redalpine. We are based in Munich, with our research centre in Zürich and teams in London, New York, and Istanbul. We are now building the engineering and research teams that will take Atlas into new industries. You will train and deploy modern neural robotic policies for real customer tasks. This is an early-career role for someone whose strongest experience may come from a university laboratory, thesis, internship, or recent research position. We care about the depth of your work and your ability to learn quickly, not the number of years on your CV. What You Will Do Train neural policies for manipulation and other embodied tasks using real and simulated data. Build data, training, evaluation, and deployment pipelines for robotic policies. Run experiments in simulation and transfer successful policies onto real robots. Collect demonstrations and deployment data, diagnose failure modes, and improve policies iteratively. Evaluate models for robustness, generalisation, latency, and real-world task success. Work alongside deployment engineers at customer sites to adapt policies to new environments and workflows. Turn research ideas into systems that operate reliably outside the lab. Requirements Experience training modern neural-network-based robotic policies through a thesis, university laboratory, internship, research project, or early professional role. Familiarity with imitation learning, reinforcement learning, vision-language-action models, or related robot-learning methods. Strong Python and hands-on experience with PyTorch, JAX, or an equivalent framework. Experience running experiments on real robots or in a robotics simulator. Good understanding of machine learning fundamentals and experimental design. Evidence of strong technical work, such as a thesis, paper, research project, open-source contribution, or working robotic system. Comfortable moving between research code and physical hardware. Willingness to travel to deployment sites. Nice to Have Experience with manipulation, dexterous control, teleoperation, or whole-body policies. Familiarity with Isaac Sim, MuJoCo, ManiSkill, or similar environments. Experience with diffusion policies, transformers, multimodal models, or vision-language-action systems. Publications or workshop papers in robotics, computer vision, or machine learning. Experience collecting or curating robot-training data. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: </strong>Austin,TX; San Francisco, CA; New York City; Washington, D.C.</p> <p><strong>About the Department</strong></p> <p>Security at Cloudflare is a diverse, focused team committed to helping secure both Cloudflare and our customers. <p><strong>Equity</strong></p> <p>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.</p> <p><strong>Benefits</strong></p> <p>Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and title: Senior Power Originator Germany
description: DORTMUND | HYBRID Help us accelerate the energy transition The energy transition is transforming the German electricity market at unprecedented speed. As more wind and solar enter the system, large-scale battery storage is becoming essential to keeping electricity available when it is needed and the grid in balance. At GIGA Storage, we develop, invest in and operate large-scale Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) across Germany, the Netherlands and Belgium, with Germany playing an increasingly important role in our growth. By 2030, we aim to manage 1.5 to 2 GW of operational BESS assets, enough capacity to provide electricity to millions of households when it is needed most. But building the assets is only part of the challenge. We also need to make sure their flexibility is used in the right markets, at the right time and through the right commercial structures. That is where you come in. What will you do? As Senior Power Originator Germany, you will play a key commercial role in bringing our growing battery portfolio to the German power market. Your focus is on identifying commercial opportunities and turning them into executable deals, from shorter-term route-to-market agreements to more complex, long-term structures. You are our eyes and ears in the German energy market. You understand what is changing, where new opportunities are emerging and how developments in power, flexibility and energy trading can be translated into commercial value for our assets. This means building relationships with utilities, energy traders, industrial clients, aggregators and other market participants, while continuously exploring both existing and new markets. A large part of your role is about turning commercial opportunities into signed deals. You take ownership of the origination process, from identifying opportunities and structuring transactions to negotiating terms and closing contracts that balance risk and return. This includes route-to-market processes, partner selection, RFPs and contract negotiations. GIGA Storage does not operate its own trading desk. Instead, we work with external trading and route-to-market partners who trade our assets. You play an important role in selecting, negotiating with and managing the commercial relationships with these partners. Sometimes an opportunity fits an existing structure. At other times, you will need to think creatively and develop a new type of transaction or commercial product. You will be part of GIGA Storage’s Commercial Energy Desk, joining a growing team at the heart of our commercial activities. You will work closely with our BE/NL Originator(s), Portfolio Management and Contract & Implementation Managers, as well as Legal and other internal and external stakeholders, to assess opportunities and bring the strongest propositions forward. As our portfolio grows, the emphasis will increasingly shift towards larger and longer-term transactions. Your home base is our office in Dortmund, where we are building a local team of approximately 3 to 5 colleagues. You will work hybrid and collaborate closely with colleagues across GIGA Storage, including travel to our Amsterdam office. What do you bring? We are looking for an experienced commercial energy professional who knows the German power market and enjoys turning market opportunities into deals. You combine strong commercial judgement with creativity and are comfortable operating in an organisation that is growing quickly and where not everything has already been defined. Approximately 7 to 12 years of relevant experience in the German energy market, with a strong background in power origination, route-to-market, structured energy products or comparable commercial activities. Experience in day-ahead and intraday power markets is particularly relevant as an additional background, but is not a standalone requirement. A strong understanding of the German power market, commercial energy structures and the relevant market participants. Experience in the German market is a must. A proven track record in structuring, negotiating and closing energy contracts and the confidence to lead commercial discussions with external counterparties. Experience gained within a utility, energy trader, renewable energy developer, aggregator or another asset-backed energy business. BESS or flexibility-market experience is preferred, but not required. A strong sense of ownership and a self-driven approach, with the ability to operate independently, take initiative and create momentum in the market as GIGA Storage continues to grow its presence in Germany. Native-level German and strong professional English. Just as important is how you work. You are commercially driven, curious and creative. You like to take ownership, build relationships and move opportunities forward rather than wait for a predefined playbook. The impact you can make Commercialise a growing BESS portfolio. Help determine how 2 GW of battery flexibility can be brought to market and turned into sustainable revenue streams. Get the freedom to make deals. GIGA Storage invests equity in its own assets, giving us greater commercial flexibility around when and how we enter into transactions. Help shape our approach in a changing market. The German flexibility and BESS market is developing rapidly. Rather than stepping into a fully established structure, you can help shape how we operate commercially as the market evolves. Make a direct impact in a small team. Work in a lean, entrepreneurial environment with short lines to decision-makers, while helping build our growing German organisation. What do we offer? At GIGA Storage, you join an ambitious international company where you can combine the scale of major energy infrastructure with the pace and ownership of a growing organisation. Our Dortmund team is still taking shape, while being fully connected to colleagues in Germany, Belgium and the Netherlands. You will also be part of GIGA-wide meetings and company activities throughout the year. An attractive salary. A performance-based bonus of up to 20%. A fixed year-end bonus of 7% to 9%. 28 days of annual leave. An annual personal development budget of €750,-. A pension arrangement combining the German statutory pension scheme with an employer contribution to an individual pension plan. A company laptop and a net monthly phone allowance of €25,- Interested? description: Who we are Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. About the role Samsara is building its Core Enterprise business in France, and we are hiring a Regional Sales Director to lead it. This is a build role: you will create the market and the pipeline machine behind it, rather than inherit an established playbook. You will lead a team of six Enterprise Account Executives. The team sells deals of €100K–€300K AOV over four to six month cycles, so the role calls for pace and velocity paired with value-based selling rigour. In this role, you will Own the performance, development and day-to-day leadership of a team of six Enterprise Account Executives Build a pipeline machine and a market: define the target accounts, segments and motions that generate repeatable new business across France Create and embed a team playbook covering prospecting, qualification, deal progression and handover, so the team sells consistently and new hires ramp quickly Coach the team through each deal cycle, driving execution and velocity and embedding MEDDIC and Command of the Message Pressure-test deal qualification, challenge assumptions, and help your team navigate the complexity of selling into large French enterprises. This isn't a role where you sit above the deals Build the commercial muscles (cross-sell, multi-product attach, stakeholder mapping) that will drive durable growth as we expand our footprint across France's largest accounts Run a structured operating rhythm of pipeline reviews, deal inspection and forecasting Coordinate ADRs, Marketing, Solutions Engineering and partners around your team's ability to coordinate supporting functions to drive pipeline and close business Fluent French and access to our Paris office An ideal candidate also has Experience at a high-growth technology company, Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. About the role Samsara is building its Core Enterprise business in France, and we are hiring a Regional Sales Director to lead it. This is a build role: you will create the market and the pipeline machine behind it, rather than inherit an established playbook. You will lead a team of six Enterprise Account Executives. The team sells deals of €100K–€300K AOV over four to six month cycles, so the role calls for pace and velocity paired with value-based selling rigour. In this role, you will Own the performance, development and day-to-day leadership of a team of six Enterprise Account Executives Build a pipeline machine and a market: define the target accounts, segments and motions that generate repeatable new business across France Create and embed a team playbook covering prospecting, qualification, deal progression and handover, so the team sells consistently and new hires ramp quickly Coach the team through each deal cycle, driving execution and velocity and embedding MEDDIC and Command of the Message Pressure-test deal qualification, challenge assumptions, and help your team navigate the complexity of selling into large French enterprises. This isn't a role where you sit above the deals Build the commercial muscles (cross-sell, multi-product attach, stakeholder mapping) that will drive durable growth as we expand our footprint across France's largest accounts Run a structured operating rhythm of pipeline reviews, deal inspection and forecasting Coordinate ADRs, Marketing, Solutions Engineering and partners around your team's priorities, influencing functions you do not directly own Hire, develop and lead an inclusive, engaged and high-performing team, developing AEs into strong Core Enterprise sellers Partner closely with your peer Regional Sales Directors, Samsara's wider leadership and Customer Success to ensure your team has the support it needs to win Champion, role model and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and into new markets Minimum requirements for the role Three or more years of proven success leading new business sales at enterprise level, with a track record of revenue delivery and overachievement against target Has built something rather than inherited it, with experience building a market or a new sales function from scratch Full team lifecycle experience: has recruited, ramped and retained a team, and can show where each happened Direct experience selling into enterprise companies at comparable deal sizes and cycle lengths Experience establishing rigour in value-based selling, using methodologies such as MEDDIC or Command of the Message Demonstrated ability to coordinate supporting functions to drive pipeline and close business Fluent French and access to our Paris office An ideal candidate also has Experience at a high-growth technology company, helping to build or refine the enterprise go-to-market playbook rather than inheriting an established one A coaching-first leadership style, with a record of developing AEs from good to exceptional Intelligence and genuine coachability: you learn fast, welcome feedback and apply it A competitive, entrepreneurial streak: you create momentum without needing to own every function involved Comfort operating in a fast-moving, scaling organisation where not everything is perfectly defined yet, and where you are expected to build process while delivering results A blend of strategic thinking and tactical intensity: you can set the market strategy and also step into a deal review to show a rep where their qualification is weak Total Rewards At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time. Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here. Flexible Working At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. title: Senior Territory Account Executive-Detroit OR Grand Rapids, MI
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: Grand Rapids, MI (Detroit could work for the right candidate)</strong></p> <p><strong>About the Department</strong></p> <p>Account Executives, Channel Account Managers, Business Development Representatives, Solution Engineers, Customer Success, and Sales Operations - all working together help our customers adopt Cloudflare and create great Internet-enabled experiences. The sales team at Cloudflare helps customers solve real, technical problems while creating the revenue streams that help the company provide free service to millions in our community.</p> <p><strong>About this Role</strong></p> <p>This role within the mid-market segment focuses on both the acquisition of new Territory accounts, as well as the expansion of existing customer accounts.  Within the mid-market segment, you will work a set of accounts in the territory sub-segments. The ideal candidate will have both a sales and technical background that enables them to drive customer engagement from technical professionals through to senior executive levels, and across Security, Network, Development and Infrastructure teams.  </p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Develop and execute a comprehensive account/territory plan to achieve quarterly sales and annual revenue targets in a defined territory and/or account list.</li> <li>Drive new business acquisition (new customer logos), customer expansion (upsell and cross sell Cloudflare solutions), and renewal within your territory.</li> <li>Engage in account mapping sessions with partners, including training new partners on our technology and GTM strategies.</li> <li>Developing scalable relationships with target partners, to expand partner ecosystem in a specific region.</li> <li>Build a robust sales pipeline through continual engagement and nurturing of key prospect accounts.</li> <li>Understand customer use-cases and how they pair with Cloudflare’s portfolio solutions in order to identify new sales opportunities.</li> <li>Craft and communicate compelling value propositions for Cloudflare services. Drive awareness through regular outbound campaigns on product and feature roadmap updates. </li> <li>Accurately forecast commercial outcomes by running a consistent sales process, including driving next step expectations and contract negotiations.</li> <li>As a trusted advisor, build long-term strategic relationships with key accounts, to ensure customer adoption, retention and expansion. Regularly evaluate usage trends and articulate value to show Cloudflare impact and provide strategic recommendations during business reviews. </li> <li>Network across different business units with each of your accounts, and multi-thread to identify and engage new divisional buyers.</li> <li>Position Cloudflare's platform in each of your target customers, including Cloudflare One and the Connectivity Cloud to realize our full potential in every customer.</li> <li>Operate internally as a liaison with cross-functional teams to share key customer feedback and insights to improve customer experience and further investments with Cloudflare.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Requirements:</strong></p> <ul> <li>3+ years of direct B2B selling experience</li> <li>Strong interpersonal communication (verbal and written) and organizational skills</li> <li>Self-motivated; entrepreneurial spirit</li> <li>Comfortable working in a fast paced dynamic environment</li> <li>Bachelor's degree required</li> <li>Demonstrated analytical and quantitative abilities</li> <li>Software and system skills are a must (SFDC, Tableau, G-suite, MSFT suite)</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Examples of desirable skills, knowledge and experience:</strong></h3> <ul> <li>5+ years in Software/SaaS/Security Sales & Channel management.</li> <li>Existing relationships and/or strong familiarity of the partner ecosystem in the region that they cover.</li> <li>Understanding of cloud infrastructure ecosystem and cloud security is highly preferred.</li> <li>Experience working in a start-up environment.</li> <li>Ability to travel up to 25% of the time.</li> <li>Technical competence strongly preferred.</li> </ul> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>
