We come from more than 50 different countries and cultures and together we are creating the future of insurance.</span></p> <p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;">Learn more at <a href="http://www.shift-technology.com" target="_blank">www.shift-technology.com</a></span></p> <p> </p></div><h4><strong>ABOUT THE ROLE</strong></h4> <p>At Shift, we are building the next generation of AI-driven platform capabilities. We are looking for an experienced, hands-on <strong>Staff AI Engineer</strong> to serve as the technical anchor for our AI capabilities; someone who is deeply passionate about building, prototyping, and scaling modern AI/LLM systems, while helping shape our broader AI engineering strategy.</p> <p>This is a high-impact, high-visibility role for a senior builder who excels at the intersection of <strong>cutting-edge AI technologies</strong> (Agentic frameworks, LLM orchestration, MCP, GenAI) and <strong>production-grade software engineering</strong>. You will work directly with data scientists, software engineers, and product leaders to design, prototype, and ship state-of-the-art AI systems into production.</p> <p>If you are a senior AI engineer looking for the next step in your career -where you can drive architectural strategy and mentor others <strong>without giving up hands-on coding and building</strong>- this role is for you.<br><br></p> <h4><strong>WHAT YOU'LL DO</strong></h4> <ul> <li><strong>Build & Architect Agentic Systems (Hands-On):</strong> Lead by doing. Design, prototype, and build production-ready agentic workflows, custom orchestration layers, and tool-calling integrations using modern frameworks.</li> <li><strong>Bridge AI & Production Engineering:</strong> Move AI prototypes into robust, production-grade microservices on Azure. Ensure AI components are scalable, low-latency, and well-integrated into the broader tech stack.</li> <li><strong>Implement Next-Gen AI Standards:</strong> Experiment with and integrate emerging paradigms into our production stack, including Model Context Protocol (MCP), advanced RAG patterns, vector pipelines, and structured LLM outputs.</li> <li><strong>Drive AI Quality & LLMOps:</strong> Establish and implement operational frameworks for experiment tracking, evaluations, prompt engineering, latency optimization, token budget governance, and model observability.</li> <li><strong>Influence & Upskill:</strong> Act as a technical mentor for agent-focused engineering squads. Lead technical design reviews, set coding standards, and help elevate the team's AI engineering capabilities.</li> <li><strong>Stay at the Cutting Edge:</strong> Continuously benchmark new models, AI tools, and architectures, translating relevant breakthroughs into practical, value-driving implementations at Shift.</li> </ul> <h4><strong><br>WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR</strong></h4> <p>We are seeking a seasoned AI engineer who combines deep, practical expertise in modern GenAI/LLM ecosystems with strong backend software engineering skills.</p> <h4><strong>Deep AI & Agentic Expertise:</strong></h4> <ul> <li><strong>Hands-On Agentic Frameworks:</strong> Proven experience building with frameworks like Microsoft Agent Framework, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, OpenAI Agents SDK, or custom orchestration frameworks.</li> <li><strong>LLM Patterns & Tooling:</strong> Practical experience with Model Context Protocol (MCP), tool/function calling, structured LLM outputs, and complex RAG pipelines (vector retrieval, hybrid search, embeddings).</li> <li><strong>LLMOps & Observability:</strong> Experience with evaluation frameworks, prompt engineering, tracing, context window optimization, and compute/token governance in production.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Production Engineering & Stack:</strong></h4> <ul> <li><strong>Programming:</strong> High proficiency in <strong>Python</strong> (required for AI ecosystem work) paired with strong experience in <strong>OOP</strong>.</li> <li><strong>Cloud & APIs:</strong> Experience building and scaling backend microservices and REST/OpenAPI endpoints in enterprise cloud environments (specifically <strong>Azure</strong>).</li> <li><strong>Data & Events:</strong> Familiarity with vector databases, relational databases, and event-driven patterns (e.g., Azure Service Bus, Kafka).</li> <li><strong>Engineering Rigor:</strong> Comfortable with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), CI/CD, testing methodologies, and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform or Bicep).</li> </ul> <h4><strong>HOW YOU WORK</strong></h4> <ul> <li><strong>Jump in and get things done:</strong> You are a proactive builder who loves turning ambitious ideas into working code. You don't wait for permission to solve hard problems.</li> <li><strong>Make things simpler:</strong> You can break down complex AI concepts and architectures into clear, executable steps for engineers, data scientists, and non-technical partners alike.</li> <li><strong>Test & learn new things:</strong> You are genuinely obsessed with the fast-moving AI landscape. You constantly experiment with new models, libraries, and papers, and know how to extract real product value from the hype.</li> <li><strong>Communicate with impact & help others grow:</strong> You lead by example and collaboration, upskilling team members through pair programming, code reviews, and pragmatic design discussions.<br><br><span style="font-size: 8pt; color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">#LI-RH1 #LI-REMOTE</span></li> </ul> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><span style="color: #000000;"><strong><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;">To support our permanent, full time employees at every stage of their careers and lives, we provide a competitive total rewards and benefits package. title: Senior Solutions Engineer | Germany | Remote
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at <u><span><a href="http://grafana.com" target="_blank">grafana.com</a></span></u> and follow us on <u><span><a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/grafana-labs/" target="_blank">LinkedIn</a></span></u> and <u><span><a href="https://twitter.com/grafana" target="_blank">X</a></span></u><u>.</u></p> <p>We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.</p> <p>You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.</p></div><h4><strong>The Opportunity </strong></h4> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">The Solutions Engineering team are the customer facing product experts. The team enables Grafana Labs worldwide growth by educating potential and existing customers to ensure that they are happy and successful. We share our technical and product expertise with customers through demos, hands on enablement, presentations, technical evaluations and ongoing interaction. We partner closely with our Sales team to help qualify and close opportunities. The Solutions Engineering team is one of the primary routes of communication from our customers to the Product Management and Engineering teams.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">A Solutions Engineer is able to really listen to a prospect or customer, understand their requirements, ask the right questions to extract as much information as required and translate all that into a solution with Grafana Labs technology. They are the bridge between the highly technical engineering folks here at Grafana Labs, our customers and our Sales team.</span></p> <p><strong>What You'll Be Doing</strong></p> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Partnering with our Sales team to articulate the overall Grafana value proposition, vision and strategy to customers</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Owning the technical engagement with customers and help close complex opportunities through advanced competitive knowledge, technical skill and credibility</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Delivering product and technical presentations to potential and existing customers</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Effectively communicate with customers and internal teams to provide feedback on our products and the competitive landscape</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Driving product conversations based on need and problems with customers</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Working with the team to enhance documentation, write blog posts, record videos, contribute knowledge base articles and create other public or private enablement material</span></li> </ul> <p><strong>What Makes you a Great Fit:</strong></p> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">5+ years of technical pre-sales experience</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Be open to various and complex assignments, this will require strong judgment, collaboration, and leadership</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">You will need first class written and oral communication skills to collaborate with our remote-first internal teams and with our worldwide customers. You will need to be able to skillfully articulate our value proposition and the technical advantages of our products</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">You love solving technical challenges and thrive on bringing creative solutions to our customers</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">You should have a technical mindset and a desire to grow technically. </span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Must be located in Germany  </span></li> </ul> <p><strong>Bonus Points For:</strong></p> <ul> <li><span style="font-weight: 400;">Experience with Open Source technologies, or in the Metrics/Monitoring space is an advantage </span></li> <li>Experience with sales methodologies like MEDD(P)ICC is a plus</li> </ul> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;"><strong>Compensation & Rewards </strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">In Germany, the OTE (On-Target Earnings) compensation range for this role is EUR 140,000 - EUR 168,500. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.</span></p><div class="content-conclusion"><div> <p><em data-stringify-type="italic">*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.</em></p> <p><strong>Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong data-stringify-type="bold">100% Remote, Global Culture - </strong>As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.</li> <li><strong>Scaling Organization</strong> – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.</li> <li><strong>Transparent Communication</strong> – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.</li> <li><strong>Innovation-Driven</strong> – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.</li> <li><strong>Open Source Roots</strong> – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.</li> <li><strong>Empowered Teams</strong> – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.</li> <li><strong>Career Growth Pathways</strong> – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.</li> <li><strong>Approachable Leadership</strong> – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.</li> <li><strong>Passionate People</strong> – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.</li> <li><strong>In-Person onboarding </strong>- We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it. </li> <li><strong>Balance is Key</strong> - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. <em>*We will comply with local legislation where applicable.</em></li> </ul> <p><strong>Equal Opportunity Employer:</strong> <em>Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow.</em></p> <p><em data-stringify-type="italic">Grafana Labs may utilize AI tools in its recruitment process to assist in matching information provided in CVs to job postings. The recruitment team will continue to review inbound CVs manually to identify alignment with current openings.</em></p> <p>#LI-Remote</p> </div> <div><em>For information about how your personal data is used once you’ve applied to a job, check out our <a href="https://grafana.com/legal/applicant-and-candidate-privacy-policy/" target="_blank">privacy policy</a>. </em></div> <div> </div></div> Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Customer Success Manager (m/f/d)
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>We’re Appinio - the real-time market research partner that supports global (and local) brands to make better consumer-facing decisions. Driven by our mission to deliver rigorous, rapid research in a refreshingly human way, we give businesses real answers from real people in minutes, not weeks.</p></div><div class="role"> <div class="job-ad-editable job-ad-editable job-ad-editor" data-content="6454830"> <p><strong><em>Your mission as a Senior Customer Success Manager</em></strong></p> <p>As Appinio continues to revolutionise and conquer the market research industry, we are dedicated to continuously delivering exceptional experiences to our clients. Our Customer Success Team plays a fundamental role in this mission and drives the strategic client relationships. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.</p></div><p><strong>The Team:</strong></p> <p>We build the engineering foundations that enable AI agents to work with enterprise tools and workflows.</p> <p>Our work focuses on the <strong>Agent Platform</strong>, which coordinates agent execution and provides controlled access to tools and execution environments. Our platform directly powers the Celonis Context Model, meaning we work as a product team in close collaboration with product managers and other roles rather than an infrastructure team. Expect to work close to the end-user experience, shipping tangible product improvements in rapid iteration loops.</p> <p><strong>The Role:</strong></p> <p>As a Senior Software Engineer, you will design, build, and operate backend services that serve the platform with the AI capabilities they need to perform useful work.</p> <p>You will own complex features from understanding the problem and defining the technical approach through implementation, deployment, and ongoing improvement. decisions, balance delivery with maintainability, and turn evolving requirements into dependable software.</p> <p><strong>The work you'll do:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Build agent execution execution:</strong> Handle concurrency, cancellation, retries, partial failures, and recovery so that long-running operations behave predictably.</li> <li><strong>Protect customer data and automated tests and evaluations, investigate failures, and improve latency, resource usage, and operational visibility.</li> <li><strong>Strengthen the engineering foundation:</strong> Refactor complex code where needed, improve development and deployment tooling, and contribute reusable APIs and libraries.</li> <li><strong>Help the team succeed:</strong> Review code, share knowledge, support less experienced engineers, and work with product and engineering partners to define success.</li> </ul> <p><strong>The qualifications you'll need:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Substantial professional experience building and operating backend software with Python, typically 5+ years, with demonstrated ownership of complex features or services.</li> <li>Proven track record in technical architecture, high-level software design, and scalable system patterns.</li> <li>Practical experience deploying agentic frameworks, machine learning models, or supporting backend ML infrastructure.</li> <li>Experience developing production APIs using FastAPI or a comparable framework.</li> <li>Experience deploying and troubleshooting services in a cloud environment, using containers, CI/CD, logs, metrics, and tracing.</li> <li>Ability to work through ambiguous requirements, explain technical tradeoffs, and balance customer needs with long-term system health.</li> <li>Clear communication in English and a collaborative approach to working with technical and non-technical colleagues (German is a plus).</li> <li>Interest in building dependable AI applications and the ability to learn new tools and concepts as the field evolves.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Experience That Would Be a Plus:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Building applications with LLMs, tool calling, agent orchestration, or the Model Context Protocol (MCP).</li> <li>Evaluating agent behavior using representative datasets and regression checks.</li> <li>Working on multi-tenant SaaS systems, authorization title: Director, Value Engineering (DACH) - CPG/Retail
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.</p></div><h2><strong>About Celonis</strong></h2> <p>Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes.</p> <p>The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and operational intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand—turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. By providing the essential business context that AI agents and tools need to act effectively, Celonis makes AI truly enterprise-ready.</p> <p>Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global partner ecosystem to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together to achieve transformational outcomes. Headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, Celonis operates globally with over 20 offices worldwide.</p> <h2><strong>About the Role</strong></h2> <p>Based at our global headquarters in <strong>Munich</strong>, as a <strong>Value Engineering Manager / Director</strong> for <strong>CPG & Retail</strong>, you will hold full operational and leadership responsibility specifically for the <strong>CPG & Retail segment across the DACH region</strong>. In this role, you will lead a dedicated, high-performing team of 6–7 Value Engineers operating at the intersection of process transformation, executive consulting, and AI-driven product execution, driving the end-to-end customer value journey and accelerating enterprise AI adoption across major retail and consumer goods brands.</p> <p>In this role, you will serve as a player-coach, actively guiding, coaching, and developing a talented, high-potential team with diverse backgrounds spanning supply chain, procurement, management consulting, and retail operations. This role offers tremendous growth potential as you both develop and learn alongside top-tier talent, while serving as a trusted advisor to C-level executives at major enterprise accounts.</p> <p><strong>Native-level German proficiency is required for this role. Candidates must be able to lead customer workshops, conduct executive presentations, and manage stakeholder interactions in German.</strong></p> <p><strong>The role is based in Munich.</strong></p> <h2><strong>What Sets Our Patch Apart</strong></h2> <p>The DACH CPG & Retail patch represents some of the world's most recognizable consumer brands, retail giants, and mobility innovators. </p> <p>As our DACH CPG & Retail customers navigate complex global supply chains, omnichannel fulfillment challenges, and the rapid rise of Process Intelligence and Agentic AI, you will engage directly—in both German and English—with vocal customer champions, C-level decision-makers, and pioneering thought leaders shaping the future of retail and consumer goods innovation.</p> <h2><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Drive Business Outcomes & Account Growth:</strong> Take full ownership of ARR targets, renewal forecasts, and net retention across the DACH CPG & Retail sector. Ensure high forecasting accuracy and steer accounts toward tangible, realized value.</li> <li><strong>People Leadership & Coaching:</strong> Recruit, onboard, lead, and mentor a team of 6–7 Munich-based Value Engineers. Maintain high standards through proactive coaching, performance management, and career progression planning.</li> <li><strong>Executive Advisory & Player-Coach:</strong> Serve as a Celonis Executive Sponsor on critical DACH deals. Join your team in the field to lead high-impact executive meetings, dry runs, value sprints, and strategic transformation workshops.</li> <li><strong>Enterprise AI Champion:</strong> Partner with customer executives to position Celonis as the foundation for modern process intelligence, digital operational excellence, and next-generation Agentic AI adoption using our Context Model and Digital Twin capabilities.</li> <li><strong>Ecosystem & Partner Strategy:</strong> Cultivate executive-level relationships across regional partner networks, services teams, and account executives to align CPG and retail customer strategies with Celonis AI solutions.</li> <li><strong>Thought Leadership:</strong> Standardize and scale best practices, reusable solution blueprints, and CPG/Retail industry-specific frameworks internally and across external customer communities.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Leadership Behaviors We Value</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Deliver Business Outcomes:</strong> Focus on top- and bottom-line impact, maintaining green customer health and expanding retention across new logos and key enterprise accounts.</li> <li><strong>Motivate, Develop & Nurture Talent:</strong> Build an inclusive, high-trust environment that attracts top-tier external talent, retains top performers, accelerates individual growth, and addresses underperformance early.</li> <li><strong>Lead by Example:</strong> Embody the "player/coach" mentality, maintaining an active on-site presence with priority accounts and upholding strict quality standards across all engagements.</li> <li><strong>Think BIG, Be BOLD:</strong> Champion an entrepreneurial growth mindset by expanding your internal/external network, spearheading new go-to-market motions, and positioning Celonis as an essential innovation driver in retail and consumer goods.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Qualifications & Scope</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Language Skills:</strong> Native or business-fluent <strong>German</strong> (spoken and written) and fluent <strong>English</strong> are required to interface effectively with executive decision-makers across the DACH market.</li> <li><strong>Location Presence:</strong> Based in or willing to relocate to <strong>Munich</strong>, with willingness to travel to customer sites across Germany, Austria, and Switzerland as needed.</li> <li><strong>Proven Leadership Experience:</strong> Track record leading pre-sales, management consulting, or value engineering teams within Enterprise SaaS, Enterprise AI, or Management Consulting.</li> <li><strong>Domain Expertise:</strong> Deep domain familiarity with supply chain, procurement, fulfillment, and operational processes within the CPG & Retail industries.</li> <li><strong>People Management:</strong> Demonstrated ability to directly manage or mentor a team of 6–7 high-performing individual contributors, with a strong passion for team coaching and talent development.</li> <li><strong>Commercial Acumen:</strong> Strong business acumen with experience owning ACV, net retention, and renewal pipeline metrics.</li> <li><strong>Executive Presence:</strong> Outstanding executive presence with a proven track record of building C-level relationships across global brands and regional retail leaders.</li> </ul> <p><strong><br></strong><strong>What Celonis can offer you:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Pioneer Innovation:</strong> Work with the leading, award-winning process mining technology, shaping the future of business.</li> <li><strong>Accelerate Your Growth:</strong> Benefit from clear career paths, internal mobility, a dedicated learning program, and mentorship opportunities.</li> <li><strong>Receive Exceptional Benefits:</strong> Including generous PTO, hybrid working options, company equity (RSUs), comprehensive benefits, extensive parental leave, dedicated volunteer days, and <a href="https://careers.celonis.com/life-at-celonis/benefits">much more</a>. Interns and working students explore your benefits <a href="https://careers.celonis.com/early-careers">here</a>.</li> <li><strong>Prioritize Your Well-being:</strong> Access to resources such as gym subsidies, counseling, and well-being programs.</li> <li><strong>Connect and Belong:</strong> Find community and support through dedicated inclusion and belonging programs. </li> <li><strong>Make Meaningful Impact:</strong> Be part of a company driven by strong <a href="https://careers.celonis.com/life-at-celonis/values">values</a> that guide everything we do: Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future.</li> <li><strong>Collaborate Globally:</strong> Join a dynamic, international team of talented individuals.</li> <li><strong>Empowered Environment:</strong> Contribute your ideas in an open culture with autonomous teams.</li> </ul> <p><strong><br></strong><strong>About Us:</strong><br>Celonis makes processes work for people, companies and the planet. The Celonis Process Intelligence Platform uses industry-leading process mining and AI technology and augments it with business context to give customers a living digital twin of their business operation. It’s system-agnostic and without bias, and provides everyone with a common language for understanding and improving businesses. Celonis enables its customers to continuously realize significant value across the top, bottom, and green line. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide.</p> <p>Get familiar with the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform by watching this <a href="https://academy.celonis.com/learn/video/discover-the-ems">video</a>.</p> <p><strong>Celonis Inclusion Statement:</strong></p> <p>At Celonis, we believe our people make us who we are and that “The Best Team Wins”. We know that the best teams are made up of people who bring different perspectives to the table. title: Senior GRC Analyst
description: <p><strong>About the Role</strong></p> <p>Reporting to the Director Information Security Governance, within the Infosec GRC Team, the Senior Governance, Risk and Compliance Analyst will help deliver and support all aspects of Ocado’s Compliance, Audit, Assurance and Attestation Programs including SOC 1, SOC 2, PCI DSS, NIST CSF, NIS 2, ISO 42001 and UK Corporate Governance Code compliance. </p> <p>The role also includes day-to-day management and coordination of the Cybersecurity Risk Register and Risk Management Program, as well as all aspects of legal and regulatory compliance as relevant to the Information Security domain including AI Governanace.</p> <p>The successful candidate will also support and contribute to wider Infosec GRC team’s responsibilities, including the Vendor Risk Management Program and Information Security policies framework.  </p> <p>As a hands-on role within a dynamic function, the successful candidate will use their compliance and assurance skillset to make constructive contributions both within Infosec and discussions/projects we contribute to across the business.<br>Reporting to the Director Information Security Governance, the role holder will support the management of all aspects of Ocado’s Attestation Programs, including Security Risk Management, Vendor Risk Management Program, AI Governance and Information Security policies framework management.  </p> <p><strong>What we’d like you to do:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Support the SOC 1, SOC 2, PCI DSS, NIST CSF, NIS 2,  ISO 42001, AI Governance, UK Corporate Governance Code and other Compliance, Audit, Assurance and</li> <li>Attestation Programs</li> <li>Performing audit testing, ensuring preparedness for accreditation</li> <li>Identifying control weaknesses and any mitigating controls</li> <li>Develop, enhance and fine-tune controls to meet compliance and business needs</li> <li>Advising teams on requirements to meet SOC1, SOC 2, PCI DSS, NIST CSF, AI Governance and other related compliance and regulatory controls</li> <li>Create audit plans and frameworks based on new or existing requirements</li> <li>Preparing in-scope teams for external audits</li> <li>Evidence gathering, deficiency plans and presenting these to external auditors</li> <li>Producing project status reports and documentation</li> <li>Identifying project/program risks and produce risk reports</li> <li>Organising and managing external audits, presenting evidence to the external auditors </li> </ul> <p>You may be asked to perform tasks as required by management deemed as a reasonable request. This job description is a summary of the typical functions of the role, not an exhaustive or comprehensive list of possible role responsibilities, tasks and duties and is subject to review. The responsibilities, tasks and duties of the job holder might differ from those outlined in the job description and other duties, as assigned, might form part of the job. </p> <p><br><strong>Knowledge, Skills and Experience</strong><br><strong><br>Essential</strong></p> <ul> <li>3+ years’ experience in performing IT Controls testing or managing SOC 2 Type 2, PCI DSS and ISO related audits in a large technology organisation.</li> <li>Strong knowledge of cloud computing environments and attestation or certification programs for technology companies that provide SaaS solutions.</li> <li>Experience assessing and auditing controls in cloud-native environments (e.g. AWS, GCP), including shared responsibility models and SaaS-based architectures</li> <li>Knowledge of current information security standards, frameworks and regulations such NIS 2, GDPR, NIST CSF, UK Corporate Governance Code etc.</li> <li>Proactive and collaborative approach, comfortable working in a fast paced environment prioritising multiple parallel activities.</li> <li>Ability to analyse security controls, while understanding the risk of certain controls not being in place.</li> <li>Ability to effectively communicate security risks and impact to various business stakeholders.</li> <li>Organising and managing external audits, presenting evidence to the external auditors</li> <li>Have at least one of ISO 27001 (or other ISO)  related Lead Auditor, CISSP, CISA, CRISC, or CISM certifications</li> <li>Performing IT Controls testing, and ensure readiness across applicable compliance frameworks. Ensuring preparedness for accreditation</li> <li>Communication and stakeholder management skills, including guiding stakeholders on their compliance obligations within the business context</li> <li>Producing project status reports and documentation</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Benefits</strong></p> <p>We believe in supporting our people with meaningful, flexible benefits that prioritise well-being and work-life balance. Here’s a snapshot of what you can expect:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Time to recharge:</strong> 25 days annual leave (rising to 27 after 5 years), plus the option to buy more - and 30 days a year to work from anywhere in the world.</li> <li><strong>Health & wellbeing:</strong> Private Medical Insurance from your first month, wellbeing support through specialist apps and EAP, plus Income Protection and Life Assurance.</li> <li><strong>Family-first policies:</strong> 22 weeks paid maternity/primary carer leave and 6 weeks paid paternity leave.</li> <li><strong>Financial support:</strong> Pension with employer matching up to 7%, share schemes (Sharesave & BAYE) and interest-free loans for train tickets.</li> <li><strong>Commuter perks:</strong> Cycle to Work Scheme, Car salary sacrifice and free shuttle buses to/from Hatfield and Welwyn Garden City stations.</li> <li><strong>Exclusive discounts:</strong> 15% off at Ocado.com with free delivery (starting in your first month) and up to 70% off at our Company Shop.</li> </ul> <p>Be bold, be unique, be brilliant, be you. We are looking for individuality and we value diversity. We are an equal opportunities employer and we are committed to treating all applicants and employees fairly and equally. We are committed to making reasonable adjustments to provide a positive, barrier-free recruitment process and supportive work environment. title: Senior Backend Engineer(Go), Storage Platform
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><span data-sheets-root="1">About Wolt</span></h2> <p><span data-sheets-root="1">At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.<br><br>Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.</span></p></div><h2>What you’ll be doing</h2> <p>As part of Wolt’s Platform department (Core Group), you’ll help improve and automate operations for our storage access platform - our real time database abstraction layer solution designed with scale and resiliency in mind . The product you will build enforces best practices by design, abstracts database infrastructure, and supports Multi-Region architecture through data sharding and replication. You join a team of highly skilled engineers in designing, building and optimizing this platform and ensuring smooth developer onboarding, constant improvement and optimization. </p> <p>As an engineer on the Storage access platform team, you’ll work on platform features such as UI for developer teams, storage abstraction layer, database automation, client SDK and proxy, Change Data Capture pipelines, caching and ephemeral storage, Hot & Cold storage management and more.</p> <h2>Our humble expectations</h2> <p>You’ll be a great fit for this role if you have the following skills and experience:</p> <ul> <li>A strong developer-to-developer mindset, with a genuine enjoyment of building for internal customers and treating other engineers as your primary users.</li> <li>Adaptability and strong motivation for working with distributed systems.</li> <li>A data-driven approach to decision-making and a collaborative mindset, with the ability to navigate disagreements constructively and deliver consistently.</li> <li>Autonomy in dynamic, fast-paced environments with frequent change.</li> <li>A product- and platform-oriented approach to engineering challenges.</li> <li>Excellent communication skills, with the ability to engage effectively with stakeholders and cross-functional teams.</li> <li>A collaborative spirit and experience contributing to diverse and inclusive work environments.</li> </ul> <h3>Technical proficiencies:</h3> <ul> <li>Expertise in NoSQL databases, particularly Cassandra or DynamoDB.</li> <li>Experience with large-scale distributed systems, emphasizing both velocity and scalability.</li> <li>Familiarity with SRE principles; however, a background in Backend Development is essential.</li> <li>Practical knowledge of Kubernetes, including EKS, as an end user.</li> </ul> <p>You don’t need to tick every box, but if you see yourself in many of these points, we’d love to hear from you!</p> <h2><strong><br></strong>What we offer</h2> <p>At Wolt, we’re committed to building an environment where engineers can make an impact while enjoying meaningful challenges. As a member of the the team you’ll enjoy:</p> <ul> <li>Working on solutions that support millions of users</li> <li>Solving complex problems in performance, reliability and automation</li> <li>A collaborative and inclusive culture that supports your professional and personal well-being</li> </ul> <p>We also offer flexible work arrangements, competitive compensation, and ongoing learning opportunities to help you thrive.</p> <p><iframe src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/Ncz4s_oBczc?si=FzuwoSOLcv5WZVRN" width="560" height="314"></iframe></p> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><h2><span data-sheets-root="1">Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion</span></h2> <p><span data-sheets-root="1">We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. title: Senior Financial Controller
description: About the role As SkyNRG grows, so does the complexity of our finance activities. We are looking for an experienced, hands-on Senior Financial Controller who combines strong financial control expertise with a commercially-minded approach. You will take ownership of financial control and reporting across key entities, projects and commercial activities. Working closely with various departments; Finance, Commercial, Legal, Operations and Project Development, you provide financial oversight and help ensure our project and commercial activities are financially well-managed. Your key responsibilities include: Financial control & reporting: Own accounting and reporting activities, including complex accounting analysis, month- and year-end closing, balance sheet control and management reporting. Planning & insights: Support budgeting, forecasting, cash-flow planning and scenario analysis, translating results into meaningful business insights. Business & project partnering: Support strategic projects and commercial agreements through financial modelling, analysis and constructive financial challenge. Subsidies & compliance: Coordinate subsidy and grant reporting and support statutory and group audits. Finance improvement: Help build scalable processes, controls and reporting structures and contribute to ERP, automation and finance transformation initiatives. Your profile As a growing company in a rapidly evolving industry, we are looking for people who embrace change and are motivated to actively contribute to building and scaling our business. You are someone who feels comfortable in an entrepreneurial environment, takes ownership, and thrives when things are still developing. You recognize yourself in the following: Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Economics or a related field, with 7+ years of relevant finance experience. Strong experience in financial control, accounting, and reporting, including budgeting, forecasting and financial analysis. Experience analyzing complex accounting topics under Dutch GAAP and developing clear, well-supported accounting conclusions. Experience working with projects or commercial agreements and translating these into financial models, insights and controls. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work independently on complex financial topics. Confident communicator who can collaborate with and constructively challenge both finance and non-finance stakeholders. Advanced Excel skills, experience with ERP systems and fluency in English. Hands-on, proactive and organised, with a strong sense of ownership. Nice-to-haves: Experience within a Big Four or similar audit environment. Experience in energy, infrastructure, industrial, manufacturing or other project-driven environments. Experience with ERP implementations or finance transformation projects. Knowledge of Dutch accounting and reporting requirements. About SkyNRG Since 2009, SkyNRG has been a change maker in the aviation industry. We are dedicated to supplying and producing high-integrity Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF), making sustainable aviation a reality. Collaboration is fundamental to achieving our ambition. We nurture genuine relationships with global partners in our drive to make SAF the alternative to fossil jet fuel. Our in-house team of SAF experts have helped over 60 airlines and corporates reduce their climate impact using the Book & Claim mechanism; the most transparent and traceable way to support aviation sustainability with real emission reductions. Sustainability is woven into the fabric of our company. We maintain an independent Sustainability Board, which advises the company on feedstocks and provides strategic guidance on wide-ranging sustainability issues. SkyNRG operations are certified against the RSB EU RED, CORSIA, and Book & Claim standards. At SkyNRG, you’ll find: An innovation-driven culture – where big ideas turn into real impact Growth opportunities – in a fast-scaling, industry-changing company A collaborative team – where your ideas and expertise are valued A mission that matters – leading the change in the energy transition by producing and supplying high-integrity SAF What we offer We offer a brand-new office in the heart of Amsterdam, designed for collaboration and creativity. Most importantly, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute to a truly game-changing green initiative, making a real impact on the aviation industry and the planet. description: About the Role Every month, hundreds of potential customers show interest in Trengo. They start a free trial, request a demo, or leave their contact details. As our Marketing Development Representative (MDR) , you'll be the first personal point of contact for potential customers, helping them find the right way to get started with Trengo. It's an 8-month contract with the possibility of extension. About Trengo Welcome to the forefront of AI-driven communication. At Trengo, we’re redefining the industry by replacing repetitive work with meaningful conversations through our AI-powered customer engagement platform. We unify communication channels and leverage agentic AI to deliver proactive, human-like service, boosting efficiency for thousands of businesses worldwide. As a fast-moving Dutch scale-up, backed by a $36M Series A and an official WhatsApp Business Solutions Provider, we thrive on acceleration. Your expertise will drive growth: you’ll make a strategic impact, champion AI innovation, and help shape the product roadmap. You’ll do this alongside an international team guided by our Dynamic pace, Future-proof mindset, Ownership, and Open culture. What your role looks like: Turn inbound interest into opportunities Be the first personal point of contact for new inbound leads, reaching out through calls and personalised emails, ideally within the same working day. Follow up with qualified free-trial sign-ups, demo requests and prospects who have expressed interest but haven't booked a meeting. Re-engage prospects whose meetings weren't booked, were cancelled or resulted in a no-show, and help them take the next step. Connect qualified prospects with the right Account Executive, making sure they have the context needed for a productive conversation. Help prospects become self-serve customers Reach out to prospects who might not be the right fit for a sales conversation but could still benefit from Trengo. Understand what they're looking for, answer initial questions and guide them towards the right self-serve plan. Follow up with free-trial users to help them get started and encourage them to take the next step towards becoming customers. Improve how we engage with leads Experiment with different outreach messages, sequences and follow-up approaches to understand what converts best. Share insights with Marketing and Sales about common objections, lead quality and what prospects are looking for. Keep HubSpot accurate and up to date by logging interactions, tracking outcomes and maintaining clean lead data. How we'll measure success You'll have a direct impact on our growth, with clear results you can track: Speed of follow-up: Making sure inbound prospects receive timely, personal attention. Meetings generated: Booking qualified meetings that turn into conversations with our Account Executives. Self-serve conversions: Helping prospects progress from initial interest to becoming paying customers. Continuous improvement: Finding better ways to engage prospects and sharing insights that help our Marketing and Sales teams improve. The tools you'll work with You'll get hands-on experience with our commercial and AI toolkit: HubSpot: CRM, lead management, outreach sequences and calling. RevenueHero: Lead routing and meeting booking. Fathom: Call recordings, feedback and coaching. Slack & Notion: Team collaboration, processes and playbooks. AI tools: Researching prospects, personalising outreach and experimenting with smarter ways of working. What you’ll bring 1-2 years of experience , ideally through an internship or an early-career role in sales, marketing, customer success or a customer-facing environment. Fluent English , both written and spoken. Dutch is a big plus. Confidence in communication: You're comfortable picking up the phone, writing personalised emails and starting conversations with people you haven't met. A proactive mindset: You don't wait for someone to tell you what to do next. You spot opportunities and take initiative. An organised way of working: You can manage multiple conversations, prioritise your day and follow through on commitments. Curiosity and willingness to learn: You're interested in SaaS, AI and how businesses grow, and you're open to coaching and feedback. A results-driven attitude: You enjoy working towards clear goals, experimenting with different approaches and understanding what works. Nice to have Experience working with HubSpot or other CRM tools. Exposure to inbound lead follow-up, prospecting or sales processes. Additional language skills such as Dutch, German, French, Spanish or Italian. Familiarity with eCommerce, WhatsApp Business or customer communication platforms. Experience using AI tools to research prospects, personalise communication or improve workflows. ⚙️ Our tech & AI mindset AI is not a buzzword at Trengo — it’s part of how we build and operate. You’ll work with AI-driven features, automation, data, or tools that help us move faster and smarter. We value thoughtful use of AI that creates real value for customers and teams. What’s in it for you? This is what we carefully prepared for you: 🚀 A key role where you’ll make a visible impact in a vibrant scale-up environment. 🌍 Hybrid working + 2 months per year to work abroad. 🏗️ A strong onboarding program with hands-on training and a dedicated buddy to set you up for success. 🧘 Mental health support with free sessions from on-demand psychologists (OpenUp) . 📚 Learning budget + 2 extra days off to attend courses or conferences. 🌴 28 vacation days to rest, recharge, and travel 🚆 Travel reimbursement to our Utrecht HQ. 📶 Monthly internet & phone allowance to stay connected. 🗣️ Dutch courses for our international colleagues. 🍴 Daily warm lunches prepared by our workplace experience team when you’re at our beautiful Utrecht office . 💼 Pension contribution to help you plan for the future. 🛫 Sabbatical: After two years, enjoy up to three months away (unpaid) to rest, recharge, or see the world. 🔍 Our hiring process Introductory call – First conversation with our Talent team. title: Senior Technical Product Manager - Agent Builder
description: Auditors sign their name to every conclusion. An agent can do the heavy lifting, but only if the auditor can see how each conclusion was reached and trace it back to its source. Agent Builder is where firms turn their own procedures into agents their whole team can run, in Alwin by DataSnipper, our agentic automation platform for audit and finance. Built well, an agent makes quality a property of the procedure, not of who happened to be staffed on the engagement. You'll own Agent Builder and the agents firms build with it. Your users are the people at firms who build agents, and the methodology and quality teams who approve them for client work. This is a technical PM role. You'll shape the harness each agent runs in: the context it sees, the tools it uses, and where a person reviews its work. You'll own the feedback loops that improve agents after release. You'll work as a peer to the Agent Builder engineering team, and with our Agent Runtime and Evals teams here in Amsterdam. About DataSnipper The hardest AI problems aren't about getting an answer fast. They're about getting one people can trust. We believe trust is essential to how society works. Every day, we rely on information that's been independently verified, from financial statements to the products we buy, to the sustainability claims companies make. Behind that trust are audit and finance professionals who examine evidence, verify information and hold organizations accountable. At DataSnipper, we build AI solutions that empower those professionals. By making evidence easier to trace and verify, we help them focus on the judgment and expertise that make their work so important. For our product and engineering team, this is where things get exciting. In audit, a plausible answer isn't good enough. Every output has to be explainable and traceable back to its source. We've just launched a brand new agentic platform, Alwin by DataSnipper. AI agents running in the cloud across hundreds of documents at once, reasoning across PDF, Word and Excel, with a full audit trail behind every step. There are lots of greenfield problems ahead, and real room to shape what we build and how we build it. And we build at scale. More than 600,000 professionals across 3,000+ organizations in 175 countries rely on DataSnipper, including Fortune 500 companies, government agencies and all Big Four audit firms. In 2025 alone, the DataSnipper platform delivered more than $1.4 billion in productivity savings to is customers . Backed by a $100 million Series B led by Index Ventures, at a $1 billion valuation, and as proud members of 1% for the Planet, we care about how we grow, not just how fast. If you want to build AI that professionals trust with work that really matters, this is your chance to help shape the future of audit and finance and do the best work of your career along the way. The problems you'll own A firm's procedure must become a harness an agent can follow, with the right context, tools and review points Models are non-deterministic, but audit work must be defensible: traceable, attributed and reviewed A firm will only rely on an agent it can test, approve and trace Reviewer feedback must make agents better, with the firm's approval and without anything reaching another client Methodology, models and standards all change. Agents in use must keep up without breaking work in progress What you'll do Own the Agent Builder strategy and roadmap, and make the trade-offs explicit Design the harness with engineering: how context is assembled, how tools are defined and called, and where a person must review Decide what builders control and what the platform sets, so agents can encode real methodology and stay consistent Build the feedback loops: turn run traces and reviewer edits into eval cases, regression tests and changes the firm approves Set the quality gates an agent must pass before release, and test every new model or methodology version before it reaches live work Report agent quality with a stated method and sample Prototype in code before you write specs. Then write short specs and decision memos that engineers can build from Spend time with the firms that build and approve agents, and turn what our forward-deployed teams learn into product, not one-off fixes What you bring A technical background: software, ML or infrastructure engineering, or several years as a technical PM on developer or AI platforms Hands-on experience shipping agent systems in production: context and retrieval, tool calling, orchestration, structured outputs, retries and fallbacks Eval practice: building datasets, calibrating LLM judges against human labels, offline and online evaluation, and regression testing across model versions Observability for LLM systems: traces, cost and latency, and classifying failures so you fix causes, not symptoms System design skills: schemas, versioning, permissions, event logs and APIs. You can read a design doc and challenge it PM experience on a product that other people build on Prototyping in code with AI tools as part of your normal work Clear, short writing What sets you apart Audit or accounting knowledge, from practice or from building products for auditors, finance teams or other experts in regulated fields Document AI: extraction, OCR, grounding and citation You've built an agent harness or framework, eval tooling, or LLM observability You've built review workflows or feedback pipelines that turn user corrections into eval or training data Experience with low-code tools, workflow designers, rule engines or DSLs Design-partner programmes with large enterprise customers What We Offer Be part of one of the fastest-growing, profitable unicorn scale-ups in the Netherlands with a global impact. Equity (Stock Appreciation Rights) to share in the company’s success and growth. Pension plan with a 6% contribution on top of your base salary. 28 vacation days per year (full-time) to support your work-life balance. Hybrid work model with at least 3 days onsite in our dynamic Amsterdam office. Daily, freshly prepared lunches by our in-house chef to keep you energised. NS business card for easy commuting to the office. A structured onboarding programme designed to set you up for success, including dedicated time to learn our product and customers before you hit the ground running. Access to continuous learning and development initiatives to grow your skills. Engage with a vibrant international team spread across seven global offices. Company-wide events like DataSnipper GO, where global teams come together. Access to OpenUp, a mental health and wellness platform supporting your wellbeing. Recruitment steps Recruiter screen Hiring Manager interview Assessment interview Final conversations with the people you would work alongside At DataSnipper, we believe great ideas come from different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. title: Senior Growth Marketer, Web & Experimentation
description: Our Growth Marketers bring buyers to datasnipper.com through integrated campaigns. You'll turn that traffic into demo requests and pipeline. You'll run A/B tests, personalize the site, work on conversion rate optimization (CRO), and manage the projects that add new functionality to our websites. You'll also bring AI into the website program, building on the AI that already runs our go-to-market. You'll work from one ranked backlog and report each week on what moved conversion. You'll form hypotheses from data, get them built with our designer and developer, and roll out the winners. Your closest partners are the Growth Marketers, our Senior Web Experience Designer and Senior Web Developer, and GTM Engineering, which collects intent data from our website. About DataSnipper We believe trust is essential to how society works. Every day, we rely on information that's been independently verified, from financial statements to the products we buy, to the sustainability claims companies make. Behind that trust are audit and finance professionals who examine evidence, verify information and hold organizations accountable. At DataSnipper, we build AI solutions that empower those professionals to make those judgements. With Alwin by DataSnipper, our new agentic platform, AI agents now take on end-to-end audit and finance procedures, while every conclusion stays traceable to its source. That frees professionals to focus on the judgment and expertise that make their work so important. We're trusted by Fortune 500 companies, government agencies and all Big Four audit firms. Today, more than 600,000 professionals across 3,000+ organizations in 175 countries rely on our platform, and in 2025 alone DataSnipper delivered more than $1.4 billion in productivity savings to its customers. Backed by a $100 million Series B led by Index Ventures, at a $1 billion valuation, we've built a strong foundation for what's next. And as proud members of 1% for the Planet, we care about how we grow, not just how fast. Alwin has just launched, demand is growing, and we're expanding into new markets and segments. With a product customers already rely on, there's a huge opportunity to make your mark. Where the website stands today Most of our inbound pipeline starts on datasnipper.com . Until now, our Senior Growth Marketer handled CRO on the side, and many people on the Marketing team publish pages, update content individually. In short, very fragmented collaboration. In an AI-dense market, that work counts for more. Anyone can generate volume now. What's hard, and what earns attention, is staying close to what our customers care about and bringing campaign ideas sharp enough to cut through. That's the work that sets this team apart, and what you'll be part of. Our tracking needs a cleanup before we can trust test results. Localized landing pages come next: Japan, DACH and France need web experiences in their own language. GTM Engineering already scores visitor intent by page, and we barely use that data on the site. Personalization by segment and market has barely started. AI already runs parts of our go-to-market. Agents nurture leads, a classifier scores the intent behind every web visit, and we enrich accounts automatically. The website hasn't caught up. Buyers also find us in new ways. More of them research software through ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google's AI Overviews before they ever reach our site. The web team has a dedicated designer and developer. This role decides what we test next and reports what worked. What you'll be doing Run the experimentation program Build the testing roadmap for datasnipper.com and the localized sites, from hypothesis to rollout. Set the website's testing rules: minimum sample size, test duration, and when to call or stop a test. Keep a learning log that Growth, Sales and Product Marketing check before they propose a test. Report results in pipeline terms: demo requests, demo-to-SQL rate and pipeline per session. Improve conversion where buyers decide Optimize the demo request flow and the pricing, product and campaign pages. Map the funnel from first visit to SQL in GA4 and HubSpot, find where buyers drop off, and fix it. Work with the Growth Marketers to match each campaign landing page to its ad, audience and market. Personalize the site Tailor content, proof points and CTAs by vertical, market and buying stage. Use intent and enrichment data from GTM Engineering to decide who sees what. Test each localized site as it launches, to the same standard as the English site. Build AI into the web program Use the intent and enrichment data we already collect to build pages that adapt to each visitor. Use AI to generate and localize test variants, so we test more ideas each month. Automate test QA, result analysis and weekly reporting, with a person signing off on the results. Prototype new AI experiences for buyers, such as an assistant that answers product and pricing questions. Manage web projects Scope new website functionality, write the brief, and run delivery with our designer and developer. Turn requests from Product Marketing, Sales, Partnerships and Growth into a ranked backlog, and use data to decide what waits. Run QA and launch, then measure each project's result. Keep the site findable and measurable Protect organic search and AI visibility in every test and launch: canonicals, page speed, schema markup and crawl access. Track traffic and demo requests referred by AI assistants, and test pages for buyers who arrive that way. Maintain website tracking with Marketing Operations in Google Tag Manager, GA4 and HubSpot. Build the weekly web performance view the team works from. What we’re looking for 5+ years in CRO, web optimization or growth marketing, ideally in B2B SaaS. You've run an A/B testing program and can walk us through tests that won and tests that lost. Data fluency. You know when to trust a test result, and when sample size, novelty or segment noise undermine it. You pull your own numbers from GA4 and HubSpot. Structure. You run a backlog, write briefs a developer can build from, and keep several projects moving. You tell stakeholders each week what ships. Collaboration. You get work done through a designer, a developer and stakeholders who all want space on the website. You involve them before you set a hypothesis, and use data to settle priority disputes. AI builder. You’ve shipped something with AI that changed how a team works: an agent, an automated workflow, or a tool other people use. Bring the example and what broke first. Commercial focus. You judge tests on the pipeline they create. description: The Role We are looking for a hands-on Head of Supply Chain to take ownership of how Lumai sources, manages and receives the components that go into our systems. run lightweight tools for parts, BoM and inventory management that will scale with the company Define supplier quality expectations, track supplier performance, and manage non-conformances and returns Our 3D optical technology carries out the matrix multiplications at the heart of AI inside beams of light travelling through free space, which lets it go beyond the limits of both silicon GPUs and integrated photonics. title: Principal AI & Automation Lead
description: AI speelt een steeds grotere rol in hoe we onze producten verbeteren, klanten ondersteunen en interne processen slimmer inrichten. Maar de échte waarde van AI zit wat ons betreft niet in de technologie zelf, maar in wat we ermee kunnen bereiken. Als onze AI & Automation Lead ontdek je waar AI het verschil kan maken. Je gaat met collega's uit verschillende afdelingen in gesprek, luistert naar hun ervaringen en uitdagingen en vertaalt ideeën en behoeften naar praktische oplossingen. Dat doe je niet alleen achter je eigen scherm. Je organiseert workshops, helpt collega's met verschillende niveaus van technische kennis op weg met AI, experimenteert met nieuwe technologie en bouwt zelf prototypes en automatiseringen. Je krijgt veel vrijheid om kansen te ontdekken, prioriteiten te stellen en initiatieven van idee tot implementatie te begeleiden. Daarmee maak je niet alleen het werk van je collega's makkelijker en leuker, maar draag je ook bij aan betere producten en dienstverlening voor onze 270.000 klanten. Wie zijn wij? Mijndomein is een van de grootste en laatste onafhankelijke hostingproviders van Nederland. Omdat we volledig in privébezit zijn, groeien we op onze eigen manier: wendbaar, klantgericht en met een langetermijnvisie. We nemen beslissingen met het belang van onze klanten én het bedrijf voor ogen. Inmiddels vertrouwen 270.000 klanten op onze diensten en beheren we meer dan 1 miljoen domeinnamen. En omdat we geloven in samen bouwen, kunnen medewerkers via onze participatieregeling mede-eigenaar worden van de organisatie en zo meedelen in de waarde die we samen creëren. Mijndomein is onderdeel van The Sharing Group, actief binnen Online, Mobiliteit en Energie Wat ga je doen? Als AI & Automation Lead speel je een belangrijke rol bij het inzetten van AI binnen Mijndomein. Je houdt je bezig met interne bedrijfsprocessen én toepassingen die onze producten en dienstverlening verbeteren. Concreet betekent dit dat je: Kansen ontdekt en prioriteiten stelt: je brengt ons huidige AI-gebruik in kaart, ontdekt verbeterkansen en bepaalt samen met collega's welke initiatieven de meeste waarde opleveren. Processen automatiseert: je ontwikkelt praktische automatiseringen en AI-workflows die repetitief werk verminderen en collega's tijd besparen. Collega's verder helpt: je organiseert toegankelijke trainingen en workshops, ondersteunt collega's bij het gebruik van AI en deelt succesvolle toepassingen tussen afdelingen. Ideeën tot leven brengt: je bouwt prototypes en pilots om nieuwe toepassingen te testen. Voor grotere of complexere oplossingen werk je samen met onze developers. Tools beoordeelt: je onderzoekt bestaande en nieuwe AI-tools en adviseert over hun toegevoegde waarde, bruikbaarheid, toegankelijkheid, veiligheid en mogelijke risico's. Resultaten zichtbaar maakt: je onderzoekt wat toepassingen daadwerkelijk opleveren, bijvoorbeeld in tijdsbesparing, kwaliteit of klanttevredenheid. Vooruitkijkt: je volgt relevante AI-ontwikkelingen en helpt op basis van nieuwe inzichten onze AI-strategie verder vorm te geven. Daarbij draait het niet om zoveel mogelijk AI-tools introduceren, maar om oplossingen die daadwerkelijk iets toevoegen. Niet ieder probleem heeft AI nodig en niet ieder experiment hoeft een succes te worden. We vinden het belangrijk om samen te leren van wat wel én niet werkt. We zoeken iemand die enthousiast wordt van nieuwe technologie, maar nog veel enthousiaster van wat je ermee kunt oplossen. Je hebt ervaring met het zelfstandig begeleiden van AI-projecten van idee tot implementatie. Je bent technisch onderlegd, bouwt graag zelf oplossingen en weet wanneer het waardevol is om de kennis en expertise van anderen te betrekken. Je kunt omgaan met een rol waarin nog niet alles vastligt. Je neemt initiatief, brengt structuur aan en helpt collega's om nieuwe technologie te begrijpen en te benutten, op een manier die aansluit bij hun kennis en behoeften. Hoe je jouw kennis en ervaring hebt opgedaan, vinden we minder belangrijk dan wat je ermee kunt bereiken. Of je nu een technische opleiding hebt gevolgd, jezelf veel hebt aangeleerd of vanuit een ander vakgebied in AI en automatisering bent terechtgekomen: we zijn benieuwd naar wat jij meebrengt. Wat breng je mee? Ervaring met het implementeren van AI-oplossingen, automatiseringen of vergelijkbare technologische verbeteringen binnen organisaties. De technische kennis om zelfstandig prototypes, AI-workflows en automatiseringen te ontwikkelen. Kennis van API's, integraties en moderne AI-tools, en inzicht in hoe je verschillende systemen met elkaar kunt laten samenwerken. Het vermogen om zelfstandig projecten te begeleiden, prioriteiten te stellen en onderscheid te maken tussen interessante experimenten en waardevolle oplossingen. Het vermogen om technische onderwerpen begrijpelijk te maken voor verschillende doelgroepen en collega's te ondersteunen bij veranderingen. Oog voor privacy, informatiebeveiliging en verantwoord gebruik van AI, waaronder mogelijke vooroordelen en risico's van AI-toepassingen. Ervaring met het ontwikkelen van toepassingen rondom LLM's, AI-agents of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG). Een nieuwsgierige, praktische en resultaatgerichte aanpak, waarbij je openstaat voor feedback en verschillende perspectieven. Mooi meegenomen, maar geen vereiste: Ervaring met programmeertalen zoals Python of JavaScript. Ervaring met automatiseringsplatformen zoals n8n, Make of vergelijkbare tools. Ervaring met het organiseren van workshops, trainingen of interne kennissessies. Affiniteit met hosting, SaaS of andere technische dienstverlening. Herken je jezelf in deze rol, maar voldoe je niet aan alle punten? Laat je daardoor niet tegenhouden om te solliciteren. We kijken graag naar jouw kennis, ervaring, potentieel en motivatie. Wat bieden wij? Stick Together, Own It & Be Bold. Dat zijn onze kernwaarden en die zie je terug in hoe we samenwerken. Bij Mijndomein krijg je de vrijheid om ideeën niet alleen aan te dragen, maar ook daadwerkelijk uit te voeren. We helpen elkaar, geven ruimte aan verschillende perspectieven en waarderen initiatief, constructieve feedback en de bereidheid om te experimenteren en te leren. We geloven dat verschillende achtergronden, ervaringen en manieren van denken ons als organisatie sterker maken. We vinden het belangrijk dat iedereen zichzelf kan zijn, zich gehoord voelt en de ruimte krijgt om zich te ontwikkelen. We zijn goed ingericht op hybride werken, maar vinden het ook belangrijk om elkaar regelmatig te ontmoeten. Daarom werk je minimaal twee dagen per week op ons kantoor in Almere, op dinsdag en donderdag . Regelmatig komt daar ook de maandag bij, waardoor je vaak drie dagen per week op kantoor bent. Daarnaast bieden we: Een passend salaris, afhankelijk van je kennis en ervaring. Internet-, telefonie- en thuiswerkvergoeding. €750 per jaar voor boeken, workshops, seminars of andere dingen die bijdragen aan jouw ontwikkeling. Een aanvullend studiebudget van €2.500 per jaar . Een vast aantal studie-uren per jaar, zodat je ook daadwerkelijk tijd kunt besteden aan je ontwikkeling. €550 voor het inrichten van je thuiswerkplek. Onze participatieregeling Good Shares , waarmee je mede-eigenaar kunt worden van de organisatie. Een pensioenbijdrage van 5,3% , volledig door ons betaald. Reiskostenvergoeding en een NS-Business Card. Ons kantoor zit pal naast station Almere Centraal. En verschillende extra's, zoals stoelmassages, vers bereide (warme) lunches op kantoor en korting op je sportabonnement. Enthousiast? Krijg jij energie van het ontdekken van mogelijkheden, het bouwen van slimme oplossingen en het helpen van anderen om technologie écht te benutten? Dan maken we graag kennis met je! We zijn vooral benieuwd naar wat je hebt gebouwd, welke verbeteringen je hebt gerealiseerd, wat je onderweg hebt geleerd en hoe jij AI binnen een organisatie als Mijndomein zou aanpakken. Dat mag vanuit je werkervaring zijn, maar ook vanuit eigen projecten of andere initiatieven. Bij ons is iedereen welkom om te solliciteren, ongeacht achtergrond, leeftijd, gender, identiteit of persoonlijke omstandigheden. Heb je tijdens de sollicitatieprocedure bepaalde ondersteuning of aanpassingen nodig? Laat het ons gerust weten, dan kijken we samen naar de mogelijkheden. Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Data Engineer (tbv Productie & ESG)
description: Heb je een passie voor data, technologie en duurzaamheid? ONE-Dyas is op zoek naar een Data Engineer om te zorgen voor de nauwkeurige verzameling, het beheer en de rapportage van productie-, koolwaterstof- en ESG-gegevens. Je zet complexe gegevens om in betrouwbare inzichten die operationele en zakelijke beslissingen ondersteunen. Wat zijn je taken? Het onderhouden en verbeteren van databases met gevalideerde productie- en ESG-gegevens. Het verzamelen en integreren van gegevens uit productiebronnen en uit geëxploiteerde en niet-geëxploiteerde activa. Het opstellen van duidelijke maand-, kwartaal- en jaarverslagen en visualisaties. Het ondersteunen van de teams Production, Engineering, HSE en ESG met gegevens ter ondersteuning van operationele en zakelijke beslissingen. HBO niveau in Techniek, Accountancy, Informatica, Milieuwetenschappen of een verwant vakgebied. Ervaring met data-engineering of ESG-rapportage, bij voorkeur binnen de energie- of olie- en gasindustrie. Kennis van databasebeheer, datavisualisatie en datagovernance. Bij voorkeur ervaring met Python, SQL of vergelijkbare tools. Sterke communicatieve en probleemoplossende vaardigheden. Een proactieve, zelfstandige en teamgerichte werkwijze met interesse in duurzaamheid. In deze functie werk je tenminste 60% van je werkweek vanuit ons kantoor in Amsterdam. Je kunt je zowel mondeling als schriftelijk goed uitdrukken in het Nederlands en Engels. Maak kennis met ONE-Dyas ONE-Dyas B.V. is het grootste particuliere exploratie- en productiebedrijf in Nederland. Als onder-nemers in de Nederlandse offshore gas- en oliesector streeft het bedrijf ernaar een belangrijke bijdrage te leveren aan de energietransitie, waarbij het vooroploopt op het gebied van duurzaam-heid en technologische innovatie. Het winnen van gas en olie dicht bij huis draagt bij aan de natio-nale economie, de voorzieningszekerheid en de klimaatdoelstellingen door gebruik te maken van lokale diensten, producten en knowhow, de afhankelijkheid van geïmporteerde brandstoffen te verminderen, de uitstoot te verlagen en te voldoen aan de hoogste milieunormen in de sector. Met wortels die teruggaan tot 1893 in de mijnbouw, kent ONE-Dyas een lange geschiedenis van succesvolle baanbrekende energieoplossingen. Tegenwoordig bestrijken de activiteiten de volledi-ge levenscyclus van offshore-activa in Nederland, Duitsland en het Verenigd Koninkrijk, waaronder het vlaggenschipproject N05-A in het Nederlandse en Duitse deel van de Noordzee, dat het eerste in zijn soort zal zijn waarin aardgas, windenergie en groene waterstof worden geïntegreerd. ONE-Dyas onderzoekt tevens actief mogelijkheden op het gebied van koolstofafvang en -opslag, en groene waterstof als toekomstige energieoplossingen. ONE-Dyas, met het hoofdkantoor aan de Zuidas in Amsterdam en circa 150 medewerkers, kenmerkt zich door een sterke ondernemingscultuur, korte lijnen tussen alle disciplines en een hechte band met haar aandeelhouders, wat leidt tot een doelgerichte en effectieve werkomgeving. ONE-Dyas geniet in Nederland, het Verenigd Koninkrijk en Duitsland een uitstekende reputatie vanwege zijn ervaring en expertise in de gehele toeleveringsketen van de olie- en gasindustrie. ONE-Dyas staat erom bekend zaken veilig, betrouwbaar en efficiënt te realiseren. Geïnteresseerd? Wil je een bijdrage leveren aan betrouwbare productie en ESG-rapportage bij ONE-Dyas? Mocht je vragen hebben over de functie, neem dan contact op met Gerlof Visser (Hoofd Production Engineering & HCA): Houd er rekening mee dat dit e-mailadres uitsluitend bedoeld is voor vragen over de functie.
