title: Data Scientist / Data Engineer
description: About Nucs AI Nucs AI is revolutionizing cancer care through cutting-edge AI and medical imaging technology. Founded in 2024 by a multidisciplinary team of oncologists, AI researchers, and healthcare innovators, we’re tackling one of medicine’s most pressing challenges: the growing demand for accurate, timely cancer diagnostics in the face of rising scan volumes and limited radiologist capacity. We sit at the intersection of diagnostics and treatment planning - building AI-powered tools at the convergence of medical imaging, radioligand therapy, and artificial intelligence. Starting with prostate cancer and expanding across oncology, we partner with world-leading medical institutions and pharmaceutical companies across the US, Europe, and Australia to bring precision oncology into everyday clinical practice. Our mission is to enhance diagnostic precision and expand access to expert-level cancer care, improving patient outcomes worldwide. We’re venture-backed, early-stage, and building a team that blends deep clinical expertise with engineering intensity - moving with the rigor the medical field demands and the speed the problem deserves. What you'll do Build auditable data pipelines for large clinical, diagnostic, and medical imaging datasets in the cloud. Own statistical analysis across clinical studies, diagnostic performance, model evaluation, and data quality. Apply classical machine learning and deep learning methods to data analysis problems. Automated ontology induction from medical documents using large language models. Build dashboards and data observability tooling. Maintain strong data lineage, provenance, traceability, and reproducibility across data workflows. Produce analyses and supporting evidence that hold up in regulatory submissions and audits. What we're looking for A master's degree or PhD in computer science, data science, engineering, mathematics, statistics, physics, economics or a related discipline 3+ years of hands-on experience in data engineering or a closely related field, with demonstrated development of production-grade data solutions Proficiency in SQL and Python and software-development standards such as Git-based workflows, automated testing, code reviews and CI/CD Comfort working with medical imaging formats including DICOM and NIfTI. Practical experience with classical machine learning and explainable ML. Working fluency with deep learning and modern LLM tooling. Experience with cloud data infrastructure. We use GCP, but equivalent platforms are fine. A strong working understanding of data lineage, provenance, traceability, and reproducibility. Unusual attention to detail around data completeness, validity, consistency, and edge cases. Flexibility at adapting to new technologies Awareness of good software practices Strongly preferred Experience with medical imaging -clinical trials, pharmaceutical, healthcare or another regulated industry is an advantage Experience with knowledge graphs / temporal knowledge graphs Experience producing statistical analyses or technical evidence used in a regulatory submission. Experience with model interpretability techniques such as SHAP. Why Nucs AI Mission with real impact – Your work directly improves how cancer patients are diagnosed and treated. Ground-floor opportunity – Early-stage company, meaningful equity, and outsized influence on the direction we take. World-class collaborators – Work alongside leading oncologists, nuclear medicine physicians, and AI researchers globally. Massive market tailwinds – Radioligand therapy and AI-driven oncology are multi-billion dollar growth markets. Autonomy and flexibility – Remote-first, flexible working. We hire great people and trust them to deliver. Equity upside – Competitive equity package. We’re building something big and want you to share in it. title: HR Adviseur
description: Als HR Adviseur binnen Matrix Fitness ben je een echte HR generalist en houd jij je bezig met het algehele personeelsbeleid en de salarisadministratie. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor jouw afdelingen waarvoor je het volledige HR beleid operationeel handen en voeten geeft. Is dit jouw volgende uitdaging? Jouw sportieve uitdaging: Het betreft een generalistische adviseursrol waarbij je jouw afdelingen faciliteert in de volledige HR dienstverlening. Van het werven van nieuwe collega’s tot het faciliteren van een goede offboarding, alle facetten komen in deze rol voorbij. Zo ben je ook verantwoordelijk voor het stroomlijnen en bijhouden van onze HR-administratie met behulp van ons personeelssysteem (AFAS) en beheer je het volledige scala aan operationele HR-taken voor het personeel. Hierbij kun je denken aan het monitoren en uitvoeren van het administratieve in- en uitdienst proces, verzuimbegeleiding van begin tot eind binnen de afdeling, het beantwoorden van HR gerelateerde vraagstukken vanuit jouw afdelingen en jouw manager en het proactief adviseren van leidinggevenden. Naast de verantwoordelijkheid voor jouw eigen afdelingen en de salarisadministratie, draag je ook de verantwoordelijkheid voor het thema ‘Vitaliteit', waarbij je een vitaliteitsdraaiboek uitvoert, bijhoudt en iedere twee jaar vernieuwd. Kortom, een veelzijdige functie waarin je de ruimte hebt om een significante impact te maken op belangrijke HR-onderwerpen binnen onze organisatie. De organisatie bestaat uit 235 werknemers, waarvan 26 leidinggevende, verdeeld over 3 landen (België, Nederland & Denemarken). Ben jij een enthousiaste en ervaren HR adviseur en werk je graag in een commerciële en sportieve werkomgeving? Dan is deze vacature wat voor jou en kijken we ernaar uit om je in ons team te verwelkomen! Je kunt bij ons rekenen op: salaris tot €5.932,- bruto per maand, afhankelijk van je kennis en ervaring; een uitstekend pensioen waarbij Matrix het grootste deel voor haar rekening neemt; 25 vakantiedagen met de optie om er 5 bij te kopen; gratis fitnessfaciliteiten op kantoor; gezellige kantine met complete keuken waarin je jouw lunch kunt voorbereiden; een digitaal leerplatform waar je vrijuit aan jouw persoonlijke ontwikkeling kunt werken; een jaarlijkse sportdag; de juiste middelen om je functie uitstekend uit te kunnen oefenen; veel ruimte voor nieuwe initiatieven en ideeën; vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid, de basis van onze Matrix Mentaliteit!; een job bij de leukste en snelst groeiende fitnessorganisatie van de Benelux; een inspirerend en enthousiast team; hierdoor leer je elke dag wel iets bij. De ideale kandidaat heeft: hbo werk- en/of denkniveau met een afgeronde opleiding HRM; minimaal 5 jaar relevante werkervaring in een adviserende rol; uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden; goede kennis van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal; uitstekende kennis van MS Office (o.a. Excel, Outlook); kennis van (en ervaring met) werken met AFAS (bij voorkeur vanuit een applicatiebeheerdersrol); de mentaliteit van een topsporter, je gaat ervoor! Hier kom je terecht Wij zijn gevestigd in Houten en de snelst groeiende leverancier van professionele fitnessapparatuur in de Benelux. Onze toestellen staan bij fitnesscentra, fysiotherapeuten, onderwijsinstellingen, hotels, bedrijven en topsport accommodaties. Als dochter van het in Taiwan opgerichte Johnson Health Tech kunnen we de voordelen van een wereldspeler bieden, maar kom je terecht in een lokaal en toegewijd team. En bij ons mag je ook nog eens sporten tijdens werktijd. Hoe tof is dat?! Mensen maken Matrix En dat is echt zo. Wij zijn een platte en dynamische organisatie waarin onze mensen het verschil maken. Binnen het bedrijf zijn de lijnen kort. Er wordt snel geschakeld en iedereen draagt veel eigen verantwoordelijkheid. De sfeer is informeel en het teamgevoel is bijna letterlijk voelbaar. title: Stage – Assistant marketing digital & commercial – Voyages d’aventure
description: D'abord, quelques mots sur nous Chez Nature Occitane, nous avons une conviction : les plus beaux voyages ne sont pas forcément ceux qui nous emmènent le plus loin. Tour-opérateur réceptif (DMC) indépendant, nous concevons et organisons des voyages à pied, à vélo et multiactivités en famille, en liberté ou accompagnés. Du Canal du Midi aux Pyrénées, en passant par les Cévennes, l'Aubrac et la Catalogne, nous invitons nos voyageurs à découvrir les territoires autrement, à leur rythme et au plus près de la nature. Notre ambition ? Développer une autre façon de voyager, plus respectueuse de l'environnement et des territoires, en privilégiant les mobilités douces, les expériences authentiques et les rencontres locales. Pour accompagner notre développement, nous recherchons un(e) stagiaire passionné(e) de voyages et d'outdoor pour rejoindre notre équipe d'Alénya. Tes missions Aux côtés de notre équipe, tu participeras activement au développement de la notoriété de Nature Occitane, à la visibilité de nos voyages et à leur commercialisation. Ton stage s'articulera autour de deux missions complémentaires : le marketing digital (80 %) et le conseil et la vente de voyages (20 %). 1. Marketing digital – 4 jours par semaine SEO et rédaction web : participer à l'optimisation du référencement naturel de notre nouveau site internet, rédiger et enrichir les contenus de nos pages destinations, séjours et articles de blog. Acquisition digitale (SEA) : participer au suivi et à l'analyse de nos campagnes publicitaires, en collaboration avec nos prestataires spécialisés. Newsletters et CRM : participer à la conception, à la rédaction et à la diffusion de nos campagnes d'e-mailing, ainsi qu'à la segmentation de notre base de contacts. Réseaux sociaux : contribuer à l'élaboration du calendrier éditorial, à la création de contenus et à l'animation de nos communautés. Analyse des performances : suivre les principaux indicateurs marketing, analyser les résultats des actions menées et proposer des pistes d'amélioration. Développement marketing : contribuer à la réflexion et à la mise en œuvre d'actions visant à développer la visibilité et les ventes sur l'ensemble de notre offre de voyages. 2. Conseil & vente de voyages – 1 jour par semaine Accompagner nos clients dans le choix de leurs voyages à pied, à vélo ou en famille. Participer à la préparation des devis et des propositions personnalisées. Participer au suivi des demandes commerciales et contribuer à leur concrétisation. Identifier les attentes et les motivations de nos voyageurs afin d'enrichir nos actions marketing. Cette immersion commerciale te permettra de mieux comprendre nos clients, nos produits et les réalités de notre métier, pour donner davantage de sens à tes actions marketing. Ces missions pourront évoluer au cours du stage, en fonction de tes compétences, de tes objectifs pédagogiques et des projets de l'entreprise. Le profil que nous recherchons Tu es étudiant(e) en marketing digital, communication ou école de commerce, idéalement en Master 2 à la recherche d'un stage de fin d'études. Au-delà de ton parcours, nous recherchons surtout une personnalité : Passionnée par les voyages, la randonnée, le vélo et les activités de pleine nature. Dotée d'excellentes qualités rédactionnelles et d'une bonne capacité de synthèse. À l'aise avec les outils digitaux et les enjeux du référencement naturel. Capable d'allier créativité et esprit d'analyse. Curieuse, organisée, rigoureuse, autonome et force de proposition. Dotée d'un bon relationnel et d'un véritable sens du service client. À l'aise en anglais. Sensible aux enjeux du tourisme durable et aux voyages bas carbone. Une première expérience en marketing digital, notamment en SEO, rédaction web ou acquisition digitale, serait particulièrement appréciée. Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? Participer au développement d'un tour-opérateur indépendant, à taille humaine et en pleine croissance. Développer des compétences concrètes en marketing digital, acquisition clients et commercialisation de voyages. Participer à des projets stratégiques et mesurer concrètement l'impact de tes actions. Être accompagné(e) par notre équipe et nos prestataires spécialisés en marketing digital. Profiter d'un cadre de travail particulièrement agréable, au sein d'un tiers-lieu à Alénya, propice aux échanges, à la créativité et au bien-être. Évoluer dans une équipe passionnée de voyages et d'outdoor. Contribuer à un projet entrepreneurial engagé pour un tourisme plus responsable. Poste basé à Alénya (Pyrénées-Orientales). Gratification selon la réglementation en vigueur. Tickets-restaurant. Accompagnement par une équipe expérimentée. Perspectives d'embauche en CDI à l'issue du stage , selon la qualité de notre collaboration et les perspectives de développement de l'entreprise. title: Senior Named Account Executive, Melbourne
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Location: Melbourne<br></strong></p> <hr> <p><strong>About the Department</strong></p> <p>The Cloudflare APAC sales organisation operates as one integrated revenue system. Account Executives, Customer Engineers, Partner Account Managers, Business Development Representatives, Customer Experience Managers, Professional Services and Revenue Operations work as a continuous engine - winning, deploying, adopting, expanding, and scaling platform commitments across the full customer lifecycle.</p> <p>The system is supported by an AI-embedded operating model. The work itself, however, remains human. The role of every seller at Cloudflare is to bring critical thinking, judgment, and trust to customer relationships and outcomes.</p> <p><strong>About This Role</strong></p> <p>We are seeking a highly accomplished Senior Account Executive to join our Enterprise Field Sales team, based in Melbourne.</p> <p>This is a high-agency, hunter-led enterprise sales role focused on winning new business and expanding Cloudflare’s presence across target accounts and other priority enterprise accounts in Melbourne and Victoria. You will be responsible for building and progressing strategic opportunities in complex organisations where access is hard-won, decision-making is distributed, and the sales cycle requires sustained executive engagement, internal alignment, and disciplined execution.</p> <p>This role is for a seller who is relentless in creating demand, skilled at mobilising internal and external stakeholders, and comfortable navigating long, multi-threaded enterprise buying processes. You will be expected to drive urgency, challenge inertia, and position Cloudflare as a strategic platform partner across security, networking, resilience, and application performance.</p> <p>You are the kind of operator who thrives in ambiguity, leads with insight, and uses AI as a force multiplier every day. You care deeply about customer outcomes, move with pace and precision, and bring the resilience required to win complex enterprise deals.</p> <p><strong>Role Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Aggressive New Logo Hunting: Identify, create, and close new enterprise opportunities across priority accounts. Build trust, shape urgency, and create the business case for change around security, networking, and infrastructure transformation.</li> <li>Executive Engagement - Internal: Mobilise and align Cloudflare stakeholders across Customer Engineering, Product, Partner teams, Deal Desk, Legal, and Revenue Operations to support deal strategy, remove blockers, and move opportunities forward with pace and discipline.</li> <li>Long-Cycle Enterprise Execution: Own complex sales cycles from first engagement through close. Manage multiple workstreams, procurement and security reviews, technical validation, commercial negotiation, and executive sponsorship over extended timeframes.</li> <li>Multi-Stakeholder Management: Build and maintain influence across diverse buying committees, including business, technical, commercial, and procurement stakeholders. Keep the deal moving by understanding each party’s priorities and decision criteria.</li> <li>Pipeline Discipline and Forecast Integrity: Build a strong, qualified enterprise pipeline and maintain forecast accuracy. Understand deal risk, stage integrity, and the concrete next steps required to convert opportunity into revenue.</li> <li>Commercial and Technical Credibility: Develop a deep understanding of enterprise operating environments and translate Cloudflare’s capabilities into clear business outcomes, risk reduction, and operational simplification.</li> <li>Strategic Value Creation: Position Cloudflare as a platform partner that enables transformation, not just a vendor that sells point products. Build durable executive relationships that support both near-term wins and long-term expansion.</li> <li>Organisational Impact: Share learnings, contribute to deal strategy, and raise the bar for enterprise execution across the wider team.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Required Experience</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience.</li> <li>Proven success selling into large enterprise accounts (ie, Retail, FSI, etc)</li> <li>Strong track record of winning new enterprise logos and closing complex, multi-stakeholder deals.</li> <li>Demonstrated success carrying and exceeding multi-million dollar quota targets.</li> <li>Experience selling infrastructure, networking, security, or platform technology into enterprise accounts.</li> <li>Strong executive discovery, business-case creation, competitive selling, negotiation, and closing skills.</li> <li>Deep understanding of enterprise networking, cloud security, and infrastructure transformation.</li> <li>Excellent communication, presence, and credibility with senior customer stakeholders.</li> <li>Comfortable operating in long sales cycles with multiple decision-makers and high technical complexity.</li> <li>Proficiency with Salesforce, Tableau, and Google Workspace.</li> <li>High judgment, curiosity, resilience, and personal accountability.</li> <li>Comfortable using AI tools to improve account planning, research, and deal execution.</li> <li>Ability to travel as required to engage customers on site and deepen strategic relationships.</li> <li>Strong communication skills.</li> </ul> <p><br><br></p> <div id="te-floating-button-container"></div> <div id="te-floating-button-container"></div> <div id="te-floating-button-container"></div> <div title: Senior Electronics Hardware Engineer (m/f/d)
description: As a Senior Electronics Hardware Engineer, you will develop the electronic systems at the heart of our electric powertrain solutions, taking ownership from requirements and circuit design through PCB development, bring-up, verification and validation. Your work will help us turn new electronics concepts into robust, reliable and production-ready hardware. This end-to-end scope is consistent with comparable senior electronics roles in Munich, where ownership typically extends from schematics and PCB design through prototype bring-up, EMC, validation and production transfer. You have a solid understanding of analog and digital electronics, power electronics and embedded hardware. You are confident working in an electronics laboratory with equipment such as oscilloscopes, multimeters and power supplies. title: Principal Solution Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>Strength in Trust </h3> <p><span data-contrast="auto">OneTrust’s mission is to enable innovation through the responsible use of data and AI. We believe that ensuring data is trusted shouldn’t slow teams down—it should accelerate what’s possible. This led us to develop the first technology platform for responsible data use in 2016. Today, with AI representing the latest and most impactful expansion of data yet, OneTrust is once again redefining what responsible innovation looks like. OneTrust, the AI‑Ready Governance Platform™, unifies regulatory intelligence, automation, and connected governance workflows so businesses can continue to move at the speed of AI while ensuring good governance to prevent data misuse at scale. Trusted by thousands of organizations worldwide, OneTrust is shaping the future where trusted data becomes a transformative force for business and society.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p></div><h3 class="_9k2iva0 p8i6j0d _1ibi0s3e heading3 _9k2iva1">The Challenge</h3> <p class="p8i6j01 paragraph"></p> <p>We’re looking for a Principal Solutions Engineer to shape and lead technical strategy for OneTrust’s most strategic and complex opportunities in France. Reporting to the Director of Solutions Engineering, you will bring broad portfolio fluency, deep enterprise technology expertise, executive-level customer engagement, and commercial judgement to help customers solve business-critical challenges with OneTrust.</p> <p>You will partner closely with Sales, Customer Success, Product, Engineering and partners to build deep account alignment, progress complex buying decisions, and create measurable customer and commercial outcomes. You will be a trusted advisor to senior customer stakeholders and a force multiplier for the Solutions Engineering organisation: setting s high bar, developing reusable approaches, and coaching others to raise the quality of our work. AI Governance is an important area of expertise for this role, alongside the breadth to lead opportunities across OneTrust’s entire platform.</p> <p class="p8i6j01 paragraph"></p> <h3 class="_9k2iva0 p8i6j0d _1ibi0s3e heading3 _9k2iva1">Your Mission</h3> <ul class="p8i6j08 p8i6j02"> <li class="p8i6j0b">Lead technical strategy for complex, strategic sales opportunities, from discovery and solution design through executive presentations, RFPs, and proof-of-concept evaluations.</li> <li class="p8i6j0b">Advise customers on integration architecture, platform capabilities, implementation approaches, and technical best practices aligned to their objectives and environment.</li> <li class="p8i6j0b">Design and guide tailored demonstrations and proof-of-concept evaluations that clearly connect OneTrust’s capabilities to customer requirements and measurable outcomes.</li> <li class="p8i6j0b">Partner with Sales leaders to build opportunity strategy, navigate technical and competitive considerations, and communicate differentiated value to technical and business stakeholders.</li> <li class="p8i6j0b">Serve as a trusted technical advisor in customer conversations, including architecture deep dives and discussions involving enterprise systems, APIs, cloud environments, and deployment patterns.</li> <li class="p8i6j0b">Coordinate with Product, R&D, technical integrations, and partner teams to validate capabilities, influence product direction, and bring customer feedback into the business.</li> <li class="p8i6j0b">Share expertise across the Solutions Engineering organization by coaching peers, developing repeatable technical assets and approaches, and helping strengthen the team’s engagement practices.</li> <li class="p8i6j0b">Build and maintain a strong understanding of the privacy industry, regulatory environment, competitive landscape, and evolving customer needs; apply that knowledge to customer engagements and solution strategy.</li> </ul> <h3 class="_9k2iva0 p8i6j0d _1ibi0s3e heading3 _9k2iva1">You Are</h3> <p class="p8i6j01 paragraph">You are a credible, customer-focused technical leader who can move comfortably between business outcomes and detailed architecture. You bring sound judgment to ambiguous, fast-moving opportunities, communicate complex topics clearly, and influence stakeholders across customers and internal teams. title: Analytics - Future Leaders Graduate Program
description: <h2><strong>Real ownership. Real impact. Build from day one.</strong></h2> <p>Are you an ambitious graduate ready to tackle complex<strong>,</strong> real-world challenges at the intersection of data, strategy and tech? </p> <p><strong>The Future Leaders Graduate Program – Business Analytics</strong> at Picnic is a two-year launchpad for exceptional talents. From day one, you join a business team, own a business topic, and become an expert in your field.</p> <p>At Picnic, we’re building the future of grocery. Using cutting-edge technology and data-driven innovation, we challenge the status quo and build the world’s smartest, most customer-focused supermarket. <br>We move fast, think big, and turn bold ideas into tangible impact.</p> <h2><strong>Tricks of the trade</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Lead with ambition</strong>: Bring your relentless determination, creativity, and grit. Take the driver’s seat and redefine the grocery shopping experience for millions. You will be expected to think independently, move fast, and deliver results.</li> <li><strong>Steep learning curve</strong>: Your growth comes from owning real problems, testing your ideas, learning from your mistakes and starting again. You'll blend hands-on training with immediate execution, you’ll move at a pace that accelerates your growth like nowhere else.</li> <li><strong>Solve real-life puzzles</strong>: Spot opportunities, use tools at the forefront of technology, and own the outcome end to end. Not just making slides, but building the solution yourself.</li> <li><strong>Innovate across borders</strong>: You’ll collaborate with teams across the Netherlands, Germany, and France, tackling challenges that redefine how Picnic operates at a European scale.</li> <li><strong>High-performance environment</strong>: You’ll work alongside some of the best teams in analytics and tech, people who set a high bar and expect you to do the same.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>From learning to leading</strong></h2> <p> </p> <p>Throughout the two-year program, you’ll own business-critical projects from start to finish, supported by mentorship, learning sessions, and regular feedback.</p> <p>You’ll strengthen your leadership skills in project management, storytelling, stakeholder communication, and giving and receiving feedback, while sharpening your technical skills in Python, SQL, Excel, and PowerPoint.</p> <p>As your scope grows, so does your responsibility. You might scale your initial project or take on new challenges within the same domain. Either way, the pace is yours to set, and there’s always a new challenge to lead and an opportunity to make an impact. That’s why every journey is unique: there’s no standardized path through the program, just continuous opportunities to learn, and lead.</p> <p> </p> <h3><strong>Where you’ll make an impact</strong></h3> <p>From day one, you’ll be embedded in a business team, taking ownership in one of the following domains:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Consumer</strong> - Drive growth through pricing, supplier strategy, and our market strategy. Think: Shaping our successful market entry into new cities. Your decisions shape how millions of customers experience Picnic.</li> <li><strong>Logistics </strong>- Build the backbone of Picnic: robotic fulfilment, demand forecasting, route optimization across Europe and much more</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Your superpowers</strong></h2> <p>You don't wait for permission. You see a problem, build the solution, and bring people with you, before anyone asks. You've probably already started something: a project, a product, a business, an initiative that didn't exist until you made it happen.<br><br>More specifically, you:</p> <ul> <li>Are about to graduate (or recently graduated) a Masters in a <strong>quantitative field</strong></li> <li>Have experience in <strong>high-performance environments:</strong> consulting, fast-growth startups, or competitive internships.</li> <li>Show an <strong>entrepreneurial mindset</strong>: you build, improve, and take ownership without being asked</li> <li><strong>Think like a builder</strong>: hands-on, curious, and driven to challenge the status quo with practical solutions</li> <li>You have already gained basic knowledge in <strong>PowerPoint, Python, SQL, Excel</strong> or alternative coding languages </li> <li><strong>EU citizenship</strong> or valid <strong>EU working permit required</strong>.</li> </ul> <p><em>Many strong candidates (particularly women) talk themselves out of applying because they don't tick every box. If this excites you and you believe you have what it takes, apply. </em><em>We only hire when we find the right match. That’s why our selection process is intentionally highly selective.</em></p> <h2><strong> </strong><strong>Why Picnic?</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Grow as we grow</strong>. We’re scaling quickly across countries and millions of customers and this is just the start. Grow your impact as we grow; we invest in your path but the driver's seat is always yours.</li> <li><strong>Work with other innovators. </strong>Work with a driven, energetic team that builds, wins, and celebrates together (think of legendary Friday drinks, our Ski trip and our parties)</li> <li><strong>Kickstart your career. </strong>Earn a competitive salary and step into a program designed to launch your long-term future at Picnic.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>When are you joining? </strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Fall Edition 2026<br></strong>Start dates: September, October<br><em>*earlier or later dates can be arranged, please indicate your preference in the application question</em></li> </ul> <ul> <li><strong>Spring Edition 2027<br></strong>Start dates: February, March<br><em>*earlier or later dates can be arranged, please indicate your preference in the application question</em></li> </ul> <p>📍 Location: Full-time in Paris, with period trips to NL and DE<br><br><span style="text-decoration: underline;">There is no </span><strong><span style="text-decoration: underline;">deadline</span>:</strong> Our aim is to find the most ambitious people out there. We onboard talents on a monthly basis, so whether you join in April or August, you’ll always have a group of people sharing the ride. </p> <p> </p> <h2><strong>Picnic Perks</strong></h2> <p><strong>🚲Health and Transportation</strong><br>Through our partnerships with Malakoff Humanis and OpenUp, you have the opportunity to enroll in our company health insurance plan, as well as free and easy access to professional psychologists, workshops, and practical tools. Additionally, if you commute to work using public transportation, we reimburse 50% of your subscription cost.</p> <p><strong>🍉Food</strong><br>Since we are located in the center of Paris, there is no on-site cafeteria. However, you will receive meal vouchers worth €11 per day to explore all the delicious restaurants nearby. Our small kitchen is also stocked with tasty snacks and refreshments.</p> <p><strong>📈Personal and Professional Development</strong><br>You will have the opportunity to develop your skills not only through exciting projects and a dynamic environment but also via training programs offered by Lepaya.</p> <p><strong>🏖️All the rest</strong><br>You get 25 days of paid vacation, plus additional rest days (RTT) based on the number of days worked in the year. Picnic provides you with a laptop, a phone, and a paid SIM card.<br>🚀Access to exclusive deals and perks through our Works Council (CSE) and our partner Swile (gift cards, concert tickets, cinema discounts, and more)</p> <h3><strong>FAQ</strong></h3> <p><strong>Do I need a quantitative background? </strong>It's a strong advantage, but not a hard requirement. If your internships and projects demonstrate real hands-on ownership and data-driven thinking, we'll consider your application. You do need a Master's degree, basic knowledge of Python or SQL, and relevant work experience.</p> <p><strong>Does the program include rotations?</strong> No, intentionally. We believe depth creates ownership, and ownership creates impact. Rather than rotating across teams, you’ll go deep in one area, build real expertise, and gradually expand your scope as your impact grows. If you have topic preferences, tell us during the process.</p> <p><strong>In what language should I apply?</strong> English. Please include your CV and Master's degree transcript or any other relevant test scores (e.g., GMAT)</p> <p><strong>What are the long-term opportunities after the program? </strong>This program is a fast track into a high-impact career at Picnic, it’s an entry point for a long-term future, not a two-year stopover. </p> <p>Career paths here are as varied as the people on them. Some grow vertically, building deep expertise and a team around them as their project expands. Others move laterally - from Commercial to Fulfilment, Distribution to Customer, or wherever their strengths and ambitions take them. What they share is real ownership, real impact, and a career they shaped themselves.<br><br><br></p> <p><iframe src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/yEQXLpeYN84?si=It-z9-XNLVMDeHEy" width="560" height="315"></iframe></p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Site Reliability Engineer - Platform Reliability
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.</p></div><p></p> <h2>What is the role</h2> <p>Platform Infrastructure provides the infrastructure, tooling, processes and services that more than a thousand Elastic engineers depend on. We are about 110 people across ten teams in three groups: Core Infrastructure, Reliability Engineering, and Engineering Productivity & Developer Experience. We run the multi-cloud platform underneath Elastic Cloud Hosted and Serverless, the shared Kubernetes platform other Elastic teams build on, the observability estate that shows Cloud engineers what production is doing, and the release path the whole Elastic Stack ships through.</p> <p>As an SRE here you take an engineering approach to reliability. You write the Go, Python and Terraform that replaces manual work, you carry the on-call rotation for what your team runs, and you work with Cloud engineering to close the gaps you find.</p> <p>Elastic is expanding its Serverless offerring, and most of what we build sits underneath it. Current work includes packing hundreds of customer projects onto shared clusters, PrivateLink and static IPs, new regions, a single identity layer across the stack, and new government regions. We are also replacing manually managed services with code-managed systems, which lets the platform grow without the on-call load growing with it.</p> <h2>Why join us</h2> <ul> <li>The scale is large. We run across multiple cloud providers and many regions, and some teams operate 200+ production deployments of our own product.</li> <li>We are customer zero for Elastic Cloud Hosted, Serverless and the observability and security products, so new features land on our systems first and our feedback goes back to the product teams.</li> <li>The engineers who use what you build are a thousand colleagues you can go and talk to.</li> <li>On-call follows the sun, which keeps the burden outside working hours small.</li> <li>We are fully distributed across EMEA, NASA and APJ and the work happens in writing, so you control how you run your day.</li> </ul> <h2>What You Will Be Doing</h2> <ul> <li>You own systems end to end as the DRI on a project, and you break the work down yourself.</li> <li>Own the outcome of projects on your team’s roadmap as the DRI, breaking the work down and pulling in help when you need it.</li> <li>Operate and harden the infrastructure that other Elastic engineers depend on, managed as code with Terraform, Go and Python.</li> <li>Build tools and services that remove manual work.</li> <li>Carry the on-call rotation for what your team runs, drive incidents to resolution and write RCAs that lead to lasting fixes.</li> <li>Improve observability, runbooks and documentation so the on-call load gets lighter over time.</li> <li>Review code and designs, and act as a second set of eyes on production changes to critical infrastructure.</li> <li>Raise risks and ideas without being asked, and mentor engineers with less experience.</li> <li>Give feedback to the Elastic product teams on the features that reach our systems first.</li> </ul> <h2>What You Bring</h2> <ul> <li>3+ years in SRE, platform engineering or infrastructure engineering, including real time operating what you built.</li> <li>Experience with Terraform at multi-workspace scale.</li> <li>Strong software engineering fundamentals in Go or Python, the languages most of what we build is written in.</li> <li>Extensive experience carrying on-call, resolving incidents under pressure and writing RCAs that hold up under review.</li> </ul> <h2>How you work</h2> <ul> <li>You take an ambiguous project, come back with a plan and own it to the end.</li> <li>You say when an estimate or a sequence is wrong before the team commits to it.</li> <li>You write clearly, because we work across nine time zones and the work happens in tickets and channels.</li> <li>You stay calm when something is broken, communicate while you work and write the follow-up that stops it happening again.</li> </ul> <p></p><div class="content-conclusion"><h2><strong>Additional Information - We Take Care of Our People</strong></h2> <p>As a distributed company, diversity drives our identity. Whether you’re looking to launch a new career or grow an existing one, Elastic is the type of company where you can balance great work with great life. Your age is only a number. It doesn’t matter if you’re just out of college or your children are; we need you for what you can do.</p> <p>We strive to have parity of benefits across regions and while regulations differ from place to place, we believe taking care of our people is the right thing to do.</p> <ul> <li>Competitive pay based on the work you do here and not your previous salary</li> <li>Health coverage for you and your family in many locations</li> <li>Ability to craft your calendar with flexible locations and schedules for many roles</li> <li>Generous number of vacation days each year</li> <li>Increase your impact - We match up to $2000 (or local currency equivalent) for financial donations and service</li> <li>Up to 40 hours each year to use toward volunteer projects you love</li> <li>Embracing parenthood with minimum of 16 weeks of parental leave</li> </ul> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Different people approach problems differently. We need that. Elastic is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law, ordinance or regulation.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We welcome individuals with disabilities and strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all individuals. To request an accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please email </span><span style="font-weight: ----- style="font-weight: 400;"> We will reply to your request within 24 business hours of submission.</span></p> <p><span style="color: #000000;">Applicants have rights under Federal Employment Laws, view posters linked below:</span> <a href="https://www.dol.gov/sites/dolgov/files/WHD/legacy/files/fmlaen.pdf" target="_blank">Family and Medical Leave Act (FMLA)</a> <span style="color: #000000;">Poster;</span><span style="color: #000000;"> <a href="https://www.dol.gov/sites/dolgov/files/ofccp/pdf/pay-transp_%20English_formattedESQA508c.pdf" target="_blank">Pay Transparency Nondiscrimination Provision</a> Poster; </span><a href="https://www.dol.gov/sites/dolgov/files/WHD/legacy/files/eppabw.pdf" target="_blank">Employee Polygraph Protection Act (EPPA)</a> <span style="color: #000000;">Poster and <a href="https://www.dol.gov/sites/dolgov/files/OFCCP/regs/compliance/posters/pdf/22-088_EEOC_KnowYourRights.pdf" target="_blank">Know Your Rights</a> (Poster)</span></p> <p><span style="color: #000000;">Elasticsearch develops and distributes encryption software and technology that is subject to U.S. export controls and licensing requirements for individuals who are located in or are nationals of the following sanctioned countries and regions: Belarus, Cuba, Iran, North Korea, Russia, Syria, the Crimea Region of Ukraine, the Donetsk People’s Republic (“DNR”), and the Luhansk People’s Republic (“LNR”). title: Senior Mechanical Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About IonQ: </strong><strong><br></strong></p> <p><u><a href="https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fionq.com%2F&esheet=54451094&newsitemid=20260316477473&lan=en-US&anchor=IonQ%2C+Inc&index=7&md5=0818ffbedc6dbad8c4d1611ac94c2a0f" target="_blank">IonQ, Inc</a></u>. [NYSE: IONQ] is the world’s leading quantum platform and merchant supplier - delivering integrated quantum solutions across computing, networking, sensing, and security. IonQ’s newest generation of quantum computers, the IonQ Tempo, is the latest in a line of cutting-edge systems that have been helping customers and partners including <u><a href="https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fionq.com%2Fnews%2Fionq-speeds-quantum-accelerated-drug-development-application-with&esheet=54451094&newsitemid=20260316477473&lan=en-US&anchor=Amazon+Web+Services%2C&index=8&md5=a7f94ee9b71a392dca3cd6c413722e51" target="_blank">Amazon Web Services, </a></u><u><a href="https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fionq.com%2Fnews%2Fionq-speeds-quantum-accelerated-drug-development-application-with&esheet=54451094&newsitemid=20260316477473&lan=en-US&anchor=and&index=9&md5=2bed627b388878763f41ffe0e4edb16c" target="_blank">and </a></u><u><a href="https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fionq.com%2Fnews%2Fionq-speeds-quantum-accelerated-drug-development-application-with&esheet=54451094&newsitemid=20260316477473&lan=en-US&anchor=AstraZeneca&index=10&md5=757c1f2c2ec94cf3982700106122164f" target="_blank">AstraZeneca</a></u> achieve 20x performance results and accelerate innovation in drug discovery, materials science, financial modeling, logistics, cybersecurity, and defense. In 2025, the company achieved 99.99% two-qubit gate fidelity, <u><a href="https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fionq.com%2Fnews%2Fionq-achieves-landmark-result-setting-new-world-record-in-quantum-computing&esheet=54451094&newsitemid=20260316477473&lan=en-US&anchor=setting+a+world+record+in+quantum+computing+performance&index=11&md5=32e9cb88afbd439026a352666cc72c91" target="_blank">setting a world record in quantum computing performance</a></u>.<br><br>Headquartered in College Park, Maryland, IonQ has operations in California, Colorado, Massachusetts, Tennessee, Washington, Italy, South Korea, Sweden, Switzerland, Canada, and the United Kingdom. Our quantum computing services are available through all major cloud providers, while we also meet the needs of networking and sensing customers across land, sea, air, and space. IonQ is making quantum platforms more accessible and impactful than ever before.  </p></div><h3>Role</h3> <p>At Oxford Ionics, now part of IonQ, we are building the first practical quantum computer. Our systems are based on ion traps, which hold individual atomic ions tens of microns above the surface of a chip, and we design and build them in house, bringing together optomechanics, vacuum and cryogenic technology, electronics and system infrastructure.</p> <p>We are looking for a Senior Mechanical Engineer to join our Systems team and take ownership of mechanical design from first requirements through to manufacture and integration. You will work on the hardware that surrounds the quantum processor, including cryostat requirements, cooling equipment, vacuum chambers and supporting structures, often in areas where the requirements are not yet fully defined.</p> <h3>Responsibilities:</h3> <p>You will work alongside scientists, technicians and the wider hardware design teams to bring new systems through to manufacture. That means producing CAD designs, bills of materials and assembly drawings, managing documentation in our PLM system and working with suppliers and our manufacturing team.</p> <p>Our manufacturing team handles most assembly, but you will support technicians in the lab, investigate problems when they arise and make sure your designs can be built in practice. description: Wat ga je doen? Tijdens deze stageopdracht duik je in het maandafsluitingsproces en verder optimalisering en automatisering hiervan. title: Senior Incident Response & Digital Forensics Consultant (m/w/d)
description: Who are we? It all starts with the mission: NVISO is here to protect European society from potentially devastating cyber attacks! This means we offer cyber security services to private and governmental organizations to help them better prepare for, prevent, detect and respond to cyber security incidents. All of this is built on four fundamental values that define who we are: We are Proud, We Break Barriers, We Care and No BS! Tasks As our Senior Incident Response Consultant (m/w/d) , you will support the NVISO incident response team (CSIRT) in responding to a wide range of cyber incidents. In addition to incident response and forensic engagements, you will work closely with the rest of the team to build & automate incident response processes, analytical capabilities, including threat hunting. You act as Incident Lead by setting investigative questions, delegating technical analysis tasks, and steer containment and eradication strategies. You produce high-quality forensic and executive reports to present findings to technical stakeholders and executives. You occasionally peer-review case notes, artifacts, and draft reports. Your responsibilities Perform host forensics (Magnet AXIOM Cyber, X-Ways, Autopsy), network forensics (Wireshark, tshark), memory forensics (Volatility, MemProcFS), and log analysis , including cloud telemetry (Microsoft 365/Azure, AWS, Google Cloud/Workspace), in support of cyber incident investigations. Lead single-system forensic analysis and contribute meaningfully to complex intrusions, including those with lateral movement, perform timeline analysis of compromised hosts and conduct live response artifact capture, volatile data collection, containment to support eradication and recovery efforts. Perform basic malware triage of executables and malicious scripts (static and behavioral) to inform containment and eradication strategies. Lead customer calls during incidents and contribute to cyber crisis management, and deliver status reports, planning for containment, eradication and recovery efforts, and input to executive-ready communications. Support improvement projects related to automation in digital forensics and further develop NVISO tools and incident response processes. Perform threat hunting engagements within customer environments, including technical planning, requirements definition, execution, and reporting. Assist in other engagements such as tabletop exercises, incident and forensic readiness assessments, and threat-intelligence-related briefings. Requirements You hold citizenship in one of the 32 NATO member states. 4+ years of hands-on experience, including acting as an incident response case lead. Strong knowledge of cyber intrusion analysis, incident response, digital forensics on Windows/MacOS/Unix, with demonstrated expertise in memory forensics (Volatility, MemProcFS), timeline analysis (e.g., MFTECmd, KAPE, Plaso/Timesketch), and disk forensics (Magnet AXIOM Cyber, X-Ways, Autopsy). Proficiency with live response tooling (e.g., Velociraptor, GRR Rapid Response, EDR live response) and coordinating remediation actions. Up-to-date on the latest cybersecurity threats and attacker TTPs. Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with an eye for detail in documentation. Effective communication and interpersonal skills to work collaboratively with clients and cross-functional teams. Ability to remain calm during crisis situations and prioritize effectively under pressure. Language: German and English at C1+ proficiency for client-facing work across DACH. Your availability We have an On-call rotation, typically one week per month. Travel Some limited travel within DE/AT/CH (~10–20%) for onsite response, workshops, and stakeholder meetings. Benefits At NVISO, we care. We are committed to offering you a highly competitive remuneration package including financial and non-financial components: Working and learning from the best people in the European cyber security industry. We have multiple SANS Instructors working at NVISO, our staff has presented at popular hacking conferences (BlackHat, BruCON, OWASP, etc) and all of our technical staff can acquire deep technical security certifications (GSE, GXPN, GREM, GCFA, OSCP, etc); An entrepreneurial and agile company, where you will be stimulated and supported in driving new initiatives (either through internal innovation or by improving our service offering), without losing sight of having fun! Regular team-building and fun events; Our commitment to coach and counsel you and help you grow; each employee receives a personal coach within the team, whose role is to ensure your well-being and helps you grow in your career! A training budget of 10,000 EUR plus 10 days paid time off rolling over two years; An annual gross base salary between 69,000 EUR and 87,000 EUR, depending on your experience; Flexible working hours and home office possibilities (incl. working abroad options within the EU); Reimbursement of Deutschlandticket + BahnCard 50 1st Class; Business Bike Leasing; Company Pension Scheme; 30 holidays. Disclaimer on the Use of AI Tools in the Application Process Please be aware that the creation and submission of application documents (e.g. CV, cover letter, case studies, etc.) using AI-powered tools is only permitted to a limited extent . Our expectations: Application documents must authentically reflect your own qualifications, personality, and motivation. The use of AI for supportive purposes (e.g. spell-checking, improving wording) is acceptable. Fully generated application documents created by AI without personal adaptation or review are not permitted. Under no circumstances may NVISO information, data, or documents be uploaded to or processed by external AI tools. We reserve the right to exclude applications from the selection and interview process that are clearly created primarily or exclusively by AI and show no recognizable personal input. The purpose of this policy is to ensure a fair and transparent recruitment process and to obtain an authentic impression of our applicants. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Country Commercial Manager - France
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3><strong>A</strong><strong>BOUT TIDE</strong></h3> <p>At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.</p> <p>Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, Germany and France.</p> <p>Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.</p> <p><strong>Tide facts:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Tide is available for UK, German and French SMEs</li> <li>Over 2 million members globally and rapidly growing</li> <li>Over $300 million raised in funding</li> <li>3,000 Tideans globally</li> <li>We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg</li> </ul></div><h2><strong>About the team </strong></h2> <p>Tide is the leading business financial platform founded in the UK, empowering over 1 million small businesses to grow and succeed. Now expanding in France, Tide offers innovative financial tools and services to micro-entrepreneurs, freelancers, independent professionals (professions libérales) and small and medium-sized businesses (TPE/PME). Our mission is to save business owners time and money, enabling them to focus on what they do best - running their business.</p> <p>You’ll be joining a dedicated and dynamic team in Paris focused on driving Tide’s market success in France. The Tide France team is in an exciting growth phase, bringing together professionals with deep expertise in fintech, product development and French market dynamics. As part of this expanding team, you’ll have the unique opportunity to shape Tide’s presence in France, working collaboratively to deliver innovative solutions for French small business owners. This is your chance to play a pivotal role in establishing the foundation for our long-term success in this key market.</p> <h2><strong>About the role </strong></h2> <p>We are seeking an exceptional <strong>Senior</strong> <strong>Country Commercial Manager</strong>, based in Paris, to drive the growth of Tide’s business accounts and payment solutions in France. In this pivotal role, you will lead product growth initiatives, leveraging analytics, customer insights, and market trends to position Tide as a leading financial partner for small businesses in France.</p> <p>As the Senior Country Commercial Manager, you will have accountability for French revenues, working closely with our Product, Engineering, and Marketing teams. Reporting directly to the Country Managing Director France, your expertise in the French market, SME customer behaviour and regulatory landscape (ACPR, PSD2, the e-invoicing reform) will be instrumental in shaping Tide’s offering and driving strategic growth.</p> <p><strong>Some of the things you’ll be doing:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Revenue Ownership: </strong>Take ownership for driving revenue growth across product lines in France. Develop and execute strategies to meet revenue targets, working closely with cross-functional teams to ensure alignment between product offerings, pricing, and go-to-market initiatives.</li> </ul> <ul> <li><strong>Local Market Expertise: </strong>Collaborate with the product research teams to conduct French market research to uncover customer needs, analyse a competitive landscape of neobanks and traditional banks, and identify market opportunities, such as the e-invoicing mandate (facturation électronique) rolling out from September 2026. Translate these insights into actionable strategies to enhance Tide’s product offerings.</li> <li><strong>Product Localization and Development: </strong>Collaborate with global product managers to design and launch products tailored to the French market, reflecting local payment habits, invoicing and accounting workflows. Lead initiatives to ensure local relevance and compliance with French and EU requirements, while maintaining alignment with Tide’s global vision.</li> <li><strong>Marketing and Sales Strategy: </strong>Work with regional marketing teams to<strong> </strong>develop and refine marketing and sales strategies for marketing the products in the French market, including partnerships with key SME channels such as accountants (experts-comptables) and the entrepreneur ecosystem (Bpifrance, CCI, incubators). Monitor performance metrics and adapt plans to ensure we meet and exceed growth targets.</li> <li><strong>Content and Collateral Creation: </strong>Support creation of high-quality marketing and customer-facing materials in French, ensuring they comply with French regulations (including ACPR rules on commercial practices) and resonate with local audiences.</li> <li><strong>Operational Readiness and Go-Live Support: </strong>Partner with the Operations team to ensure seamless product launches, from final QA testing to internal training and ongoing support for new features.</li> <li><strong>Cross-Functional Collaboration</strong>: Act as the central point of contact between Tide’s global teams and the Paris team, driving alignment and ensuring projects are delivered efficiently.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What we are looking for </strong></h2> <ul> <li>You have 7+ years' relevant experience ideally within the SME, SaaS, or fintech industries in France. Experience with banking or payment solutions for French SMEs is highly desirable.</li> <li>You are fluent in French (native or near-native) and professional English, as you’ll work daily with French customers and partners and with Tide’s global teams.</li> <li>You know the French SME ecosystem well (micro-entrepreneurs, TPE/PME, accountants, banking and payment players) and its regulatory environment.</li> <li>You excel at developing and executing commercial strategies that deliver measurable business impact. You’re not afraid to roll up your sleeves and remove blockers.</li> <li>You have very strong project management skills and can foster collaboration with teams outside of your direct control by building strong relationships.</li> <li>You’re well versed in product analytics, and can use data to drive decisions within product marketing campaigns and follow it up with actions to constantly improve on product acquisition and engagement  goals.</li> <li>You’ve worked across multiple markets, navigating the complexities of global product development with a keen understanding of localization requirements.</li> <li>You’re comfortable working in a fast-moving company where priorities can change and processes may need to be created from scratch.</li> <li>You’re a self-starter who doesn’t wait for instruction, and who works backwards from targets to ensure effective execution.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll get in return: </strong></h2> <ul> <li>25 days of paid leave per year (congés payés)</li> <li>Additional 3 days of paid leave for volunteering or L&D</li> <li>We invest in your development with a professional L&D budget</li> <li>Complementary health insurance (mutuelle) and disability and life cover (prévoyance)</li> <li>Statutory pension contributions (basic and Agirc-Arrco complementary pension)</li> <li>50% reimbursement of your public transport pass (e.g. Navigo)</li> <li>Extended Parental Leave</li> <li>Mental health support through Plumm</li> <li>A one-off home office budget</li> <li>Work and travel globally - up to 90 days per country outside of your home country</li> <li>Team socials </li> <li>Sabbatical Leave </li> </ul> <h2><strong>Tidean Ways of Working</strong></h2> <p>At Tide, we champion a <strong>flexible workplace </strong>model that<strong> </strong>supports both in-person and remote work to cater to the specific needs of our different teams. </p> <p>While remote work is supported, we believe in the power of face-to-face interactions to foster team spirit and collaboration. Our offices, including our Paris office, are designed as hubs for innovation and team-building, where we encourage regular in-person gatherings to foster a strong sense of community. </p> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE</h3> <p>At Tide, we believe that we can only succeed if we let our differences enrich our culture. Our Tideans come from a variety of backgrounds and experience levels. We consider everyone irrespective of their ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, neurodiversity or differently-abled status. We celebrate diversity in our workforce as a cornerstone of our success. Our commitment to a broad spectrum of ideas and backgrounds is what enables us to build products that resonate with our members’ diverse needs and lives. </p> <p>We are One Team and foster a transparent and inclusive environment, where everyone’s voice is heard.</p> <p> </p> <p><em>At Tide, we thrive on diversity, embracing various backgrounds and experiences. We welcome all individuals regardless of ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, or disability. Our inclusive culture is key to our success, helping us build products that meet our members' diverse needs. We are One Team, committed to transparency and ensuring everyone’s voice is heard.</em></p> <div class="p-rich_text_section"> </div> <div class="p-rich_text_section"><strong>Disclaimer</strong></div> <div class="p-rich_text_section"> </div> <div class="p-rich_text_section"><em>It has come to our attention that individuals or agencies are falsely claiming to represent Tide and are reaching out to candidates regarding job opportunities. title: Director of Engineering, KYX
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3><strong>A</strong><strong>BOUT TIDE</strong></h3> <p>At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.</p> <p>Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, Germany and France.</p> <p>Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.</p> <p><strong>Tide facts:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Tide is available for UK, German and French SMEs</li> <li>Over 2 million members globally and rapidly growing</li> <li>Over $300 million raised in funding</li> <li>3,000 Tideans globally</li> <li>We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg</li> </ul></div><h3>ABOUT THE ROLE:</h3> <p>Tide is hiring a Director of Engineering to lead the engineering organisation behind KYX (KYC and KYB). Our vision for KYX is a world where every genuine business, business owner, their team, and everyone connected to them, onboards to Tide in minutes, unlocks the products they need as they grow, and never has to think twice about their data, while we identify bad actors, stop them at the door, continuously review their activity and off-board them the moment they're found.</p> <p>You will be accountable for engineering strategy, organisation and execution across three domains. Onboarding KYX covers identity and access for registration and login, due diligence policy execution and vendor orchestration across the onboarding journey, and the risk scoring and agentic AI that assesses new applicants. Continuous KYX covers ongoing due diligence through periodic and event-triggered reviews, and how business owners bring their own team members onto their account. Risk Scoring is the KYX Scoring & ML team whose models power decisions across both domains.</p> <p>This role sits at the intersection of regulated risk operations, member-facing conversion and applied AI. KYX Ops and KYX Policy set the rules you build for, Second Line of Defence sets the risk appetite, and our regulators set the bar. We need someone who can raise onboarding conversion and due diligence quality while driving the cost of KYX servicing per member down, and who can scale agentic solutions into workflows where a wrong answer has consequences for a member and for Tide.<br><br>As Director of Engineering, KYX you will</p> <ul> <li>Own the engineering strategy and organisation for KYX, from onboarding identity, access and due diligence through continuous monitoring to risk scoring, unifying leadership that today sits in separate Onboarding and Continuous KYX lines.</li> <li>Lead engineering across backend, frontend, data science and ML engineering, distributed across Hyderabad, Delhi, Sofia, Belgrade, Bucharest and Vilnius.</li> <li>Own KYX Scoring & ML as a shared capability serving both onboarding and ongoing decisioning, including the model lifecycle end to end from development through backtesting and staged rollout to production monitoring.</li> <li>Scale agentic AI in regulated workflows, from onboarding risk scoring through to screening, review and verification, in line with Tide's agentic governance framework.</li> <li>Work with KYX Ops, KYX Policy, Second Line of Defence and Product across the UK, EU and India, and with IAM on the still-to-be-sharpened boundary around login and access.</li> <li>Deliver measurable outcomes: higher automated decisioning rates, better due diligence and screening quality, and a falling KYX cost per member.</li> <li>Build once, deploy globally, and keep market-specific logic isolated.</li> </ul> <p>This is one of the most important engineering roles at Tide. You will shape how quickly and how well we onboard members, how confidently we scale into new markets under our own licences, and how far applied AI can compound into a lasting advantage in a regulated environment.</p> <h3>WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR:</h3> <ul> <li>Experience leading engineering organisations in identity, onboarding, fraud, financial crime or another regulated decisioning domain.</li> <li>Strong track record of turning platform investment into measurable outcomes: conversion, due diligence quality, unit economics and workflow automation.</li> <li>Experience taking machine learning from development into production at scale, and owning model performance once live.</li> <li>Experience operating in a regulated environment, working with Ops, Policy and second line risk and compliance functions,</li> <li>Strong judgement across organisation design, delivery, platform strategy, data architecture and technical quality.</li> <li>Ability to lead distributed teams across multiple markets and unify previously separate engineering lines behind one roadmap.</li> <li>Experience deploying AI or agentic systems inside regulated workflows, with a clear view on governance, evaluation and human oversight, would be a bonus.</li> </ul> <h3>WHAT YOU’LL GET IN RETURN:</h3> <p>Our location-specific employee benefits are designed to cater to the unique needs of Tideans:</p> <ul> <li>Competitive Compensation –  Competitive salary and share options.</li> <li>Time Off – Generous annual leave on top of bank holidays.</li> <li>Parental Leave – Paid maternity, paternity, and adoption leave to support your family journey.</li> <li>Sabbatical – Extended unpaid and paid leave options after completing milestone years with Tide.</li> <li>Access to salary sacrifice benefits – like Nursery (could save up to 47% on fees!) and Cycle to Work discounts</li> <li>Health Insurance – Comprehensive Private family insurance plan.</li> <li>Life & Accident Cover – Comprehensive accidental and life insurance protection.</li> <li>Mental Wellbeing – Access to therapy sessions, courses, meditations, and workshops.</li> <li>Retirement Planning – Build your retirement fund faster with Tide’s pension scheme on eligible earnings.</li> <li>Volunteering & Development Days – Paid days annually for volunteering or personal growth.</li> <li>Learning & Development – Annual budget for books, courses, coaching, and more.</li> <li>WOO (Work Outside the Office) – Work from abroad for up to 90 days annually.</li> <li>Home Office Setup – Contribution towards setting up your home office</li> <li>Laptop Ownership – Keep your old laptop and get a new one when it’s time for a replacement.</li> <li>Snacks & Meals – Daily breakfast spread with all-day coffee, tea, and juices.</li> </ul> <h3>TIDEAN WAYS OF WORKING</h3> <p>At Tide, we champion a <strong>flexible workplace </strong>model that<strong> </strong>supports both in-person and remote work to cater to the specific needs of our different teams. </p> <p>While remote work is supported, we believe in the power of face-to-face interactions to foster team spirit and collaboration. Our offices are designed as hubs for innovation and team-building, where we encourage regular in-person gatherings to foster a strong sense of community.</p> <div id="message-list_1777351501.983109"> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div><span style="color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">#LI-AC1 #LI-Remote</span></div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE</h3> <p>At Tide, we believe that we can only succeed if we let our differences enrich our culture. We consider everyone irrespective of their ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, neurodiversity or differently-abled status. We celebrate diversity in our workforce as a cornerstone of our success. Our commitment to a broad spectrum of ideas and backgrounds is what enables us to build products that resonate with our members’ diverse needs and lives. </p> <p>We are One Team and foster a transparent and inclusive environment, where everyone’s voice is heard.</p> <p> </p> <p><em>At Tide, we thrive on diversity, embracing various backgrounds and experiences.
