title: Client Success Senior Manager
description: <p><strong>Your wellbeing, our mission. Join a company shaping a healthier world.</strong></p> <p><strong>GET TO KNOW US</strong></p> <p>At Wellhub we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. Our platform connects employees worldwide to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep—all in one simple subscription. Headquartered in NYC with team members in Europe, North America and South America, we’re on a mission to make every company a wellness company.</p> <p>We believe work should be fulfilling, inspiring, and balanced. Here, you’ll find a team that values wellbeing, collaboration, and different perspectives, where passion and creativity push boundaries to create real impact. Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally. </p> <p><strong>Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing!</strong></p> <p> </p> <p><strong>THE OPPORTUNITY</strong></p> <p>We are hiring a Senior Enterprise Client Success Manager to join our Client Success team in London.</p> <p>Client Success at Wellhub plays a critical role in ensuring our largest and most strategic enterprise clients successfully adopt, scale, and extract measurable value from our wellbeing solutions. In this role, you will manage a portfolio of complex enterprise accounts, owning the post-sale relationship and driving client retention, engagement, and commercial outcomes.</p> <p>This is a hands-on, client-facing role suited for someone who is comfortable managing complexity, building strong stakeholder relationships, and working cross-functionally to deliver impact. The role is hybrid, with an expectation to be in the office 2x per week.</p> <h1><span style="font-size: 10pt;"><strong>YOUR IMPACT</strong></span></h1> <ul> <li>Own the post-sale lifecycle for a portfolio of large enterprise clients, acting as the primary point of contact and ensuring long-term partnership success.</li> <li>Build and maintain trusted relationships with HR, Reward, and Wellbeing stakeholders across complex client organisations.</li> <li>Drive client adoption, engagement, and retention by translating client goals into clear success and engagement plans.</li> <li>Lead renewals and support expansion opportunities within your portfolio, clearly articulating value and impact.</li> <li>Use data and insights to monitor performance, identify risks, and recommend improvements to client strategy.</li> <li>Collaborate closely with internal teams (Wellbeing Engagement, Operations, Customer Experience, User Growth, Partnerships, Commercial) to ensure effective delivery.</li> <li>Proactively identify issues and risks, clearly articulating client impact and urgency to your manager to enable timely escalation and resolution.</li> </ul> <h1><span style="font-size: 10pt;"><strong>WHO YOU ARE<br></strong></span></h1> <ul> <li>8+ years of experience in Client Success, Account Management, or a similar client-facing role.</li> <li>Experience managing mid-to-large enterprise clients in a complex, fast-paced environment.</li> <li>Comfortable owning renewals and participating in commercial conversations with clients.</li> <li>Strong relationship-building skills, with the ability to engage and influence senior client stakeholders.</li> <li>Data-aware, with confidence using insights and reporting to inform decisions and conversations.</li> <li>Highly organised, able to manage multiple accounts and priorities simultaneously.</li> <li>A collaborative, resilient professional who remains calm and solution-oriented when navigating change and complexity.</li> </ul> <p>We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don't match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. For this specific role, please note that prior experience in driving new business growth and successfully securing significant contracts with complex organizations are mandatory requirements.</p> <h1><span style="font-size: 10pt;"><strong>WHAT WE OFFER YOU</strong></span></h1> <p>With thoughtful benefits, emotional wellbeing resources, and a culture that empowers you to take ownership of your role and your wellbeing, we create an environment where you can thrive in all dimensions of your life. Our benefits include:</p> <p><strong>WELLHUB:</strong>  Free Gold membership with access to onsite gyms and studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental wellbeing support, and more! Add up to three family members to your plan, ensuring access to wellness for those who matter most to you.</p> <p><strong>HEALTHCARE:</strong> Health and dental insurance. </p> <p><strong>FLEXIBLE WORK:</strong> As a Flexible First company, we offer hybrid and remote options to give you the freedom to work in a way that suits you. The model for this specific role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. We offer all employees a one-time reimbursement to set up their home office equipment and a monthly work allowance to help cover the costs of working from home. Our offices are in Germany, Italy, Netherlands, Portugal, Romania, Spain, and the UK. You can work from any office or remotely based in any of these countries.</p> <p><strong>FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE: </strong> Flexibility for us isn’t just about where we work—it also means being able to shape how and when we get things done. Together with their leaders, employees define schedules that align with their time zones, team needs, and personal routines.</p> <p><strong>PAID TIME OFF:</strong> We know how important it is to take time away from work to recharge. Employees receive a minimum of 25 days paid holiday per year with an additional day for each year of tenure (up to 5) in addition to annual holidays (including an extra holiday on your birthday!). </p> <p><strong>PARENTAL LEAVE:</strong> Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life. Take the time to be present and enjoy your growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents. Parents giving birth are eligible for an extended leave and a ramp-back period to return part-time while they get settled.  </p> <p><strong>CAREER GROWTH:</strong> Access world-class platforms, participate in interactive sessions,  build your personalized development roadmap, and explore internal opportunities. We focus on continuous learning and feedback to support your journey toward personal and professional success. </p> <p><strong>CULTURE:</strong> You’ll join a team of passionate people who come together to break boundaries, support each other, and create a meaningful impact in workplace wellness. We win together, building trust through open communication and a culture where every perspective matters. <a href="https://wellhub.com/en-us/careers/our-values/">Learn more about our shared culture and values here. </a></p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Want to see what it’s really like to work here? Follow us on </strong><a href="https://www.instagram.com/lifeatwellhub/"><strong>Instagram</strong></a><strong> @lifeatwellhub and watch our team video on </strong><a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZgIPiszTVm4"><strong>YouTube</strong></a><strong>!</strong></p> <h1><span style="font-size: 10pt;"><strong>Diversity, Equity, and Belonging at Wellhub</strong></span></h1> <p>We aim to create a collaborative, supportive, and inclusive space where everyone knows they belong. </p> <p>Wellhub is committed to creating a diverse work environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law.</p> <p>Our commitment to inclusion also extends to how we recognize and reward our people. We’re proud to be Syndio Fair Pay Certified, reflecting our ongoing dedication to equitable and fair pay practices across our global team. <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/posts/wellhub_fairpay-syndio-activity-7407826561531363328-wbN_?utm_source=share&utm_medium=member_desktop&rcm=ACoAAAzHQWABKsRqcpvxy4QpDCJNe_szRdC4hgY">Read more about it here.</a></p> <p>Questions on how we treat your personal data? See our <a href="https://wellhub.com/en-us/careers/job-applicant-privacy-notice/">Job Applicant Privacy Notice.</a></p> <p> </p> <p><span style="color: rgb(255, 255, 255);"><strong> #LI-HYBRID</strong></span></p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

Maintain early visibility of consequential developments within appropriate confidentiality controls.</li> </ul> <p><br><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>Key Qualifications and Experience</strong></span><br><br>What we need</p> <ul> <li>A strong record of senior communications leadership in Europe and the Middle East, with substantial in-house technology-company experience and the ability to operate credibly across the region.</li> <li>Outstanding storytelling and narrative-development skills: translating complex business and technology priorities into compelling, credible stories for different audiences and markets.</li> <li>Demonstrated people-management experience: setting goals, coaching, managing performance and developing capable colleagues.</li> <li>Gravitas and senior experience to personally lead high-stakes, multi-stakeholder situations, advise business leaders and navigate competing interests with sound judgment.</li> <li>Evidence of judging when personal involvement is essential and when to delegate, alongside strong media relationships and experience directing agencies and regional resources.</li> <li>Outstanding English writing, editing and spoken communication, with the curiosity and rigor to understand complex technology and build accurate narratives.</li> </ul> <p>Helpful experience</p> <ul> <li>AI, cloud infrastructure, enterprise technology or another complex B2B sector; regional expansion, infrastructure investment or a publicly listed company.</li> <li>Substantial Middle East communications work, relevant media relationships and additional regional language skills.</li> <li>Agency experience is valuable alongside substantial in-house experience; an agency-only background does not meet the role’s requirements. Journalism experience can be beneficial.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Competencies and Behavioural Traits</strong><br><br>Strong narrative judgment, senior presence, clear prioritisation and calm leadership. A capable people manager who develops others, gives direct feedback and delegates with purpose. Takes personal ownership where the stakes or complexity require senior experience, while keeping regional and global colleagues aligned. Comfortable with ambiguity, iteration, course-correction, experimentation and (occasionally) failure.<br><br><strong>What We Offer</strong><br><br>A senior communications leadership role shaping narratives and stakeholder relationships across Europe and the Middle East, working closely with business and global communications leaders and developing the regional team.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Benefits & Perks:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Competitive compensation</li> <li>Career growth and learning opportunities</li> <li>Flexibility and ownership</li> <li>Collaborative and innovative culture</li> <li>Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects</li> <li>International environment and talented teams</li> </ul> <p><strong>What's it like to work at Nebius:</strong></p> <p>Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI </p> <p><strong>Equal Opportunity Statement:</strong></p> <p>Nebius is an equal opportunity employer. title: Solutions Architect, Onchain Compliance - EMEA
description: Build a Safer World. TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure. As a Solutions Architect on TRM's Onchain Compliance - EMEA team, you are the technical owner of the sales cycle for crypto exchanges, banks, fintechs, and payments companies. You partner with Account Directors from the first discovery call through close, then stay close as customers integrate and go live. You turn a compliance team's requirements into an architecture they trust and a pilot that proves it. The impact you will have: Own the technical win on strategic onchain compliance deals, using TRM's platform and AI-assisted workflows to turn each customer's compliance process into an architecture they trust. This directly determines whether TRM lands and keeps tier 1 accounts. Compress time to value by building tailored, AI-assisted demos within days of discovery, showing compliance teams how TRM plus AI cuts manual alert review. Design and prove API integrations that fit real compliance operations, including alert triage, case management, and escalation, and use AI tooling to prototype them quickly. Build reusable, AI-enabled demo and integration assets so every deal moves faster than the last and the team scales without adding manual work. Feed field insight back to Product and Engineering, shaping the roadmap so TRM stays ahead of what compliance teams need next. What we’re looking for: 5+ years in pre- and post-sales technical roles (Solutions Architect, Sales Engineer, Solutions Engineer, or Customer Success Engineer), increasingly using AI tools in your workflow. Hands-on experience scoping, implementing, and supporting API-based SaaS integrations, including using AI to prototype and test them faster. Comfort with REST APIs and scripting in Python, JavaScript, or TypeScript, and with AI coding assistants to build quick prototypes. Familiarity with AML, KYC, sanctions screening, or transaction monitoring, and interest in applying AI to speed compliance review. Daily use of AI tools with the judgment to know when to trust the output and when to verify it. Strong discovery, prioritization across several opportunities at once, and clear communication with both engineers and senior compliance leaders. Bonus: blockchain fundamentals, crypto compliance regulation, or experience building AI-enabled workflows. If you are excited by the mission but do not check every box, we encourage you to apply. About the Team: Solutions Architecture at TRM is a globally distributed, fully remote team that works asynchronously through Slack and detailed documentation. The team is on the front lines of TRM: trusted technical advisors to customers and a primary source of customer insight for Product and Engineering. The work is intellectually demanding. You translate complex compliance and blockchain problems into clear solutions under real deal pressure. Expect high ownership and pace. You run your opportunities end to end and are trusted to make the technical call. Team Operating Rhythms: Weekly customer syncs, bi-weekly health syncs, and account POD calls, with regular direct customer engagement. Async-first communication through Slack and written documentation. Distributed, not distant. Travel 20 to 30 percent for customer meetings and onsite sessions. On-Call Responsibilities: Schedule: No formal on-call rotation. Frequency: Occasional off-hours escalations for live customer incidents (HM to confirm at intake). Travel Requirements: Schedule: As needed for customer meetings and onsite sessions. Frequency: 20 to 30 percent. Onsite Requirements: Schedule: Occasional customer onsite visits. Frequency: HM to confirm at intake. Learn about TRM Speed in this position: Within days of discovery, you put a demo built around the customer's compliance workflow in front of them, not a generic walkthrough. Within days of a customer's commitment, you have agreed success criteria and a live pilot environment. In the first 90 days, you build reusable demo and integration assets that cut setup time on the next deal. Application Instructions If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team. Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your skills and qualifications for the role. If you send your resume directly to someone at TRM, we can’t guarantee it will reach the appropriate hiring team. Applying directly is the best way to ensure your application will be considered. Interviewing with TRM Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while allowing you to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, an AI skills assessment, and a Leadership Principles interview. Recruiter Intro: Qualifications, motivations, and alignment with the role. Hiring Manager: Deep dive into your relevant experience, skills, and impact. First Round: 1–2 interviews focused on the skills most critical to the role. Final Round: Hands-on case study. This is usually a panel-style session where we go deeper into your craft, problem-solving, and alignment with TRM. References: Former colleagues who can provide insight into your work and impact. Offer: Congrats! Your recruiter will present the offer and compensation details. Welcome to TRM: We're excited to build a safer world with you! Your recruiter will share your specific interview plan and preparation guidance along the way. AI Fluency at TRM AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM. We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks. At TRM, AI fluency means you are among the top 10 percent of operators in your function in how you apply AI to: Accelerate repeatable workflows Structure and solve problems Improve output quality Increase speed and leverage You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process. Life at TRM We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day. TRM moves FAST. We are a high-velocity, high-ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days. Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving. At TRM, you should expect: Priorities and targets to change quickly Operating with a high degree of ambiguity A high level of personal ownership and accountability Close collaboration across teams and functions Frequent, high-touch communication Creative problem-solving and out-of-the-box thinking A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes This environment is energizing for people who enjoy building, solving hard problems, and making progress in situations that are not always fully defined. It also requires thriving in ambiguity, adjusting course as new information emerges, and maintaining focus and positivity in a fast-moving and intense environment. We also recognize that this style of operating is not for everyone. If you are primarily optimizing for predictability or a consistently balanced workload, we encourage you to use the interview process to pressure-test whether this environment is truly the right fit. We want teammates who thrive here, not just survive here. If you are excited by meaningful problems, motivated by ambitious goals, and energized by working alongside mission-driven colleagues, there is a good chance you will find TRM to be an exceptional place to grow and contribute. Leadership Principles We hire and grow against three leadership principles. They’re the standards for how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions. Impact-Oriented Trailblazer: We put customers first and move with speed, focus, and adaptability. We treat every plan like an experiment – test, ship, measure, and iterate quickly. Master Craftsperson: We care deeply about our craft. We balance speed with high standards, own outcomes end‑to‑end, and invest in getting better everyday. Inspiring Colleague: We add clarity and energy, not noise. We bring humility, candor, and a one‑team mindset — giving and receiving feedback to make the team stronger. Join our Mission At TRM, we care deeply about our craft. We are looking for individuals who want their work to matter, who experiment with speed and rigor, and who take pride in building a safer world for billions of people. title: Senior AI Architect & Consultant (m/w/d)
description: Wer wir sind Die Mayflower GmbH baut Individualsoftware mit Fokus auf Generative AI – seit 1998 inhabergeführt. Wir bringen komplette AI-Infrastrukturen in Produktion: Model-Serving, Agent-Gateways, Chat und Voice – direkt in der Umgebung des Kunden. Dich erwartet ein agiles Arbeitsumfeld mit echter Verantwortung und flachen Strukturen – Entscheidungen triffst Du selbst, statt sie durch Freigabeschleifen zu schieben. Wir suchen Dich – jemanden, der AI-Systeme nicht nur konzipiert, sondern ihren Weg in die Produktion aktiv mitverantwortet. Von der Architekturberatung auf C-Level bis zum Produktivbetrieb: Du entwirfst die Lösung und bringst sie mit dem Team in den echten Einsatz. Was dich erwartet Anspruchsvolle Projekte mit LLMs, Agentic RAG und AI-Agent-Frameworks (z. B. LangGraph, PydanticAI, Mastra oder OpenAI Agents SDK) – inklusive Deep-Agent-Architekturen. Du baust Evaluation-Pipelines und Observability (Logging/Tracing mit LangSmith, Langfuse o. Ä.) auf und arbeitest mit modernem MLOps-Stack sowie Vector Databases. Du entwirfst Lösungsarchitekturen für komplexe Kundenvorhaben – mit Security, Compliance, Skalierbarkeit und Datenschutz im Hinterkopf – von der ersten Skizze im Gespräch bis zur konkreten Roadmap. Gemeinsam im Team führst Du Deep-Dive-Calls und Workshops mit Kunden durch und bringst sie in die nächste Projektphase. Du begleitest die Anbahnung neuer Projekte und unterstützt unser Team im Pre-Sales mit technischer Glaubwürdigkeit. Du kommunizierst souverän auf C-Level – Du verstehst ökonomische Ziele, sprichst die Sprache von Entscheider:innen und verbindest technische Exzellenz mit Business-Impact. Der Schwerpunkt Deiner Rolle liegt mit etwa 50 % in Kundenprojekten, in intensiven Phasen auch darüber. Den übrigen Teil Deiner Zeit investierst Du in Pre-Sales-Gespräche und Workshops, die Du vorbereitest und durchführst, sowie in die strategische Unterstützung von Geschäftsführung und Sales. Konferenzen, Community-Events, Fachbeiträge: Präsenz ist ein Plus, keine Bedingung. Wichtig ist uns nur, dass Du bereit bist, Dich fachlich zu zeigen. Du reist 4–8 Tage im Monat zu Kunden und Kolleg:innen – Reisebereitschaft innerhalb Deutschlands, bei Bedarf auch in Österreich und der Schweiz, ist Teil der Rolle. Das solltest du mitbringen Langjährige Erfahrung als Architekt:in oder Senior Engineer, idealerweise bei einem Dienstleister oder in der IT-Beratung. Projekterfahrung mit Agentic-AI-Implementierungen, die über Prototypen hinausgeht: LangChain, LangGraph und Deep Agents im echten Einsatz – oder vergleichbare Tiefe im TypeScript-Umfeld (Mastra) bzw. im Microsoft-Ökosystem (Semantic Kernel / Microsoft Agent Framework, Azure AI Foundry). Vector Databases und MLOps sind ein Plus. Die Kompetenz, Kunden AI-Konzepte und Architekturen anschaulich und praxisnah zu vermitteln. Du kannst Lösungen im Kundengespräch skizzieren und überzeugend vertreten – Storytelling und Präsenz sind Deine Stärken. Du begegnest C-Level auf gleicher Ebene – Du verstehst, welche Aspekte Entscheider:innen bewegen und wie Du technische Konzepte in wirtschaftliche Relevanz übersetzt. Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch (C1+) und konversationssicheres Englisch. Das haben wir zu bieten Kompetitive Vergütung: Attraktives, marktgerechtes Gehaltspaket, das zu Deiner Erfahrung und Kompetenz passt. Echte Produktionsverantwortung: Deine Systeme laufen produktiv bei großen Unternehmensgruppen - nicht in der Demo-Umgebung. Gute Software bauen: Hier wird echter Wert auf Code- und Softwarequalität gelegt. Kein 08/15: Abwechslung durch unterschiedliche Branchen, Use Cases und Technologien - vom GPU-Cluster bis zum Voice-Agenten. Kundenbeziehung auf Augenhöhe: Wir pflegen eine ehrliche und vertrauensvolle Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Kunden. Mache einen Unterschied: Viel Verantwortung, großer Gestaltungsspielraum - in einem Mittelständler, in dem dein Beitrag den wirtschaftlichen Erfolg direkt beeinflusst. Lerne immer dazu: Weiterbildung (intern und extern), Training-on-the-job und regelmäßige Weiterentwicklungs- und Gehaltsgespräche. Wie arbeiten selbstorganisiert: Wir geben dir den Freiraum, den Rahmen für gute Arbeit selbst mitzugestalten – im Team wie beim Kunden. Werde berühmt: Eine technische Redaktion unterstützt dich beim Schreiben und Publizieren, sodass du als Experte nach außen sichtbar wirst. Du musst nicht die klügste Person im Raum sein: Echte Sparring-Partner, die deine Ideen gemeinsam mit dir auf die Probe stellen und weiterentwickeln. Schalte einfach ab: Niemand erwartet Erreichbarkeit nach Feierabend, im Urlaub oder trotz Krankmeldung. Viele Überstunden sind bei uns nicht üblich. Gut für die Psyche: Ersthelfer psychische Gesundheit, Employee Assistance Programm und ein offener Umgang mit mentaler Gesundheit. Freiraum für dein Privatleben: Flexible Arbeitszeiten, bis zu vier Tage Homeoffice die Woche, spontan einen Tag frei, Arbeiten aus dem EU-Ausland, Sabbatical oder 4 Wochen Urlaub am Stück. Bring dein +1 mit: Brave Bürohunde oder Kinder an schulfreien Werktagen sind herzlich willkommen. Finanzielle Benefits: Regelmäßige Teamevents, Wellpass, 30 Tage Urlaub, Kindergartenzuschuss, Deutsche Dienstrad. Der Kontakt zu uns Du hast Feedback oder Fragen zu der Stelle? title: Senior Product Manager - F/H
description: Le Product Management, c'est notre ADN. Chez Hubvisory, tu ne te contentes pas de gérer un backlog : tu deviens la référence produit incontournable pour accompagner nos clients grands comptes dans la transformation de leurs produits digitaux et de leurs organisations. Ton rôle est d'allier vision stratégique et excellence opérationnelle pour délivrer de la valeur tangible dans des environnements complexes. Ce que tu fais concrètement : Tu prends la main sur un périmètre produit à fort enjeu business. Tu analyses les processus en place, tu identifies les leviers d'amélioration réels et tu formalises une vision produit et une feuille de route alignées sur les priorités métier. Tu décides avec la donnée. Tu mesures l'effet de tes arbitrages sur l'usage et la performance commerciale, tu construis les indicateurs qui manquent, et tu transformes une analyse en recommandation argumentée. Pas en tableau de bord de plus. Tu traduis le besoin métier en produit. Exigences fonctionnelles, user stories, critères d'acceptation, priorisation que tu assumes et que tu sais défendre. Tu interviens sur le socle SI. Tu contribues au cadrage et à l'évolution des briques applicatives concernées, en gardant la main sur le pourquoi quand tout le monde discute du comment. Tu alignes un écosystème dense. Métiers, produit, data, IT : tu fais converger des parties prenantes multiples vers des décisions cohérentes, et tu accompagnes l'adoption des solutions auprès des équipes. Tu documentes ce qui compte. Processus, décisions, dépendances, évolutions fonctionnelles : ce que tu laisses derrière toi tient sans toi. Tu participes à la vie d'Hubvisory. Tu consolides ta posture de consultant, tu partages tes retours d'expérience et tu évolues, selon tes aspirations, vers des rôles de Product Leader ou Manager Conseil. Tu as travaillé sur des briques IA (recommandation, agents, GenAI) ou tu as une appétence réelle pour intégrer l'IA au cycle produit. On cherche des PM qui qualifient les cas IA avant de les mettre en place, pas des PM qui militeraient pour de l'IA partout. 👉 Pourquoi rejoindre Hubvisory ? Hubvisory est le seul cabinet en France focalisé exclusivement sur le Product Management et l'IA. Pas de practice data généraliste, pas de conseil en transformation sur tous les sujets. On fait une chose, on la fait bien. Un parcours d'accompagnement sur-mesure. Nos rituels collectifs (Hub'Times) et nos revalorisations bi-annuelles récompensent la vraie progression, pas l'ancienneté. Une communauté interne engagée : 20% des collaborateurs se sont volontairement engagés à travers plus de 20 projets à impact menés depuis 2022 (mécénat de compétence, organisation de maraudes, fresque du climat, etc.) Des valeurs fortes : depuis 10 ans, Hubvisory grandit autour de la bienveillance, la méritocratie, l'ambition, l'expertise et l'apprentissage. Le package : 44.000-52.000€ fixe brut, revalorisations bi-annuelles, intéressement jusqu'à 22% des profits redistribué de façon égalitaire. Pré-requis du poste 👉 Le profil que nous recherchons Tu justifies d'au moins 5 ans d'expérience en tant que Product Manager ou Product Owner sur des produits digitaux, dont une expérience significative en écosystème complexe : plusieurs métiers, plusieurs systèmes, des décisions qui ne se prennent jamais seul. Tu sais mener un sujet produit de la discovery aux critères d'acceptation, et tu as déjà porté une vision et une feuille de route face à des parties prenantes exigeantes. Ta maturité data est réelle : tu interprètes toi-même les chiffres, tu structures des hypothèses, tu mesures pour décider. Tu es à l'aise pour contribuer au cadrage fonctionnel de briques applicatives structurantes, sans y perdre ta hauteur de vue produit. Un passage par le commerce, le e-commerce ou la supply chain, en particulier sur les sujets d'offre et de référencement, est un vrai plus. Une familiarité avec un progiciel de gestion de type SAP également. Trois qualités qui font la différence ici : une posture conseil assumée, une excellente communication client et une rigueur analytique à toute épreuve. Anglais professionnel. Comment se déroule le processus de recrutement ? Étape 1 : Echange avec un RH pour valider l'adéquation entre ton projet et notre modèle Etape 2 : Validation de tes hard skills avec cas pratique avec un manager Étape 3 : Validation de tes soft skills avec un entretien avec un VP Etape 4 : Echange téléphonique avec un RH pour la proposition d'embauche Quelle que soit l'issue de ton process, tu reçois un retour de notre part sous 7 jours maximum ! Si tu veux plus d’information sur notre processus de recrutement, on en a fait un article sur notre blog . Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Product Manager IA & Data - HF
description: Une démo d'IA qui impressionne ne fait pas un produit. Entre le prototype et l'usage réel, il y a la qualité des données, la fiabilité des réponses, les coûts, l'adoption par les équipes et la valeur business à démontrer. C'est là que se joue le métier de PM IA & Data, et c'est là que tu interviens chez Hubvisory. Tu accompagnes des comptes comme Ledger, Decathlon ou Veolia dans la conception de produits dont le cœur est l'IA ou la donnée. Selon les missions, tu es PM IA (LLM, RAG, agents), PM Data (plateformes, produits data, pilotage par la donnée), ou les deux à la fois. Tu ne te contentes pas de piloter un backlog : tu décides de ce qui doit être construit, de ce qui est réaliste, et de ce qui rapporte. Tes missions Cadrer les cas d'usage à valeur. Tu traduis des problématiques métier complexes en une roadmap IA ou Data ambitieuse, avec un ROI clair. Arbitrer la faisabilité. Données disponibles, qualité, contraintes techniques, coûts : tu tranches entre ce qui est souhaitable et ce qui est tenable. Piloter du POC à la production. Tu portes le produit de la première expérimentation jusqu'à son déploiement et son adoption. Travailler avec les équipes Data, ML Ops et Tech. Tu comprends leurs contraintes, tu challenges les choix d'architecture et tu parles un langage commun. Mesurer ton impact et défendre tes décisions. Qualité des sorties, adoption, valeur créée : tu définis les indicateurs et tu les portes devant les parties prenantes. Fédérer. Tu rends accessible une technologie complexe à des interlocuteurs exigeants, pour les aligner sur une vision produit claire. Notre objectif : faire de toi un PM IA & Data de référence, capable de mener des produits intelligents jusqu'à la production, que ce soit sur l'IA, sur la donnée ou sur les deux. Selon ton appétence, ton évolution se construit vers Senior, Product Leader, Manager ou Principal. Pourquoi rejoindre Hubvisory Une rémunération lisible. De 46 à 58 K€ selon ton expérience, une part variable et l'intéressement jusqu'à 22% des profits, redistribué de façon égalitaire. Un pure player du Product, en avance sur l'IA et la Data. Le Product est notre sujet de prédilection, pas une offre parmi d'autres. Nous avons créé notre track IA & Data dès 2024, quand le marché hésitait encore. Tu rejoins une équipe qui a de l'avance, avec des produits IA en production, pas des démonstrations. Une progression alignée sur ton impact. Revalorisations salariales bi-annuelles, passages de grade fondés sur la performance et non sur l'ancienneté. Un onboarding structuré. Un parcours collectif et individuel, avec un plan de formation et une montée en charge progressive. Tu es accompagné par un buddy et un mentor dédiés, et tu as accès à 1000h de contenu à la carte. Une taille humaine. Avec 135+ consultants, chacun est identifié, écouté et accompagné. Le profil recherché 2 à 5 ans d'expérience comme PM / PO sur des produits digitaux, dont au moins une expérience significative sur un produit IA ou Data. Tu as l'envie et la capacité de couvrir les deux champs. Utiliser l'IA au quotidien ne suffit pas : on attend d'avoir porté un produit et d'avoir pesé sur ses choix techniques. Indispensables : maîtrise de la Discovery et du Delivery, lecture de code (Python / JS), bases solides en SQL, compréhension des APIs (REST / GraphQL) et des architectures LLM / RAG. Atouts : notions de MLOps, outils d'orchestration (LangChain, n8n), expérience en conseil ou en grand groupe produit. Savoir-être : curiosité et esprit critique, capacité à vulgariser, engagement dans le collectif (chez Hubvisory, tu t’engages à la fois chez le client et au sein du cabinet). Anglais courant. Le process de recrutement Échange avec un RH : ton projet, notre modèle, tes attentes (45 min) Cas pratique avec un Manager : hard skills, en live (90 min) Projection stratégique avec un VP ou un cofondateur : posture et vision (90 min) Échange de closing avec un RH (15 min) Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Consultant·e Senior Transformation Product & Conduite du changement (H/F)
description: Une réorganisation qui tient sur le papier, tout le monde sait faire. Celle qui tient encore un an après, c'est une autre histoire. Chez Saint-Gobain, nous avons créé un Product Ops Center pour diffuser la culture produit à l'échelle du groupe. Chez SNCF, Decathlon ou France TV, nous aidons les Directions à quitter la logique projet pour une logique produit. Ce changement ne se décrète pas en COMEX. Il se construit avec les managers, les équipes et les dirigeants, jusqu'à ce qu'il devienne la nouvelle normalité. Ton rôle : porter ces transformations, de la première conversation avec un COMEX jusqu'au moment où l'organisation fonctionne sans toi. Ce que tu vas faire Embarquer les équipes. Tu acculturés, tu accompagnes les managers, tu traites les résistances une par une plutôt que de les contourner. Dessiner l'organisation. Gouvernance, rôles, rituels : des modèles pensés pour durer, pas pour une restitution. Changer la façon de décider. Tu installes un pilotage par la valeur : OKR, KPI stratégiques, nouveaux circuits de décision. Faire grandir les collectifs. Ateliers, formations, coaching des équipes produit et de leurs leaders. Parler à tous les étages. Tu tiens la même crédibilité face à un COMEX que face à une équipe opérationnelle. Notre objectif pour toi : que ton expertise de conseil se mesure à ce qui change réellement chez le client. Ensuite, tu choisis ta voie : Manager, pour faire grandir une équipe, ou Principal, pour devenir la référence sur ton sujet. Pourquoi Hubvisory Le produit est notre seul sujet. Pour un profil Change, c'est rare : tu transformes des organisations autour du produit, entouré de PM, designers et AI Engineers que tu peux solliciter à tout moment. Tu sais ce que tu gagnes, et pourquoi. De 58 à 68 K€ selon ton expérience, une part variable, et un intéressement jusqu'à 22 % des profits partagé à parts égales. Ton impact se voit vite sur ta fiche de paie. Revalorisations deux fois par an, et la majorité des postes à responsabilité occupés par des collaborateurs évolués en interne. Tu démarres entouré. Deux semaines de Campus pour prendre nos méthodes en main, un buddy, un mentor, et 1000 h de formation à piocher selon tes besoins. Tu connais les gens avec qui tu travailles. 135+ consultants : l'exigence d'un cabinet, sans l'anonymat. Le profil recherché Tu as au moins 5 ans d'expérience en cabinet de conseil (transformation, organisation, stratégie ou digital), avec des missions menées de bout en bout. Indispensables : conduite du changement, design d'organisation, animation d'ateliers, aisance avec les C-levels comme avec les équipes opérationnelles. Atouts : pilotage par la valeur (OKR), agilité à l'échelle (SAFe, Spotify…), coaching agile ou produit. Posture : conseil, influence sans autorité hiérarchique, engagement dans le collectif. Le process de recrutement Échange avec un RH : ton parcours, ton projet, notre modèle (45 min) Cas pratique avec un Manager : une situation de transformation à structurer, en live (90 min) Projection stratégique avec un VP ou un cofondateur : posture de conseil et vision (90 min) Échange de closing avec un RH (15 min) Quelle que soit l'issue de ton process, tu reçois un retour de notre part sous 7 jours maximum. Dann werde Teil von #TeamGusti. 🚀 👉 Bewirb Dich jetzt über unser Online-Formular. 📹 Zusätzlich bitten wir Dich, uns ein kurzes, kreatives Video im zweiten Schritt des Bewerbungsformulars hochzuladen. Hier findest du die Anforderungen dafür: Erstelle ein Streetstyle-/Lifestyle-Reel, in dem du eine Tasche auf natürliche, modische und authentische Weise präsentierst. Das Video kann Folgendes enthalten: Verschiedene Outfit-Kombinationen Das Styling der Tasche zu einem Look Ein Spaziergang durch die Stadt oder eine alltägliche Umgebung Zeige, wie die Tasche Teil des Lebensstils einer Person wird Vergiss das Storytelling mit deiner Stimme nicht : Erzähle mit deiner Stimme eine kurze, nachvollziehbare Geschichte rund um die Tasche. Vermittel den Zuschauern, warum die Tasche zu ihrem Lebensstil passt, und lass sie sich vorstellen, wie sie sie selbst nutzen würden. Eine verschmutzte Linse kann unerwünschte Effekte, unscharfe Bereiche oder eine verminderte Bildqualität verursachen. ✅ Kamera: Nimm immer mit der Rückkamera deines Smartphones auf. title: Senior Response Engineer (Application & network security)
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h2><strong>Available Location: Singapore</strong></h2> <h2><strong>About the Department</strong></h2> <p><strong>Cloudforce One</strong> is Cloudflare's threat operations and research team, responsible for identifying and disrupting cyber threats ranging from sophisticated cyber criminal activity to nation-state sponsored advanced persistent threats (APTs). Cloudforce One works in close partnership with external organizations and internal Cloudflare teams, continuously developing operational tradecraft and expanding ever-growing sources of threat intelligence to enable expedited threat hunting and remediation.</p> <p>Members of Cloudforce One are at the helm of leveraging an incredibly vast and varied set of data points that only one of the world's largest global networks can provide. The team analyzes these unique data points at massive scale and efficiency, synthesizing findings into actionable threat intelligence to better protect our customers.</p> <h2><strong>About INTERDICT</strong></h2> <p><strong>I.N.T.E.R.D.I.C.T.</strong> (Identify, Neutralize, Triage, Engage, Respond, Disrupt, Integrate, Contain, Threat Hunting) is Cloudforce One's unified operational security organization responsible for identifying, analyzing, and responding to threats targeting Cloudflare and its customers. INTERDICT encompasses three main sub-functions:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Cloudflare Managed Defense (CMD):</strong> Network and application security monitoring for 'Under Attack' mitigation support.</li> <li><strong>PhishGuard:</strong> Managed email threat detection and response service.</li> <li><strong>Detection Engineering:</strong> ML model development and detection optimization.</li> </ul> <p>Together, INTERDICT provides comprehensive <strong>24×7×365 protection</strong> across email, application, and network threat surfaces.</p> <h3><strong>Role Summary</strong></h3> <p>As a <strong>Senior Response Engineer</strong> within the Cloudflare Managed Defense Center (CMDC), you will serve as a subject-matter expert and technical escalation point for threat mitigation across Cloudflare’s strategic enterprise customer base. In this role, you will lead the response to sophisticated, multi-vector cyberattacks spanning OSI Layers 3, 4, and 7, operating beyond standard playbooks to diagnose anomalies, engineer custom mitigations, and stabilize mission-critical infrastructure under fire.</p> <p>Beyond active incident command, you will act as a force multiplier: architecting customer-specific defense strategies, authoring and refining automated detection logic, mentoring Tier 1 and Tier 2 engineers, and collaborating directly with Cloudflare Product and Engineering teams. We are looking for an experienced, high-ownership technical leader who excels during high-stakes incidents and is passionate about mentoring others while advancing threat mitigation at scale.</p> <p>CMDC operates 24×7×365. <strong>This role participates in a regional shift rotation and on-call escalation rota including periodic weekend and public-holiday coverage as part of a follow-the-sun model across AMER, EMEA, and APAC.</strong></p> <h3><strong>Role Responsibilities</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Act as the technical lead and incident commander during high-impact, multi-vector security events, designing and deploying bespoke mitigation strategies when standard runbooks do not suffice.</li> <li>Perform deep-dive forensic analysis into complex Layer 3/4 and Layer 7 traffic anomalies, identifying zero-day attack patterns, sophisticated bot networks, and novel evasion techniques.</li> <li>Apply advanced mitigation strategies and filter malicious traffic using Cloudflare’s core security suite, including Magic Transit, Web Application Firewall (WAF), and Advanced Rate Limiting.</li> <li>Lead technical communications and incident bridge calls with enterprise C-level executives, principal network engineers, and security teams during critical events, clearly articulating root causes, impact assessments, and remediation paths.</li> <li>Monitor and investigate proactive security alerts across internal telemetry systems to rapidly triage incoming events, assess blast radius, and validate threat severity.</li> <li>Adhere to and champion strict customer SLAs for alert response times, event analysis, and clear executive reporting.</li> <li>Mentor and elevate Tier 1 and Tier 2 engineers through structured shadowing, technical post-mortems, and internal training.</li> <li>Partner with internal Engineering and Product teams to translate operational attack trends into prioritized platform enhancements, tool feedback, and automated detection logic.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Role Requirements (Must-Have Skills)</strong></h3> <ul> <li>A minimum of 6–8 years of hands-on experience in a high-volume Security Operations Center (SOC), Managed Detection and Response (MDR), network engineering, or incident response environment dealing directly with live threat mitigation.</li> <li>Comprehensive knowledge of networking principles and internet infrastructure, including TCP/IP, UDP, ICMP, DNS, BGP routing mechanics, and edge network design.</li> <li>Deep expertise in Layer 7 protocols and web architectures (HTTP/1.1, HTTP/2, HTTP/3, TLS handshakes/ciphers, reverse proxy models, and API security).</li> <li>Experience analyzing network traffic data for anomaly detection and designing, tuning, and executing advanced mitigation strategies against L3/L4 and L7 attacks, including bespoke countermeasures when standard playbooks are insufficient.</li> <li>Advanced proficiency in packet capture and network traffic analysis using tools such as tcpdump, Wireshark, or tshark to isolate anomalies and dissect malformed or novel payloads.</li> <li>Practical experience analyzing and mitigating security incidents using AI and machine learning tools, paired with the hands-on capability to build and integrate custom tooling that improves operational workflows, accelerates log telemetry analysis, and defends against AI-driven botnets and adversarial edge attacks.</li> <li>Proficiency in using the command line (Bash shell) alongside general system administration literacy across Linux, Mac, or Windows environments.</li> <li>Proven experience commanding incident bridges, making decisive risk-tradeoff decisions, and maintaining composure while managing enterprise stakeholders during high-pressure crises.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Nice-to-Have Skills</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Direct experience querying large-scale distributed logging and analytics systems using SQL, GraphQL, ClickHouse, or SIEM platforms (Splunk, Elastic, Sumo Logic).</li> <li>Hands-on experience defending against advanced persistent threats (APTs), credential stuffing, scraping botnets, or application-layer bypass attacks against major CDNs/WAFs.</li> <li>Relevant industry certifications, such as CISSP, CCNP/CCIE, or advanced GIAC credentials (e.g., GCIA, GCIH, GNFA).</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage

title: Senior Territory Account Executive, Korea
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Location: Seoul</strong></p> <p><strong>About the Role</strong></p> <p>The Cloudflare APAC sales organisation operates as one integrated revenue system. Account Executives, Customer Engineers, Partner Account Managers, Business Development Representatives, Customer Experience Managers, Professional Services and Revenue Operations work as a continuous engine — winning, deploying, adopting, expanding, and scaling platform commitments across the full customer lifecycle.</p> <p>The system is supported by an AI-embedded operating model. The work itself, however, remains human. The role of every seller at Cloudflare is to bring critical thinking, judgment, and trust to customer relationships and outcomes.</p> <p>In this role, you will be responsible for driving significant growth by landing and expanding a portfolio of assigned customers in your assigned territory. The ideal candidate possesses a strong blend of sales acumen and technical understanding, enabling them to engage effectively with both technical and non-technical buyers. As a Senior Territory Account Executive, you will drive revenue velocity by utilizing foundational sales data layers for accurate forecasting, proactive pipeline management, and consistently exceeding attainment targets.</p> <p>You are the kind of operator who uses AI as a force multiplier every day, cares more about customer outcomes than job boundaries, and demonstrates curiosity, judgment, and high agency.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own and execute a comprehensive territory plan to consistently achieve and exceed sales and revenue targets.</li> <li>Cultivate long-term strategic relationships with key accounts and partners. Lead executive-level transformation narratives that earn the right to be in the architecture conversation.</li> <li>Leverage top partners as an extension of the sales team to co-sell alongside where they bring customer relationships, services capability, or procurement leverage. Drive regular forecast & pipeline cadences with top partners.</li> <li>Understand customer network architectures, the problems that Cloudflare can solve and effectively translate Cloudflare’s solutions to drive successful platform sales, ensuring clients can secure and scale their own AI-driven workloads.</li> <li>Manage contract negotiations and structure platform-level commercial commitments (multi-year, multi-product, outcome-anchored) rather than point-product deals.</li> <li>Stay engaged through onboarding, adoption, and the first renewal. Partner with Customer Engineers, Professional Services on a deployment plan with milestones tied to measurable outcomes.</li> <li>Proactively build and manage a robust sales pipeline by leveraging internal tools, AI-assisted research and pipeline sources (BDR, Channel, Marketing).</li> <li>Maintain high standards in pipeline discipline, CRM hygiene and forecasting accuracy.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor's degree or equivalent with at least 8+ years of relevant work experience.</li> <li>Experience selling technology solutions in high-growth technology firms.</li> <li>Demonstrated track record of consistently meeting and exceeding multi-million dollar quota targets.</li> <li>Proficient in discovery, positioning, competitive selling, negotiation, closing, and multi-threaded land and expand strategies.</li> <li>Strong understanding of computer networking, cloud security technology, and how enterprise infrastructure adapts to automated data workflows.</li> <li>Exceptional interpersonal communication skills and value selling skills.</li> <li>Proficiency in modern sales software, customer data environments, and core systems (e.g., Salesforce, Tableau, G-suite).</li> <li>Thinks critically rather than reacting, exercises judgment under uncertainty, names risks honestly, shows genuine empathy for customers as people, can point to relationships built over time on trust, and demonstrates visible curiosity in how they prepare, sell, and learn.</li> <li>Willingness to actively engage with AI tools and experiment.</li> <li>Ability to travel as required.</li> <li>Cultural fluency for assigned markets; language proficiency where required.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>

title: Senior Social Media Manager - 12 Month FTC (Maternity Cover)
description: Frontier is an independent video game developer and publisher, crafting immersive gaming experiences with fun gameplay and unparalleled artistic quality. Renowned for its iconic creative management simulation games, Frontier captivates players worldwide with immersive and authentic game worlds. The modern studio is located in the vibrant technology hub of Cambridge (UK). The talented team at Frontier are dedicated to nurturing our existing portfolio and delivering our exciting future roadmap. This role is offered on a full in-studio basis or a hybrid basis (minimum 3 days per week in the studio). We can provide a comprehensive relocation support package as part of any offer, should you need to relocate. WHAT'S THE ROLE? We’re looking for a Senior Social Media Manager for a 12-month fixed term contract (Maternity Cover), who will provide senior operational ownership of our social media activity across multiple titles and channels. You will lead defined areas of social strategy, campaign planning and delivery, translating business and campaign requirements into clear channel plans, content priorities, and measurable outcomes. Working autonomously, you will coordinate social workstreams from brief through to delivery, provide senior guidance on channel activity and copy, support team best practice, and act as a key social media contact across Publishing and Development. You will use insights, social listening and performance data to improve activity, identify risks and opportunities, and inform decision-making. WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING Lead Frontier’s organic social strategy across X, Instagram, TikTok, Facebook and YouTube. Set channel plans aligned with brand, product, audience, and commercial goals. Maintain publishing standards and improve social processes and best practice. Own social workstreams across campaigns, launches, DLCs, live-service updates, and events. Turn campaign requirements into clear deliverables, timelines, priorities, and approvals. Own social content calendars and coordinate publishing across Frontier’s portfolio. Review social copy, content plans and channel activity to maintain quality and brand voice. Brief social-first assets and support reactive content, short-form video and event coverage where appropriate. Use social listening, audience insight and performance data to identify trends, opportunities, and risks. Coordinate with Product Marketing, PR and Communications, Influencer Relations, Community Management, Customer Support, Development and Creative Services. Represent social requirements in campaign planning and communicate plans, risks, and recommendations clearly. Build stakeholder buy-in and help resolve blockers or competing priorities. Coordinate day-to-day delivery, providing direction, support and mentoring to less experienced team members while sharing knowledge and developing team standards and capability. WHAT YOU'LL BRING Significant experience managing branded social media channels, ideally within games, entertainment, or another fast-moving consumer environment. Experience leading complex social campaigns through the full planning and delivery lifecycle across multiple channels and stakeholders. Strong experience developing and executing social media-led tactical plans and go-to-market strategies. Strong project management capability, with the ability to define deliverables, manage dependencies, coordinate approvals, and protect deadlines. Excellent knowledge of X, Instagram, TikTok, Facebook and YouTube, including platform formats, audience behaviours and best practice. Excellent social copywriting, editing and proofreading skills, with strong judgement around brand voice, accuracy and audience context. Experience using social analytics, listening, and reporting tools to evaluate performance and turn insight into practical recommendations. Ability to identify emerging reputational or delivery risks and develop proportionate mitigation plans. Proven ability to influence stakeholders, gain buy-in and work effectively across functions and levels of seniority. BONUS IF YOU HAVE Hands-on experience creating or editing reactive, short-form or social-first video and image content. Experience supporting event coverage, live activations or creator-led activity. Experience mentoring colleagues or helping to develop team standards, processes and capability. Experience working across a portfolio of products, franchises, or international channels. Strong understanding of gaming audiences, online communities and the role of social media across launches and live-service engagement. WHAT WE CAN OFFER YOU You will work with talented and passionate people to support, develop or publish our sophisticated and enduring games, in a creative, collaborative and inclusive environment. We love what we do, and we work hard to provide outstanding experiences for our players. Wellbeing is a big focus at Frontier, and we are continually evolving how we can support our people. We encourage a healthy work/life balance and provide a range of wellbeing activities, initiatives and sessions to support both mental and physical health. We offer a competitive salary and benefits package, which includes a success-based annual bonus, share option schemes, life assurance, private family healthcare, flexitime working hours, enhanced maternity/paternity leave, in-house subsidised catering, support with relocation, a Cycle to Work scheme, free bike servicing, and social activities and events. We strive to create an environment where everyone can fully demonstrate their capability and potential. If you therefore need any reasonable adjustments to support you during the recruitment process, please speak to your Talent Acquisition representative. So do you feel you do not meet every single requirement but still intrigued? We encourage you to still apply! You can help make our company even better. We do not discriminate based on race, color, national origin, sexual orientation, gender, age, mental or physical ability, or any way you represent yourself. We strongly believe diversity makes for more successful teams. Why Protolabs? We are the leaders in digital manufacturing. We hire doers, makers, and creative thinkers who tackle our roles with an entrepreneurial spirit. Our culture is centered around meaningful work that brings new and innovative products to market at unprecedented speeds. We are a diverse team that comes from all walks of life and take pride in our team who is smart, genuine, humble, and passionate about what we do. It’s our people who fuel our creativity and make our culture feel like home. Join our team as a Senior Machine Learning Engineer - AI Technical Lead! This is a hybrid role, and we are currently considering candidates based in the Netherlands. Protolabs is a digital manufacturing company that turns CAD files and technical drawings into physical parts fast and at scale. Our AI team builds systems that empower workflows in digital manufacturing such as finding similar parts, geometry understanding, and automated routing of work to the right expert. We are looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to act as Technical Lead for our horizontal innovation work, the foundational technical building blocks that serve multiple use cases across the value chain. The work is distinct in that the technology often comes first and the use case follows: this is true innovation, where you prove a capability is possible and then drive it into business value. You will be the single technical point of contact for these initiatives, driving core development of transformative capabilities. You will observe the market, bring new innovations into the organization, and partner across engineering and business teams to turn technology into measurable impact — mentoring and influencing engineers inside and outside your own team without formal authority. What You Will Do: Technical leadership & core development Drive core development of transformative capabilities. Take over full technical ownership as the primary technical contact for product management, engineering management, and partner teams on the delivery and roadmap of these initiatives. Create, maintain, and review the technical roadmap together with product and engineering management. Provide architectural guidance for ML systems on inference, agentic approaches and hybrid AI systems; industrialize and maintain proven-value use cases. Technical implementation across a broad range of AI use cases Implement progressive ML solutions for various business domains in agile, crossfunctional teams; rapidly prototype to validate feasibility and value in a scalable manner. Co-develop use cases with domain software teams in temporary cross-functional setups. Market observation & innovation Observe the market and propose new innovations based on technologies emerging outside the company. Evaluate build vs. buy vs. adapt decisions based on cost, effort, risk, and long-term maintainability. Produce written technology-evaluation recommendations (opportunity, feasibility, effort, fit) and find ways to multiply exploration speed by involving other engineers. Identify opportunities where new technology could add business value; hand clear tech ideas to product and business teams to review and validate; identify integration requirements. Cross-organisation delivery & architecture Partner with other engineering teams to deliver business impact through integrating new technologies and new solutions. Draft, share, and align architectural designs for each building block across the organisation, obtaining sign-off from affected teams before integration starts; bring designs to architecture board review. Platform & environment Contribute to foundational environments for (Gen)AI experimentation, model development, evaluation, and deployment. Collaborate with global platform counterparts to implement MLOps, CI/CD, data pipelines, and observability. Advocate for reusable components, shared libraries, and internal tooling to accelerate usecase delivery. Mentoring & influencing Mentor and coach engineers across the organisation — inside and outside your own team— through PR reviews, work scoping, design reviews, and documentation reviews. Proactively surface in-team and cross-team barriers to leadership as they arise, with suggestions on how to resolve them. Identify needs and tech-stack gaps blocking engineers from delivering, and raise them for prioritization. What You Bring: Technical 7+ years of hands-on AI/ML engineering experience, with strong depth in machine learning and deep learning — modeling, data pipelines, evaluation, and shipping models to production using state-of-the-art frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow/Keras, scikit-learn, XGBoost). Proven ability to build models that serve as autonomous decision systems — applied to critical business problems with large, heterogeneous data. Strong Python engineering fundamentals: clean, modular, testable code; data pipelines; model versioning; CI/CD for ML; packaging for production (e.g. Docker, service wrappers). Solid ML experimentation practice: experiment tracking set up from scratch (e.g. Weights & Biases, MLflow), model evaluation, and iterative improvement tied to measurable business outcomes. Solid understanding of data transformation techniques, languages, and libraries (e.g. Pandas, Polars, SQL, dbt). Familiarity with modern GenAI — LLMs, transformers, vector stores, retrieval techniques (RAG), embedding strategies, and agentic workflows — and GenAI stacks such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, and OpenAI/Azure/AWS SDKs. Cloud-native, building scalable, secure, and compliant production systems. MLOps background: CI/CD, model deployment, monitoring/observability, IaC, and workflow orchestration (e.g. Prefect, Weights & Biases, or equivalents). Familiarity with backend systems principles, including API serving, containerization, distributed compute, security considerations. Leadership & Collaboration Demonstrated ability to lead technically without formal authority: mentoring engineers, design/PR/documentation reviews, and aligning stakeholders across teams. Experience owning architecture end-to-end: drafting, sharing, and driving sign-off of architectural designs across multiple teams. Experience working in Agile environments — contributing to Scrum ceremonies, breaking work into increments, and collaborating closely with product and engineering management in iterative delivery. Ability to lead through ambiguity and early-stage environments; proactive, systematic problem solving. Ability to translate emerging technology into business value — framing opportunities, scoping with product and engineering partners, and identifying integration requirements. Excellent communication skills across global departments: able to align engineers, product/engineering management, and leadership, and to present technical opportunities to both engineering and business audiences. Mindset Builder mentality: pragmatic, resourceful, iterative. Curiosity and willingness to experiment while ensuring quality and security. Critical thinking in uncertain or rapidly evolving contexts Bonus Points If You Have : Experience with AWS managed services. Experience with manufacturing/industrial ML applications. Experience with geometric/spatial data: point clouds, meshes, voxel grids, or CAD - derived representations. Experience with vector databases, scalable retrieval architectures, guard railing LLMs, and prompt engineering. Experience collaborating in international teams across time zones. What's In It For You: Part of our incredible journey is clearly down to our amazing team, and we strongly believe in giving people a space to truly, authentically be themselves. We also believe that treating our employees well and sprinkling a great place to work with some nice perks can make work a little sweeter. Annual company bonus. We celebrate success together! Employees are not only rewarded for their achievements but also for contributing to the overall success of the business. Wellness and well-being with access to OpenUp psychologists, practice mindfulness with Headspace and tons more. Doggo-friendly office. We are big pet lovers and fully encourage hanging out with your (and your colleagues’) furry friends in the office Daily Lunch and snacks are provided in the office; it's a moment for our teams to connect and recharge. Shared meals strengthen our bonds and fuel collaboration. We offer learning and development days to be used for training or on volunteering, money to spend on learning courses, events, trainings, Access to our in-house LEARN platform with diverse courses, training, and workshops, In-house 3D Printing and much more! title: CDI - DESIGNER JUNIOR JERSEY (H/F)
description: LA MAISON JACQUEMUS Jacquemus a été fondée par Simon Porte Jacquemus en 2009 à Paris, en France. Dédiée à la mémoire de la mère du créateur, la marque puise son inspiration dans une passion pour la culture. Les collections femme et homme font référence à l'art de vivre à la française et aux gestes universels de beauté, intégrant des influences allant de la photographie d'art aux arts décoratifs, en passant par le cinéma, la peinture et la sculpture. Au fil des années, Jacquemus a mis en scène ses défilés dans des lieux uniques et inattendus, notamment une piscine parisienne, le Musée Picasso, un champ de lavande en Provence, un champ de blé aux abords de Paris, un marais salant en Camargue et une plage à Hawaï. Plus récemment, la marque a investi des lieux tels que le canal du Château de Versailles (Le Chouchou), la Fondation Maeght (Les Sculptures), la Casa Malaparte (La Casa) et l'appartement parisien d'Auguste Perret (La Croisière). Basé dans le 8ᵉ arrondissement de Paris, Jacquemus est une maison de mode indépendante comptant plus de 300 employés. Réputée pour sa forte présence numérique et son expansion internationale, la marque a développé des expériences de vente innovantes à travers le monde avant d'ouvrir son premier flagship permanent au 58 Avenue Montaigne à Paris en 2022. Depuis, des boutiques ont été ouvertes à New York (SoHo) et Londres (New Bond Street). VOTRE ROLE Rattaché(e) à la Head of Design, vous intervenez sur la création des collections homme et femme, jersey, bain et flou show, des recherches d'images jusqu'au suivi des prototypes en normalisation. Ce poste couvre à la fois la création et le développement produit : vous travaillez en lien avec les usines partenaires et participez au bien aller de chaque pièce. VOS MISSIONS Réaliser les recherches iconographiques et construire les boards de collection Mener les recherches de volumes, de finitions et de graphismes Réaliser les visuels sur Photoshop et les maquettes Assurer le sourcing matière Établir les fiches de lancement et suivre les corrections de prototypes Réaliser les dessins techniques Participer aux essayages Accompagner les pièces jusqu'à la normalisation, en lien avec les usines VOTRE PROFIL Vous justifiez d'une première expérience d'environ 2 ans en tant que designer junior, idéalement sur le jersey et/ou le flou. Vous avez également : Une sensibilité forte pour le bien aller du vêtement, avec un attrait pour le flou et le travail en 3D La maîtrise de la suite Adobe (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign) et une aisance en dessin technique Un esprit autonome, débrouillard et force de proposition La capacité à prendre rapidement des automatismes et à gérer plusieurs sujets en parallèle L'envie d'évoluer au sein d'un studio créatif exigeant Le poste est basé à Paris dans le 8ème arrondissement Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

description: sizeless builds the data layer for physical AI in construction. Contractors film an open trench with a smartphone. Diversity of thought, background and culture broadens our knowledge of the world and helps us learn, grow, and gain new perspectives.
