title: Principal AI Engineer - AI Tutor
description: <p><strong>About DataCamp</strong></p> <p>DataCamp's mission is to empower everyone with the data and AI skills essential for 21st-century success. By providing practical, engaging learning experiences, DataCamp equips learners and organizations of all sizes to harness the power of data and AI. As a trusted partner to over<strong> 17 million learners</strong> and<strong> 6,000+ companies</strong>, including 80% of the Fortune 1000, DataCamp is leading the charge in addressing the critical data and AI skills shortage.</p> <p><strong>About the role</strong></p> <p>Research has consistently shown that one-on-one tutoring dramatically outperforms traditional classroom instruction—a finding known as Bloom's 2 Sigma Problem. Despite decades of awareness, no solution has successfully delivered personalized tutoring at scale. Until now.</p> <p>We are building an AI tutoring system designed to emulate and eventually surpass the best human tutors. You will work on the core AI system that delivers real-time, adaptive learning experiences to learners. <strong>If you're excited about building the future of human learning, this role is for you.<span style="text-decoration: underline;"> This role can be done remotely from anyone of the following; United States, United Kingdom, Belgium, Portugal OR UAE</span></strong></p> <p><strong>About you</strong></p> <p>At DataCamp, we seek individuals who embody our core values of data-driven decision-making, action, transparency, ownership, and customer focus. You thrive in a fast-paced, high-performing environment and are driven by a passion for making a meaningful impact. You're adaptable, embracing change and ambiguity with enthusiasm. Your initiative and entrepreneurial spirit push you beyond just meeting targets—you aim to understand the "why" behind our goals and take ownership to drive the business forward. You’re a collaborative team player who values transparency and always seeks to improve and innovate. If this sounds like you, we encourage you to apply!</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Build and evolve the core AI tutoring system</strong>, including prompt architectures, agentic workflows, and real-time adaptive behaviors.</li> <li><strong>Run rigorous experimentation and evaluation</strong>, developing custom metrics and frameworks to measure learning effectiveness and improve model reliability.</li> <li><strong>Design and implement scalable, maintainable software</strong>, integrating AI capabilities with platform systems, content pipelines, and user experience components.</li> <li><strong>Collaborate cross-functionally</strong> with educators, content creators, and product teams to translate pedagogical goals into technical solutions.</li> <li><strong>Prototype and productionize novel model interactions</strong>, leveraging emerging research and capabilities to advance the tutor’s intelligence.</li> <li><strong>Ensure quality, safety, and observability</strong> through monitoring, testing, guardrails, and iterative refinement of model behavior.</li> <li><strong>Share knowledge and elevate teammates</strong>, contributing to a culture of clarity, simplicity, and continuous learning.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Qualifications</strong></p> <h3><strong>Technical</strong></h3> <ul> <li>1+ years building complex LLM-based systems, with strong prompt engineering intuition and experience designing agentic workflows.</li> <li>Ability to design meaningful evaluation methods, including custom metrics and frameworks when off-the-shelf options fall short.</li> <li>Strong software engineering fundamentals, architectural thinking, and fluency in Python; comfortable working with production infrastructure, cloud environments, and CI/CD.</li> <li>Actively follows AI research and emerging capabilities, applying new ideas creatively to real problems.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Product & Pedagogy</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Strong empathy for learners and content creators; able to translate pedagogical goals into system behavior and product decisions.</li> <li>Ability to reason holistically across AI behavior, content structure, platform features, and user experience.</li> <li>Familiarity with learning science or a desire to develop expertise.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Character & Collaboration</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Drawn to difficult, ambiguous problems with no clear blueprint; persistent in exploring and refining solutions.</li> <li>Preference for elegance and simplicity in system design.</li> <li>Communicates clearly across mediums and enjoys mentoring and collaborating in small, high-ownership teams.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Why Datacamp? </strong></p> <p>Joining DataCamp means becoming part of a dynamic, creative, and international start-up. Here are just a few of the reasons why you’ll love being on our team:</p> <ul> <li>Exciting challenges: Face new technical challenges daily, keeping your work engaging and rewarding.</li> <li>Competitive compensation: We offer a competitive salary with attractive benefits.</li> <li>Flexibility: Benefit from flexible working hours because the future is flexible! </li> <li>Continuous learning: Access a yearly learning budget for conferences & training to support your professional growth.</li> <li>Global retreats: Participate in international company retreats, fostering a global team spirit.</li> <li>Equipment: Yearly refreshment of your IT Equipment budget for your home working setup.</li> <li>Amazing team: Collaborate with a truly exceptional team—seriously, we’re awesome!</li> </ul> <p> </p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: ERP Key User / Senior ERP Consultant (microtech büro+) – Auftragssachbearbeitung & Einkauf (m/w/x)
description: BITTE KEINE PERSONALVERMITTLER Erobere mit uns gemeinsam Zukunftsmärkte, entdecke neue Technologien und wachse in eine echte Schlüsselrolle mit zukünftiger Führungsverantwortung hinein! Bei der Epotronic GmbH verbinden wir marktführende Hersteller wie DJI und technologische „Hidden Champions“ mit der Praxis. Wir sind spezialisiert auf den Vertrieb und Einsatz von High-Tech-Drohnen, Vermessungs- und Inspektionsgeräten (LiDAR, GNSS), Roboterhunden, sowie passender Software. Zu unseren Kunden zählt die Bundesrepublik Deutschland, internationale Großkonzerne, Behörden, Universitäten, Ingenieurbüros und Spezialbetriebe. Der Erfolg gehört dir: Unser Umsatz stieg von 2 Mio. € im Jahr 2021 auf 9 Mio. € im Jahr 2023 bevor wir uns komplett von unserem Investor trennten. Wir arbeiten seit dem unabhängig ohne Investoren im Hintergrund – unsere Ziele setzen wir uns selbst. Um dieses Wachstum auf das nächste Level zu heben, suchen wir eine unternehmerisch denkende Persönlichkeit. Deine Rolle & Perspektive bei uns Du bist kein reiner Verwalter und auch kein reiner IT-Theoretiker, sondern ein Hands-on-Allrounder der das operative Tagesgeschäft im Griff hat und dieses mit ausgeprägtem Prozessverständnis selbstständig optimiert. Du übernimmst schrittweise zentrale Aufgaben direkt von der Geschäftsführung, um unsere Systemlandschaft rund um microtech büro+ aktiv weiter zu entwickeln. Perspektivisch baust du deinen Bereich eigenständig aus und wächst, sofern gewollt, in die Führungsverantwortung (Teamlead IT / Operations / Kaufmännische Leitung) hinein. So teilt sich dein Alltag auf: 1. Operatives Tagesgeschäft – Auftragssachbearbeitung, Einkauf, Produktmanagement, Buchhaltung (ca. 50 %): Auftragssachbearbeitung: Ganzheitliche Erfassung, Bearbeitung und Steuerung von Kundenaufträgen (vom Angebot über Auftragsbestätigung und Lieferschein bis hin zur Rechnungsstellung oder -korrektur). Einkauf & Beschaffung: Operative Bestellabwicklung, Überwachung von Lieferterminen, Artikelstammdatenpflege sowie Kommunikation mit unseren internationalen Herstellern und Logistikpartnern. Vorbereitende Buchhaltung: Schnittstellenarbeit zur Finanzbuchhaltung (Rechnungsprüfung, Belegkontrolle und Klärung von Differenzen). → sinkt perspektivisch in 2-3 Jahren auf ca. 30% 2. ERP-Betreuung & Prozessoptimierung in microtech büro+ (ca. 30–40 %): System-Verantwortung: Du betreust, leitest und optimierst unsere Prozesse im Warenwirtschaftssystem microtech büro+ als interner Key User / Prozess-Leads. Bei steigender Skalierung wird sich deine Verantwortung um den Trainerjob erweitern. Automatisierung & Struktur: Du identifizierst manuelle Zeitfresser im Alltag und stellst sie durch clevere Workflows, Regeln, eigene Tabellenansichten, Filter und angepasste Drucklayouts ab. Du kennst dich idealerweise schon mit GraphQL aus oder den alten COM und EDI-Schnittstellen. Schnittstellen-Management: Du überwachst und optimierst den Datenfluss zwischen büro+ , unserem Online-Shop, dem CRM-System und der Buchhaltung. Export und Import sind dir vertraut. → steigt perspektivisch mit zunehmender Skalierung 3. Zukunfts- & IT-Projekte (ca. 10–20 %): Mitarbeit an neuen strategischen und technischen Projekten. Weiterentwicklung unserer internen IT-Infrastruktur, Digitalisierungsthemen und direktes Sparring mit der Geschäftsleitung. Natürlich kannst du dich auch bei Produktthemen einbringen, damit der Spaßfaktor noch weiter steigt. Qualifikation – Das bringst du mit Praxishintergrund: Erfolgreich abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung (z. B. Groß- und Außenhandel, Industriekaufmann/-frau) oder ein betriebswirtschaftliches/technisches Studium mit mehrjähriger Berufserfahrung in der Auftragsabwicklung und/oder im Einkauf. ERP-Expertise: Fundierte Erfahrung als Key User, Super-User oder intensiver Anwender in microtech büro+ (oder tiefgreifende Prozess-Erfahrung in einem vergleichbaren ERP-System wie JTL, Sage, Haufe X360, weclapp o. ä. mit dem Willen, dich rasant in büro+ einzuarbeiten). Hands-on-Mentalität: Du packst im Tagesgeschäft (Aufträge, Einkauf, Belege) selbstverständlich und fehlerfrei zu, denkst aber bei jedem Klick darüber nach, wie man den Prozess morgen noch besser machen kann. Technik- & IT-Affinität: Verständnis für Schnittstellen (Shop, CRM, DATEV/Buchhaltung), Datenstrukturen und moderne IT-Tools. Sprachen: Verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift sowie sehr gute Englischkenntnisse (für die Kommunikation mit internationalen Herstellern). Persönlichkeit: Gewissenhaft, lösungsorientiert, durchsetzungsstark und bereit, echte Verantwortung zu übernehmen. Benefits Überdurchschnittliche Wachstumschancen: Du übernimmst direkt Verantwortung von der Geschäftsführung. Mit dem Ausbau deiner Rolle und des Teams steigen auch deine Führungsverantwortung und dein Gehalt spürbar an. Freiheit & Flexibilität: Ein hohes Maß an Eigenverantwortung, ein professionelles und flexibles Arbeitsumfeld (mobiles Arbeiten 1–2 Mal wöchentlich möglich) und Kernarbeitszeiten rund um die Mittagspause. Zukunftstechnologien: Direkter Einblick in die rasant wachsenden Branchen Robotik, Drohnentechnologie, Reality Capture und KI-Datenerfassung inklusive regelmäßiger Einblicke durch unsere Hersteller. Flache Hierarchien: Ein schlagkräftiges, internationales und hilfsbereites Team ohne Konzernbürokratie – gute Ideen für Prozessverbesserungen setzt du bei uns sofort um. Klingt nach deinem nächsten Karriereschritt? Dann überzeuge uns mit einer modernen und schlagfertigen Bewerbung! Nenne uns darin mindestens ein starkes Argument für deine ERP-/Prozess-Kompetenz oder eine konkrete Idee/Erfahrung , wie du in der Vergangenheit einen Ablauf im System optimiert hast Lebenslauf und Zeugnisse / Zertifikate Rückfragen gerne telefonisch unter +49 (0) 211 59892931 Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Head of GRC & Assurance
description: We’re a team of experts pushing the limits of what’s possible, united by our common goal to unlock true freedom through digital ownership, making technology accessible for all. We believe in a world where users, creators and enterprises manage their value with ownership and freedom. Our curiosity drives us to innovate, empowering individuals on a global scale. We believe change is constant and our team moves forward as one, with a culture of problem-solving where every employee is empowered and supported to challenge tradition and create solutions. Our mission is simple: to make self-custody accessible and give people the keys to their own financial futures. If you want to make a true impact, we want you to join us at Ledger. At Ledger, we’re proud to be the global platform for digital assets and Web3, with over 20% of the world’s crypto assets secured through our Ledger devices. With our headquarters in Paris, and offices in Vierzon, Grenoble, Montpellier, London, Portland, Geneva, Zurich and Central Singapore, we have a team of around 600 professionals developing a variety of products and services to enable individuals and companies to securely buy, store, swap, grow and manage crypto assets – including the Ledger hardware wallets line with more than 7.5 millions units already sold in 200 countries. The team: You'll join the Security team under the CSO. You will lead Ledger's security risk governance and assurance, emphasise our answers to institutional customers' security requirements, and the evidence that our controls work. What you’ll be doing: Be the customer-facing voice of Ledger's risk and assurance position: due diligence, audits, contract security reviews and calls with customer security and risk teams. Run enterprise security risk governance, the quality of the risk register and the records of risk acceptance. Manage the ISO 27001 programme and prepare SOC 2 readiness. Translate the legal requirements identified by Legal, including DORA, MiCA and NIS2, into security controls and evidence. Govern third-party assurance and assess or coordinate the assessment of controls. Provide independent challenge of security controls, and report to the Risk Committee. Build and lead the GRC and assurance team, and own its strategy, roadmap and budget, including audit firms and assessors. What we’re looking for: 12+ years in security risk, GRC or financial-sector compliance, including 5+ years leading a team. Director-level management experience: you have built a GRC or risk function, owned its budget and audit relationships, and presented to executive committees or boards. title: Senior-adviseur duurzaamheid en business development
description: Jouw impact bij Movares Jij maakt duurzaamheid concreet, creëert nieuwe kansen en vergroot de maatschappelijke impact van complexe projecten. Samen met de teamleider zorg je voor een gezonde werkvoorraad en verdere groei van het team. Dit ben jij bij Movares Je bent een ondernemende adviseur die inhoudelijke deskundigheid verbindt met commercieel inzicht. title: Senior SEO & GEO Manager
description: Who we are We believe travel can create Citizens of the World. When people cross Europe slowly, by train, they come back more curious, more open and better able to understand people unlike themselves. With colleagues from more than 50 countries, our diversity sparks curiosity, insight and a culture of openness, which is essential to understanding our travellers and one another. Three values connect everyone at Interrail: we lead with our purpose, we own our impact, and we choose for growth. We work in a hybrid way, from our office in Utrecht and our homes across the Netherlands. Who we’re looking for Someone who can shape how travellers discover Interrail, whether they’re typing into a search engine or asking an AI assistant to plan their trip. Exploring Europe by rail is one of the most transformative ways to travel, and there’s a big, untapped opportunity to make it even easier. With SEO and GEO, you’ll help travellers get inspired, plan and book their next rail adventure with an Interrail Pass in fewer steps. Also, it’s good to know that the team has agreed to meet in the office every Tuesday and Thursday, so you’ll be expected to be in the office on these days to work side by side with your colleagues. What you’ll be doing You’ll be joining the Growth team (in a nutshell: the people who turn traveller curiosity into journeys booked), reporting to our E-Commerce Lead. You’ll own the end-to-end SEO and GEO strategy, so that Interrail is found, cited and recommended wherever travellers research rail travel in Europe. Working across content, product, engineering and PR/brand, you’ll turn search and AI visibility insight into meaningful, measurable growth. Strategy and leadership Own and scale a unified SEO and GEO strategy and roadmap, aligned to commercial goals across our priority markets. Prioritise investment across markets and languages based on search demand, commercial opportunity and local traveller needs. Be our internal expert on how AI is changing travel discovery, embedding SEO and GEO thinking across marketing, content, PR/brand and product. Partner with engineering, content and product to get the right work prioritised and shipped. Technical SEO and architecture Own technical SEO for our large, complex site and set the technical roadmap with product and content. Lead our SEO architecture: hreflang at scale, domain and subfolder strategy, and localisation quality across languages. Make sure search engines and AI systems can access and understand the site, with the right structured data and clear, consistent information on passes, pricing and eligibility. Own our crawler access policy for AI bots together with legal and engineering, balancing visibility against content protection. GEO Own our GEO strategy and roadmap: how we earn mentions, citations and recommendations across markets and languages. Build our GEO measurement framework, tracking brand presence, citation share, share of voice against competitors and sentiment. Spot recurring inaccuracies in AI-generated answers, fix them at the source with the relevant teams and track whether accuracy improves. Partner with PR, partnerships and social to strengthen the off-site signals AI models rely on, from trusted travel publications to community presence and review platforms. Measure and attribute AI-referred traffic and conversions, and run structured tests to build repeatable GEO playbooks. Assess emerging opportunities, such as AI agents that plan and book travel, and advise on what Interrail needs to be ready. Content and topical authority Shape content strategy and topical authority across destinations, routes, guides and inspiration, balancing discovery with pass and booking intent. Make sure our content performs in both search results and AI answers, with clear factual structure and original rail expertise worth citing. Be the SEO and GEO advisor to the content team, building a shared roadmap that connects visibility opportunity to editorial output. Set and govern content quality standards (briefs, structure, internal linking, E-E-A-T) and upskill the team in SEO and GEO best practice. Identify gaps, cannibalisation and refresh opportunities, and advise on what to create, update, consolidate or retire. Measurement and reporting Forecast organic and AI-driven performance, set KPIs across both, and report clearly to senior stakeholders. What success looks like Non-brand searches make up a growing share of organic traffic and revenue across our priority markets. A GEO measurement framework is live, and our citation share and share of voice in AI answers are improving against key competitors. The SEO and GEO roadmap is agreed with product, engineering and content and delivered as planned, including website and CMS changes that launch without loss of organic visibility. Recurring inaccuracies about passes, pricing and eligibility in AI answers are identified, fixed at the source and measurably reduced. What we’re looking for Here’s what will help you in this role. If you don’t match every point, we’d still love to hear from you. In terms of your experience and skills: Demonstrated experience leading SEO strategy across content and technical, ideally in travel, e-commerce or a large content or marketplace environment. Hands-on GEO experience, with examples of your approach, results, measurement limitations and the decisions that followed. A working understanding of how AI search experiences select and cite sources, and how that differs from traditional ranking. A strong track record in international and multilingual SEO at scale. A solid technical foundation, including structured data, and the ability to influence engineering roadmaps. Outstanding cross-functional collaboration: you align teams around a shared roadmap and take initiatives from idea to launch without direct authority, reviewing results together and applying the learnings. A data-driven, commercial mindset: comfortable forecasting, sizing opportunity, attributing impact in a maturing channel and presenting to leadership. A test-and-learn mindset, comfortable building new capabilities in a fast-changing environment. Experience partnering closely with content, editorial, PR or brand teams. Fluency with the core toolset: Google Search Console, GA4, an SEO platform such as Semrush or Ahrefs, a crawler such as Screaming Frog, log-analysis tools and GEO tracking tools. Fluent English; another European language, ideally German, French, Italian or Spanish, is beneficial to have. Our offer A hybrid way of working, with some days each week in our Utrecht office and the rest from home. A free NS train card, so you can travel across the Netherlands for work and in your free time. A free Interrail Pass every year for you and a companion, so you can travel across Europe the way our travellers do. Unlimited access to OpenUp, an online wellbeing platform. A personal wellbeing allowance of up to €1,500. A training allowance of up to €4,000 for learning that’s relevant to your role. A variable annual bonus (target 4%), based on company and individual performance. An annual team trip across Europe, so you see first-hand what our travellers experience. The option to work from abroad for 20 days a year. An annual leave package of 28 days, plus study days, volunteer days and a culture day. Salary Scale: 60. Monthly gross salary (excluding 8% holiday allowance): €5,300 – €6,400 (full-time), based on experience. Curious to apply? Apply directly through our careers page . We’ll ask you to share your CV in English (our business language) and tell us why you’re interested in Interrail and this role. It doesn’t hurt to be creative; we enjoy seeing your personality shine through. For some roles, we may also ask you to complete a short task based on the real job, so you can show us your skills in practice. If we’d like to get to know you better, the next step is a first conversation with Talent Acquisition, followed by interviews with the team. It’s a two-way conversation: a chance for you to explore Interrail, and for us to get to know you. To keep our hiring fair, we use blind screening in the early stages. Your name, photo, date of birth, gender, nationality, contact details and social media links are hidden, so our first decisions are based only on your skills, experience and potential. In the meantime If you’re curious, why not check us out on LinkedIn and get a sense of our culture and values? Got questions? Our team would be happy to help: just drop us a note at While you’re here, you can plan your own trip and find your Pass at www.interrail.com . Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

Verfügbarkeit: Bereitschaft, Prozesse für einen 24x7-Betriebssupport zu unterstützen. Un onboarding très complet permettant une intégration et une montée en compétence rapides. Une aventure dans laquelle la formation et le partage des connaissances font partis du quotidien. Rejoindre une entreprise avec une vie d’équipe riche et dynamique : conférences, team-buildings, déjeuner, offsite, afterwork, etc. Nos valeurs 🤝 Chez Doctrine, nos 4 valeurs nous accompagnent au quotidien et dans notre ambition de faire bouger les choses. title: Software Engineer - Dynamics
description: Wanna join the adventure? Loft Orbital is looking for a Software Engineer to join the Dynamics team within Ground Platform. Dynamics computes the timeline of what every spacecraft in our fleet can do and when (contacts with ground stations, links, accesses, unavailability windows) and turns it into schedules: which satellite talks to which ground station, when, and in which order of priority. As our fleet grows, these services need to handle more data, more queries, and harder allocation problems. You’ll bring strong backend engineering to that challenge: making our APIs fast, our databases scale, and our contact allocation and scheduling smarter. No astrodynamics background is needed; you’ll work alongside flight dynamics engineers who bring that expertise. If you enjoy hard performance problems and optimization with real-world constraints, we’d love to hear from you. About this role: Build and optimize our scheduling capabilities: model constraints and objectives, design algorithms and solver-based approaches that produce feasible, high-quality schedules across a growing fleet, and replan quickly when things change Evolve contact allocation (Contact Allocation Framework) to share ground station capacity across satellites and missions Improve the performance of our backend services and APIs: profile, find bottlenecks and cut latency for the timeline and scheduling services that operators and other teams rely on Design and evolve our data layer for large, fast-growing time-based datasets: data modeling, partitioning, indexing, query optimization and retention Shape the architecture of Dynamics services for low latency and scale, in step with the rest of Ground Platform Collaborate with flight dynamics engineers, Mission Platform (Execution & Insights) and satellite operators to turn their needs into reliable, performant software Have the opportunity to take part in spacecraft operations through SatDevOps rotations, occasionally helping investigate anomalies Must Haves: Solid backend software development experience, in Python Strong algorithmic foundations for scheduling and optimization problems: modeling constraints and objectives, heuristics, and knowing when to reach for a solver Proven track record improving the performance of APIs or backend services (profiling, caching, concurrency, load testing) Strong relational database skills, ideally PostgreSQL: data modeling, indexing, partitioning, reading query plans Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal Nice to Haves: Experience with constraint programming or operations research (e.g. OR-Tools / CP-SAT , MILP solvers), or with scheduling and allocation problems Django and GraphQL (Graphene) Time-series or geospatial data at scale (e.g. TimescaleDB, PostGIS) Kubernetes and observability tooling (OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana) Interest in space (astrodynamics knowledge not required) Some of Our Awesome Benefits: Equity, we want you to have an active role in our success Up to 35 days of Paid Time Off (vacations & RTT ) and flexible working hours, we want you to be at your best Health and life insurance, we care about your health Lunch Vouchers, because let’s be honest, we love food! (we even have a slack channel about it #loft-gourmand ) Cross-office travel opportunities between San Francisco, Colorado, and Toulouse to learn from our differences Company and team off-sites and many other events to work & celebrate together Relocation assistance to Toulouse when applicable * Research shows that while men apply to jobs where they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women and other underrepresented people tend to only apply when they meet 100% of the qualifications. At Loft, we value respectful debate and people who aren’t afraid to challenge assumptions. We strongly encourage you to apply, even if you don’t check all the boxes. Who We Are Loft: Space Made Simple. Founded in 2017, Loft provides governments, companies, and research institutions with a fast, reliable, and simple way to deploy missions in orbit. We integrate, launch, and operate spacecraft, offering end-to-end missions as a service across Earth observation, IoT connectivity, on-orbit AI, national security missions, and more. Leveraging our existing space infrastructure and an extensive inventory of satellite buses, Loft is reducing years-long integration and launch timelines to months. With more than 30 missions flown, Loft’s flight heritage and proven technologies enable customers to focus on their mission objectives. With a growing fleet on track to reach 30 satellites by 2027, we are scaling up quickly across our offices in San Francisco, CA | Golden, CO | and Toulouse, France to meet accelerating demand for space infrastructure. title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer, FeedForward 3D/4D Reconstruction
description: At Parallel Domain, we believe that autonomous systems – from self-driving cars to contactless delivery drones – have the opportunity to drastically improve the quality of life for billions of people. That is why we love what we do: enabling our customers to develop their technology safely using the Parallel Domain data generation platform. Our platform revolutionizes the way our customers generate sensor data for AI development. We're looking for people like you to join us in pushing the boundaries of artificial intelligence and synthetic data. About the role Before any physical AI system is trusted in the real world, it has to prove itself in ours. Parallel Domain turns real captured drives into faithful digital replicas — geometry, appearance and motion that perception stacks are trained and validated against. We are hiring a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to push our feed-forward reconstruction stack forward — from static 3D toward full 4D scenes over time. You will join a small, deep team where your technical judgment carries real weight from day one, and your work will ship in a pipeline customers depend on. What You'll Do Advance our feed-forward reconstruction models . Improve how we predict geometry, camera pose and appearance from real capture with transformer-based models, and extend it from static scenes to dynamic 4D. Train at scale . Run multi-node GPU training on large multi-view and video datasets, and decide what to scale, what to ablate and when a result is real. Define what "good" means . Build evaluation the team trusts for reconstruction quality, temporal consistency and geometric accuracy. Explore stronger priors . Investigate where generative models, such as pre-trained video diffusion, can help fill gaps the capture did not see. Land research in the product . Work with the pipeline engineers to get results into production, and care whether they hold up there. Track the field . This area moves monthly; form a view on where it is heading and argue for it. What we're looking for Hands-on feed-forward reconstruction experience . You have built or trained feedforward 3D reconstruction models (for example in the lineage of DUSt3R, VGGT, π³ or D4RT), and you know where they work and where they break. A track record of models others relied on . We weight demonstrated depth over years served : a recent PhD with the right focus and an experienced research engineer are both credible here. Large-scale trainin g. Practical experience with multi-node, multi-GPU training and telling a promising run from a stalled one early. Strong PyTorch skills in a large shared codebase with real build and CI. Research judgment . You turn an ambiguous direction into experiments that resolve something, and change your mind when the numbers say so. Clear communication with researchers, pipeline engineers and leadership alike. Strong pluses These are listed in order of how much they matter to us. Feed-forward Gaussian prediction . Experience predicting 3D Gaussians directly from images in a single pass, rather than fitting them per scene. Top-tier publications in feed-forward reconstruction . First-author or significant work at CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, NeurIPS, ICLR or SIGGRAPH in this area. Video diffusion models . Familiarity with diffusion or flow-matching video models, especially camera-conditioned generation. Dynamic scenes . Work on dynamic reconstruction, scene flow or temporal consistency. Real-world capture . Experience with automotive, robotics or drone data and its mess: imperfect calibration, motion blur, poses you cannot trust. Making big models fast, or open-source contributions to widely used reconstruction libraries. Why join Parallel Domain? We are assembling a team of creative, talented visionaries seeking to build a new technology that will change the world. You will be able to learn, build, and scale our team and technology in a collaborative, creative culture that values every team member. To attract and inspire the right talent, we offer: • Competitive compensation (range will be openly discussed early in our interview process) • Employer-paid supplemental medical, mental health, dental, and vision benefits. • Flexible paid vacation, sick time, winter shutdown, and 11+ holidays per year • Paid parental leave • Equipment budget to optimize your setup • Annual learning and development stipend Parallel Domain celebrates diversity and is committed to creating a safe and inclusive environment for all our people. We are committed to providing employees with an environment free of discrimination, bullying and harassment. All employment decisions at Parallel Domain are based on business needs, job requirements and individual qualifications. We will maintain our commitment to and support of equal employment opportunity for all individuals without regard to race, national/ethnic origin, colour, religion, age, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, marital status, family status, genetic characteristics or physical/mental disability. Our commitment extends to any other protected classes which may exist under applicable law. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Frontend Engineer - React
description: ResearchGate is the professional network for scientists and researchers. From climate change and emerging diseases to food security and the responsible development of AI, the challenges facing our world are complex. Still, we’re optimistic about the power of millions of scientists working together to tackle them. We provide scientists with the help and support they need by connecting them to the world’s most active scientific community. We've built a platform that gives the world's scientists the tools and services they need to connect, collaborate, and advance their research. Over 25 million members from 193 countries use ResearchGate to share, discover, and discuss research. Objective of the role We're looking for an enthusiastic frontend engineer with the skills and ability to turn great ideas into reality. You should have an in-depth understanding of current web technologies and front-end development, and be passionate about creating a great user experience. Your input will help us grow and maintain our React front-end. Join a team that encourages you to explore, learn, and go beyond, while seeing your work lead to actionable results. Put your creative problem-solving and development skills into action and make a positive impact on science and society. This is a full-time position based in Germany. The team You will be an integral part of the product team dedicated to enhancing ResearchGate's publisher-facing product. This role involves designing, constructing, and refining the platform to further our mission of facilitating global scientific connections and ensuring open access to research. At present, our team is working on making ResearchGate a great platform for publishers to connect with existing and future authors. Your immediate colleagues will consist of JavaScript and PHP engineers, an Engineering Manager, a Product Manager, a UX Designer, and a UX Writer. Our team places great value on our collaborative and communicative work culture and we eagerly anticipate integrating a new Engineer into this environment. Responsibilites Create web interfaces using TypeScript and React for new products and features. Seamlessly integrate our front-end with our back-end world using GraphQL and PHP. Maintain and improve existing features and related infrastructure. Collaborate with Product Managers, Designers, and Software Engineers to deliver compelling publisher-facing products. Requirements 5+ years frontend web development experience in TypeScript (React), CSS Demonstrated ability to create code that is easily comprehensible, maintainable, and testable. Eagerness to acquire new skills, delve into different technologies and programming languages, and a willingness to acknowledge areas where expertise may be lacking. Approach problem-solving thoughtfully, embracing curiosity and maintaining an open-minded perspective. You are comfortable incorporating AI-assisted development tools into your daily workflow and exercise strong engineering judgment when evaluating and refining their output. Knowledge of GraphQL. It would be a plus if you already had knowledge of relational and document-based databases (we use MongoDB and Postgres). What we're looking for You take responsibility over your own solutions and continuously improve them. You engage in proactive and efficient communication within our distributed work environment. You focus on building a great product. You excel at designing and creating coherent, user-centric interfaces that display complex information. The interview process We start with a short call with HR or an Engineering Manager to align on the details of the job inquiry. There will be a longer discussion about your technical and professional experience and expectations with an Engineering Manager and another colleague. We’ll facilitate a technical interview with one or two engineers with some pair programming and technical discussion. You'll have a conversation with our VP of Product, Mark, and our VP of Engineering, Frank, to learn more about our product and engineering organization and discuss how your experience aligns with our goals. Last but not least, you will meet with our CEO, Ijad, and our VP of Finance & People team, Jess. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Executive & Personal Assistant, Founders’ Office
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Executive & Personal Assistant, Founders’ Office</strong></p> <p><strong>Location:</strong> San Francisco, CA or New York, NY (In-office / Hybrid)</p> <h3><strong>About the Role</strong></h3> <p>Cloudflare is seeking an exceptional, highly organized, and discreet <strong>Executive & Personal Assistant</strong> to join our Founders’ Office support team. Based in either <strong>San Francisco</strong> or <strong>New York City</strong>, this role works in close alignment with two Senior Executive Business Partners who manage direct daily support for Cloudflare’s Co-Founders.</p> <p>This is a versatile, high-touch role combining executive administrative support, event coordination, personal projects, and lifestyle logistics. You will provide critical execution capacity behind the scenes—anticipating needs effortlessly, moving between business and personal requests seamlessly, and ensuring every detail is handled with precision, follow-through, and strict confidentiality.</p> <h3><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Executive & Founder Support:</strong> Manage executive calendar coordination, meeting logistics, priority tracking, expense reports, and backup support alongside the Senior Executive Business Partners.</li> <li><strong>Travel & Itinerary Planning:</strong> Coordinate domestic and international executive and personal travel, including private aviation charters, luxury lodging, ground transportation, dining arrangements, and detailed door-to-door itineraries.</li> <li><strong>Events & Entertaining:</strong> Plan and execute private dinners, VIP hospitality, and personal events, managing venue sourcing, guest lists, menus, invitations, and on-site vendor logistics.</li> <li><strong>Personal & Lifestyle Support:</strong> Coordinate day-to-day personal logistics, appointments, dining reservations, executive gifting, wellness schedules, and ad-hoc errands.</li> <li><strong>Special Projects:</strong> Assist with special research, bespoke purchasing, prospective property coordination, and vendor oversight for home/office maintenance and seasonal projects.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What You Bring</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Experience:</strong> 5+ years of experience supporting C-suite executives, Founders, or UHNW individuals in a combined executive and personal assistant capacity.</li> <li><strong>Core Skills:</strong> Exceptional organization, eagle-eyed attention to detail, and proactive follow-through</li> <li><strong>Travel & Hospitality Expertise:</strong> Deep experience booking, managing, and troubleshooting travel, including private aviation charters and luxury accommodations. You offer a high-touch concierge service.</li> <li><strong>Professional Demeanor:</strong> Personable, polished, and collaborative, adept at partnering seamlessly with internal teams and external vendors, holding firm boundaries, and maintaining complete confidentiality</li> <li><strong>Technical Savvy:</strong> Strong working knowledge of Google Workspace (G-Suite) alongside practical adoption of AI and modern productivity workflows.</li> </ul> <h2><strong style="font-size: 14px;">Compensation</strong></h2> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location and level.</p> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>

title: Senior Research Scientist 3D Reconstruction & Spatial AI
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Intrinsic is an AI robotics group at Google aiming to reimagine the potential of industrial robotics. Our team believes that advances in AI, perception and simulation will redefine what’s possible for industrial robotics in the near future – with software and data at the core.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Our mission is to make industrial robotics intelligent, accessible, and usable for millions more businesses, entrepreneurs, and developers. We are a dynamic team of engineers, roboticists, designers, and technologists who are passionate about unlocking the creative and economic potential of industrial robotics.</span></p></div><h2>Role</h2> <p>As a Senior 3D Reconstruction & Spatial AI Engineer, you will own the development of the geometric and semantic perception stacks that power our physical AI framework. You will design real-time systems that enable our robots to translate unstructured, dynamic 3D environments into structured, queryable world models - seamlessly linking high-level task planners (such as VLM/VLA models) directly to robust, low-level manipulation and grasp policies in Flowstate. </p> <h2>How your work moves the mission forward</h2> <ul> <li>Design and deploy real-time spatial perception and state estimation pipelines using both in-house models like Gemini/Gemma and open source models</li> <li>Build multi-sensor fusion pipelines integrating RGB-D, stereo cameras, and IMU data into dense spatial representations (ex: point clouds, neural occupancy grids, or implicit signed distance function fields)</li> <li>Ground high-level semantic concepts into 3D geometric structures. This means building queryable, object-centric 3D scene graphs that map not just where an object is, but what it is, and its relationship to the other objects, and its functional properties</li> <li>Integrate open-vocabulary vision language models (ex: CLiP based visual descriptors, DINOv2) into 3D metric space to allow the robot to reason about natural language instructions (ex: ‘pick up the half-eaten apple and put it in the trash bin’)</li> <li>Develop learning-based spatial models (such as 3D Diffusion Policies) that utilize 3D point clouds to predict continuous grasp poses and trajectories</li> <li>Translate abstract semantic logic into functional affordances (ex: identifying the ‘graspable’ part of a mug versus the ‘containment’ part)</li> <li>Collaborate with eng teams to ensure that stochastic, learned semantic models cleanly map to deterministic safe boundaries on physical hardware</li> <li>Drive data strategies for collecting, labeling, and generating 3D synthetic data </li> </ul> <h2>Skills you will need to be successful</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Education:</strong> PhD (preferred) or Master’s in Robotics, Computer Vision, Machine Learning, or a related quantitative field—with a focus on Spatial AI, SLAM, or Embodied AI .</li> <li><strong>3D Vision:</strong> Deep mathematical foundations in multi-view geometry, camera calibration, visual-inertial odometry (VIO), and probabilistic state estimation .</li> <li><strong>Modern Deep Learning:</strong> Proven experience training and deploying multimodal architectures (VLMs/VLAs), contrastive learning frameworks, or 3D neural scene representations (NeRFs, Gaussian Splatting)</li> <li><strong>Programming & Systems</strong>: Expert level command of Python (PyTorch)</li> </ul> <h2>Skills that will differentiate your candidacy</h2> <ul> <li>Experience with robotics middleware (ROS2) and real time execution constraints would be a plus</li> <li>Hands-on "battle scars" from deploying onto physical robotic manipulators or mobile platforms</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p>At Intrinsic, we are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. Employment at Intrinsic is based solely on a person's merit and qualifications directly related to professional competence. Intrinsic does not discriminate against any employee or applicant because of race, creed, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding), or any other basis protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. It is Intrinsic’s policy to comply with all applicable national, state and local laws pertaining to nondiscrimination and equal opportunity.</p> <p>If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please contact us at: ----- Find more English Speaking Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

title: (Mid-Senior) Project Manager - Workday Optimization & HR Transformation (m/f/d)
description: At Flix, we offer a dynamic work environment with competitive pay, strong growth opportunities, and a tech-driven approach to making travel more accessible, sustainable, and affordable. You will join Flix's People & Organization in the Digital Transformation team to lead our HRIS transformation programme to optimize our processes, revamp payroll ecosystem and define the target operating model for a human-led, AI-partnered and agent-operated People function. As (Senior) Project Manager (m/f/d), you will bring structure to a large, fast-moving transformation across various workstreams. You will turn ambition into a plan, a decision framework and a delivery rhythm that HR, our internal Workday technology team and external partners can all follow. The role reports to the Head of Digital Transformation, and will work closely with People Operations, People Partners, Centres of Expertise and Tech teams. This role is based in Berlin , with a minimum office presence of 3 days per week. About the Role Lead HRIS transformation , owning the integrated plan, milestones, dependencies and RAID log across the HRIS revamp, payroll transition and operating-model workstreams, and keeping all our functional and tech teams working as one delivery engine Set up project governance and decision frameworks , including master data ownership, DACI/RACI and decision rights, intake and prioritization, escalation paths and steering forums Plan and facilitate process revamp workshops with our process owners, People Partners and CoEs, driving as-is/to-be gap analysis, global-first standardization with justified local variants, and clear process ownership across the hire-to-retire lifecycle Translate business needs into technical requirements , working with our HRIS tech team, user stories, acceptance criteria, testing and UAT, release readiness and documentation Steer a complex global payroll transformation including middleware solutions, integrations, parallel runs, sign-offs and cut-over, and building a repeatable migration playbook Manage stakeholders and drive proactive change management with transparent reporting, risk escalation, adoption metrics and a calm, structured presence when priorities shift About You 7+ years of experience managing complex, multi-country transformation programmes in HR technology, with a track record of delivering in a global-local environment Proven experience in Workday transformation projects, such as optimization, business process redesign or platform revamps, with enough technical fluency to challenge and align with configuration, security and integration teams. Workday certifications are an advantage Hands-on experience in payroll transformation , such as vendor migrations, country roll-outs, parallel runs and cut-over planning. Experience with global payroll providers is a strong plus Experience shaping target operating models and governance frameworks , including service delivery models, master data governance, DACI/RACI and decision-rights design Strong workshop and process-revamp skills, with the ability to facilitate cross-functional groups, map as-is/to-be processes (e.g. BPMN) and reach decisions without losing momentum Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, including influencing senior leaders, translating between business and technical teams, and staying calm and building structure in ambiguity. Familiarity with works council and multi-country compliance requirements is a plus Strong hands-on knowledge of Jira and Confluence . Certifications in project management or agile delivery (e.g. PMP, PRINCE2, SAFe, Scrum) are a plus. We recognize that everyone carries a unique set of valuable skills and experiences. If you think you could have an impact even though you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply. We want to hear from you! Hybrid work model : We are an office-first company, but we offer flexibility to balance work and life. Wellbeing support : Access confidential 1:1 counselling, courses, and stress management for yourself and up to four family members. Learning & Development : Take advantage of language classes, training courses, and expert-led sessions to grow your skills. Mentoring Program : Connect with experienced colleagues to gain insights and accelerate your career. To view more local benefits specific to each office location, please check out this link: Locations - Flix Career Why Join Flix? At Flix, you'll find teams that rally together to overcome challenges and spark creativity. We believe in ownership culture - giving you the freedom to take initiative, make an impact, and shape your own career path. As we continue to expand across the globe, you can make a real difference in how we work. If you're ready to grow and lead your journey, Flix is the place for you! description: Senior Sales Operations Manager - Partnerships Location: Berlin (office-first) Contract: Permanent Team description Partnerships is where SumUp is growing into a full service platform for integrators and enterprise partners, and Sales Operations keeps that growth running, from partner budgets and payments to the pipeline data that shows what's working. In this role, you'll take full ownership of the Sales Operations process domain from your first weeks and shape it for the long term, becoming the main point of reference for how our processes, tools and ways of working fit together. You'll also shape how we measure progress and success. What you'll do Own the Sales Operations process domain for Partnerships and act as the main point of reference for how processes, tools and teams work together Design, automate and improve Partnerships processes Review how commission and revenue share payments work, find ways to improve them and source a tool where needed Build Salesforce reporting and monitoring that tracks partner interactions , proposals and process KPIs, so the team can see progress and act on it Be the bridge between our Partnerships and Data, Systems and Finance teams to turn feedback from process users into improvements, supported by training and clear documentation What you'll bring Solid experience in a similar role, with a strong foundation in leading complex projects or strategic consulting Experience optimising sales and budget processes across regions and functions, with strong skills in process automation. Strong knowledge of Salesforce and other business systems, including shaping stages, fields and reporting around a sales pipeline. Expert level skills in Excel or Google Sheets and AI native. Ability to turn business needs into clear specifications for technical teams, and to source and evaluate new tools. Experience working closely with sales and finance teams within a fast paced and agile environment. A pragmatic and proactive approach, and the ability to keep moving through change and uncertainty. Nice to have: experience in people management, such as managing or mentoring others. Why you should join SumUp 🌎 Opportunity to work with SumUppers globally on large-scale fintech products used by millions of businesses worldwide, from our Berlin office. This involves an office-first set up 🌈 Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion: be part of a workplace that values and promotes diversity, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone's perspectives are respected and embraced 🚀 Enrolment onto our Virtual Stock Option programme: you will own a stake in SumUp's future success 📚 A dedicated annual L&D budget of €2000 for your individual development, which can be used to attend conferences and/or advance your career through further education 💶 A corporate pension scheme where we match up to 20% of your contributions 🏖 Generous time off: enjoy 28 days of paid leave plus public holidays and special leave days 🚵 Numerous other benefits such as Urban Sports Club subsidy, Kita placement assistance, subsidised office lunches 🌴 Break4me: 1-month sabbatical after 3 years of service 🔗 Referral Bonus: earn additional rewards by referring talented individuals to join the SumUp team About SumUp Be empowered to do more that matters. Today, over 4 million businesses in 39 markets rely on SumUp as their financial partner to manage payments, finance and customer relationships. Our commitment to small businesses is reflected in our diverse team of over 4,000 SumUppers from over 90 nationalities, united by global collaboration and an innovative mindset. Our core values lay the foundation for who we are and what we stand for, shaping our work culture and driving our success. We foster inclusivity and a continuous learning culture, providing a safe space for personal and professional growth. title: Test Technician
description: WHO WE ARE Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant. Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach. Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions. WHY JOIN PROXIMA FUSION You will get to work on some of the most complex tech challenges to bring abundant, safe, clean energy to the world. You'll get to join and learn from an exceptional selection of accomplished and driven individuals. Do your life’s best work and enjoy the journey. Get to show that big things are possible in Europe when you assemble the best talent. YOUR IMPACT At Proxima Fusion, we're developing the world's leading stellarator technology. To turn cutting-edge designs into reality, we need skilled technicians who can bring complex, first-of-a-kind hardware to life. As a Technician at Proxima Fusion, you'll work hands-on with Proxima-designed components, magnets, mechanical assemblies and other critical systems, supporting their build, assembly, integration and testing. Working closely with Engineering, Manufacturing and Quality, you'll help turn ambitious designs into reliable hardware, solve practical challenges on the shop floor and contribute to developing the processes and tooling needed to build Alpha. This is a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of advanced engineering and hands-on manufacturing, helping build one of Europe's most ambitious engineering projects. WHAT YOU WILL DO Run acceptance and characterization tests across incoming High Temperature Superconducting (HTS) tape, cables, intermediate assemblies, complete plate assemblies, and completed coils, supporting both development and production. Prepare and identify test articles by cutting, soldering, terminating, mounting, and fixturing in accordance with the test plan. Install sensors, voltage taps, feedthroughs and measurement wiring with careful grounding and shielding. Set up and operate dimensional inspection equipment, electrical instruments, high-current supplies, liquid-nitrogen baths, cryostats, cryocooler-based rigs and vacuum systems after training and authorization. Carry out critical-current and n-value measurements, joint-resistance, insulation-resistance and high-voltage insulation tests, plus visual and dimensional checks, using approved methods. Configure data acquisition and check connections, signal quality and instrument settings before each run. Follow test sequences precisely, monitor sample behavior and pause or stop at defined limits or unexpected conditions. Maintain full traceability of sample identity, test configuration, instrument settings, raw data, observations and deviations so that results and setups can be reproduced. Check data for completeness and plausibility, reduce and present results clearly, and compare them with defined acceptance criteria. Record all deviations, escalate suspect results or failures, and obtain approval before changing acceptance criteria. Troubleshoot test setups, wiring, instrumentation, and data acquisition. Distinguish test-article behavior from measurement faults, involving equipment technicians for machinery or rig repairs beyond approved routine care. Keep rigs ready for testing through pre-use checks, calibration-status verification, approved routine care and consumables management. Coordinate servicing and calibration, and recheck the test configuration after maintenance. Commission new fixtures with design and test engineering, and help turn development setups into documented, repeatable operations. Support failure investigations through post-test inspection and, when authorized in an agreed investigation plan, sectioning and other destructive examination. WHO YOU ARE A technical apprenticeship or qualification in electronics, mechatronics, laboratory work or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience. Hands-on testing, laboratory or measurement experience in an industrial, research or engineering environment. Practical electrical measurement skills. The ability to read engineering drawings and wiring diagrams and work precisely to a formal test procedure. Experience using data-acquisition systems and basic data reduction, with accurate record-keeping and the judgment to question implausible results. A disciplined approach to safety, configuration control and traceability. The ability to work across teams, communicate observations clearly and adapt as hardware and test methods develop. Working English for following procedures, recording results and discussing technical findings. Ln2 Experience Nice to have Experience with superconductoring, high or low temperature, cables or magnets, including critical-current measurements. High-current DC testing or quench detection. Experience with cryogenic testing, liquid nitrogen or helium, cryocoolers or vacuum systems. Specialist low-level instrumentation experience, including voltage taps, feedthroughs, sensor mounting, grounding and shielding. CAD literacy for reviewing or developing test fixtures. Python or LabVIEW for test automation, data handling, and plotting. German language skills. title: AI & Data Platform Engineer (GCP) (all levels)
description: Über KnowWay KnowWay entwickelt KI-Agenten für kritische Infrastruktur: Energie, Telekommunikation und öffentlicher Sektor. Wir automatisieren Geschäftsprozesse mit autonomen Agenten, und zwar für Kunden, bei denen Compliance, Nachvollziehbarkeit und Datensouveränität Pflicht sind. Wir begleiten unsere Kunden über den gesamten Daten- und KI-Lebenszyklus. Wir sammeln und speichern die Daten, verarbeiten sie mit und für KI, sichern ihre Qualität und integrieren die Ergebnisse in produktive Systeme. Das Projekt Für einen führenden Telekommunikationskonzern in Deutschland setzen wir Daten- und KI-Projekte auf der Google Cloud um. Wir kennen die gesamte Prozess- und Systemlandschaft des Kunden, arbeiten darin und bauen mehrere Plattformen, auf denen die Fachbereiche ihre Anwendungsfälle betreiben. Mehrere Anwendungsfälle laufen parallel und stehen an unterschiedlichen Punkten zwischen Discovery und Live-Betrieb. Unser Delivery-Team deckt dabei ungewöhnlich viel ab: Business-Analyse und die Definition der eigentlichen Anforderungen, Solution Design, schnelle PoCs und die Produktivsetzung. Wo es passt, verwenden wir vorhandene Plattform-Capabilities wieder, und wo etwas fehlt, entwickeln wir es neu. Der Stack läuft bereits produktiv. Dazu gehören LLM-Extraktionspipelines über einen gemanagten AI-Service mit vorgeschaltetem Compliance-Proxy, agentische Systeme mit Vector Search, Batch-Verarbeitung und Orchestrierung, ein zentrales Data Warehouse und containerisierte Services. Die Infrastruktur ist komplett als Code beschrieben und läuft in einer streng abgeschotteten Umgebung mit mehreren Freigabestufen. Auf der Roadmap stehen unter anderem der Umbau des Query-Layers, die Anbindung von On-Premise-Systemen an Cloud-Worker und die Integration weiterer Quellsysteme. Die Rolle Du arbeitest mit uns dort, wo Datenpipelines, KI-Modelle und Cloud-Infrastruktur zusammenkommen. Gemeinsam mit dem Team sorgst Du dafür, dass das Ergebnis im Produktivbetrieb zuverlässig läuft, und übernimmst dabei nach und nach mehr Verantwortung. Jeder Schritt soll nachvollziehbar, überwacht und wartbar bleiben, auch wenn sich Datenmengen, Dokumentqualität oder Anforderungen ändern. Zwei Wege in diese Rolle Der Stack reicht von der Infrastruktur über Datenpipelines bis zu LLM- und Agentensystemen. Niemand bringt das alles auf Expertenniveau mit, deshalb beschreiben wir zwei Profile mit jeweils anderen Entwicklungsperspektiven. Wenn Du einen Schwerpunkt und die Bereitschaft hast, auch in die andere Richtung mitzudenken, dann ist die Rolle die Richtige für Dich. Profil A - Platform-Schwerpunkt : Deine Erfahrung liegt vor allem in GCP/Cloud-Infrastruktur, Infrastructure as Code und Deployment. Daten- und AI-Pipelines willst Du so weit verstehen, dass Du sie betreiben und debuggen kannst. Profil B - AI & Data-Schwerpunkt : Deine Erfahrung liegt vor allem in AI Engineering, LLM- und Datenpipelines und in Datenmodellierung. Die Infrastruktur darunter willst Du so weit verstehen, dass Du selbst deployen und Probleme bis in die Plattform verfolgen kannst. In der Rolle entwickelst Du Dich jeweils in die andere Richtung: Mit Profil A arbeitest Du Dich zunehmend in AI- und Datenthemen ein, mit Profil B in Infrastruktur und Plattform. Wir planen das bewusst ein, und Du übernimmst auf der anderen Seite nach und nach mehr Aufgaben. Die Rolle passt auch für Junior- und Mid-Level-Engineers. Wichtiger als viele Jahre Erfahrung ist uns, dass Du in einem der beiden Bereiche schon praktisch gearbeitet hast und Lust hast, Dich in den anderen einzuarbeiten. Die Anforderungen unten "für beide Profile“ + das A oder B-Profil sind das Minimum, mit dem Du einsteigen kannst. Wer mehr mitbringt, steigt entsprechend höher ein. Deine Aufgaben Die Listen beschreiben das Spektrum des Teams. Wie viel davon Du am Anfang übernimmst, hängt von Deiner Erfahrung ab. Gemeinsamer Kern: Entwicklung und Betrieb von Datenpipelines auf GCP: Batch-Verarbeitung, Orchestrierung, Beladung der Datenplattform Anbindung neuer Datenquellen. Jede Quelle hat ihre eigenen Eigenheiten, deshalb lässt sich eine Anbindung selten einfach auf die nächste übertragen. Fehlersuche über die gesamte Kette, von der Quelldatei über Pipeline und Modell bis in die Anwendung Zusammenarbeit mit den Plattform-Teams des Kunden und Begleitung der technischen Freigabeprozesse Enge Abstimmung mit unserem Solution Architect zu Datenmodell und Architektur Schwerpunkt Platform: Aufbau und Pflege der Infrastruktur mit Terraform, über mehrere Umgebungen und Freigabestufen CI/CD-Pipelines, Deployment-Automatisierung, Container-Builds und Vulnerability-Gates Netzwerk, IAM, Secret-Management, Verschlüsselung und Zugriffskonzepte Logging, Monitoring und Alerting für Pipelines und Anwendungen Kostenkontrolle und Ressourcendimensionierung Schwerpunkt AI & Data: Entwicklung von LLM-Extraktionspipelines: Segmentierung und Klassifikation von Dokumenten, prompt-basierte Extraktion, Schema-Validierung, Upsert in die Datenplattform Extraktionsgenauigkeit bewerten und verbessern, auf Basis belastbarer Messungen Agentische Systeme und RAG: Multi-Agent-Architekturen, Embeddings, Vector Search, Evaluierung von Tool-Auswahl und Antwortqualität Datenmodellierung und Migration: Schema-Design, Historisierung, Umbau des Query-Layers von BigQuery nach Postgres Datenqualität als eigenes Arbeitsfeld Was Du mitbringst Für beide Profile: Mindestens etwa ein Jahr Berufserfahrung mit Datenpipelines, Cloud-Infrastruktur oder KI-Systemen. Eine längere Werkstudententätigkeit in einem Engineering-Team zählt auch. Idealerweise lief davon schon etwas in Produktion und nicht nur in Notebooks oder Proof-of-Concepts. Gute Python-Kenntnisse und solides SQL. Erfahrung mit GCP oder einer anderen Cloud wie AWS oder Azure. Kommst Du nicht von GCP, traust Du Dir zu, Dein Wissen schnell zu übertragen. Du arbeitest mit Git und Code Review und hast CI/CD schon in der Praxis genutzt. Du bleibst an einem Problem dran, bis Du verstehst, was passiert, auch wenn die Ursache drei Systemgrenzen weiter liegt. Deutsch und Englisch mindestens fließend. Unser Team arbeitet in beiden Sprachen, die Dokumentation der Fachbereiche ist auf Deutsch. Profil A (Platform): In mehreren dieser Punkte hast Du schon Erfahrung: Terraform oder ein vergleichbares IaC-Werkzeug GCP-Kernservices oder ihre Pendants bei anderen Clouds: Cloud Run, Cloud Storage, Cloud SQL, IAM, Networking, Secret Management CI/CD-Pipelines und Container-Builds Logging, Monitoring und Alerting in der Cloud Interesse an Daten- und AI-Pipelines: Du willst lernen, sie zu betreiben, zu debuggen und zu erweitern Profil B (AI & Data): In mehreren dieser Punkte hast Du schon Erfahrung: LLM-Anwendungen gebaut, etwa für Extraktion aus unstrukturierten Dokumenten, mit strukturierten Ausgaben, Schema-Validierung und Prompt-Design Du kennst die Grenzen von LLMs, etwa Nicht-Determinismus, Halluzination und Datenqualität als limitierenden Faktor, und Du misst die Genauigkeit Deiner Ergebnisse. Datenpipelines und Datenmodellierung: BigQuery oder ein vergleichbares Warehouse, Orchestrierung, Schema-Design Interesse an der Infrastruktur darunter: Du willst lernen, selbst zu deployen und Probleme bis in die Plattform zu verfolgen Nice-to-have: Erfahrung mit Gemini/Vertex AI, Document AI oder vergleichbaren Cloud-AI-Diensten Erfahrung mit Agenten-Frameworks (Google ADK, LangChain o. Ä.), Vector Search und RAG-Evaluierung Erfahrung mit Dataflow/Apache Beam, Composer/Airflow oder Kubeflow/KFP Erfahrung mit Data-Warehouse-Migrationen und Historisierungsmustern (SCD-2) Erfahrung mit Django/DRF Erfahrung mit OCR-Verarbeitung und schwankender Dokumentenqualität Erfahrung in regulierten oder governance-lastigen Enterprise-Umgebungen, etwa mit Security-Assessments, Datenschutz-Prüfungen und Verschlüsselungskonzepten Du setzt AI-Coding-Tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot o. Ä.) aktiv ein und hast einen eigenen Workflow, mit dem Du ihre Ergebnisse prüfst Branchenkenntnisse in Telekommunikation, Infrastruktur oder Rechnungsprüfung Wie wir Dich einarbeiten Du bekommst eine feste Ansprechperson im Team und startest mit einem abgegrenzten Teil, zum Beispiel einer Pipeline oder einem Modul. Code Reviews und Pairing mit erfahrenen Kolleginnen und Kollegen sind dabei Dein wichtigster Lernweg. So arbeiten wir mit KI Wir versuchen, KI in jedes Asset einzubauen, an dem wir arbeiten. Dabei prüfen wir jedes Mal, wo sie hilft, ob sie überhaupt hilft, ob ihr Einsatz compliant ist und wie man sie richtig einsetzt. Das gehört bei uns zur täglichen Routine und sollte auch zu Deiner werden. Was wir bieten Gehalt zwischen 60.000 und 80.000 Euro brutto im Jahr, je nach Erfahrung Erfolgsbeteiligung Betriebliche Weiterbildung Firmenevents und Company Offsites Flexible Arbeitszeiten und Homeoffice Ein Stack, der in Produktion läuft und den Du substanziell weiterentwickeln kannst, statt nur Tickets abzuarbeiten Standort Du arbeitest überwiegend im Homeoffice. Einmal pro Woche treffen wir uns als Team im Ruhrgebiet, im Wechsel in Duisburg und Dortmund, und einmal im Monat beim Kunden in Düsseldorf. Damit das gut machbar bleibt, sollte Dein Wohnort höchstens etwa 1,5 Stunden Fahrzeit von Dortmund oder Duisburg entfernt sein. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Customer Engineering Manager
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3><strong>Available Locations: Mexico City, Mexico</strong></h3> <h3><strong>What you’ll do as a Customer Engineering Manager</strong></h3> <p>As a SE Manager for Cloudflare for the LATAM Markets  you will be responsible for managing a cross functional, full sales life cycle and technical activities for Cloudflare customers. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of?
