title: Robot Learning Engineer, Human Motion Data (m/f/d)
description: About EASE EASE builds active, AI-powered exoskeletons for logistics and manufacturing. As a TUM spin-off, we have just started series production, and paid pilots with well-known logistics companies have led to first purchase orders. Our goal: move every parcel better, manually with an exoskeleton or autonomously with a robot. The role Our exoskeletons are deployed in real warehouses and production plants and capture what video-only datasets miss: body pose, joint kinematics, interaction torques, vision, and hand forces from real human work. Your job is to turn that data into skills our humanoid can actually perform, so that human workers and robots can work side by side on the same tasks. description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: </strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Austin, TX</strong></li> <li><strong>San Francisco, CA</strong></li> <li><strong>New York, NY</strong></li> <li><strong>Remote, US</strong></li> </ul> <h2>About the Department</h2> <p>Cloudflare helps build a better Internet and the Emerging Technology and Incubation (ETI) team invents, launches, and brings to market new technologies built on Cloudflare's network. Drive decisions and plans to closure, follow through on what is owed, and prep and close out the big moments such as planning cycles, onsites, and key forums. The teams will trust you to help set priorities across the group and to own new projects or dependencies. You will partner with the executive assistant, who handles booking, expenses, and logistics, while you help prioritize the calendar.</p> <p><strong>Research and Analysis: </strong>Get into the details with the teams: research and analysis, solving problems, and producing the docs and materials the head of ETI needs while keeping them human. You will be a real sounding board, with useful commentary and feedback.</p> <p><strong>Communications: </strong>Help ETI tell its story, internally and, with the Communications team, externally. You work independently and ask for help when you need it. You solve thorny problems by getting to first principles and then aligning the team on the goal; executing, learning, and adapting.</p> <ul> <li>Gets into the weeds and really understands the details, while keeping the high-level perspective</li> <li>Systems minded: thinks through dependencies and how the pieces fit together</li> <li>High agency: figures out ways to make things work</li> <li>Deeply curious: wants to know how and why the world works and is always learning</li> <li>Learns enough about how the Internet, crypto, and business work to give useful insight and make decisions on their own</li> <li>Builds well with LLMs, even if not a developer, shown by clear communication, structured thinking, and ownership of tasks</li> <li>Works comfortably with senior leaders and handles confidential information with discretion</li> <li>Excellent written and verbal communication skills</li> <li>A high degree of attention to detail</li> <li>The ability to work in a fast-moving and ever-changing environment</li> <li>A desire to receive feedback and grow</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Compensation</strong></p> <div id="model-response-message-contentr_ee1e331a02991da7" class="markdown markdown-main-panel md-content enable-luminous-fast-follows enable-updated-hr-color tutor-markdown-rendering"> <div class="first-token"><strong class="" data-path-to-node="0" data-index-in-node="0">Application Deadline:</strong> February 21, 2027</div> <h3 data-path-to-node="1"><strong data-path-to-node="1" data-index-in-node="0">Compensation</strong></h3> <p data-path-to-node="2,0,0">Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <ul data-path-to-node="2"> <li> <p id="p-rc_fd65bd246204b359-19" data-path-to-node="2,1,0"><span data-path-to-node="2,1,0,0">For SF, SJ, and Bay Area Metro based hires: Estimated annual salary of $216,000 - title: Senior Engineering Manager, Customer Observability
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: </strong>Austin, TX |  New York, NY | Lisbon, Portugal | London, UK</p> <h4><strong>About the Role</strong></h4> <p>As the Engineering Manager for our Developer Observability Platform you will manage a high-velocity customer-obsessed team. Your mission will be to empower customers by making their telemetry discoverable and actionable in one place. </p> <p>The team is international and distributed, they move fast and are deeply attuned to customer feedback. They bring a deep range of observability experience from major companies and fast-moving startups. This is a deeply cross-functional role that will need to understand the nuances of monitoring some of our most complex and high volume primitives such as Workers, Workers for Platforms, Agents, and Durable Objects. This is a high-visibility role that will be directly interfacing with some of our biggest customers.</p> <h4><strong>Responsibilities</strong></h4> <ul> <li> <p>Deliver excellent customer outcomes above all else. Whatever is required - building, planning, deciding, designing, communicating - you are accountable and get it done.</p> </li> <li>Set the technical and product vision along with your PM and Engineers. Build the right thing at the right time.</li> <li> <p>Building an observability platform for the current AI driven ecosystem. Agents empower new types of platforms capabilities even as they require new types of observability.</p> </li> <li> <p>Own the operational aspects of your platform such as SLOs, incident response, customer escalations, and technical debt. Reliability is its own feature.</p> </li> <li> <p>Recruit, mentor, and grow engineers. We have a high bar and expect you to raise it.</p> </li> <li> <p>Cultivate a team culture that values fast iteration, high agency, and ownership.</p> </li> <li> <p>Work cross-functionally with a range of platform and product teams to instrument and surface meaningful data in actionable ways.</p> </li> </ul> <h4><strong>Desirable Skills, Knowledge & Experience</strong></h4> <ul> <li> <p>A minimum of 8 years of relevant industry experience, including at least 4 years managing software engineering teams.</p> </li> <li> <p>Proven track record leading teams that have shipped and operated complex, large-scale systems and data-driven applications. Preferably in observability, developer platforms, cloud infrastructure, edge/proxy systems, or high-scale APIs.</p> </li> <li> <p>Significant technical depth, with the ability to guide architectural discussions, make credible technical decisions, review designs, and unblock your team.</p> </li> <li> <p>Strong developer tools taste. You have used and built enough observability products to know what makes them delightful or painful.</p> </li> <li> <p>Demonstrated ability to hire, coach, and develop senior engineers, and to build high-performing, inclusive teams that ship. You care about teams and team culture.</p> </li> <li> <p>A hands-on approach to leadership: you consider yourself a builder, stay close to the code, know the numbers, know the customer, and know what to build next.</p> </li> </ul> <h4><strong>Bonus Points </strong></h4> <ul> <li> <p>Working on hosted customer-facing observability products</p> </li> <li> <p>Instrumenting observability in global-scale, production environments </p> </li> <li> <p>Implementing observability (OTLP, OLAP databases such as Clickhouse, Grafana, Elasticsearch, Kibana, etc)</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience building with Cloudflare’s Developer Platform and have opinions on where we could improve, especially with respect to observability.</p> </li> </ul> <h4>Compensation</h4> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <ul> <li>For NY-based hires: Estimated annual salary of $220,000 - $303,000</li> <li>For Portugal-based hires: Estimated annual salary of €89,000 - €122,000</li> </ul> <h4>Equity</h4> <p>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare's equity plan.</p> <h4>Benefits</h4> <p>Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family. Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun! The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.</p> <p>Health & Welfare Benefits</p> <ul> <li>Medical/Rx Insurance</li> <li>Dental Insurance</li> <li>Vision Insurance</li> <li>Flexible Spending Accounts</li> <li>Commuter Spending Accounts</li> <li>Fertility & Family Forming Benefits</li> <li>On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program</li> <li>Global Travel Medical Insurance</li> </ul> <p>Financial Benefits</p> <ul> <li>Short and Long Term Disability Insurance</li> <li>Life & Accident Insurance</li> <li>401(k) Retirement Savings Plan</li> <li>Employee Stock Participation Plan</li> </ul> <p>Time Off</p> <ul> <li>Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave</li> <li>Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave</li> </ul> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. title: Client Success Manager - Netherlands
description: We are the platform turning browsing into shopping . We connect 200 million shoppers with deals they love while boosting local sales for hundreds of top retailers and brands. We help consumers save time and money while making smart shopping decisions, and we support retailers and brands in engaging customers from online research to in-store purchases. In 2024, Shopfully joined forces with the North American company , creating a global leader in the sector. Together, we reach 400 million households and serve over 1,000 top retailers and brands across 27 markets, including Europe, Canada, the USA, Latin America, and Australia. Ready to spark your growth with us? WHO WE LOOK FOR 🦄 We’re expanding into the Netherlands – and you could be one of our very first team members! We are looking for a Client Success Manager who combines hands-on campaign expertise , outstanding client communication , and an AI-first mindset . This is a highly client-facing role : you will work closely with our Performance and Paid Marketing teams, who handle most of the set-up and monitoring, and be ready to set up campaigns end-to-end and optimize them where needed and, above all, be the trusted point of contact for our clients throughout the whole campaign journey. You will own the operational execution and performance success of digital campaigns for our clients in the Netherlands, from the internal and client kickoff through optimization to periodic performance evaluations. The role goes well beyond campaign set-up: you will keep clients informed proactively , turn performance data into clear and convincing stories, and use AI , to work smarter, faster and with better insights. Your work directly impacts campaign performance, client satisfaction, and long-term customer partnerships. WHAT YOU WILL DO 🏄 Client Communication & Relationship Management Be the main point of contact for your clients: communicate consistently and proactively about progress, results and next steps Run periodic evaluations with the client, translating performance into clear insights and recommendations Build trusted, long-term relationships and translate client objectives into effective, measurable campaign strategies Campaign Set-up & Coordination Lead the internal and client kickoffs, coordinate content with all stakeholders and supervise the respective Performance and Paid Marketing teams in setting up campaigns, stepping in to do the full set-up yourself when necessary Collaborate closely with Sales, Client teams and internal stakeholders to ensure campaign success and delivery on time Optimization & Performance Optimize campaigns where needed, turning data into concrete actions to achieve the best possible results for the client Monitor and analyze performance, and manage campaign tracking, reporting and performance dashboards across formats, in coordination with the Performance and Paid Marketing teams Reports, Presentations & Sales Support Create reports and presentations for your clients, from regular performance updates to periodic evaluations Support the Sales team in creating decks for their proposals AI-Powered Ways of Working Use AI tools, in particular Claude, to generate reports and presentations, analyze performance and streamline your daily workflow Identify opportunities to improve and scale campaign processes through AI and automation Collaboration & Administration Work closely with international colleagues, with English as the language of collaboration Handle client invoicing WHAT YOU WILL NEED 🪄 Experience: 2–5 years in digital marketing, campaign management, or account management, ideally in an agency or international environment. Client Communication: Excellent communication skills and a proactive approach. You feel at ease being the main point of contact, translating data into clear insights and building trusted relationships. AI Proficiency: Confident in using AI in your daily work, in particular Claude for generating reports and insights, and curious to keep exploring new ways to work smarter. Coordination & Organization: Strong coordination skills, detail-oriented and able to manage multiple campaigns, deadlines and stakeholders at once. Optimization & Data Mindset: Curious about data, with a drive to achieve the best results for the client and the ability to make data-driven decisions. Digital Expertise: Strong knowledge of digital channels, trends, and tools (CRM systems like HubSpot, analytics tools like Google Analytics, SEMrush, Looker; display advertising platforms; Meta Business Suite). Excel or similar skills (Pivot tables) are a must. Campaign Knowledge: Proven experience managing multi-channel campaigns, understanding KPIs, and optimizing performance. Languages: Native-level Dutch and fluent spoken English. Mindset: A positive, proactive attitude and the energy to keep campaigns, clients and colleagues moving. 👉 At our company, we value diversity and actively encourage it — we believe a variety of perspectives and backgrounds makes us stronger. We focus on potential rather than on having a “perfect” CV. If this role excites you and you believe you could grow into it — even if you don’t tick every single box in the requirements — we’d love to hear from you! NICE TO HAVE 🎆 Comprehensive understanding of retail marketing functions, including budgets, retail purchase cycles, and category-specific user behavior (e.g., FMCG, Grocery, Fashion). LOCATION 🌐 While you need to be based in the Netherlands , you can benefit from our flexible hybrid or full remote model, empowering you to work where you're most effective. WHAT YOU WILL FIND AT SHOPFULLY 🤗 🌎 An opportunity to thrive in a rapidly scaling multinational company 🕶️ A vibrant, informal, and inclusive work environment 🧠 We champion autonomy, flexibility, and a hybrid work model, empowering you to own your work 📚 Access to learning opportunities and regular feedback sessions 🍓 Enjoy our central, modern offices featuring fresh snacks, coffee (including vegan options!), and ergonomic setups 🎉 Engage in meaningful team events: offsites, happy hours, company parties and celebrations that unite us beyond daily tasks 💻We provide all the necessary equipment for you to work effectively and set up your workspace, wherever you are 🧰 Benefit from additional country-specific advantages based on local contracts and practices WHO WE ARE 💜 We’re a team of 450 people (and counting!), from 30 different nationalities. We’re on a mission to innovate, and we believe the key to that is seeing the world through a variety of perspectives. That’s why building a more diverse team, as well as bringing in even more talent, is so important for us. TO FEEL AT HOME 🛋️ IN SHOPFULLY YOU NEED 🎯 Progress Over Perfection : We move forward. Always. In a fast-moving world, speed with purpose beats certainty without action. Momentum matters—not for its own sake, but because it drives results. Clarity Through Transparency : We bring each other along. We work in teams, not silos. Transparency gives context, and context enables action. That means we share decisions early, publish work in progress, and document outcomes so others can learn, move faster, and build better. Learn Loudly : We grow by doing and by daring. Big bets unlock big breakthroughs. But real innovation demands risk, and risk always carries the possibility of failure. That’s not a flaw. It’s the price of ambition. Challenge with Empathy : We speak up, even when it’s hard—because candor shows care, and leads to better outcomes. Listening deeply is how we grow. Disagreeing openly is how we build trust. Always Build Better: We are builders—of products, systems, and ideas. But more than that, we are builders of better. Better has no finish line. It’s a mindset. The aforementioned entities will act as joint controllers for the limited purpose of intra-group sharing related to the evaluation of candidates’ applications. description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>Brief info about Vinted </strong></h2> <p data-renderer-start-pos="1"><span data-sheets-root="1">Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third. <br>The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:<br><br><strong><a href="https://careers.vinted.com/marketplace" target="_blank">Vinted Marketplace</a></strong> is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.<br><br><a href="https://careers.vinted.com/vintedgo" target="_blank"><strong>Vinted Go</strong></a> enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.<br><br><a href="https://careers.vinted.com/vintedpay" target="_blank"><strong>Vinted Pay</strong></a> is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.<br><br>Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. </span></p></div><h2><strong>Information about the position </strong></h2> <p>You’ll become part of the Trust’s Detection team, with a mission to protect the Vinted community from harmful activities and content. The Detection team in the Trust domain is engaged in detecting, understanding, and stopping illegal, dangerous or inappropriate content within the Vinted Marketplace. As a Senior Decision Scientist embedded in a product team, you will become part of a cross-functional team and drive quality decisions by bringing actionable insights from data. </p> <p>You will lead hypothesis-driven product experimentation, translating data into actionable insights and product improvements. You will design and evaluate experiments with support from experienced stakeholders, ensuring rigorous validation of results and a clear, measurable impact, while maintaining high standards of data quality and accessibility.</p> <h2><strong>In this position, you’ll </strong></h2> <ul> <li>Partner with your team and stakeholders to identify strategic opportunities and provide data-driven recommendations and answer critical business questions.</li> <li>Work alongside other decision scientists to detect and investigate specific fraud patterns.</li> <li>Test and analyse opportunities to validate their value and understand their business impact, using statistical methods and visualisation tools.</li> <li>Select, calculate, and monitor your team's key performance indicators, proactively flagging issues, running analyses, and understanding root causes.</li> <li>Enable your team and direct stakeholders to independently leverage data for business insights via self-service dashboards.</li> <li>Contribute to a data-driven culture by promoting best practices in analytics and decision-making to make data count.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About you </strong></h2> <ul> <li>Extensive proven working experience as a Decision Scientist, Data Analyst, Data Scientist or a related position.</li> <li>Good analytical thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to balance depth of analysis with business impact.</li> <li>Familiarity with SQL and Python for data analytics.</li> <li>Experience with BI tools (e.g., Looker, Tableau, Power BI).</li> <li>Knowledge of statistical methods, such as A/B testing, regression analysis, and other inferential techniques.</li> <li>Highly results-oriented and comfortable with iterative processes.</li> <li>Strong communicator who can convincingly present results to both technical and non-technical audiences.</li> <li>Fluent in English, both written and spoken.</li> <li>Advantage: experience working in the Trust & Safety or Fraud-related area.</li> <li>Advantage: previous experience working in product teams.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Work perks  </strong></h2> <ul> <li>The opportunity to benefit from our share options programme</li> <li>25 days of paid annual leave</li> <li>Newest MacBook models</li> <li>Confidential Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for you and your family</li> <li>Frequent team-building events</li> <li>Home office support: we provide IT workstation equipment and a personal budget of up to €540 for home workplace furniture</li> <li>Lunch benefit per working day</li> <li>A personal monthly budget for shopping on Vinted</li> <li>Collective Defined Contribution Pension plan</li> <li>NS Business Card for your commute to the office by public transport</li> <li>Company bike leasing scheme</li> <li>Monthly budget for a flexible benefits platform</li> <li>Work from Home allowance</li> <li>A dog-friendly office</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Working at Vinted </strong></h2> <p><strong>Workation policy</strong></p> <p>Better balance holidays with workdays by working remotely! Up to 90 days per year in the EU, of these, 21 days can be spent globally. For non-EU citizens, it's 21 days worldwide. This can be combined with time off for vacation or personal time.</p> <p><strong>Individual learning budget</strong></p> <p>Each year, you’ll be given a learning budget (starting at €3,000), and a total of up to 10 working days over a 2-year period to support your personal and professional development.</p> <p><strong>Hybrid work</strong></p> <p>Our hybrid model, with 2 recommended office days a week, gives you and your team the flexibility to decide if and when you want to work from home, and when to catch up in person.</p> <p><strong>Equal opportunity</strong></p> <p>We welcome applications from everybody, regardless of your background, identity, or life experiences. Job openings come with guides, not checklists. If you’re excited about a role, but don’t identify with every point in the ‘About you’ section, apply anyway – you might still be the perfect match!</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="title">The annual gross salary range for this position excluding 8% holiday pay is:</div><div class="pay-range"><span>€67.700</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>€91.500 EUR</span></div></div></div> Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

Your mission is to ensure our hardware is accessible, secure, and performant across diverse environments—ranging from bare-metal deployments to complex virtualized and multi-device cloud infrastructures. Deep knowledge of OS internals, particularly kernel memory management and I/O paths. Strong understanding of memory safety requirements in kernel space. Ensure the security of accelerator operations through strict memory protection and resource isolation. Debug complex failures that span the entire stack: from hardware and kernel to hypervisor and guest OS. Support the scaling of our architecture from single-device setups to large-scale multi-device deployments. Healthcare coverage (including family-friendly options), pension contributions, professional development support, and 25 days of PTO, in addition to public holidays. Ownership of a key technical domain, with significant vertical and/or horizontal growth opportunities, based on performance and individual drive. title: Research Scientist Intern (PhD) - Cohort '27
description: Who we are Foundation models transformed text and images. Structured data - the largest and most consequential data format in the world - stayed untouched, until now. What LLMs did for language, we're doing for tables. We pioneered tabular foundation models: TabPFN v2 was a Nature cover story, has passed 3.5M+ downloads and 7,500+ GitHub stars, and runs in production from detecting lung disease with Oxford Cancer Analytics to preventing train failures with Hitachi . The hardest problems - millions of rows, real-time inference, entirely new modalities - are still open, and no one else is working on them at this level. We're a small, highly selective team of 40+ with backgrounds from Google, DeepMind, Meta, Apple, Amazon, Jane Street, and CERN, led by Frank Hutter , Noah Hollmann , and Sauraj Gambhir , and advised by Bernhard Schölkopf and Turing Award winner Yann LeCun. In July 2026, less than 18 months after our €9M pre-seed, we joined SAP as an independent frontier AI lab - same team, mission, and open-weights models, now backed by more than €1 billion over four years. About the role You’ll join our research team for a 4 to 6 month internship, in the cohort that starts in May 2027. The work is hands-on, with tabular foundation models, a new class of AI model, and how they’re applied. We have more open research problems than people to work on them, and you’ll get a project matched to your interests and expertise, with the chance to publish the results. Some of the problems we’re working on: Scaling model architectures and training Models that read text and tables together Architectures for time series, forecasting and anomaly detection Faster training and inference Causal reasoning in foundation models Learning across multiple related tables Benchmarks that show where tabular foundation models work and where they break, in science and in industry What we’re looking for You’re doing a PhD in computer science, applied maths, statistics, electrical engineering or a related field. You have at least one first-author or shared-first-author paper at a top venue such as NeurIPS, ICML or ICLR. You've turned your own research ideas into working experiments, for example in PyTorch, and you can tell when code is quietly wrong, whether you or a coding agent wrote it. You can join us in Freiburg or Berlin from May 2027 for 4 to 6 months. Experience with data science for tabular data or time series data is a plus Mentorship at Prior Labs Your mentor will be one of the researchers building TabPFN, who’ll help you with the technical side of your project and with your development as a researcher. Before you accept, we agree on a project area and a mentor with you, so you know what you’re working on and who you’re working with from day one. During the internship you’ll also work alongside the rest of our research and data science teams. Benefits A cohort of PhD interns who start with you, and a week-long workshop in Freiburg with the whole cohort in summer 2027 Opportunity to publish your work Compute for your project Healthcare, transportation and fitness covered Key dates Applications close on 1 January 2027. We review applications as they arrive, so applying early helps. The cohort starts on 1 May 2027 with a joint onboarding. We can make exceptions, but we’d like you to start with the cohort. The internship lasts 4 to 6 months, with 6 preferred. Life at Prior Labs You'll work alongside researchers and builders who hold themselves to a very high bar - in the quality of their work and in how they work with each other. We move fast and still take the time to do things right. Our teams are based in Berlin, Freiburg, and New York - when you're working on something as hard as TabPFN, being in the same room matters. But great people come from everywhere, and in exceptional cases we're open to remote, which usually means frequent travel to one of our offices. Wherever you're based, the whole company comes together regularly for offsites to build and celebrate together. Our Commitments The best products and teams are built by people with a wide range of perspectives and backgrounds. We welcome applications from all identities and walks of life - especially if you've ever felt discouraged by "not checking every box" - and provide equal opportunities regardless of gender, sexual orientation, origin, disability, or any other trait that makes you who you are. title: Electrical Engineer
description: About pplwise pplwise is a recruiting consultancy for fast-growing technology companies across Europe. About our client: Filics Filics is reinventing intralogistics with autonomous mobile robots (AMRs) that change how material moves. Its double-runner system makes Filics the first and only AMR that can drive through load carriers such as Euro pallets. This breaks with forklift logic and sets a new standard for efficiency. Filics is a small, hands-on team that solves hard problems with engineering excellence. Leadership goes to those who take initiative and consistently deliver. As Electrical Engineer (m/f/d) at Filics, you will design the electronics at the core of the next generation of robots. About the role This is an on-site/hybrid role in Munich, close to engineering and assembly. Filics doesn’t just use off-the-shelf components. It builds its own custom IP. The robots run on advanced boards that cover a wide range of electrical engineering. On one end is high power, such as battery and motor controllers. On the other end are high-speed interfaces like PCIe, USB and MIPI CSI. The real challenge is making all these subsystems work together as one system. Many of these problems have no textbook solution. Solving them takes solid experience, a deep understanding of the physics and a creative mind. The EE team is small, and the robot is far from finished. You’ll own your boards end to end : requirements, system design, schematic, layout, design review, sourcing, manufacturing, testing and validation. You’ll keep owning them for as long as they’re in production. You’ll work closely with Embedded Software, Mechanical Engineering, Software and the Production team. As Filics moves from prototypes to series production, your designs need to work reliably at scale , not just in the lab. What you’ll do Take full ownership of a complex PCB project and get it running in as few revisions as possible Design high-power and high-speed circuits and make sure they work together at system level Design for EMC, manufacturability and testability, and take boards through EMC testing and certification Bring new technical approaches to the team, for example a new converter architecture that enables higher charging power in a smaller package Introduce useful processes from your experience, such as simulation workflows that validate a layout before it goes to production Help with board bring-up and debugging together with Embedded Software, and support Production with clear documentation and training Take over ownership of existing boards so the team shares responsibility About you Several years designing electronics in an R&D environment at a smaller hardware company driven by innovation (e.g. robotics, e-mobility, aviation, autonomous vehicles, motion control) A proven record of taking PCBs within a larger system from requirements to a validated product Strong skills in schematic design and PCB layout (Altium, KiCad, OrCAD or similar) Hands-on debugging experience with an oscilloscope, logic analyzer, VNA or spectrum analyzer, plus soldering Experience with designs that went through EMC testing or CE certification An innovator’s mindset: you have built something new or significantly improved an existing concept Basic simulation know-how (e.g. LTspice, ANSYS, thermal/EM/tolerance analysis); deeper experience is a strong plus Basic experience with Linux and embedded software You work independently, take ownership and thrive without rigid structures What Filics offers Real ownership of your designs, from first draft to series production Space to innovate and a wide range of technical challenges, from power electronics to high-speed design A small, high-caliber team with close collaboration across disciplines Fast growth: one year at Filics teaches you what usually takes many years at a large company An on-site/hybrid role in Munich, close to Engineering and Assembly Sound like you? title: Produktionsmitarbeiter  (m/w/d)
description: Bei GALVANY ist es unser Ziel, klimaneutrales Wohnen für alle zur Realität zu machen. Wir setzen auf Umsetzung und entwickeln konkrete, smarte Lösungen, indem wir Wärmepumpen, Batteriespeicher und Smart Metering einfach zugänglich, zuverlässig und bezahlbar machen. Wir sind ein profitables Greentech-Startup und glauben, dass nachhaltiger Impact und langfristiges Wachstum nur auf Basis eines gesunden Geschäftsmodells möglich sind. Um unsere ambitionierte Tech Roadmap umzusetzen haben wir im Frühjahr 2026 eine Seed-Finanzierung in Höhe von 10 Millionen Euro mit Set Ventures und AENU abgeschlossen. Getrieben von Kundennutzen, Klarheit und Verantwortung stehen wir für hochwertige Heizlösungen und ein Arbeitsumfeld, in dem Menschen Verantwortung übernehmen und nachhaltigen Mehrwert schaffen. Die Rolle In unserer Eigenproduktion bauen wir die Komponenten vor, die unsere Installationsteams beim Kunden direkt einsetzen: hydraulische Cubes und elektrische Unterverteilungen für die Wärmepumpe. Je besser sie vorgefertigt sind, desto schneller und sauberer läuft die Installation vor Ort. Cubes sind unsere vormontierten Hydraulikmodule, die alle wesentlichen Komponenten für den Heizkreis kompakt in einem Gehäuse bündeln. Wir fertigen sie in mehreren Varianten für unterschiedliche Wärmepumpen und Einbausituationen. Unterverteilungen sind die elektrischen Verteiler, über die die Wärmepumpe abgesichert und angeschlossen wird. Sie werden nach Plan in Standardvarianten je Geräteserie und Leistungsklasse aufgebaut. Du arbeitest in einem kleinen Produktionsteam innerhalb von Supply Chain, eng verzahnt mit Lager, Kommissionierung und Einkauf. Die Produktion wächst mit unseren Installationszahlen und zieht 2027 in unser neues Hauptlager in Ludwigsfelde. Deine Aufgaben Montage von Cubes: Rahmen aus Aluprofilen aufbauen, Komponenten einsetzen, Verrohrung in Edelstahl-Pressfitting und Gewinde herstellen, Verkleidung montieren. Aufbau und Verdrahtung von Unterverteilungen nach Bestückungsplan, Stückliste und Stromlaufplan, inklusive Beschriftung der Betriebsmittel. Qualitätsprüfung vor Auslieferung: Dichtheitsprüfung der Cubes, Sicht- und Funktionsprüfung der Unterverteilungen, Dokumentation der Prüfergebnisse. Vorbereitung von Material für die Produktion, z. B. Kabel ablängen, Anschlusssets zusammenstellen, Rohre zuschneiden. Übergabe fertiger Cubes und Unterverteilungen in die Projektkommissionierung, termingerecht zur geplanten Installation. Pflege der Materialbestände am Arbeitsplatz und frühzeitige Meldung von Fehlmengen an Lager und Einkauf. Mitarbeit an der Weiterentwicklung unserer Varianten und Arbeitsabläufe: Rückmeldung aus der Montage zu Stücklisten, Bauteilen und Prozessen. Ordnung, Sauberkeit und Arbeitssicherheit in deinem Produktionsbereich. Dein Profil Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Elektroniker:in für Energie- und Gebäudetechnik, Anlagenmechaniker:in SHK, Mechatroniker:in oder vergleichbare Qualifikation. Erfahrung in Montage, Verdrahtung oder Rohrinstallation, idealerweise im Schaltschrank-/Verteilerbau oder in der Heizungstechnik. Du liest Stromlaufpläne, Bestückungspläne und Stücklisten sicher und setzt sie genau um. Handwerkliches Geschick und sauberer Umgang mit Werkzeug, z. B. Pressmaschine, Crimpzange, Abisolierwerkzeug. Von Vorteil: Qualifikation als Elektrofachkraft, Erfahrung mit Prüfungen nach DIN VDE 0100-600 bzw. DIN EN 61439 oder Grundkenntnisse zu Wärmepumpen-Hydraulik. Gute Deutschkenntnisse (mind. B2), um Arbeitsanweisungen und Pläne sicher zu verstehen. Benefits Werde Teil eines schnell wachsenden und profitablen Climate-Tech-Startups. Attraktive und wettbewerbsfähige Vergütung. Feste Arbeitszeiten ohne Montage- und Reisetätigkeit. Strukturierte Einarbeitung in unsere Cube- und Unterverteilungsvarianten. Individuelle Benefits, abgestimmt auf deine Bedürfnisse, z. B. Sportmitgliedschaften, ÖPNV-Ticket oder Learning Budget. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Named Account Executive, New Business
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h2><span style="color: rgb(230, 126, 35);">Available Locations</span></h2> <hr> <p>Munich, Frankfurt or Berlin</p> <h2><span style="color: rgb(230, 126, 35);">About the Role</span></h2> <hr> <p>We are seeking an exceptional new-logo builder to join our <strong>Named Sales Team</strong> as a <strong>Senior Named Account Executive</strong>. Your primary mission is new logo acquisition within an assigned portfolio of high-potential Named accounts: identifying, pursuing, and closing net-new business with leading enterprises across Germany. You will create opportunities where no existing relationship or active buying process exists, open doors at executive level, and establish Cloudflare as a long-term platform partner. Developing and expanding a limited number of existing Named accounts will be secondary to winning new business. The ideal candidate combines a relentless prospecting mindset with sophisticated enterprise sales execution, executive presence, and genuine technical fluency, enabling credible engagement from the boardroom to CISOs, CIOs, CTOs, and Heads of Infrastructure.</p> <p>As a Senior Named Account Executive, you will own your territory and assigned Named-account portfolio end-to-end. You will prioritise accounts based on their potential, build multi-year account plans, generate high-quality pipeline through direct outreach and the wider partner ecosystem, and orchestrate virtual deal teams across Customer Engineering, Product, Deal Desk, Legal, and Partners. You will lead complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles, challenge customers’ thinking with a strong point of view, and consistently exceed new logo and new business targets. In line with Cloudflare’s AI-native culture, you will actively leverage AI tools across prospect research, account prioritisation, executive outreach, account planning, meeting preparation, and pipeline management—using them as a genuine force multiplier in how you hunt and sell.</p> <h2><span style="color: rgb(230, 126, 35);">Responsibilities</span></h2> <hr> <p><strong>New Logo Acquisition within Named Accounts:</strong> Own the identification, pursuit, and closure of net-new business across your assigned Named-account portfolio as the primary focus of the role. Build pipeline proactively through personalised executive outreach, disciplined prospecting, ecosystem engagement, partner channels, industry networks, and referrals. Create demand rather than relying on inbound opportunities, and consistently bring significant new logos onto the Cloudflare platform.</p> <p><strong>Named Account Planning:</strong> Develop and execute comprehensive, multi-year account plans for priority net-new targets and selected existing Named accounts. Identify whitespace, business initiatives, power structures, buying processes, competitive dynamics, and potential entry points. Continuously assess account potential and concentrate time and resources on the accounts and opportunities with the greatest potential for platform-wide adoption.</p> <p><strong>Executive Relationship Management:</strong> Build trusted relationships at CISO, CIO, CTO, and board level, often starting without an existing Cloudflare presence. Develop broad, multi-threaded executive networks within target Named accounts and act as a trusted advisor by bringing relevant market insight, a compelling point of view, and clear business value—not simply responding to RFPs.</p> <p><strong>Complex Sales Cycle Leadership:</strong> Lead sophisticated enterprise sales processes from initial engagement through contract signature. Navigate technical, security, legal, procurement, financial, and executive buying centres simultaneously. title: Payment Operations Manager (w/m/x)
description: Über Patronus Patronus entwickelt intelligente Notruf-Technologie, die Senior*innen mehr Sicherheit und Unabhängigkeit im Alltag gibt. Als Payment Operations Manager (w/m/x) wirst du Teil unseres Partner & Payments Management Teams (aktuell 5 Personen) und berichtest direkt an unsere Senior Team Lead Partner & Payments Management. Wenn Pflegekassen die Kosten für die Patronus-Uhr übernehmen, steckt dahinter ein komplexer Prozess: vom Antrag auf Kostenübernahme über die Bestätigung und die Abrechnung bis zum Zahlungseingang. Genau diesen geschäftskritischen Prozess verantwortest du – mit direktem Einfluss auf unseren Cashflow. Was uns als Team ausmacht: Echte Ownership statt Abarbeiten, schnelle Umsetzung und offene Kommunikation. Wir sind ein bisschen nerdy, wenn es um saubere Prozesse und gute Daten geht – und mindestens genauso begeistert, wenn ein Problem endlich an der Wurzel gelöst ist. Wenn es dir genauso geht, bist du bei uns richtig! Deine Mission Du verantwortest die Abrechnung mit Pflegekassen End-to-End – vom Antrag auf Kostenübernahme bis zum Zahlungseingang – und packst dabei selbst operativ mit an. Du steuerst unseren Abrechnungsdienstleister sowie weitere externe Partner und treibst offene Themen mit ihnen und den Kassen konsequent bis zum Ergebnis. Du prüfst Abrechnungs- und Zahlungsdaten, erkennst Auffälligkeiten und finanzielle Risiken früh und machst Zahlen und Prozesse mit einem aussagekräftigen Reporting transparent. Du löst nicht nur Einzelfälle, sondern erkennst Muster, behebst Ursachen und baust Abläufe so auf, dass sie dokumentiert, skalierbar und wo sinnvoll automatisiert sind. Du gestaltest aktiv mit, wie sich unsere Abrechnung in Zukunft aufstellt – nicht nur auf dem Papier, sondern auch in der Umsetzung. Dein Talent Du bringst mindestens 3 Jahre Berufserfahrung in Operations, Prozessmanagement, FinOps, Partnermanagement oder Abrechnungsmanagement mit, idealerweise im Healthcare- oder Tech-Umfeld. Du hast nachweislich Prozesse von Grund auf aufgebaut und externe Dienstleister gesteuert. Du bist proaktiv, übernimmst Ownership, erkennst Verbesserungspotenzial und packst operativ mit an. Dabei kommunizierst du klar und verbindlich – intern wie extern. Du arbeitest analytisch und sehr genau, bist sicher in Google Sheets/Excel und nutzt AI-Tools wie Claude oder ChatGPT selbstverständlich im Arbeitsalltag. Du sprichst Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau und Englisch mindestens auf B2-Niveau. Plus: Erfahrung in der Abrechnung mit Pflege-/Krankenkassen Erfahrung mit Automatisierung und No-Code-Tools (z. B. Jahr) 🧘 Fitness & Freizeit: Bis zu 50% Rabatt auf Urban Sports Club, Corporate Benefits, Restaurant-Deals sowie Family & Friends Coupon auf die Patronus Uhr 🚲 Mobilität: 30% Rabatt aufs Job Ticket sowie vergünstigtes Fahrrad-Leasing 🥤 Verpflegung: Kostenfreie Softdrinks & Kaffeevollautomat, Müslibar, vierteljährliche Company Brunches sowie wöchentliche Healthy Snacks 💻 Hardware: Freie Wahl zwischen MacBook und Lenovo 🌍 Impact: Ein Produkt mit echtem gesellschaftlichem Mehrwert plus ein Volunteering-Tag im Jahr Einfach. Wir sind mehr als ein Anbieter für intelligente Notruf-Uhren – wir entwickeln Technologien, die Menschen ein selbstbestimmtes Leben ermöglichen: We create a world where aging is delightful. Möglich macht das unsere revolutionäre Patronus-Uhr: Auf den ersten Blick nicht als Notruf erkennbar, ermöglicht sie es Nutzer*innen, jederzeit und überall unkompliziert Hilfe zu rufen. title: Recruiter, R&D (APJ)
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><p><strong>An overview of this role</strong></p> <p>As a Technical Recruiter, you'll help GitLab build the engineering and product teams behind our DevSecOps platform. In this individual contributor role, you'll partner with leaders across Engineering, Product, Security, and UX and own searches from intake through close. You'll build inclusive pipelines and use data and market insight to guide hiring decisions, while growing into a trusted talent advisor.</p> <p><strong>What you'll do</strong></p> <ul> <li>Manage full-cycle searches for roles such as Backend and Frontend Engineers, Site Reliability Engineers, Security Engineers, Data Engineers, Engineering Managers, and Product Managers, delivering against agreed recruiting goals and key metrics with accurate, timely documentation in Greenhouse.</li> <li>Lead intake and kickoff conversations to align hiring teams on role scope, technical requirements, team context, interview plans, and timelines, with senior team guidance as needed.</li> <li>Partner with hiring teams on structured, equitable technical interviews with clear competencies and actionable feedback; challenge assumptions and escalate risks or blockers early.</li> <li>Use talent-market research, compensation benchmarks, funnel metrics, and candidate feedback to shape search strategy and address hiring issues.</li> <li>Assess technical candidates on depth of experience, scope and impact of past work, problem-solving, and open source or community contributions, and how well their skills fit GitLab's teams and technology.</li> <li>Build research-based, diversity-focused sourcing plans that balance applicants, passive talent, referrals, internal talent, and targeted outreach across technical communities and specialized talent pools.</li> <li>Deliver a thoughtful candidate experience through disciplined pipeline management, proactive communication, timely feedback, and offer negotiations that clearly explain compensation, equity, and benefits.</li> <li>Improve recruiting practices by sharing learnings and reusable resources, using artificial intelligence (AI) responsibly, and representing GitLab's mission, values, and culture.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What you'll bring</strong></p> <ul> <li>Intermediate-level recruiting experience, with a track record of owning full-cycle searches independently.</li> <li>Technical recruiting experience, or a strong interest in learning engineering and product disciplines, tech stacks, team structures, and how software is built and shipped.</li> <li>Developing advisor skills: building stakeholder trust, influencing without authority, and managing hiring team expectations.</li> <li>Experience building proactive, diversity-focused sourcing strategies and balanced pipelines for hard-to-fill or specialized roles.</li> <li>A data-informed approach that turns funnel insights into practical actions.</li> <li>Strong organization across multiple requisitions and clear written and verbal communication across time zones, with attention to detail and candidate care.</li> <li>Experience with an applicant tracking system and recruiting tools such as Greenhouse, LinkedIn Recruiter, LinkedIn Insights, SeekOut, or comparable platforms; ability to evaluate AI-generated work, protect confidential information, and share responsible workflows with team members.</li> <li>Experience recruiting for DevSecOps, developer tools, or open source software is helpful, not required.</li> </ul> <p><strong>About the team</strong></p> <p>We work in a globally distributed, remote-first Talent Acquisition team where clear communication and reliable follow-through matter. Our team members share learnings and create reusable resources to improve the quality and consistency of hiring across Research & Development.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off </a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a> </li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/company/culture/inclusion/#examples-of-select-underrepresented-groups">underrepresented groups</a> are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.</p> <hr> <p><strong>Country Hiring Guidelines: </strong>GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.  </p> <p><strong>Privacy Policy: </strong>Please review our <a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/candidate-faq/recruitment-privacy-policy/" target="_blank">Recruitment Privacy Policy.</a> Your privacy is important to us.</p> <p>GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. See also <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/people-policies/inc-usa/#equal-employment-opportunity-policy" target="_blank">GitLab’s EEO Policy</a> and <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/labor-and-employment-notices/#eeoc-us-equal-employment-opportunity-commission-notices" target="_blank">EEO is the Law</a>. If you have a disability or special need that requires <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/people-policies/inc-usa/#reasonable-accommodation" target="_blank">accommodation</a>, please let us know during the <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/interviewing/#adjustments-to-our-interview-process" target="_blank">recruiting process</a>.</p></div>

title: Marketing Specialist (Benelux & Nordics)

title: People Operations Onboarding Specialist
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: </strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Austin, TX</strong></li> <li><strong>London, UK</strong></li> </ul> <p><strong>Work arrangement:</strong> Hybrid </p> <p><strong>Engagement:</strong> 9 month contract</p> <p><strong>Hours:</strong> Full-time</p> <p><strong>Reports to:</strong> Global Onboarding Program Manager, Austin, TX</p> <p><strong>About the role</strong></p> <p>Cloudflare is building a consistent, welcoming onboarding experience for new hires around the world. We're hiring two Onboarding Specialists one in the Austin, TX and one in London, England. You'll run the day-to-day work of getting new hires ready, welcomed, and set up for success.</p> <p>You'll be the main contact for new hires, hiring managers, and recruiters from offer acceptance through the first weeks. You'll partner with IT, recruiting, learning and development, and Workplace teams, and you'll report to the Global Onboarding Program Manager.</p> <h4><strong>What you'll do</strong></h4> <ul> <li><strong>Manage start dates.</strong> Track upcoming starts, handle start date changes, and work with recruiters and hiring managers to keep timelines on track.</li> <li><strong>Own the preboarding process.</strong> Complete and follow up on every step between offer acceptance and Day 1, so each new hire arrives ready.</li> <li><strong>Facilitate orientation.</strong> Lead regional new hire orientation sessions, in person and virtually.</li> <li><strong>Manage orientation facilitators.</strong> Schedule, prepare, and support the colleagues who present at orientation. Handle changes and keep sessions running smoothly.</li> <li><strong>Provide onboarding support.</strong> Answer new hire and manager questions, resolve common issues through our ticketing system, and escalate when needed.</li> <li><strong>Communicate with new hires.</strong> Send timely, clear, and friendly messages that tell new hires what to expect before and during their first days.</li> <li><strong>Maintain and create onboarding content.</strong> Keep orientation materials, guides, and resources accurate and up to date.</li> <li><strong>Support new hires in Workday.</strong> Manage new hire data in Workday. Help new hires complete their tasks and training, and fix issues as they come up.</li> <li><strong>Support right to work and work authorization.</strong> Verify new hires' employment eligibility, including the US I-9 and UK Right to Work processes, and our internal work authorization programs. Follow up on outstanding documents, and keep records accurate and confidential.</li> <li><strong>Improve how we work.</strong> Spot recurring problems, build simple tools and templates, and improve documentation to make onboarding smoother and more scalable.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience:</strong></h4> <ul> <li>2+ years in HR operations, onboarding, Du bringst deine Erkenntnisse aus Trainings, dem Onboarding und der täglichen Praxis aktiv in Reportings sowie Management Präsentationen ein und lieferst damit wertvolle Impulse für die Weiterentwicklung unserer Servicequalität. Du verantwortest die Pflege und den kontinuierlichen Ausbau unserer Knowledge Database und stellst die Aktualität sowie Qualität der Inhalte sicher. Du arbeitest eng mit den operativen Führungskräften undFachbereichen zusammen, um Veränderungen an Prozessen, Produkten und Systemen frühzeitig in Schulungsmaßnahmen zu überführen. Dein Profil Du bringst mindestens 3 Jahre Berufserfahrung als Trainer im Customer Care mit, idealerweise bei einem auf Customer Care spezialisierten Dienstleistungsunternehmen. Du verfügst über fundierte didaktische Kenntnisse und weißt, wie du Schulungen praxisnah gestaltest und auf unterschiedliche Zielgruppen und Wissensstände abstimmst. Du hast ein gutes Gespür für Servicequalität, kennst dich mit gängigen Kennzahlen wie CSAT, FCR und Bearbeitungszeiten aus und erkennst Verbesserungspotenziale. title: Growth Marketing Manager (m/w/d) – Denken. Bauen. Wachsen.
description: Metropolregion Nürnberg – Vollzeit ab sofort Über uns Viele Menschen haben nach dem Essen immer wieder Beschwerden und wissen nicht, woran es liegt. Mit viatolea® finden sie ihre Auslöser heraus: Auf Basis eines Ernährungs- und Symptomtagebuchs, unterstützt durch moderne Technologie und unsere Ernährungsfachkräfte, durchlaufen Nutzer:innen ein strukturiertes Programm und stellen danach ihre Ernährung individuell um. viatolea ist ein CE-gekennzeichnetes Medizinprodukt und eine Ausgründung der FAU Erlangen-Nürnberg. Für Versicherte unserer Partnerkrankenkassen ist das Programm 100 % kostenfrei. Wir sind ein junges Unternehmen und arbeiten seit rund vier Jahren an der Idee hinter viatolea. Eingefahrene Strukturen gibt es bei uns nicht: Wir probieren aus, lernen schnell und entscheiden auf kurzem Weg. Unsere Vision Wir haben eine klare Vision: Jeder Mensch, der nach dem Essen immer wieder Beschwerden hat, soll wissen, dass es einen Weg gibt, die eigenen Auslöser herauszufinden. Dafür möchten wir viatolea bekannter machen und möglichst viele Menschen erreichen, für die unser Programm passt. Wie wir dahin kommen, gestaltest du. Deine Aufgaben Als unsere erste Marketingkraft verantwortest du Strategie und Umsetzung und hast vom ersten Tag an viel Gestaltungsspielraum. Du entwickelst unsere Marketingstrategie weiter, setzt Prioritäten und entscheidest, wohin Zeit und Budget fließen. Du analysierst unseren Funnel von der ersten Suche bis zur aktiven App-Nutzung, findest Hürden und verbesserst Website, Landingpages und Registrierung mit sauberen A/B-Tests. Du baust unsere Sichtbarkeit über SEO und Content aus, in Suchmaschinen und zunehmend auch in KI-Suchen wie ChatGPT. Du betreust bestehende Kanäle wie Meta und Google Ads und entscheidest anhand von Zahlen, wo sich weiterer Einsatz lohnt. Du entwickelst Botschaften und Inhalte für Website, Newsletter, Social Media und unsere Partnerkassen. Du legst KPIs fest, verbesserst Tracking und Reporting und machst sichtbar, was wirkt. Du setzt selbst um: Texte, Landingpages, Kampagnen und Tests baust du selbst, bei Bedarf mit externer Unterstützung. Das bringst du mit Uns ist wichtiger, wie du denkst, als wie viele Jahre in deinem Lebenslauf stehen. Du lernst schnell und willst verstehen, warum etwas funktioniert: Du arbeitest dich zügig in neue Themen ein, hinterfragst Annahmen und stellst die richtigen Fragen. Du denkst analytisch und in Funnels: Du triffst Entscheidungen auf Basis von Zahlen und weißt, wann Daten aussagekräftig sind und wann nicht. Du hast erste Erfahrung im Online- oder Growth-Marketing, idealerweise mit SEO, SEA oder Conversion-Optimierung, ob im Job, in eigenen Projekten oder als Quereinstieg. Du arbeitest sehr selbstständig: Du setzt dir Ziele, priorisierst und ziehst Dinge durch. Du packst selbst an, statt nur zu beauftragen. Du schreibst sehr gut und hast ein Gespür für Botschaften, die Menschen erreichen. Du sprichst und schreibst Deutsch auf sehr hohem Niveau (C2). Erfahrung im Gesundheitsbereich ist kein Muss. Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Ernährungsteam zusammen, damit Inhalte fachlich stimmen und den Regeln für Gesundheitswerbung entsprechen. Was wir dir bieten Gestaltungsspielraum: Du arbeitest direkt mit uns Gründer:innen zusammen und triffst Entscheidungen selbst. Impact: Mehr als 15.000 Menschen haben viatolea bereits genutzt. Was du verbesserst, siehst du direkt in den Zahlen. Entwicklungsperspektive: Mit dem Wachstum von viatolea wächst auch dein Verantwortungsbereich, perspektivisch bis zum Aufbau und zur Führung eines eigenen Marketing-Teams. Starkes Umfeld: Wir arbeiten mit Krankenkassen sowie der FAU Erlangen-Nürnberg und der LMU München zusammen und wurden schon mehrfach ausgezeichnet. Diese Erfolge feiern wir regelmäßig gemeinsam im Team :-) Flexibilität: flexible Arbeitszeiten und ein Tag Homeoffice pro Woche. Interessiert? Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und ein paar Sätze dazu, was dich an der Stelle reizt. Und gern auch: Was würdest du an unserem Auftritt als Erstes ändern, und warum? Pauline freut sich darauf, von dir zu hören! Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Mainframe Data Engineer - 3 to 6 Months Contract
description: We are seeking an experienced Senior Data Engineer with a strong background in designing, deploying, configuring, and managing enterprise-scale data engineering platforms within secure, on-premises and air-gapped environments. The ideal candidate will have extensive hands-on experience working with Apache Hadoop and Apache Spark clusters , including installation, configuration, administration, troubleshooting, performance optimisation, and workload management in environments with restricted or no internet connectivity. This role will support our Global Data Centre (GDC) environment, requiring a candidate who understands the operational and technical challenges of delivering robust, scalable, and secure data platforms within isolated infrastructure. The successful candidate will work closely with infrastructure, platform, DevOps, and data engineering teams to build and maintain reliable data processing capabilities. Key Responsibilities Design, deploy, configure, and maintain Apache Hadoop and Apache Spark clusters in on-premises and air-gapped environments. Manage the full lifecycle of Hadoop/Spark platforms, including installation, upgrades, patching, configuration, monitoring, and troubleshooting. Develop, implement, and maintain scalable data pipelines for batch and distributed data processing. Optimise Spark workloads and Hadoop cluster performance, including resource allocation, job scheduling, and capacity management. Work with PostgreSQL and other enterprise data systems to support data integration, storage, and processing requirements. Support the deployment and management of containerised applications using Kubernetes and Helm. Implement and manage service-to-service communication and traffic management using Istio Service Mesh. Ensure software dependencies, container images, packages, and platform components can be deployed and maintained without external internet connectivity. Implement secure configuration and operational practices aligned with enterprise security requirements. Troubleshoot complex infrastructure, cluster, application, and data pipeline issues. Collaborate with infrastructure, security, DevOps, and application teams to ensure platform stability and availability. Maintain technical documentation, deployment procedures, operational runbooks, and platform architecture documentation. Support integration with legacy enterprise data systems, including VSAM. Requirements Required Technical Skills & Experience 1. Apache Hadoop & Apache Spark Strong hands-on experience deploying, configuring, and administering Apache Hadoop clusters. Proven experience deploying and managing Apache Spark clusters and workloads. Experience with distributed data processing, batch processing, and large-scale data pipelines. Strong understanding of cluster architecture, resource management, performance tuning, and troubleshooting. Experience operating big data platforms in on-premises and air-gapped environments. 2. Air-Gapped & On-Premises Infrastructure Practical experience working in isolated, restricted-network, or air-gapped environments. Understanding of offline software installation, dependency management, package repositories, and container image management. Experience managing platform deployments without direct access to public internet repositories. Knowledge of secure infrastructure operations and enterprise deployment standards. 3. Containerisation & Platform Engineering Experience with Kubernetes-based platform deployments. Hands-on experience with Helm charts for application and platform deployments. Working knowledge of Istio Service Mesh, including traffic management, service discovery, and secure service-to-service communication. Understanding of container orchestration and microservices architecture. 4. Data Systems & Engineering Strong experience with PostgreSQL, including database integration and performance considerations. Experience designing, developing, and maintaining data pipelines. Understanding of distributed data storage and processing architectures. Knowledge of VSAM and integration with legacy enterprise data environments. Preferred / Desirable Skills Experience supporting large-scale enterprise or government data centre environments. Familiarity with Linux system administration. Experience with infrastructure automation and configuration management. Knowledge of data security, access controls, encryption, and secure data handling. Experience with monitoring, logging, and platform observability. Exposure to DevOps and CI/CD practices in restricted-network environments. Candidate Profile The ideal candidate will be a hands-on technical engineer rather than purely an architectural or theoretical resource. They should be comfortable taking ownership of the deployment, administration, troubleshooting, and ongoing operational management of Hadoop and Spark platforms. Candidates must be able to demonstrate practical experience working within environments where internet connectivity is restricted or unavailable, with an understanding of the additional complexities involved in deploying and maintaining enterprise data platforms in such environments. B2B-Einheit in Köln, die aber auch als Stammhaus für die Gruppe fungiert: Du leitest, entwickelst und erweiterst ein Team aus 6+ hochmotivierten Expert*innen, das mit hoher individueller Eigenverantwortung die Bereiche AI & Automation, Data Intelligence (Sourcing, Engineering & Analytics) sowie IT Systems abdeckt Du gestaltest und priorisierst mit dem Senior Management die Data & Technology-Entwicklungsagenda mit den Zielen „scale efficiently“ und „outperform the market“ – und setzt diese mit dem Team und unseren externen Partnern um Mit exzellentem Business-Verstand bist Du der Architekt / die Architektin unserer gruppenweiten Datenstrategie, über verschiedene Länder und Geschäftsmodelle hinweg, und verantwortest den Ausbau unserer Databricks-basierten Datendrehscheibe Du verantwortest die Weiterentwicklung der System- und Solutions-Landschaft für den B2B-Bereich, von Tools über Micro-Solutions bis zu unserem gerade in Einführung befindlichen, Dynamics-basiertes ERP und weiteren Systemen – und übernimmst auch operativ Führung für große Initiativen Du orchestrierst die effiziente Bereitstellung – meist über Partner – der nötigen „unsichtbaren“ Basisprozesse, von IT Infrastruktur und Service über Datenschutz bis zur NIS-2-Compliance Du organisierst unseren erfolgreichen Dauerlauf entlang der „fast-moving technological frontier“: durch effiziente Screening-, Bewertungs- und Upskilling-Prozesse im Team stellst Du sicher, dass wir laufend die aktuellen Innovationen, Tools und Best Practices kennen, bewerten und für unsere Zwecke passend adoptieren Du treibst auch außerhalb des eigenen Teams den ständigen Verbesserungsprozess der Firma als AI- and Data-driven company voran, z.B. durch Playbooks und ständigen Ausbau der "AI & Data literacy" in allen Fachabteilungen Qualifikation So, oder so ähnlich sieht dein Hintergrund aus: Du blickst auf mehrere Jahre Führungserfahrung im Technology- und Data-Bereich zurück, in denen Du gelernt hast, High-Performance-Teams zu "empowern" Du kannst eine ambitionierte und skalierbare Weiterentwicklungsagenda auch in einem hochdynamischen Umfeld gleichzeitig agil, aber auch stabil gestalten und belastbar umsetzen; idealerweise bringst Du Scale-Up-Erfahrung mit. Du hast bewiesen, dass Du Daten-, Technologie- und Business-Perspektive nahtlos verzahnen kannst, und Lösungen von einem klarem Verständnis der kurz- und langfristigen Business-Perspektiven aus priorisierst und gestaltest. Du weißt aus operativer Erfahrung, wie eine effizient verzahnte Daten- und Systemarchitektur im Zielzustand einer skalierten Firma aussieht, und bringst ggfs. sogar Erfahrung mit Projekten zur IT-Architektur, Systemauswahl und/oder -Einführung mit Laufend weitere Hands-on-Erfahrungen mit neuesten Technologien zu sammeln, ist für Dich keine Aufgabe, aus der man herauswächst, sondern eine Selbstverständlichkeit Deiner Führungsphilosophie Du bringst KI- und Datenkompetenz auf Führungsebene mit und führst diese Themenfelder mit unbändiger Neugierde, Experimentierfreude und Mut zum Scheitern – aber nicht als Selbstzweck, sondern mit gutem Gespür für angemessenen Aufwand und Risiko Du fühlst Dich mit einem Microsoft-Stack als Basis wohl (MS 365, Azure Databricks, Power-Platform, MS Dynamics) Das erwartet dich: Du gestaltest die Strukturen eines erfolgreichen, schnell wachsenden Unternehmens grundlegend mit, unterstützt von Gründern, Senior Management und einer Menge Energie aus dem Team Du erlebst die Entwicklung eines Pioniermarkts - und treibst diese mit voran Du bist Teil eines exzellenten, hochmotivierten Teams mit einer dynamischen und offenen Unternehmenskultur Durch regelmäßige Events und den offenen Austausch mit dem gesamten Team an unserem modernen Bürostandort lernst Du alle Facetten des Unternehmens kennen Unser starkes Wachstum und individuelle Förderung von Talenten öffnen dir starke Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten in deiner Karriere und deiner Persönlichkeit Ein moderner Office-Komplex in Köln mit bezuschusster Kantine, warmen Gerichten, Salatbar und Bowls.
