title: Software Engineer II: Autonomous Supply Chains
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>About Flexport: </strong></h2> <p>At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year. </p> <p>The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.</p></div><h1>Applied AI Engineer, Autonomous Supply Chains</h1> <h2>About Flexport</h2> <p>Look around you. Almost everything in the room crossed an ocean to get there. Moving one container from a factory to a warehouse takes 10 to 15 companies: truckers, customs brokers, port terminals, ocean carriers, insurers, lenders and warehouses, each with its own systems, paperwork and rules. A freight forwarder runs that whole journey, so the brand that makes the goods doesn't have to.</p> <p>Most forwarders still run it on email, spreadsheets and phone calls. We call it email freight forwarding. Flexport runs it on one platform, where AI agents do the routine work and experts step in where judgment matters. We've moved $175B of goods for more than 13,000 brands across 135 countries. Our agents handle 21 million tasks a year, and up to 80% of customs work is automated.</p> <p>Global logistics is a $13 trillion industry, and even the largest forwarder earns less than 3% of global logistics outsourcing revenue. People-powered operations don't scale: to grow, you hire. Software broke that ceiling for taxis with Uber, and for payments with Adyen and Stripe. Freight is next.</p> <p>Amsterdam is one of Flexport's six engineering hubs, alongside San Francisco, Seattle, Chicago, Shanghai and Shenzhen. We own four domains end to end: Customs Technology, Autonomous Supply Chains (Applied AI), Platform and Security. See what we build at <a href="https://amsterdam-engineering.flexport.com">amsterdam-engineering.flexport.com</a>.</p> <h2>The team: Autonomous Supply Chains</h2> <p>Logistics is famously hard to automate, because the happy path rarely happens. One customer won't take deliveries on a Tuesday. Another wants invoices only on Fridays, with some lines merged and others renamed. Until recently, people handled all of that by hand. Now operators use Forge, the agentic platform we build, to automate their own work: catching anomalies, routing exceptions, escalating stuck containers and adjusting invoices to each customer. Forge remembers every customer's rules and learns from every workflow run, so it gets smarter every day.</p> <p>Autonomous Supply Chains is our Applied AI team: small, senior and reporting to the VP of Engineering. Self-driving cars are rated from level 0 to level 5. Most of the freight industry still runs at level 0: people emailing spreadsheets. Our goal is level 5 for freight, with Forge as the best agentic platform there is, handling every complexity, every calamity and every odd preference without skipping a beat.</p> <p><strong>Stack:</strong> TypeScript, Rust, Next.js, Temporal, Postgres and Snowflake, with models from Anthropic, OpenAI and Google.</p> <h2>The role</h2> <p>As an Applied AI Engineer II on Autonomous Supply Chains, you'll build the agents and AI-powered applications that make Flexport's operations faster and increasingly autonomous. You'll find the most painful problems in our operations, design the solution and ship it to operators moving freight across 135 countries. This isn't a role where you join a team and pick up tickets.</p> <h2>What you'll do</h2> <ul> <li>Design and ship end-to-end AI agents that handle real logistics work, such as customs compliance, document processing, invoice validation and exception management.</li> <li>Build the evaluation, guardrails and human-in-the-loop flows that make an agent trustworthy enough to run 24/7.</li> <li>Stay on top of what's happening in the world of AI, and channel those innovations straight into the product. When Jev came out this fall, we had three use cases live within two weeks.</li> <li>Work directly with operators, domain experts and leadership to turn ambiguous problems into shipped products, and measure whether they worked.</li> <li>Move fast from idea to production, and treat every deployment as a chance to learn.</li> <li>Cross organizational boundaries to understand problems deeply and get things done without waiting for permission.</li> </ul> <h2>You should have</h2> <ul> <li>3+ years of software engineering experience, and you've built seriously with LLMs, whether in production, in side projects or just because you couldn't stop yourself.</li> <li>LLM fluency: agent patterns, tool use, RAG, prompt design and evaluation. You know the difference between what works in production and what looks good in a demo.</li> <li>Full-stack capability in TypeScript and Next.js. You can own a feature end to end.</li> <li>Product instinct: you can tell what's worth building, not just how to build it.</li> <li>Clear written and spoken communication in English, including design docs that people actually read.</li> </ul> <h2>Nice to have</h2> <ul> <li>Experience with workflow orchestration, such as Temporal.</li> <li>Experience building internal tools or operator-facing applications.</li> </ul> <h2>How we work</h2> <ul> <li><strong>We value builders.</strong> People who think end to end, do their own discovery and ship independently. Nobody hands you a spec.</li> <li><strong>Your users sit next to you.</strong> Operators, customs experts and account teams work in the same office. Watch them use your tool, and fix it before dessert.</li> <li><strong>Any model, any harness.</strong> Use any frontier model from Anthropic, OpenAI or Google, in all the popular coding harnesses. Our engineers manage swarms of coding agents from their first week.</li> <li><strong>We ship dozens of times a day,</strong> with continuous deployment and a platform team obsessed with making it safe and fast.</li> <li><strong>Hybrid, in English.</strong> We're together in our office on Nieuwezijds Voorburgwal, a few minutes from Dam Square, three days a week*. The other days are flexible. English is our working language, and we work daily with colleagues in the US and China.</li> <li><strong>No logistics background needed.</strong> Almost nobody joins knowing what an HTS code or a bill of lading is. The experts sit a few desks away.</li> <li><strong>Agile, but not dogmatic.</strong> Teams decide how they work best.</li> </ul> <h2>Why this role is special</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Your work is visible:</strong> a small, senior team that reports to the VP of Engineering. What you build gets noticed, and your ideas shape the direction.</li> <li><strong>Real stakes:</strong> your agents act on real shipments for 13,000+ brands in 135 countries, so the impact is immediate and measurable.</li> <li><strong>You're early:</strong> the playbook for applied AI in logistics hasn't been written yet. You'll help write it.</li> </ul> <h2>What's in it for you</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Equity for everyone:</strong> every team member becomes a shareholder in a pre-IPO company in a multi-trillion dollar industry.</li> <li><strong>25 vacation days,</strong> based on full-time employment, plus Dutch public holidays.</li> <li><strong>Health insurance, fully paid:</strong> a collective plan with basic and additional packages. Flexport pays the monthly premium.</li> <li><strong>Pension:</strong> a defined contribution scheme.</li> <li><strong>Breakfast and lunch:</strong> daily catered lunch with vegetarian options, breakfast, snacks and drinks in the office.</li> <li><strong>Commute covered:</strong> Flexport covers home-to-office commuting costs if you live outside Amsterdam.</li> <li><strong>Parental leave:</strong> time off for both parents to bond with a new child.</li> <li><strong>Wellbeing support:</strong> an Employee Assistance Program through Aetna for you and your household, at no cost.</li> <li><strong>Visa sponsorship:</strong> we sponsor visas for the right candidates and help you move to Amsterdam. Eligible international hires may also benefit from the Dutch expat tax ruling.</li> </ul> <h2>Our hiring process</h2> <ol> <li><strong>Application review:</strong> our team reviews your application.</li> <li><strong>Recruiter screen:</strong> talk about your experience, the role and your questions about Flexport.</li> <li><strong>Remote coding:</strong> your first coding interview takes place over video.</li> <li><strong>Onsite coding and system design:</strong> a second coding interview and system design in our office.</li> <li><strong>Project deep dive:</strong> discuss a project from your experience with the hiring manager.</li> <li><strong>Team debrief:</strong> the interview team reviews feedback together. You don't attend this step.</li> <li><strong>Offer:</strong> if there's a match, your recruiter walks you through the offer.</li> </ol> <p>An additional remote coding round may be needed if the earlier coding interviews leave questions to resolve. Your recruiter will confirm the plan before interviews begin. We only contact candidates from ----- addresses, and we will never ask you for money or banking details.</p> <h2>Commitment to equal opportunity</h2> <p>At Flexport, our ability to fulfill our mission of making global commerce easy and accessible relies on having a diverse, dedicated and engaged workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, physical and mental disability, health status, marital and family status, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, military and veteran status, and any other characteristic protected by applicable law.</p> <h2>Global data privacy notice for job candidates and applicants</h2> <p>Depending on your location, the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) may regulate the way we manage the data of job applicants. By submitting your application, you are agreeing to our use and processing of your data as required. title: Senior Product Manager
description: <p><strong>Join Proton and build a better internet where privacy is the default</strong></p> <p>Founded in 2014 by scientists who met at CERN, Proton was built on the belief that <strong>privacy is a fundamental human right</strong>. What started as an encrypted email service has grown into an ecosystem of privacy-first products, including Proton Mail, VPN, Drive, Pass, and Calendar, used by millions of people worldwide.</p> <p>We're profitable, independent, and building for the long term. Free from venture capital control and advertising-driven business models, we focus on what matters most: our users. Our work helps protect digital freedom, from everyday privacy to supporting journalists and activists in challenging environments.</p> <p>Today, we're an international team of 700+ people, with offices across 9 countries. We have high standards for the people we hire and the work we do. You'll work alongside talented, driven colleagues who challenge each other, take ownership, and care about getting things right.</p> <p>Explore our <a href="https://proton.me/community/open-source">open-source projects</a>.</p> <h3 class="Lexical__h3">The Role</h3> <p class="Lexical__paragraph">We're building something new at Proton and we're hiring a Senior PM to lead it from the front.</p> <p class="Lexical__paragraph">This role sits at the intersection of product strategy, community dynamics, and Proton's mission to give people back control over their digital lives. You'll own the roadmap and execution for a product that brings privacy-first community experiences to millions of users. The team is small and senior; the scope is large. You’ll turn an ambitious product direction into clear strategy, crisp requirements, shipped experiences, and measurable outcomes.</p> <p class="Lexical__paragraph">We're looking for someone who has lived inside community products: who understands how engagement compounds, why moderation decisions shape culture, and how trust is built (and destroyed) at scale. If you've helped build or grow a platform where users interact, organize, and belong, and you want to do it in a way that doesn't exploit the people using it, this is the role.</p> <hr> <h3 class="Lexical__h3">What You'll Own</h3> <ul class="Lexical__ul Lexical__ul--depth-1"> <li class="Lexical__listItem" value="1">Define and drive the product strategy and roadmap end-to-end — from first principles through to shipped features — without waiting for direction from above</li> <li class="Lexical__listItem" value="2">Own the metrics that matter: activation, engagement, retention, and community health. title: Oracle EPM Specialist
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p> </p> <p><strong>Available Location:</strong> Austin, TX</p> <p><strong>Job Title:</strong> <strong>Senior </strong><strong>Oracle EPM Specialist</strong></p> <p><strong>Role Summary</strong> This critical role is responsible for ensuring smooth financial operations throughout the close cycles by maintaining the stability, security, and high performance of Oracle GL and Oracle EPM environments. The EPM Specialist will absorb knowledge transfer from implementation partners and serve as the primary operational lead for Financial Consolidation and Close - FCCS, Account Reconciliation - ARCS, and Enterprise Data Management - EDMCS. A core aspect of the job involves collaborating cross-functionally with IT and business teams to understand downstream system impacts, manage critical system handshakes, and oversee regular maintenance. Partnering closely with Financial Systems leadership, you will help translate the strategic roadmap into reality. </p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Cross-Functional System Execution:</strong> Work closely with finance, IT, and cross-functional teams to implement roadmap initiatives and evaluate downstream impacts.</li> <li><strong>Troubleshooting & Resolution:</strong> Investigate and resolve data load, mapping, validation, and calculation issues. Track and resolve recurring or critical issues through Oracle Service Requests</li> <li><strong>Financial Module Ownership:</strong> Define and own the functional configuration roadmap for key financial modules, including General Ledger<strong>.</strong></li> <li><strong>Compliance and System Configuration:</strong> Directly design and configure Oracle Fusion to ensure enforcement of critical financial compliance standards (e.g., ASC 606/IFRS 15, SOX).</li> <li><strong>Data Integration Management:</strong> Administer Data Exchange pipelines, import/export definitions, and update EDM subscriptions to keep metadata aligned. Manage calculation rules, consolidations, and cash flow mappings.</li> <li><strong>Maintenance & Patching:</strong> Review release notes and perform patch regression testing on monthly EPM patches, promoting updates safely across DEV, TEST, and PROD pods.</li> <li><strong>System Support & Operations:</strong> Manage and monitor user access control, including assigning predefined and application roles. Provide functional support during close cycles, assisting users with application navigation, workflows, and Smart View queries.</li> <li><strong>Solution Architecture & Development:</strong> Partner with leadership to design, build, and optimize scalable EPM data models and solutions. Translate business requirements into technical architecture and execute complex development work across FCCS, ARCS, PCMCS and EDMCS.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Role Requirements (Must-Have Skills)</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Active Oracle Cloud EPM Certification(s)</strong> (e.g., Financial Consolidation and Close (FCCS), Account Reconciliation (ARCS), Enterprise Data Management (EDMCS), Profitability and Cost Management (PCMCS) or EPM Data Integration).</li> <li>Strong experience managing and supporting Oracle EPM applications, specifically FCCS, ARCS, PCMCS, and EDMCS.</li> <li>Proven ability to manage daily operations, including integrations, consolidations, and reconciliations.</li> <li>Exceptional troubleshooting skills, specifically regarding Smart View installations, connection settings, and resolving setup conflicts.</li> <li>Experience managing user security, access roles, and maintaining compliance governance.</li> <li>Ability to perform monthly/quarterly close operations and execute environment health checks.</li> <li>Exceptional communication skills with the ability to partner effectively with cross-functional IT and business teams to evaluate inbound and outbound data flows and build architectural solutions.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Nice-to-Have Skills</strong></p> <ul> <li>Familiarity with Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC).</li> <li>Familiarity or experience with Oracle Tax Reporting (TRCS), as future roadmap capabilities may expand into this area.</li> <li>Experience with Risk Control Matrix (RCM) functionality to monitor Segregation of Duties (SOD) controls between ERP and EPM systems.</li> <li>Prior experience with other Finance Planning tools (e.g., PBCS, Adaptive Planning, Planful, Pigment, SAP, IBM, OneStream, etc is a plus).</li> <li>Conceptual understanding of Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), or Agentic AI frameworks</li> </ul> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>

We help hospitals get good products at fair prices, with far less manual work. We build the software. And we move the goods. SANOVIO aOS, our agentic operating system for procurement, handles master data management, portfolio management and digital procurement processing. SANOVIO Fulfillment covers global direct sourcing, quality control, warehousing and logistics. Founded in 2024 in Munich by Noel Nosswitz, Alexander Hüttner and Yong Wang, we work with hospitals in Germany and Switzerland, purchasing groups and international suppliers. We are customer-funded: our customers are our only investors. The role As Technical Product Manager, you turn real procurement problems into working software. You sit between our hospital and supplier users, our engineering team and the founders. You decide what we build next, shape how it works, and often build the first version yourself. You work on SANOVIO aOS and the internal tools behind our fulfillment operations: AI agents that clean item master data, workflows that move an order from request to ward, and integrations with hospital and supplier systems. A large part of the role is talking to customers. You join calls and on-site visits with hospital purchasing teams, purchasing groups and suppliers, show them what we build, take their feedback and turn it into product decisions. You are a trusted contact for our customers on everything technical. Location: Munich (on-site, with flexibility). What you will do Own the product roadmap for selected areas of SANOVIO aOS, from problem discovery to release. Be in close, regular contact with customers: hospital buyers, purchasing groups and suppliers, plus our own operations team, to understand how procurement works in practice. Lead the implementation of SANOVIO aOS at customers: from setup and data onboarding to go-live. Own product education: run trainings and onboarding for customers and our internal teams, and create guides and demos. Write clear product specifications and translate them into tasks engineering can ship. Understand and map user flows end to end, and find where users lose time or get stuck. Iterate fast: ship a first version, learn from real users and improve it within days, not months. Design and prototype AI agents and LLM-based features, for example matching products across supplier catalogues or checking certificates. Automate internal workflows across procurement, quality, warehousing and finance, and connect the systems behind them. Define how we measure success for each feature and follow up after launch. Make sure what we build is secure, reliable and handles confidential hospital and supplier data with care. Technical Skills Strong software engineering fundamentals, including practical experience with Python, APIs, databases and modern development tools. Hands-on experience developing AI-powered applications using large language models, AI agents and related technologies. Experience implementing workflow automation and integrating different software systems and data sources. Understanding of software architecture, data processing, deployment and the development of reliable, maintainable applications. Familiarity with information security, access management and the responsible handling of confidential data. Experience with modern AI-assisted development tools and an interest in continuously expanding your technical expertise. What else you bring A degree in computer science, engineering, business informatics or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Graduates are welcome, as are candidates with 1 to 2 years of work experience. A background in consulting (for example strategy, tech or operations consulting) and a strong pull towards AI: you build with LLMs and agents yourself, not only in slides. Experience in product development: you have taken a product or internal tool from first idea to something people use every day. Experience in customer-facing work: you enjoy presenting to customers, running workshops and explaining a technical decision to a hospital buyer as clearly as a business problem to an engineer. You take ownership, work in a structured way and are comfortable when things are not yet defined. You are AI-native: you use AI tools every day and follow what is new in the field. You care about healthcare and want your work to have a visible effect on patient care. Fluent English and German at C1 level or higher, as many of our customers work in German. What we offer A real problem with a direct effect on patient care. AI that acts: you ship agents that do real work in procurement, not demos. Software and logistics in one company, so you see your product used from order to ward. A lot of responsibility from day one, real ownership of your area and short paths to the founders. An office in the heart of Munich. How to apply Apply here with your CV and your LinkedIn profile. A link to your GitHub, portfolio or personal website is optional. title: Forward Deployed Engineer (f/m/x)
description: Become part of Tanso and decarbonize industries with us. What if the impact of your role extended beyond a job title? Not through marketing spin. Not through vague "purpose-driven" messaging. But through software that helps industrial companies understand, manage and actively reduce their environmental impact. That's what Tanso is building. And it's one of the reasons people join us. Why Tanso? Take Action in a Fast-Moving, High-Impact Environment. We move fast on sustainability because the urgency is real. That means decisions that matter, transparent processes, and the agility to navigate change. Challenge & Grow Through Ownership. Take ownership immediately, build expertise through hands-on experience, and leverage every available resource to achieve outsized impact. Foster Trust with Mission-Driven Collaborators. You'll join a team that prioritizes impact and each other. We give honest feedback, share credit, support each other when it matters, and hold high standards together. Embrace Responsibility & Drive Impact. Turn fragmented emissions data into actionable insights. Your work has immediate, visible impact - clearer decision-making and genuine momentum toward change. AI First-Mindset. We embrace cutting-edge technology to solve sustainability challenges. Push the boundaries of innovation and stay ahead of what's possible. Commitment to Performance & Excellence. We cultivate a high-performance culture where you thrive. Push yourself and others to excel, celebrate wins, learn from setbacks, and raise the bar. Your role Each industrial company we work with sets things up differently. Activity data sits in SAP, in energy management systems, with fleet providers and in spreadsheets, and each company has its own approval steps and reporting requirements. Our platform handles the calculation and reporting. Getting each customer's data and processes into it, reliably and in a way they trust, is where a lot of the value is created. As a Forward Deployed Engineer (f/m/x) , you own that part. You'll work directly with our customers' sustainability, finance and IT teams, connect their systems to Tanso, and build the integrations, data pipelines and workflows that make the platform work for them. You'll write production code in our codebase, not workarounds next to it. And when you solve the same problem for a second customer, you'll make sure it becomes part of the standard product, so nobody has to solve it a third time. Key responsibilities Own customer implementations end-to-end, from scoping to go-live and the first completed reporting cycle. Build the integrations, features and workflows our biggest customers need to work with Tanso day to day. Ship them in our codebase together with our product teams. Connect Tanso to the systems customers already use, such as ERP systems like SAP, data warehouses or Microsoft 365, and make sure these connections work reliably. Build AI agents which take over routine implementation work, and share what works with the rest of the team. Run on-site workshops with sustainability managers, finance and IT. Your profile Hands-on experience in software engineering, solutions engineering or a technical implementation role. AI-native way of working: AI agents are an integral part of how you build and deliver. Strong communication skills, in writing and in person: You explain technical decisions in a way that sustainability managers, finance and IT teams all understand. Excellent German and English, spoken and written (C2): You run workshops and present to customers in German and work with our team in English, so both need to be at a professional level. Solid full-stack skills: You are comfortable working in an existing codebase and with external APIs. Product sense: You can distinguish what a customer asks for from what they actually need, and you build the simplest solution that solves it. Willingness to travel regularly to customers across the DACH region. What we offer A highly competitive compensation package with an attractive equity package to participate in Tanso's growth. Hybrid working model that combines the benefits of onsite collaboration with the flexibility needed. A company-contributed pension plan to support long-term financial security. Yearly budget to support ongoing professional development. Sponsored access to EGYM Wellpass to prioritize your wellbeing with thousands of options. Exclusive discounts that help you save on a wide range of everyday brands, services, and experiences. Our team We're a diverse group of people, and that diversity is what makes us great. We bring unique perspectives to everything we do and are always eager to learn from each other. We work in cross-functional teams to tackle ambitious challenges, actively seek feedback and be the best versions of ourselves. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

Deine Rolle Bei VESTIGAS entstehen täglich Daten in Sales, Customer Success, Finance und Produkt. Bisher sind sie aber noch nicht dort verfügbar, wo Entscheidungen fallen. Als Lead Business Operations & Data baust du die Systeme, mit denen wir das Unternehmen steuern. Dazu gehören klare Prozesse, ein gemeinsames Datenmodell und Kennzahlen, auf die sich Geschäftsführung und Teams verlassen können. Außerdem sorgst du dafür, dass der manuelle Aufwand nicht mitwächst, wenn wir wachsen. Du berichtest direkt an Korbinian, der bei uns Operations, Finance & People verantwortet. Den Operations Bereich gibt es so noch nicht – du baust ihn auf und entscheidest mit, was zuerst kommt, und packst selbst mit an. Deine Aufgaben Unternehmenssteuerung aufbauen: Du entwickelst ein gemeinsames Datenmodell für Kunden-, Vertrags-, Nutzungs-, Finanz- und Organisationsdaten. Darauf baust du Auswertungen, Soll-Ist-Vergleiche und Reportings für Geschäftsführung, Strategy und die Teams. Kennzahlen sind klar definiert, Quellen nachvollziehbar. Prozesse entlasten: Du findest heraus, wo im Unternehmen Zeit für manuelle Arbeit draufgeht, und machst Schluss damit - Erst Prozesse vereinfachen, dann automatisieren, gerne mit KI. Am Ende zählt, wie viel Zeit du den Teams tatsächlich zurückgibst. Systeme und Datenflüsse gestalten: HubSpot ist da, aber noch nicht da, wo wir es brauchen. Du übernimmst das System, strukturierst es gemeinsam mit Sales, CS und Finance neu und sorgst dafür, dass Daten von Lead über Pilot und Vertrag bis zur Rechnung sauber durchlaufen. title: Product Frontend Engineer
description: quinn is becoming the way people employ, across the globe, through one app. quinn is an app-based, managed payroll and employment-administration service. We run it for private households employing a cleaner, nanny, or caretaker, and for businesses that manage employment relationships at scale. The customer stays the legal employer: quinn registers the employment, runs payroll, and handles social insurance, taxes, and filings on their behalf, automated end to end. Where everyone else sells software, quinn sells the outcome. We don't sell payroll software. We run payroll. The purpose behind it is simple: Fair employment. For all. Correct and fair employment, made simple and accessible for any employer and any employee, in any market quinn enters. Where this is going Think about what Revolut did to banking. All of the complexity (the regulation, the clearing, the compliance) handled invisibly in the background, and one simple experience at the front. Nobody using Revolut thinks about what happens behind the screen when they open a new account, swap currencies or send money abroad. It just works, in a couple of taps. Nobody should have to think about it in order to employ someone either. That is what quinn is building, and it is further along than most people assume: a profitable core business, running today in Switzerland, Germany and the UK, expanding into new markets both by launching and by acquiring. By 2030 quinn intends to be the destination brand for fair employment across six countries and more, on one platform, with one experience. One platform means one frontend. One experience means it looks and behaves like quinn whether you are in Zurich or in London, a household or a company. In this strategy that is not a nice-to-have. It is the strategy. Which is why the surface matters more than anything else. Everything quinn does is designed to disappear. The interface is the only part the customer ever sees, and it is the whole proof that the complexity behind it is really handled. Why this role exists Today , quinn runs on several separate web apps: one per product and market, each with its own frontend, grown over the years as the company grew. Our backend engineers built them alongside everything else, plus an internal admin tool that grew the same way. They all work: thousands of employers run payroll through them every month. But nobody was ever tasked with owning the frontend development, so each one got built the way frontend is built by Backend Developers, seen as a hassle rather than the main aspect users interactive with. What comes next is one frontend that replaces all of them, built from scratch: one quinn app for employers, employees and our own support team, in the browser first, then in the App Store and Google Play from the same work. Alongside it, the frontend of Maestro, the internal tool that replaces the old admin for batch processes. The phone app is the surface that matters most, so everything is built for it from the first screen rather than adapted to it afterwards. That is the opening. How we work We are AI-native, and we mean it operationally rather than as a slogan. AI is how the work gets done here. It is why a small team ships like a large one, and it is a large part of how one person will be able to hold the standard we are describing. We expect you to be at the front of that. Not to have heard of the tools, to live in them, and to build your own leverage with them: scaffolding, visual regression checks, design-token pipelines, whatever takes manual work out of the way. And we expect the judgement that has to come with it. AI writes code that looks right and is subtly wrong: structure that doesn't scale, patterns that fall apart three screens later, components that work once and never again. You take the speed and throw away the rest. AI never lowers the bar here. It is the reason the bar can be this high. Tasks What you will own Everything on the screen: The frontend of the quinn app and the web app. App first. One app for everyone who uses quinn: the employer, the employee, and our own support team working inside the customer's account. The frontend of Maestro, our internal batch tool. Desktop and dense: queues, runs, tables, filters, multi-select, keyboard shortcuts. A different discipline from the app, built on the same components. The component library across quinn Home and quinn Business: one frontend, one experience, every market and every device. Whether the app feels native: response, scrolling, gestures, transitions, biometric login, push. Nothing that gives away it isn't native. The quality of what you ship. Nothing leaves your hands half-finished. Where design ends, engineering begins. We have a design team, and they own how quinn looks and behaves: the flows, the visual design, the tokens, the component specs. You don't design. You own everything from there: how it is built, and everything a design file cannot reasonably specify, such as gestures, keyboard, safe areas, what happens between the drawn breakpoints, the loading, offline, pending and failed states, what a three-line German label does to a layout that was designed for English. You are in the room before design starts, saying what already exists in the library and what a new pattern costs. Not at the end, receiving a handover. When you and design disagree, they decide how it looks and behaves and you decide how it is built. Nothing enters the component library without both of you. Requirements Who we are looking for You care about interfaces more than anyone else in the room. You see the two-pixel misalignment without being told, and it bothers you until it is fixed. You build and maintain UI components and design systems, not one-off screens. You can build a mobile app that feels like one. And you can also build a desktop tool full of tables, filters and keyboard shortcuts, because Maestro is one. You understand UX and how people actually behave, not only how a screen looks. And you write code other people can take over: scalable, structured, documented. Not something that only works while you are in the building. You are independent and decisive. Nobody will spec every detail for you and nobody will review your pixels. You are fluent in English, no other language is required. And if you have a portfolio, a live product, or anything you have shipped that you are proud of, show it to us. Not a requirement, but it tells us more than a CV does. Most importantly: you want this one. Not a frontend role at a company where the frontend is a chore. This one, the app nobody has built yet, the standard nobody has set yet, and a company where getting it right actually decides whether the strategy works. The Team We are a small, fast, direct team. We do not have a lot of process or a lot of hierarchy. We do have a clear strategy, an ambitious plan, and five values we actually mean: Be open, Own it, Speak up, Keep it simple, Bias for action. This is one of the most important hires we will make this year. We are not rushing it and we are not filling a seat. We are looking for the person who reads this and thinks: finally. title: Marketing Manager, ANZ
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>About the Role</strong></p> <p>Cloudflare is looking for an enthusiastic B2B Enterprise marketing manager, who is dynamic, creative, and analytical. The individual has a track record of delivering creative and smashing programs that generate new prospects and grow the marketing revenue pipeline. This person will be dedicated to growing our businesses in ANZ across enterprise and public sector accounts. </p> <p>You will support the creation, launch, and execution of campaigns that span a variety of channels - email, social, and webinars as well as supporting end-to-end execution of our in-person and virtual events, either direct or with our partners. You have a natural inclination to measure the effectiveness of marketing activities, strong project management skills, and the ability to think strategically and orchestrate many moving parts. You must have strong working knowledge and expertise in demand generation marketing funnel and lead flows. The right candidate will have the ability to work cross-functionally with all teams in-region, across APAC and in headquarters in San Francisco. This is a regional role based in Sydney or Melbourne, Australia. Market experience and expertise is required for this role.</p> <p><strong>What you'll do</strong></p> <ul> <li>Report into the Head of Marketing APAC, based in Singapore</li> <li>As the ANZ Enterprise marketing manager, you will plan, promote, and execute field marketing initiatives across the region that capture mindshare, drive prospects into customers and support Cloudflare customers on their journey to build and secure on Cloudflare.</li> <li>You will be accountable for online, trade shows, conferences, executive dinners, workshops, developing communities, and the full range of regional marketing tactics and execution for Australia across enterprise & public sector.</li> <li>Manage campaigns from strategic planning and execution to evaluation, ensuring smooth project management throughout. Oversee timelines, track ROI, and implement data-driven optimisations to continuously improve performance and communicate campaign results to key stakeholders.</li> <li>Work in cross-functional teams and collaborate closely with global & regional demand centre teams, the partner team, BDR, product marketing, sales, marketing operations, sales ops and others in the development, execution and measurement of high-impact integrated marketing campaigns (global or regional) that are optimised and relevant across the marketing mix - online, offline, ABM, communities and more.</li> <li>Align marketing initiatives to directly support sales objectives, focusing on full lead lifecycle and funnel management, from lead generation to opportunity progression and customer loyalty and expansion.</li> <li>Assess campaign performance using SFDC and Tableau reporting, evaluate ROI, and provide data-driven recommendations for improvement.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Examples of desirable skills, knowledge and experience</strong></p> <ul> <li>5 to 8 years proven experience in B2B marketing (enterprise software, cybersecurity, SaaS, regional marketing and/or info security experience a plus)</li> <li>BA/BS in Marketing, Business, Economics, or other quantitative field</li> <li>On the digital side, you will be supporting our digital teams to help with execution and optimisation of online marketing campaigns across multiple channels (e.g. email, webinars, social media, etc.). </li> <li>Excellent channel experience working with partner marketing, distribution, resellers and systems integrators. </li> <li>In addition, you must have experience in planning, budgeting and managing trade shows, events, and conferences from start to finish</li> <li>Have proven track record of launching successful online and offline marketing campaigns and driving qualified leads in the funnel</li> <li>Strong project management/organisational skills and the ability to successfully manage multiple initiatives at once</li> <li>Strong interpersonal skills, collaborative, and the ability to coordinate across multiple departments in different time zones</li> <li>Results oriented with experience using qualitative and quantitative metrics with a focus on revenue, conversion, sales and other marketing goals</li> <li>Analytically inclined, exceptional organisational skills, with rigorous attention to detail</li> <li>Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced and ever-changing environment with tight deadlines</li> <li>Having a strong sense of curiosity and passion for learning</li> <li>Exhibit strong stakeholders’ management and communication skills</li> <li>Hands-on experience with Salesforce, Marketo, and Tableau, will be an advantage.</li> <li>Previous experience in a high growth company in the SaaS, security, or network space, combined with knowledge of how the Internet works is a plus</li> <li>An established player in the business and marketing community with a strong business network which included media, marketing agencies, events organisers, social media platforms amongst others.  </li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>

You understand what is slowing down the infrastructure teams building on Mistral Cloud — translating those insights into products that are flexible, easy to build on, and performant at scale. title: Analytics Engineer
description: The Challenge Talk360 connects more than 6 million people worldwide every year, and we rely on data we can trust. We have built the foundations of a modern data platform, and now we are looking for an Analytics Engineer to carry the build forward and make that data work for every team. You will be a driving force in how Talk360 works with data, spotting where the numbers disagree, helping decide what the right definition is, and building the models that settle it. As the foundations mature, the role might lean further towards analytics, and we will shape that together. Our current tech includes: Data warehouse: BigQuery Ingestion: Stitch Transformation: dbt Cloud Visualisation: Omni, replacing Tableau and QuickSight What you’ll do Data Modelling & Pipelines: Build and maintain scalable, reliable data models that expose high-quality data for analysis and reporting. Decide what each new data source needs and model it for the warehouse, working with Tech, who own our infrastructure and ingestion. Source of Truth: Grow our dbt project with new, tested and documented models, keeping one agreed definition for every metric. You will be extending and improving a codebase with its own conventions, not starting from a blank page. Automation: Replace manual routines and hand-built reports with reliable, automatic reporting that teams can check and trust. Stakeholder Collaboration: Work closely with teams across the business to understand what they need, challenge it where it helps, and translate it into technical solutions that enable reliable self-serve data for decision making. Quality & Governance: Set the standards and conventions that keep the warehouse maintainable as we grow, and build the monitoring and alerting that catches data quality issues before they reach the business. AI-Ready Data: Name, describe and define our data clearly and consistently, so that colleagues and AI tools can ask questions of it and get the right answer. Champion Data Culture: Champion the use of data to optimise business performance, coach colleagues to explore it themselves in Omni, and bring fresh analytical ideas to the table. Working with AI AI is part of how we work every day, and it will be part of your role. We expect you to use AI tools to write and review SQL and dbt code, draft tests and documentation, and speed up investigation, and to check what they produce with a critical eye. You are accountable for the quality of what you ship, however it was written. The Team You will report to Rianna, our Head of Data, and work with Max (Data Insights) as part of our small Data team of three on day-to-day modelling priorities. You will work with the Tech team, who own our data infrastructure and ingestion, and partner directly with stakeholders across the business. Who you are You have owned analytics engineering work end to end. You have solid SQL and dbt experience, including extending and maintaining an existing dbt project as well as building new models (Cloud or Core). You are comfortable designing data models from ambiguous or undocumented business logic, not just working from an existing spec. You see yourself as a strategic partner to the business who wants to understand the underlying question, and you can clearly communicate the impact of your technical work in plain language. You use AI tools in your analytics work and you have good habits for checking what they produce. You write tests and documentation with every model, and you keep an eye on warehouse cost and on how sensitive data is handled. You are familiar with Git fundamentals. We use dbt Cloud for orchestration and deployment, so we do not require deep pipeline engineering. How we hire There are four stages: 30-minute call with our recruiter. 60-minute conversation with the hiring manager. 75-minute case study, done in our office with colleagues from across the business. There is nothing to prepare and no take-home task. 30-minute conversation with a senior leader. What we have for you Competitive compensation 80,000 - 90,000 euros per year all-in gross Learning and growth €1,500 annual personal development budget, plus access to company-wide training sessions to keep learning and evolving. Time to recharge 25 vacation days Option to swap two public holidays per year for days that better reflect your culture or beliefs Recharge Fridays, unlocked when team targets are met (we’ll tell you more during the interview) Work from anywhere As a global and diverse team, we encourage you to work from another city or country for up to 2 weeks per year, gain fresh perspectives and spark new ideas. A team you’ll actually want to be part of Weekly team lunch every Thursday Regular team moments and outings An international and diverse team, with colleagues from the Netherlands, South Africa, Nigeria, Suriname, Turkey, Egypt, Kenya, Ukraine and beyond Set up for success Company laptop and all the tools you need to do your best work Monthly phone allowance and commuting allowance An environment to grow and make impact A collaborative environment where you can learn from others, take ownership, and contribute to a meaningful mission. About Talk360 Talk360 has grown into a global communications platform connecting more than 6 million people worldwide. We've successfully spun off our payments business into NjiaPay, stepped into the gap left by Skype, and built a profitable, sustainable business. We're now expanding beyond our own consumer app through our SDK, enabling partners to integrate Talk360's calling infrastructure directly into their own products. Our ambition is simple: To become the world's most trusted way to call any phone number. Here’s what our users say: “I like Talk360 because it saves me a lot of money. title: Web Project Manager & Assistant to Head of Web (m/f/d)
description: Location: hybrid (office & remote) About what. AG what. is a Zurich-based digital agency. This is a hands-on, hybrid role: operational and administrative support for the Head of Web, plus running smaller web projects of your own — more doing than overseeing. You'll independently lead smaller website projects, coordinate designers and developers, communicate directly with clients and ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget and to our quality standards. At the same time, you'll work closely with our Head of Web, helping coordinate larger projects, prepare client meetings, follow up on deliverables and keep day-to-day operations running smoothly. We're looking for someone who can think ahead, bring structure to a busy environment and take things off the Head of Web's plate without needing constant direction. The position starts at around 50% (roughly 20 hours per week), with daily check-ins and the potential to grow as responsibilities increase. What you'll do Project Management Independently manage smaller website projects from kick-off through design, development, testing and launch. Act as the main point of contact for clients on your assigned projects. Coordinate designers, developers and other specialists to ensure smooth project delivery. Translate client requirements into clear tasks, priorities and deliverables. Manage project timelines, budgets and scope, identifying potential risks early. Coordinate testing, quality assurance and website launches. Keep clients informed about progress, next steps and upcoming milestones. Support the Head of Web Support the Head of Web in coordinating larger and more complex website projects. Prepare client meetings, agendas, presentations and project documentation. Track open tasks, decisions and deadlines, proactively following up with clients and internal teams. Help prepare project estimates, proposals and statements of work. Support budget tracking, resource planning and project reporting. Coordinate communication between clients, project teams and internal stakeholders. Take ownership of operational and administrative tasks to free up the Head of Web for strategic priorities and client relationships. Identify opportunities to improve internal processes and make project delivery more efficient. Client Communication & Coordination Handle day-to-day client requests and coordinate their implementation with the team. Ensure requests are properly documented, prioritised and assigned. Follow up on outstanding client feedback, approvals and deliverables. Maintain clear, friendly and professional communication with clients. Support ongoing client relationships by ensuring reliable delivery and responsiveness. Recognize when issues require escalation and involve the Head of Web at the right time. Key & Essential Skills Project Management Experience Some experience running or closely supporting website projects (agency or consultancy a plus); full PM seniority is not required. Ability to independently manage smaller projects while supporting larger, more complex initiatives. Strong organizing skills and the ability to manage multiple projects, deadlines and stakeholders simultaneously. Experience coordinating cross-functional teams, including designers and developers. Good understanding of project budgets, timelines, scope and change requests. Technical & Digital Understanding Solid understanding of website development processes, from design to launch. Real hands-on experience with WordPress (ideally also Payload or similar): you work in these tools confidently, not just know the interface. Basic understanding of UX, digital marketing, SEO and website analytics. Ability to understand technical discussions and translate them into clear actions. Experience with project management tools such as Linear, Jira, Asana or similar platforms. Comfortable using AI tools to improve productivity, documentation and daily workflows. Communication & Organisation Fluent professional German and strong English communication skills. Excellent written communication and attention to detail. Ability to communicate confidently and professionally with clients. Strong prioritisation skills and a structured, solution-oriented approach. Comfortable working independently while knowing when to ask questions or escalate issues. Proactive in following up on tasks and ensuring nothing falls through the cracks. What makes you a fit You take ownership. You don't just coordinate tasks; you make sure things actually get done. You're one step ahead. You anticipate what needs to happen next and take action without waiting to be asked. You bring structure. You enjoy organising information, managing priorities and keeping multiple projects moving. You're a strong communicator. You know how to keep clients informed, manage expectations and communicate professionally. You're detail-oriented. You notice missing information, unclear requirements and potential problems before they become bigger issues. You're a team player. You're equally comfortable leading your own projects and supporting someone else in delivering larger initiatives. You're adaptable. You can switch between project management, client communication and operational tasks without losing track of priorities. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys the variety of agency work, likes taking responsibility and gets satisfaction from making complex workflows run smoothly. You'll have the opportunity to manage your own projects while working closely with an experienced Head of Web, gaining exposure to larger enterprise clients and more complex digital initiatives. Perks Beautiful office in Seefeld, Zurich, for candidates working in a hybrid setting. Flexible working hours and the opportunity to work remotely. Real responsibility and ownership of your own projects. Close collaboration with the Head of Web and exposure to enterprise-level digital projects. A multicultural team that learns together, including daily hands-on work with AI tools. Flat hierarchies and a results-oriented working environment. Fair compensation and profit participation. Personal development opportunities and room to grow within the company. How to Apply Apply via our website with your CV and a 2–3 minute introduction video in German (e.g. Loom or YouTube). Tell us what attracted you to this role, share an example of a website project you've managed and explain how you stay organised when juggling multiple priorities. 👉Applications without a video or sent through other channels (e.g. email or social media) won't be considered. title: Partnerships Operation Intern
description: About Dust Work is being rewritten, and the people holding the pen are the ones who actually run it. With enterprise-grade governance, flexible model choice, and a collaborative interface for humans and agents to work together, Dust empowers AI Operators at the world’s fastest-moving companies to rewire how work gets done. With 70%+ weekly active users, people stick with Dust as much as they do with Slack and Notion. We don't get piloted and shelved. We land once, and spread. We're at an exciting stage of our journey, and growing fast. We're serving great customers like Datadog, 1Password, Cursor, Clay, Vanta and Persona, and aim to x5 our growth by the end of 2026. Dust is backed by Sequoia with a determined team of optimists (coming from Stripe, OpenAI, and Stanford) who like to focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously while doing so. The Generalist named us among the Future 50 . Summary As a Partnership Operations Intern, you will help turn partner relationships into repeatable growth. You will have real responsibility for making partners successful, helping opportunities move forward, and building the systems that allow our partner ecosystem to scale. This is a very hands-on role for someone who wants to learn how partnerships and the indirect channel really work. You will work directly with a wide range of external actors, including agency and consultancy leaders, partner sales and delivery teams, technology partners, and customers, while collaborating closely with Sales, Marketing, Operations, and Product at Dust. You will not be limited to observing or executing a narrow checklist. You will own projects, see their impact, and help shape how Dust works with partners from the ground up. What you'll do Keep partners moving and growing Animate the partner community through regular updates, follow-ups, check-ins, and activation initiatives. Support partner onboarding and help partners find the right information, people, and resources at the right time. Reply to partner questions and requests promptly, with clear next steps and strong follow-through. Keep partner records, documentation, trackers, and workflows accurate and up to date across HubSpot, Introw, and Crossbeam. Help design and improve scalable partner infrastructure, including onboarding flows, partner tiering, enablement tracking, and partner activity monitoring. Track partner KPIs and help maintain dashboards covering activation, pipeline, attribution, engagement, and performance. Identify recurring friction points and turn them into clearer processes, automations, or reusable resources. Turn partner opportunities into revenue Support partners throughout the deal creation process, from the first opportunity to a qualified pipeline item and a closed deal. Create quotes and coordinate the information needed to move deals forward accurately and quickly. Help maintain clean deal registration and partner attribution workflows in HubSpot. Use tools such as Default, n8n, and Dust to reduce manual steps and improve visibility across the deal lifecycle. Location We're prioritizing building our team with an in-person culture at our offices in Paris, London, San Francisco, and New York because we value the magic that happens when talented people work closely together. We have an office-first culture. Some of the best things about building at Dust are the energy, the fast decisions, and the unexpected conversations that unlock a hard problem, which happen because we are in the same room. Being together is not a formality, it is how we do our best work, and it is something we actively protect. That said, we hire people with strong judgement and we extend that trust to how they manage their time. When working from home makes more sense for what you need to get done that day, we trust you to make that call. Why Dust The models are powerful enough. What's missing is the product layer where AI meets how companies actually work. That's what we're building: the infrastructure that lets any team turn scattered knowledge and tools into coordinated execution with agents they build, own, and run themselves. We use Dust ourselves every day. We get to shape how humans and agents collaborate while solving our own problems with the product we ship. That loop is rare, and it's why we move fast. If you're excited about defining a new category and want to join a determined team of optimists who focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously, we'd love to talk. Even if you don't check every box in our requirements, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse perspectives and backgrounds, and we're more interested in your potential and passion than a perfect match to our checklist. Learn how we think and work. Our product constitution, a story about our mission Your Next Co-Worker Isn’t Human , Stanislas Polu , VivaTech 2026. title: IT Specialist Frontend Platform
description: Wie ben jij Jij bent een pragmatische IT‑specialist met een sterke operationele basis. Je houdt van techniek, maar krijgt vooral energie van het stabiel en voorspelbaar laten functioneren van platformen. Je schakelt makkelijk tussen techniek, operatie, regie en samenwerking. Je behoudt overzicht in complexe ketens en weet prioriteiten te stellen. Daarnaast herken je jezelf in het volgende: HBO werk‑ en denkniveau richting IT; ervaring als IT Specialist, Application Engineer of Platform Engineer; ervaring met services en (SaaS) oplossingen op Microsoft Azure; praktische kennis van Kubernetes / containers / application gateways (bij voorkeur AKS); ervaring met informatie analyse, operations, beheerprocessen en incidentafhandeling; kennis van monitoring tooling (pré: Dynatrace); ervaring met CI/CD en OTAP‑omgevingen; kennis van networking, routing, firewalls en DNS, App en Lowcode oplossingen; affiniteit met security, identity en toegangsbeheer (AD / Entra ID); ervaring met samenwerken en regie op leveranciers of MSP‑partijen; je communiceert helder, werkt gestructureerd en neemt verantwoordelijkheid. Wat ga je doen Bij Univé werken we iedere dag aan zekerheid voor onze leden. Dat doen we niet alleen met verzekeringen, maar ook met betrouwbare digitale dienstverlening. Binnen IT Kern bouwen en beheren we het fundament waarop onze dienstverlening draait. Betrouwbaarheid, veiligheid, continuïteit en samenwerking staan daarbij centraal. Het team Frontend Platform speelt hierin een cruciale rol. Wij zorgen ervoor dat onze websites, klantomgevingen en digitale contactkanalen stabiel, veilig en toekomstbestendig functioneren. Denk hierbij aan frontendplatformen, CRM‑omgevingen, monitoring, identity & access management, cloudplatformen en integraties met andere ketens. Vanwege verdere professionalisering van ons platform zoeken wij een IT Specialist Frontend Platform. Een pragmatische IT‑specialist die techniek begrijpt én overzicht houdt in de keten. De komende jaren staan onder andere een managed service partner transitie, implementatie van ons ledencontact platform, verdere standaardisatie, lifecyclemanagement, security‑verbeteringen en professionalisering van beheerprocessen centraal. Deze thema’s sluiten aan op de bredere IT Kern doelstellingen rondom stabiliteit, schaalbaarheid, monitoring, governance en professionalisering van IT‑processen. Als IT Specialist Frontend Platform zorg jij ervoor dat onze platformen stabiel, voorspelbaar en veilig functioneren. Jij bent de verbindende factor tussen techniek, operations, leveranciers en interne teams. Je bent niet alleen technisch sterk, maar begrijpt ook hoe processen, beheer, changes en samenwerking in de praktijk werken. Je overziet de gehele keten en weet verstoringen structureel op te lossen. In deze rol ligt de nadruk nadrukkelijk op continuïteit, regie, beheer en samenwerking binnen de keten. Daarbij werk je zowel hands‑on als coördinerend. Wat bieden wij Een inhoudelijk sterke rol binnen een cruciaal platform voor Univé. veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief en vakinhoudelijke ontwikkeling. Nauwe samenwerking met ervaren collega’s binnen Frontend Platform. Een afwisselende rol waarin techniek, beheer en samenwerking samenkomen. De mogelijkheid om actief bij te dragen aan de verdere professionalisering van IT Kern. Hybride werken vanuit Zwolle en thuis. Overige Arbeidsvoorwaarden jaarsalaris is minimaal € 57.487 en maximaal € 81.163 op basis van een 38-urige werkweek (inclusief vakantiegeld, een dertiende maand en exclusief variabele beloning); 13e maand en 8% vakantiegeld; variabele collectieve prestatiebeloning van maximaal 9% van het jaarsalaris; 26 vakantiedagen bij een 38‑urige werkweek; goede pensioen- en studiekostenregeling; thuiswerk- en reiskostenvergoeding; korting op schade‑ en zorgverzekeringen bij Univé. Wie wij zijn Univé is een coöperatieve organisatie die altijd dichtbij haar leden staat en gericht is op het bieden van financiële zekerheid. Het groeiende bedrijfsonderdeel IT staat voor de uitdaging om het IT-landschap en de IT-organisatie binnen de Univé Formule te transformeren in een wendbare, innovatieve, bestuurbare en toekomstgerichte platform-organisatie. Schaalbare technologie en processen, optimaal gebruik van datatoepassingen, integratie en standaardisatie zijn hierbij belangrijke doelen. Zo levert IT kostenefficiënt en effectief een strategische bijdrage aan de continuïteit en innovatiekracht van Univé. De CIO Office biedt ondersteuning door richting en houvast te geven aan strategische doelen en kaders. Het team Frontend Platform Binnen Frontend Platform werken we aan het beheer en de continuïteit van platformen die direct bijdragen aan de digitale dienstverlening van Univé. Daarbij werken we nauw samen met DevOps‑teams, architectuur, security, leveranciers en andere platformteams. title: Federal Account Executive, DHS

Job level and compensation will be determined based on the candidate's experience and alignment to role expectations.</p> <h3>Equity</h3> <p>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.</p> <h3>Benefits</h3> <p>Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family.  Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun!  The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.</p> <h3>Health & Welfare Benefits</h3> <ul> <li>Medical/Rx Insurance</li> <li>Dental Insurance</li> <li>Vision Insurance</li> <li>Flexible Spending Accounts</li> <li>Commuter Spending Accounts</li> <li>Fertility & Family Forming Benefits</li> <li>On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program</li> <li>Global Travel Medical Insurance</li> </ul> <h3>Financial Benefits</h3> <ul> <li>Short and Long Term Disability Insurance</li> <li>Life & Accident Insurance</li> <li>401(k) Retirement Savings Plan</li> <li>Employee Stock Participation Plan</li> </ul> <h3>Time Off</h3> <ul> <li>Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave</li> <li>Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company.
