title: Senior Product Manager - Bookkeeping
description: Are you looking to have an impact on the daily life of millions of entrepreneurs in France (and tomorrow in Europe)? Are you looking for a work environment that values trust, proactivity, and autonomy? Are our Product Principles aligned with your vision? Then Pennylane is the right place for you ! Our vision We aim to become the most beloved financial Operating System of French SMEs and Accounting Firms (and soon, European ones). We help entrepreneurs rid themselves of time-consuming tasks related to accounting and finance while providing them with access to key financial information to assist in making the best decisions for their business. About us Pennylane is one of the fastest growing Fintechs in France (and soon to be in Europe!) In almost 7 years of existence, we’ve managed to : 💻 Make ourselves known as a groundbreaking accounting and financial software for small businesses and their accountants 💰 Raise a total of €225 millions, including from Sequoia, the famous fund from the Silicon Valley who invested early in companies like Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal and much more... 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Grow from 7 cofounders to 1300+ happy Pennylaners : we’re now recognized as one of the greatest places to work in France (and also remotely), with a 4.6/5 rating on Glassdoor . 🌍 Build an international environment with more than 25 nationalities, with a strong remote-friendly culture, where 30% of the employees are already working from all parts of Europe 🤝 Earn the trust of thousands of customers and accounting firms and obtain outstanding ratings 🚀 Already more than 1M+ small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and over 4,500 accounting firms use Pennylane in France! WHY this position is of utmost importance to reach our mission Autopilot is Pennylane’s AI add-on for accounting firms, designed to automate bookkeeping and move accountants from execution to supervision—with a clear ambition: a 1-click VAT return . The challenge is no longer only to build a powerful product, but to activate it at scale, prove its value and turn adoption into revenue . As the first PM of the new Bookkeeping / Autopilot Growth squad, you will play a central role in making that happen. You will help hundreds of thousands of companies adopt Autopilot, connect firms to the value it already delivers and shape Pennylane’s AI monetization strategy. HOW you will contribute to the company as a Product Manager As a Senior Product Manager, you will join a 100+ person Product organization, working with 300+ engineers to make Autopilot the default way firms run their bookkeeping. You will: Understand what drives adoption. Talk to firm owners and accountants, analyse product data with SQL, Amplitude and Metabase, and identify where firms hesitate to activate Autopilot. Turn insights into measurable growth. Define clear hypotheses, metrics and stop criteria, then run B2B experiments through holdouts, cohort analysis and staged rollouts. Own the growth strategy. Set your OKRs, shape the roadmap and focus the squad on the initiatives that drive activation, trust, usage and revenue. Build with a cross-functional squad. Partner closely with a Product Designer, Engineering Manager and product-focused engineers, starting with MVPs and iterating based on what you learn. Work across the ecosystem. Collaborate with the squads building Bookkeeping and Autopilot, as well as Data, Product Marketing, Pricing, Sales, Customer Success and Account Management. Scale adoption beyond the product. Design in-product and lifecycle experiences that help firms self-serve, while providing commercial teams with the signals they need to support adoption. Build for France and Germany from day one. Design configurable solutions rather than simple translations, and work with the German team to make what works in France scalable internationally. Help define a new way of building product. Work agentic-first, design for supervision and stay relentlessly user-obsessed—using AI tools and agents every day to explore data, prototype and move faster. WHAT you can expect from your life at Pennylane Within one month You'll learn everything about our company, our teams, and our vision during the first onboarding week You'll familiarize yourself with the product, the accounting industry and the accountant channel (you will have access to a lot of documentation and will attend trainings organized by your peers) You'll understand how Autopilot works: what it automates, how confident it is, and where it still needs a human You'll have mapped the Autopilot adoption funnel, at company and firm level: eligible, enabled, expanded, paying Within 3 months You'll have set the adoption baseline and targets with your manager You'll have shipped and read your first experiments on activation, hand in hand with your Product Designer and Engineers You'll have impacted positively at least one OKR You will have set up your continuous discovery routine with firms and be ready to build your roadmap Within 6 months You'll be autonomous at defining your OKRs and your roadmap You'll have shipped at least one step change in how firms activate Autopilot You'll have made the time Autopilot saves visible to firm owners You'll have prepared the switch to paid with Pricing, Product Marketing and Sales You'll have equipped Account Managers and CSMs with an adoption playbook they actually use You'll share your learnings and playbooks with the other Autopilot squads and with Germany What do we do to make your work life easier 🏢 You'll be able to work remotely from anywhere in Europe, as long as your contract allows you to; 📈 You'll get company shares to enjoy a piece of the success story you're building with us; 🏡 You’ll have a budget to turn your home into a more comfortable workspace, as well as a monthly allowance to work from a coworking space whenever you feel like it; ⛹️Through our partner Gymlib, you’ll have access to 8000 fitness spaces in Europe and more than 300 activities related to wellness; 🇬🇧 You’ll have access to Busuu to perfect your English or your French; 💻 You’ll get the latest Apple equipment; 🎉 You’ll be part of a vibrant social community : we do lots of sports together (Foot, running, climbing...), we love to hang out and have a drink together (thursday afterwork drinks on our rooftop is a usual thing. Twice-a-year we do company seminars, last time we went on a trip to the French Alps and it was fabulous !). And.. If you're based in 🇫🇷 : 🏢 You’ll be able to work fully from your home or any co-working space in France, or from our wonderful office in the center of Paris 🏝You’ll get 10 additional days off (to the 25 standard ones) to rest and do what you love each year 🍜 You’ll have lunch credits (Swile card) to buy your favorite food every day 🏥 You’ll have a great healthcare cover (Alan Blue) to take care of yourself and your family We're working on providing those last advantages to our people based outside of France as well, but it can be quite more complex depending on different countries. What does the recruitment process look like? You will first have a general chat with Charlène , Talent Acquisition Manager (45 min) You'll then have a discussion with one member of our Product team to assess the fit and the Product culture (45 min) You'll then pass a live case study on an Autopilot adoption problem with 2 Product Managers from our team (1h15) You'll have a final round with Tancrède (our CPO) and a Group PM or a Head of Product (60 min) We make sure we move fast; you can expect the recruitment process with us to last between 15 and 25 days in total. Language For this specific role, a full fluent level in French 🇫🇷 is required. What you’ll bring Proven experience driving growth, adoption or monetization , ideally in B2B SaaS or a scaled B2C product, with measurable results; Strong data fluency and hands-on analytical skills: you can go from SQL query to dashboard to actionable decision, using Amplitude or equivalent tools—even when the data is imperfect; Rigour in experimentation: you know when sample sizes are too small for A/B testing and can design robust holdouts, cohorts and staged rollouts instead; A strong understanding of AI-powered products: you can assess automation quality across confidence, accuracy, coverage and evaluation—and know what it takes to build user trust; Excellent product sense and user research skills: you can uncover what makes professional users comfortable delegating critical work to a machine; Strong cross-functional leadership: you influence and align multiple squads and commercial teams without relying on formal authority; Clear, structured communication skills , with fluency in French and professional proficiency in English; Previous Product Management experience in a scale-up or large technology company. Experience in accounting is not required, but curiosity for the domain and comfort with complexity are essential. Experience with pricing and packaging, free-to-paid transitions, paid add-ons, lifecycle/CRM or sales-assisted PLG would be a strong plus. 🇫🇷 Données personnelles Pennylane traite vos données pour gérer votre candidature et évaluer votre adéquation au poste. Si votre candidature n’aboutit pas, vos données peuvent être conservées 2 ans à compter de notre dernier échange ou de la clôture du recrutement afin de constituer & gérer un vivier de candidats. Vous pouvez vous opposer à tout moment et demander la suppression de vos données en écrivant à : Notre data policy 🇬🇧 Personal Data Pennylane processes your data to manage your application and assess your suitability for the position. If your application is unsuccessful, your data may be retained for 2 years from our last exchange or the closing of the recruitment process, in order to build and manage a candidate pool. You may object at any time and request the deletion of your data by writing to Learn more 🇩🇪 Personenbezogene Daten Pennylane verarbeitet Ihre Daten, um Ihre Bewerbung zu bearbeiten und Ihre Eignung für die Stelle zu beurteilen. Sollte Ihre Bewerbung nicht erfolgreich sein, können Ihre Daten bis zu 2 Jahre ab unserem letzten Austausch oder dem Abschluss des Rekrutierungsverfahrens gespeichert werden, um einen Kandidatenpool aufzubauen und zu verwalten. Sie können jederzeit Widerspruch einlegen und die Löschung Ihrer Daten beantragen, indem Sie an Mehr erfahren 🇪🇸 Datos personales Pennylane trata sus datos para gestionar su candidatura y evaluar su idoneidad para el puesto. En caso de que su candidatura no sea seleccionada, sus datos podrán conservarse hasta 2 años a partir de nuestro último contacto o de la finalización del proceso de selección, con el fin de constituir y gestionar una reserva de candidatos. Puede oponerse en cualquier momento y solicitar la eliminación de sus datos escribiendo a Más información Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

To keep our adult traffic channels growing, we're looking for a Senior Performance Marketeer to take full ownership of ExoClick ( main source), TrafficJunky and potentially other sources. You report to the Performance Marketing Lead. This is a hands-on role with real ownership. You build, optimise and scale campaigns end to end, decide where the budget goes and own the results. In your first year, you'll take over these channels, keep them stable and grow the monthly budget from five to six figures through sharper optimisation, new creative and lander tests, and new inventory. title: Senior Mechanical Analysis Engineer
description: Your mission You will be responsible for mechanical calculations for all systems or part of the system in Thorizon’s reactor design. As a key member of the calculation expertise center, you will provide mechanical calculation expertise to the teams responsible for reactor design studies and ensure the delivery of mechanical calculation work within the project’s performance, cost, and time constraints. You will develop mechanical calculation expertise to meet the needs of the Thorizon project and its future developments, ensuring the quality and validity of the studies and work performed across projects, from PILOT to FOAK/NOAK. You will hold a functional leadership role over the team of structural analysis engineers and will be integrated into a broader, multidisciplinary group of mechanical design engineers and materials experts, reporting to the Head of Mechanics and Materials. In this role you will: Define, execute, and deliver mechanical calculation work, including calculation specifications, strategies, assumptions, and calculation notes, within the project’s performance, cost, and time constraints. Lead a group of mechanical calculation engineers across projects, from PILOT to FOAK/NOAK, providing in-depth calculation engineering input and ensuring that design choices are technically sound and consistent with requirements and applicable Codes & Standards. Ensure the correct use of calculation tools, develop specific tools, and maintain high-quality, reliable studies. Prioritize work according to project needs and recommend any necessary actions within your area of expertise. Participate in external networks, including international initiatives, to stay at the forefront of industry developments. Put your knowledge to use, develop your ideas, explore different aspects of mechanical engineering, and play a crucial role in the company’s growth About you: You hold a master’s degree and bring more than 10 years of experience in mechanical engineering calculations. You have at least five years of experience in FEM simulation and analysis, covering linear structural analysis, structural seismic response, thermal stress and fatigue, with advanced or expert proficiency in ABAQUS and/or ANSYS. You bring at least three years of experience applying ASME III and/or RCC-M. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We are building tools that help make the new internet <strong>payable</strong> by giving our users the ability to take control over how AI agents pay for resources across the Internet.</p> <p>Building these capabilities requires solving problems across high-throughput web infrastructure, low-latency transaction processing, digital wallets, and emerging agentic payment protocols. We bridge mainstream fiat commerce rails with decentralized protocols, enabling micro-payments at Internet scale. We celebrate our achievements, support each other when we make mistakes, and hold each other and our work to a high standard.</p> <h3>About the role</h3> <p>We are looking for an Engineering Manager to build and lead the engineering team across Agentic Commerce.</p> <p>You will be responsible for the people, execution, and engineering quality behind products that power machine-to-machine payments and monetization, such as our <a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/monetization-gateway/">Monetization Gateway</a>. Your success will be measured by the quality and output of the team you build, the engineers you develop, and the systems and products they deliver.</p> <p>This role may require flexibility to be on-call outside of standard working hours to address technical issues as needed.</p> <h3>What you'll do</h3> <ul> <li>Manage, coach, and grow engineers working across high-throughput payment pipelines, agent authentication, and web-scale commerce architecture.</li> <li>Own execution by establishing clear priorities, creating predictable delivery, and giving engineers the context and autonomy to own meaningful areas of the product.</li> <li>Lead the development of agentic payment systems leveraging emerging open standards (x402, Web Bot Auth, ACP, UCP) to enable low-latency, machine-to-machine micropayments.</li> <li>Lead the engineering behind usage metering, pricing definition engines, outcome verification, and revenue attribution models tailored for agentic workflows.</li> <li>Build capabilities that give businesses granular visibility and control over their agent-generated revenue streams.</li> <li>Partner closely with Product Management to understand customer problems, shape the roadmap, and turn broad opportunities into clear engineering outcomes.</li> <li>Bridge mainstream and decentralized tech, interfacing with blockchain teams while keeping execution focused on mainstream, high-throughput web and fiat commerce rails.</li> <li>Balance near-term product delivery with thoughtful technical investments that allow promising ideas to grow.</li> <li>Own the operational health of the systems in your area, including observability, incident response, cryptographic security, and long-term reliability.</li> <li>Develop technical leaders and create space for engineers to lead architecture and implementation.</li> </ul> <h3>Responsibilities</h3> <p>We want you to love it here. judgment and enjoy working with Product Management to decide what is worth building, what needs improvement and what should not be built at all.</li> <li>You are comfortable with ambiguity and with finding structure in areas where the opportunity is clearer than the roadmap.</li> <li>You communicate clearly, give direct feedback, and can explain complex technical decisions to both engineers and non-engineers.</li> </ul> <h3>Examples of Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</h3> <ul> <li>Strong technical grounding in distributed systems, low-latency transaction processing, API design, web security, or adjacent areas.</li> <li>Experience building or operating products involving traditional payment rails, digital wallets, or open authorization/authentication standards (e.g., OAuth, WebAuthn, Web Bot Auth).</li> <li>Experience operating systems where correctness, reliability, and security matter as much as feature delivery.</li> <li>A track record of hiring, developing, and retaining strong engineers.</li> <li>Experience partnering closely with Product Management to shape and execute a roadmap.</li> <li>Experience taking products or major capabilities from an ambiguous title: Design Engineer, Notion.com
description: WHO WE ARE Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work. ABOUT US: Notion helps you build beautiful tools for your life’s work. In today's world of endless apps and tabs, Notion provides one place for teams to get everything done, seamlessly connecting docs, notes, projects, calendar, and email—with AI built in to find answers and automate work. Millions of users, from individuals to large organizations like Toyota, Figma, and OpenAI, love Notion for its flexibility and choose it because it helps them save time and money. In-person collaboration is essential to Notion's culture. We require all team members to work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays, our designated Anchor Days. Certain teams or positions may require additional in-office workdays. ABOUT THE ROLE: The Web team builds Notion.com http://Notion.com to inspire current and future customers. We tell the story of what’s possible with Notion, give people ideas for what they might make themselves, and route them to the place of greatest impact: learning more, getting in touch with sales, or making their first workspace. We’re looking for a frontend engineer with a designer’s eye and a toolmaker’s instincts. Someone who can take an idea from a rough sketch to a working prototype to a beautifully finished experience. You care about the shape of a letterform, the rhythm of a page, and what happens in the few milliseconds after someone clicks. You also care about how it’s built—and whether a simpler way exists. The tools are changing what’s worth attempting. An idea you might once have set aside can become a working experiment; a tool you wished existed can become part of your practice. Working with agents should give you more room to follow those instincts—to try another direction, throw away an approach that isn’t working, or spend longer on the detail that makes the whole thing click. We’re interested in what you make with that room. The Web team at Notion is changing around that possibility. We are a small team that’s focused on making unusually good things, with fewer handoffs, simpler systems, and more time spent on work that deserves human attention. You’ll help us get there: making new experiences on notion.com http://notion.com and building tools that take care of the repetitive work. There’s plenty here to question, plenty to make, and room to surprise us. WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE: - By your 90th day, you’ll be shipping to Notion.com http://Notion.com faster than we do today, working directly with Creative, Marketing, Growth, or Product Marketing, and leaving jigs and agent loops behind you: components, scripts, and workflows that review code, triage alerts, and watch flows like login and pricing. - By the end of your first year, you’ll be a daily driver of the site, from end to end, with your fingerprints all over the reusable pieces behind it, the monitoring that catches problems early, and the habit of retiring pages, code, and dependencies that stop earning their place. SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: - Taste. You have a deep feel for typography, grids, proportion, and restraint. You can make something feel alive without adding more to it. You can explain why a detail matters—and recognize when it doesn’t. - Exceptional technical ability. Semantic HTML, modern CSS, JavaScript and TypeScript, React, and the browser’s layout, rendering, and animation systems are materials you know well. You build accessible, responsive, fast experiences, and your work feels as considered in the browser as it does in a mockup. - 8–12 years of experience in frontend development or design engineering, and a bachelor’s degree in design, computer science, human-computer interaction (HCI), or related field. - Ability to treat code as a creative medium. Your process includes quick experiments, discarded approaches, and prototypes other people can actually use. You can move quickly while an idea is uncertain, then slow down for the details that make it worth shipping. - You make tools that leave more room for craft. You notice when a task starts repeating and build the jig: a component, script, or agent workflow that makes the next pass easier and more precise. You know what to standardize and what to leave open, so the tool supports your eye without making every result look the same - Agents are already part of how you build. You’ve gone beyond autocomplete. You can show us workflows you’ve put together, what they do on their own, how you check their work, and what you’ve learned when they go wrong. We hire talented and passionate people from a variety of backgrounds because we want our global employee base to represent the wide diversity of our customers. If you’re excited about a role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every bullet point listed in the job description, we still encourage you to apply. If you’re a builder at heart, share our company values, and enthusiastic about making software toolmaking ubiquitous, we want to hear from you. Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. Your focus is GitLab's internal operations, rather than customer implementations or development of the GitLab product.</p> <p>Building fast matters, and we want engineers who ship. But speed without understanding the problem leads to the wrong solution shipped quickly. The right tool wins, whether that's custom code, a platform, or a well-crafted prompt.</li> <li>Be Customer Zero: use GitLab's AI products in our own internal workflows, assess how they perform in practice, and share feedback with R&D to help improve them.</li> <li>Partner with stakeholders to translate requirements into working solutions. Practical, hands-on experience with modern AI technologies, specifically:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Prompt engineering as a core discipline:</strong> designing effective system prompts, managing context windows, structuring multi-turn interactions, evaluating output quality, and iterating systematically on prompt design.</li> <li><strong>Model selection and cost-performance trade-offs:</strong> developing judgment on when a smaller fine-tuned model outperforms a general-purpose large one, when RAG is the right architecture versus expanding the context window, and how to think about capability versus cost.</li> <li><strong>Agentic architecture patterns:</strong> tool use, multi-agent orchestration, human-in-the-loop designs, guardrails, evaluation frameworks, and production-grade reliability patterns.</li> <li><strong>Practical fluency across the LLM ecosystem:</strong> hands-on experience with models from Anthropic, OpenAI, open-source alternatives, and growing judgment about which to reach for and when.</li> </ul> <ul> <li><strong>AI Safety & Risk Awareness -</strong> You think critically about how the solutions you build could be exploited, misused, or produce unintended consequences. You know how to design appropriate guardrails (input validation, output filtering, access controls, prompt injection defenses, and data leakage prevention) and you treat these as first-class engineering concerns.</li> <li><strong>Curiosity About Flow & Constraints -</strong> Comfortable engaging with workflow maps, end-to-end process diagrams, and constraint analysis. You don't need to be the one leading the diagnosis yet, but you should be eager to learn and contribute.</li> <li><strong>Business System Awareness -</strong> Familiarity with the landscape of enterprise business systems: CRM (Salesforce), marketing automation (Marketo), support platforms (Zendesk), integration and orchestration tools (Workato), AI platforms (Relevance AI), and enterprise search and knowledge tools (Glean). title: Senior Named Account Executive (AI & Digital Natives)
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h2>Available Locations</h2> <ul> <li>Atlanta, Georgia</li> </ul> <h3><strong>About the role</strong></h3> <p>The Enterprise AI and Digital Natives segment is Cloudflare's fastest growing and highest visibility market. This segment is dedicated exclusively to the largest organizations in the modern tech economy including premier SaaS platforms, hyperscale digital marketplaces, and leading AI labs. This is a deep infrastructure, developer centric play where technical alignment and deep engineering partnerships are our most critical currencies, resulting in Cloudflare’s largest and most complex enterprise agreements.</p> <p>Digital Native AEs at Cloudflare sell into the most innovative companies in North America. In targeting high-growth, technologically advanced, and venture-backed companies, AEs are positioned to drive in-depth product discussions while communicating and demonstrating value quickly to customers.  This role within the digital native segment focuses on both the acquisition of prospective Digital Native accounts, as well as the expansion of existing customer accounts.  The ideal candidate will have both a sales and technical background that enables them to drive customer engagement from technical professionals through to senior executive levels, and across Security, Network, Development and Infrastructure teams.</p> <h2>Responsibilities</h2> <ul> <li>Develop, execute, and maintain your territory plan to exceed quarterly sales targets and annual quota assignment.</li> <li>Be an expert in three unique sales motions; new business acquisition (new customer logos), customer expansion (upsell and cross sell Cloudflare solutions), and renewal within your territory.</li> <li>Build a robust sales pipeline utilizing the four sourcing funnels: AE led outbound, BDR, Channel, and Marketing Inbound.</li> <li>Develop and strategically leverage a deep technical understanding of the problems Cloudflare solves in order to drive a consultative sales motion.</li> <li>Craft and communicate compelling value propositions for Cloudflare services. Drive awareness through regular outbound campaigns on product and feature roadmap updates.</li> <li>Accurately forecast, build commercial outcomes by running a consistent sales process, including driving next step expectations and contract negotiations.</li> <li>As a trusted advisor, build long-term strategic relationships with key accounts, to ensure customer adoption, retention and expansion. Regularly evaluate usage trends and articulate value to show Cloudflare impact and provide strategic recommendations during business reviews.</li> <li>Network across different business units with each of your accounts, and multi-thread to identify and engage new divisional buyers.</li> <li>Position Cloudflare's platform in each of your target customers, including Cloudflare One and the Connectivity Cloud to realize our full potential in every customer.</li> <li>Operate internally as a liaison with cross-functional teams to share key customer feedback and insights to improve customer experience and further investments with Cloudflare.</li> </ul> <h2>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</h2> <ul> <li>5+ years sales experience selling B2B SaaS</li> <li>Strong B2B discovery skills</li> <li>Candidates have a point of view of industry trends and able to customize a client centric why change narrative</li> <li>Track record of beating annual targets of $1M+ and successfully managing complex six figure deals</li> <li>Experienced in multithreading into the C-suite and across an organization to manage a complex sales cycle</li> <li>Self-motivated; entrepreneurial spirit</li> <li>Bachelor's degree required</li> <li>Software and system skills are a must (SFDC, Tableau, G-suite, MSFT suite)</li> <li>Ability to travel up to 25% of the time.</li> </ul> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>

Pour réussir dans ce poste, il est fondamental d'incarner les valeurs essentielles qui unissent WPP et WPP Media : </p> <ul> <li>Être <strong>Extraordinaire</strong> en favorisant un leadership collectif qui inspire une créativité véritablement transformationnelle. </li> </ul> <ul> <li>Créer un environnement <strong>Ouvert</strong> en trouvant l'équilibre parfait entre l'épanouissement de nos collaborateurs et la satisfaction de nos clients, le tout fondé sur une confiance mutuelle. </li> </ul> <ul> <li>Diriger avec <strong>Optimisme</strong> en stimulant activement la croissance et le développement pour mobiliser l'ensemble de notre organisation. </li> </ul> <p><strong><em><u>A propos d’Openmind : Une marque de WPP Media A Leading WPP Media Brand</u></em></strong><strong><em><u> </u></em></strong><strong><em><u> </u></em></strong></p> <p>Openmind by WPP est un modèle d'agence intégrée puisant dans les talents de l'ensemble de WPP. Au cœur de cette solution se trouvent les meilleures capacités avancées de données et de technologie, alimentées par l'investissement de WPP dans l'IA, pour maximiser l'impact de l'investissement média de Nestlé.</p> <p></p> <p> </p> <p><strong>RESPONSABILITÉS :</strong></p> <p>L’équipe Openmind est une équipe experte du paysage médias français et de la manière dont les consommateurs interagissent avec celui-ci. <br>En tant qu’Account Director, vous aurez comme responsabilités de :</p> <p>- Leader la partie opérationnelle de l’équipe, sous la supervision du Business Director, en vous assurant de la gestion du workflow et de la qualité des rendus.</p> <p>- Développer et mettre en œuvre les stratégies média annuelles, en pilotant les prises de parole offline et digitale</p> <p>- Rédiger des recommandations média claires et convaincantes, en justifiant vos choix stratégiques</p> <p>- Sélectionner les canaux et superviser la production des plans média</p> <p>- Collaborer étroitement avec les experts média pour la planification opérationnelle des campagnes</p> <p>- Gérer les relations avec les autres fonctions internes de l'entreprise - conseil, stratégie, études, experts autres leviers/media, finance, ainsi que les relations avec les acteurs externes - clients, régies et partenaires</p> <p>- Assurer un contact direct et proactif avec les clients, en les conseillant et en répondant à leurs besoins, et veiller au respect des délais</p> <p>- Superviser la production et la présentation des bilans de campagne</p> <p>- Manager et encadrer une équipe en l'accompagnant dans son développement professionnel.</p> <p> </p> <p> </p> <p><strong>COMPÉTENCES REQUISES :</strong></p> <p>· Formation supérieure Bac +4/5 en Marketing/Communication.</p> <p>· Expérience de 6 à 7 ans en agence média, régie ou chez l'annonceur.</p> <p>· Connaissances approfondies des leviers média online et offline, de leur orchestration et de leur exécution.</p> <p>· Une expérience dans l’opérationnel digital serait un plus.</p> <p>· Excellentes compétences rédactionnelles et de présentation.</p> <p>· Esprit d'analyse, de synthèse et de rigueur.</p> <p>· Curiosité, autonomie et proactivité.</p> <p>· Sens de l'organisation et souci du détail.</p> <p>· Anglais courant.</p> <p></p> <p class="x_MsoNormal"> </p> <p><strong><em><u>La vie chez WPP Media et ses avantages :</u></em></strong></p> <p><em>Notre engagement à façonner l'avenir des médias se manifeste par un soutien actif au développement professionnel de nos talents, les aidant à atteindre leur plein potentiel. title: Principal Partner Account Manager, Service Provider, EMEA
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. and drive pipeline development across multiple SP partners. </li> </ul> <p><span style="color: rgb(230, 126, 35);"><strong>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</strong></span></p> <hr> <ul> results in driving growth and innovation.</li> <li>Experience working in the Technology sector: Network and/or cybersecurity experience a must.</li> <li>Excellent communication, negotiation, and work independently and collaboratively across various teams in a fast-paced, matrixed environment.</li> </ul> <p><strong><span style="color: rgb(230, 126, 35);">Compensation</span></strong></p> <hr> title: Head of Marketing

title: Stage Ingénieur Data (6 mois) - F/H - Lyon
description: Qui sommes-nous ? Q ENERGY France est un acteur majeur du marché des énergies renouvelables en France. Autrefois affilié au groupe RES, l’entreprise œuvre depuis 27 ans dans le développement, la construction et l’exploitation de projets éoliens et photovoltaïques. Aujourd'hui également positionnée sur le marché du stockage d'énergie, Q ENERGY poursuit son expansion vers de nouveaux domaines afin de proposer des solutions intelligentes et complètes pour la production et la fourniture d’énergie durable en France. L'entreprise compte près de 300 collaborateur.rice.s et 6 agences sur le territoire ainsi qu'un siège social basé à Avignon. Q ENERGY France est une entreprise de la holding européenne Q ENERGY Solutions, créée en 2021 par Hanwha Solutions dans l'objectif de conduire à la prochaine génération de production d'énergie verte et flexible en Europe. Basée à Berlin, Q ENERGY Solutions est une société sœur de Q CELLS, fabricant de modules photovoltaïques reconnu à travers le monde. Les deux sociétés constituent la division Energie du groupe Hanwha Solutions, basé à Séoul. Vos missions : Rattaché.e à l'équipe Business développement, vous contribuez à la construction d'une infrastructure de données fiable au service de l'activité opérationnelle. Vous concevez un processus complet qui collecte des données issues de sources externes variées, les fiabilise et les met à disposition dans nos outils SIG. Vos principales missions : Identifier et qualifier les sources de données : recenser de manière exhaustive les sources externes pertinentes (open data, bases institutionnelles, données géographiques…) et évaluer leur format, leur fréquence de mise à jour et leur fiabilité. Croiser les sources entre elles : définir et mettre en œuvre une méthode de rapprochement (record linkage), afin d'identifier de façon fiable les mêmes éléments présents dans plusieurs sources. Consolider les données : nettoyer, harmoniser et compiler les données dans un format cohérent, prêt à être intégré à notre base de données existante. Garantir la cohérence entre sources : mettre en place des contrôles de qualité et des règles de mise à jour, pour éviter qu'une modification dans une source ne crée des incohérences dans l'ensemble de la base. Publier les résultats : intégrer les données consolidées à la base et les rendre exploitables dans les outils SIG de l'entreprise. Automatiser le processus : industrialiser la chaîne de traitement pour permettre des mises à jour régulières et reproductibles, sans intervention manuelle. Documenter la méthode : rédiger une documentation claire de la démarche et des choix retenus, pour assurer la maintenance et la transmission du dispositif. Connaissance des méthodes de rapprochement de données et des notions de statistiques associées (probabilités, scoring, mesures de similarité) ; Notions de SIG (QGIS, ArcGIS ou équivalent) et de données géospatiales. title: Engineering Manager
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p>About the department</p> <p>Cloudflare's Engineering team builds and runs the software that handles a large share of the Internet's requests. We also build the internal tools and platforms that software depends on. Teams own large areas with real impact and work autonomously within them, whether their customers are external or other Cloudflare engineers.</p> <p>About the team</p> <p>Developer Productivity builds the internal tools and platforms Cloudflare engineers use to take code from commit to production. We own developer infrastructure (CI/CD, build systems), developer insights and ADLC metrics, AI-assisted development, and Cloudflare-on-Cloudflare dogfooding.</p> <p>We're responsible for AI-assisted development across all of Cloudflare engineering, and adoption has grown 4 to 6 times over in the last year. We also own the tooling behind Cloudflare's Engineering Codex, the standards every engineering team is expected to meet.</p> <p>About the role</p> <p>This is a front-line engineering manager role leading a team of 6+ engineers in Bengaluru. The team's initial focus will be on two areas:</p> <ul> <li> <p><strong>AI tools for engineers.</strong> Agents, agentic systems, MCP servers, evals, and context engineering that change how Cloudflare engineers write, review, and ship code.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Engineering standards and the tooling that enforces them.</strong> Continuing to transform our Engineering standards into automated guardrails, paved paths, and feedback engineers can act on, instead of checklists and manual review.</p> </li> </ul> <p>You'll own the product direction for both areas. There are no dedicated product managers on the team. Our users are Cloudflare engineers, and our engineers work as product engineers who talk to users, watch how tools get used, and help decide what to build next. You'll lead that work, deciding what to build and why, and making sure it gets adopted and solves real problems.</p> <p>You don't need to write code every day, but you should be able to review a design, debug a broken pipeline, or prototype an agent when the team needs it.</p> <p>We move fast. AI tooling changes month to month, so a six-month plan is stale in six weeks. We ship small, put it in front of engineers early, and change course based on what we hear. We'd rather ship a rough version this week and improve it next week than spend a month polishing a design doc. We add process only when it solves a real problem.</p> <p>You'll partner closely with engineering managers and principal engineers in the US, UK, and Europe, and work with teams across Cloudflare's global organization. The team starts in Bengaluru. As it grows, it may include engineers in other regions.</p> <p>What you'll do</p> <ul> <li> <p>Hire, onboard, and grow your team. Coach engineers to think like product engineers, run career conversations, give direct feedback, and handle performance.</p> </li> <li> <p>Own the product roadmap. Spend time with the engineers who use your tools, decide which problems matter most, and say no to the rest.</p> </li> <li> <p>Keep the team shipping. Release in small increments, get feedback from users quickly, and cut process that slows the team down without adding value.</p> </li> <li> <p>Deliver in both focus areas: agents, MCP servers, and evals the rest of engineering relies on, and Codex standards turned into CI/CD checks, templates, and policy-as-code, with remediation and exception workflows to match.</p> </li> <li> <p>Measure whether the work is landing: tool adoption, Codex compliance, and what engineers actually think of the experience.</p> </li> <li> <p>Own operations for the platforms your team runs, including on-call and incident response.</p> </li> </ul> <p>What we're looking for</p> <ul> <li> <p>3+ years managing software engineers, including hiring, onboarding, and developing people.</p> </li> <li> <p>8+ years of total software engineering experience, with enough recent hands-on work to hold your own in code and design reviews.</p> </li> <li> <p>Hands-on experience with AI in engineering organizations, such as building agents, running agentic systems in production, or governing how a company uses AI. This is not a model-training or ML research role.</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience building or running developer tools, internal platforms, or CI/CD systems.</p> </li> <li> <p>Product and user thinking. You've owned a roadmap, with or without a PM, and you can point to decisions you made because of what users told you or how they actually used what you built.</p> </li> <li> <p>A bias to action. You've led teams that shipped often and changed direction when the evidence called for it, while still delivering on commitments.</p> </li> <li> <p>Clear judgment and clear writing. You make sound trade-offs and explain the "why" as well as the "how". Much of your work with partners will happen asynchronously across time zones.</p> </li> </ul> <p>Bonus points</p> <ul> <li> <p>You've built MCP servers or LLM evals, or worked on context engineering for agents.</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience with policy-as-code or compliance automation.</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience measuring developer productivity, using frameworks such as DORA or SPACE, or developer surveys.</p> </li> <li> <p>You've built a team from scratch or started an engineering presence in a new location.</p> </li> <li> <p>Familiarity with TypeScript, Go, or Kubernetes-based systems.</p> </li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? title: Solutions Consultant, Mid-Market, Spain
description: WHO WE ARE Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work. ABOUT THE ROLE: Notion is shaping the future of Go-To-Market, and as a Solutions Consultant (SC), you’ll bring that future to life by building alongside customers and turning their biggest challenges into measurable outcomes. As a customer-facing, quota-carrying SC, you’ll bring together technical fluency and commercial ownership to grow your book of business. You’ll build pipeline with BDRs, engage key stakeholders, lead discovery, co-build workflow solutions live with customers, and guide opportunities through close. You’ll connect each solution to a clear business case and stay engaged through adoption, expansion, and renewal so customers realize the value of what they buy. You’ll partner with BDRs, Outcomes Architects, and technical or product specialists while maintaining clear ownership of customer relationships, opportunity momentum, and next steps. If you’re a builder who loves to sell—and want to work at the intersection of AI, productivity, and enterprise—this is the role. This role will be based in either Dublin. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE: - Create pipeline across your book of business. Build target-account plans with BDRs and initiate outreach to priority stakeholders to generate qualified opportunities, alongside BDR-sourced pipeline. - Own opportunities from first conversation through close. Lead discovery, qualify business needs and urgency, align stakeholders, shape the solution and business case, and drive the evaluation and commercial decision. Navigate commercial sizing, proposal construction, procurement, legal, and security review to close deals with the right scope, credits, and implementation path. - Design and validate workflow solutions that deliver measurable value. Map current- and future-state workflows, co-build solutions live in Notion, and define realistic scope, success criteria, and an implementation path. Translate customer needs and validated outcomes into a clear business case, commercial recommendation, and decision path. Treat discovery as an opportunity to build and validate. - Orchestrate the right partners while maintaining ownership. Engage BDRs, Outcomes Architects, and technical or product specialists at the right moments, with clear context and asks, while owning opportunity momentum, customer communication, and next steps. - Drive customer value and commercial growth after signature. Partner with Outcomes Architects, guide the initial path to value with a clear adoption plan, on onboarding and ongoing multi-workflow adoption, and own expansion strategy and renewal planning. Stay accountable for translating credits sold into credits consumed, and surface risks or expansion opportunities as customer workflows mature. SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: - Commercial ownership and pipeline generation. You can demonstrate how you created or advanced business, influenced customer decisions, and owned measurable outcomes. Relevant experience may come from quota-carrying sales or adjacent customer-facing roles. - Technical fluency and builder mindset. You are comfortable building live in software and can demo, co-design, and troubleshoot with a customer without needing a specialist in the room. - AI fluency. You are excited about AI, build with new tools, and continually learn new ways of working. - Discovery, qualification, and value articulation. You can uncover customer needs, map workflows, qualify business impact and urgency, and translate what you learn into commercial outcomes, adoption plans, and clear success criteria. - Agency, urgency, and learning velocity. You set clear goals, take initiative, learn from customer interactions, and apply those learnings to improve outcomes. You bring new ideas and workflows to customers and make complex problems easier to solve. - Complex customer engagement. You can lead multi-stakeholder interactions and navigate procurement, legal, and security review cycles. - Fluency in Spanish. NICE TO HAVES: - Full-cycle B2B software sales experience or solutions engineering experience, with a consistent track record of exceeding quota across new-logo acquisition and expansion motions. - Familiarity with usage-based or consumption-based pricing models and the ability to structure credit-based commercial proposals. - Prior experience selling to mid-market and enterprise accounts in productivity, collaboration, or workflow software. - Experience in a shared account ownership model, partnering with a post-sale or Customer Success team as part of an integrated customer motion. Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role's scope and complexity, and the candidate's experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. The estimated range for total on target earnings (including base salary and on target incentive pay) for this role is €174,000 - €186,000 per year. By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550. https://dev.notion.so/a3ce416456924276a59de91bca740028?pvs=21 #LI-Onsite A NOTE ON AI You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. title: Senior Specialist Solutions Engineer, Cloudflare One - Russian or Hebrew speaking
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3><strong>Available Location: London, UK or Munich, Germany or Amsterdam, Netherlands</strong></h3> <h3><strong>About the Department</strong></h3> <p>The Specialist Solutions Engineering team at Cloudflare is a group of trusted technical advisors who partner with our customers to solve their most complex security and performance challenges. We are passionate about technology and dedicated to helping our customers understand and leverage the full power of Cloudflare's global network to achieve their business critical objectives.</p> <h3><strong>About the Role</strong></h3> <p>As a Senior Solutions Engineer Specialist, you will be a pivotal technical expert and strategic advisor, focusing on the Cloudflare One product suite. You will partner with our sales team and engage directly with our customers to architect and demonstrate how our SASE platform can solve their unique security, performance, and reliability needs. Your expertise will be crucial in guiding prospects through complex technical evaluations, ensuring they have the confidence to adopt Cloudflare as a core component of their IT and security infrastructure.</p> <p>This role requires a blend of deep technical curiosity, strong communication skills, and a genuine passion for helping customers transform their network and security architecture. Candidates are expected to actively use AI tools in their day-to-day life for research, preparation, automation, or customer engagement.</p> <h3><strong>Responsibilities</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Serve as a trusted technical advisor</strong> to our customers, helping them architect the optimal solution for their business needs using the Cloudflare One product suite.</li> <li><strong>Stay at the forefront of AI-era security challenges</strong> by developing expertise in how enterprises govern and secure AI tool adoption, including Shadow AI visibility, data loss prevention for AI applications, MCP server access controls and Agentic AI Governance.</li> <li><strong>Guide qualified prospects</strong> through the solution design and proof-of-value stages, effectively demonstrating the key capabilities and value of the Cloudflare One portfolio.</li> <li><strong>Collaborate with sales partners</strong> to consistently achieve pipeline generation and revenue goals.</li> <li><strong>Analyze customer IT landscapes</strong> and security requirements to develop robust architectures that support their strategic objectives.</li> <li><strong>Clearly articulate the benefits</strong> and technical differentiators of the Cloudflare One product portfolio against competing solutions.</li> <li><strong>Enhance customer retention</strong> by identifying, capturing, and communicating product gaps or feature requests to internal product and engineering teams.</li> <li><strong>Collaborate with Product Teams</strong> by being the voice of our customers by sharing insights, trends, and product gaps to help shape the product suite and solution roadmap.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Qualifications</strong></h3> <p>Successful candidates are curious, customer-focused, and have a passion for learning. We are looking for individuals with a strong background in technical sales or systems engineering who can effectively communicate complex concepts to both technical and executive audiences.</p> <p><strong>Key Qualifications:</strong></p> <ul> <li>5+ years of experience in a customer-facing technical role such as Technical Sales, Solutions/Systems Engineering, or a related field.</li> <li>Active adoption of the use of AI tools in professional day to day workflows and knowledge on AI security concepts relevant to enterprise customers:  Securing employee AI tool usage,  Governing AI application access, and understanding the data leakage risks posed by generative AI tools</li> <li>Demonstrated experience presenting technical solutions and communicating the value of network and security transformation to senior-level executives.</li> <li>Deep understanding of the modern cybersecurity landscape, including common threats (e.g., malware, ransomware, phishing, botnets) and mitigation strategies.</li> <li>Fundamental knowledge of customer network and application architectures, including hybrid environments leveraging public clouds (Azure, AWS, GCP).</li> <li>Solid grasp of SASE concepts and Zero Trust networking architectures.</li> <li>Hands-on experience with one or more of the following: Secure Web Gateway (SWG), CASB, DLP, DNS security (including DNS over HTTPS), Identity Provider (IdP) integration (SAML, OTP), and SIEM/log analytics platforms.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Fluent in English (written & spoken), Russian and/or Hebrew</li> <li>Proficiency with networking fundamentals, including routing, subnetting, VPNs, and SD-WAN concepts.</li> <li>Understanding of AI agentic architecture and the security requirements and challenges in implementation at scale.</li> <li>Familiarity with client operating system fundamentals and software distribution methods.</li> <li>Knowledge of the competitive landscape for CDN, WAF, DDoS mitigation, and Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) solutions.</li> <li>Direct experience with Cloudflare's Zero Trust solutions (Access, Gateway, Browser Isolation) is a significant plus.</li> <li>Strong project management skills, with the ability to work to deadlines and prioritize effectively among competing goals.</li> </ul> <h3 class="" title: Chief of Staff
description: Overview Physical AI, a real model of the world, is the next trillion dollar opportunity and a foundational pillar for energy, robotics and superintelligence. At Jua we are building it now. Our models already run on four continents and help power the energy buildout needed to support ever larger intelligence. We are assembling a world-class team of researchers and entrepreneurial minds to turn this model into reality at global scale. If you want the opportunity of your life, come build physical AI with us. The Role You work directly with Jua’s Leadership. You operate as a force multiplier — plugging into whatever's highest-leverage that day, from fundraising and investor work to product calls, deals, and fixing what's broken before it slows us down. What you're pulled into will shift as the business does — some stretches this is heavily fundraising and investor-facing, others it's operational firefighting or unsticking a cross-functional project. The pace is high, the context load is real, and you'll see everything. This is also a launchpad into an executive leadership role. This role is best suited for someone who has been an early-stage operator or ex-founder, and has hands-on experience with start-ups that are still in the build-phase. If that's you, expect a founder's vantage point on how Jua scales — the pace and stakes of building it yourself, without carrying it alone. What You Will Do Problem-solve directly with the leadership team on the highest-leverage issues across the business — from product, marketing and operations to fundraising and partnerships. Sit in high-stakes meetings with customers, investors, and strategic partners, and turn what happens there into clear next steps. Bring clarity to priorities and make sure decisions actually turn into action. Build lightweight dashboards and operating rhythms that help the team learn from data that's still evolving — without pretending it's cleaner than it is. title: Senior Customer Success Manager (Dutch speaking/ Nederlandstalig)
description: Over de rol 🎯 Als Senior Customer Success Manager bij DataSnipper zorg je ervoor dat onze klanten hun doelen bereiken met onze innovatieve, AI-gedreven oplossingen. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de klantreis, van onboarding tot langdurige waardecreatie en retentie, en bouwt sterke relaties op basis van vertrouwen en samenwerking. Je helpt klanten sneller waarde te halen uit onze producten en draagt bij aan de groei en het succes van ons bedrijf. Deze rol biedt een unieke kans om nauw samen te werken met professionals die de wereldwijde kapitaalmarkten draaiende houden, door uitzonderlijke service te leveren en een actieve en betrokken community voor onze klanten op te bouwen. Word jij enthousiast van Customer Success en pak je graag zelf de regie? Dan horen we graag van je! Over DataSnipper Wij geloven dat vertrouwen essentieel is voor hoe de samenleving werkt. Elke dag vertrouwen we op informatie die onafhankelijk is gecontroleerd, van jaarrekeningen tot de producten die we kopen en de duurzaamheidsclaims van bedrijven. Achter dat vertrouwen staan audit- en financeprofessionals die bewijs onderzoeken, informatie verifiëren en organisaties ter verantwoording roepen. Bij DataSnipper bouwen we AI-oplossingen waarmee deze professionals die beoordelingen kunnen maken. Met Alwin by DataSnipper, ons nieuwe agentic platform, nemen AI-agents audit- en financeprocedures van begin tot eind over, terwijl elke conclusie terug te voeren is op de bron. Zo houden professionals ruimte voor het oordeelsvermogen en de expertise die hun werk zo belangrijk maken. Meer dan 600.000 professionals bij ruim 3.000 organisaties in 175 landen vertrouwen op ons platform. Daaronder vallen Fortune 500-bedrijven, overheidsinstanties en alle Big Four-accountantskantoren. Alleen al in 2025 leverde DataSnipper zijn klanten een productiviteitswinst op ter waarde van meer dan 1,4 miljard dollar. Met een Series B-financieringsronde van 100 miljoen dollar onder leiding van Index Ventures, bij een waardering van 1 miljard dollar, leggen we een solide basis voor onze volgende groeifase. Als lid van 1% for the Planet kijken we niet alleen naar hoe snel we groeien, maar ook naar hoe we groeien. Voor onze Customer Success-teams wordt het nu extra spannend. Alwin is net gelanceerd, de vraag groeit en we breiden uit naar nieuwe markten en segmenten. Met een product waar klanten al op vertrouwen, heb je de kans om echt je stempel te drukken op de volgende stap. Wat ga je doen Trusted Advisor zijn: Je bent een strategische partner voor belangrijke beslissers, zoals auditpartners en -managers, controllers, finance directors en IT-besluitvormers, en begeleidt hen bij de transformatie van hun organisatie met DataSnipper. Business transformatie aanjagen: Je helpt klanten hun workflows en processen opnieuw uit te vinden en laat zien hoe de AI-mogelijkheden van DataSnipper meetbaar bijdragen aan efficiëntie, kostenbesparing en kwaliteit binnen audit en finance. Strategische, consultatieve oplossingen bieden: Je denkt mee over de uitdagingen van elke klant en vertaalt dat naar praktisch advies, zodat zij hun audit- en financeworkflows optimaliseren en hun strategische doelen bereiken met DataSnipper. Klanten helpen om meer waarde uit DataSnipper te halen: Je geeft uitgebreide trainingen, organiseert regelmatige Business Reviews en ontwikkelt succesplannen, zodat klanten de functionaliteiten van DataSnipper omarmen en aantoonbare waarde halen uit ons platform. Hechte klantrelaties opbouwen: Je bouwt sterke, langdurige partnerschappen op basis van vertrouwen, diepgaand inzicht in de sector en oprechte betrokkenheid bij het succes en de resultaten van je klanten. Over teams heen samenwerken: Je werkt samen met Product, Engineering, Sales en Solutions Engineering en deelt klantinzichten over workflowuitdagingen, use cases en technische vereisten om productinnovatie te stimuleren.
