title: Senior Platform Engineer
description: About Orakl Oncology At Orakl Oncology, we are accelerating the development of oncology treatments. Today, fewer than 5% of new cancer drugs succeed in clinical trials. Clearly, new methods are needed. We combine cutting-edge biology and AI to build the next generation of insight platforms with the world's largest cohort of patient tumor avatars. These avatars fuel our AI-powered predictive engine , helping to anticipate clinical trial outcomes, validate therapies, and uncover new drug candidates. By generating multimodal, real-world data, we deliver insights that consistently outperform existing solutions. Our mission is simple yet ambitious: to bring more effective treatments to patients who need them - and to make drug development smarter, faster, and more personalized. We collaborate with top hospitals, research institutes, and pharmaceutical companies worldwide. Backed by leading investors, we are a fast-growing, mission-driven startup at the intersection of science and technology. The company is growing fast, and we are now seeking the best talents to come and join our exciting and ambitious team in the fight against cancer - join us! Position overview Orakl runs its data and AI platform on AWS: Dagster pipelines, a versioned PostgreSQL warehouse, ephemeral Fargate and EC2 compute, eight microservices. Unique in-house and hospital-provided biological, clinical and omics data flow through it every day. We continuously train our proprietary AI models on this every day to create new scientific insights that will benefit patients. We are hiring a Platform Engineer across three missions: infrastructure, security and scalability. You will be our first dedicated platform hire, and you will decide what this platform looks like for the next years. This is a high-stakes, high-ownership position. Our stack Cloud: AWS (Paris region), cross-cloud backup to a second European provider Compute: ECS and Fargate, EC2, ephemeral provisioning per job Data: PostgreSQL, S3, versioned transformations Code: Python everywhere, Docker, Terraform, GitHub, GitHub Actions, Dagster orchestration, Nextflow What you will be doing 1. Security: Codebase, incident management, AI guardrails, fleet management. These are the main things that you will be focusing during your first months with us: Secure the codebase : workflow permissions, pinned actions, dependency and secret scanning, package security. Run vulnerability watch and build our incident response tooling: establish the blast radius, write the fix, deploy it company-wide, run the postmortem. Define our AI guardrails : we use AI tools heavily and we are embedding them in the product, so we need clear rules on which data those tools may reach and how their output is reviewed before it ships. Develop our fleet management tools to **keep our laptops up-to-date and secure, define and enforce security practices, deploy and maintain management and security tooling to our fleet. 2. Infrastructure management: Compute, data access, observability. Own our AWS compute : VPC and network segmentation, EC2 allocation. Support data storage. As the team and our partner base grow, access to sensitive data has to stay compartmented and auditable. You will be consulted on where data belongs, across RDS, Redshift, PostgreSQL and the rest, and on keeping access to it properly controlled. Build the observability layer : metrics, logs and traces in one place, alerting that fires on real failures. Own secure access to our infrastructure : secure networks, access control and policies, observability. 3. Scalability: Improve the tools we have, choose the ones we will need. Our product is being built and the volume of data coming in keeps growing, which will call for architecture and resources we do not use today. You will be expected to anticipate failures and future needs, and bring your expert knowledge and experience to our systems & designs. Who you are Minimum qualifications 5+ years in platform, infrastructure or site reliability engineering , with security a real part of the job rather than an occasional task. Deep hands-on AWS : IAM and identity management, VPC design, RDS, container orchestration, secrets management, federated authentication for CI. Terraform in production with a real review workflow behind it, and containers you have operated rather than only deployed to. Ownership of CI/CD security , ideally GitHub Actions: supply chain integrity, dependency management, build provenance. Incident response as a practitioner. You have been the person on the hook, not the person who read the report afterwards. Fluent in English . Preferred qualifications Highly sensitive data in a high-stakes regulated sector: health, finance or defence. Working knowledge of French health data regulation (HDS, CNIL, GDPR), or another regulated environment and the appetite to learn this one quickly. Device management at scale (Jamf, Kandji, Fleet or equivalent) and automated joiner, mover and leaver processes. Dagster or a comparable orchestration framework, and PostgreSQL in production. What we offer Mission: work in a cutting-edge environment, on the forefront of cancer research. Impact: take ownership of a critical piece of an early-stage, fast-moving company, with the opportunity to shape it; your engineering decisions will carry through to our science and, ultimately, to patient outcomes. Team: join a collaborative, multidisciplinary team where you’ll work alongside stellar clinicians, biologists, and engineers towards a common mission. Interview Process Hiring Manager Call: Getting to know each other, aligning on expectations and context. Technical Deep Dive: A deep conversation on your experience relative to the role. Technical Case: A exercise representative of the real challenges you'll face. Reference Call: A conversation with several people with whom you've worked closely. Founder Interview: A final discussion with our founders on vision, culture fit, and mutual ambitions. 👉 More about Orakl here and here Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Lab Automation Lead
description: About us, and our mission At Orakl Oncology, we are accelerating the development of oncology treatments. Today, fewer than 5% of new cancer drugs succeed in clinical trials. Clearly, new methods are needed. We combine cutting-edge biology and AI to build the next generation of insight platforms with a large cohort of patient-derived tumor avatars. These avatars fuel our predictive engine, helping to anticipate clinical outcomes, validate therapies and uncover new drug candidates. By generating multimodal, real-world data, we aim to make drug development smarter, faster and more personalized. We collaborate with leading hospitals, research institutes and pharmaceutical companies. Backed by leading investors, Orakl is a fast-growing, mission-driven startup at the intersection of biology, automation and AI. Position overview Orakl runs a high-throughput 3D cell‑culture platform to culture patient-derived organoids (PDOs). These patient-derived specimens reveal critical information into the patient disease, but require heavy maintenance work. Automating these workflows will be critical to improve the reliability and traceability of experimental work. We are hiring our first automation lead to build the Automation function from scratch. This is a high ownership and high autonomy job. You will map our processes, decide what to automate and what to leave alone, specify and source the equipment, negotiate with vendors and integrators, commission the machines, run them with the lab team, and hire the people the function needs. As the ideal candidate, you have already put automated lines or special machines into service, and you know what typically breaks between commissioning and the first experimental runs. While previous experience in biology is a plus, it is not a strict requirement: you will be taught all you need to know. However, you do need a proven experience in working deeply embedded in interdisciplinary teams. Key responsibilities Map cell culture workflows end to end and identify key process automation and optimisation opportunities. Own the automation roadmap. Present and lead the implementation of the major decisions to Orakl’s leadership. In line with the automation strategy you will have identified, evaluate vendors and integrators. Write user requirement specifications, acceptance criteria and interface requirements for each project. Negotiate price, scope, delivery, acceptance, support and consumables terms autonomously within agreed thresholds. Lead design reviews and factory and site acceptance tests. Translate our proprietary cell culture protocols into automated machine execution with our team of cell biologists and scientists. Track machine availability, hands-on time per line, interventions, failures and recovery time. Use the data to decide the next step. Coordinate with Orakl’s management to anticipate future automation needs on the platform and adjust the roadmap accordingly. Hire and develop the automation technicians and engineers the roadmap needs. Set the standards for the automated platform: documentation, quality control, safety, qualification, change control, vendor management. In this role you will collaborate closely with our cell culture, cell biology and data science teams. You will be at the heart of Orakl Oncology’s capabilities roadmap and help generate unprecedented amounts of biological data to power scientific discovery in cancer. Key qualifications Must-have Engineering degree (generalist, robotics, industrial, mechanical or process engineering) or equivalent, and at least eight years of experience. Exceptional process thinking skills: you map flows, time operations, find bottlenecks and question the processes. Experience in supplier negotiation and budget ownership on your own projects. Experience in PLC and robot programming concepts, scheduling software, instrument interfaces, basic scripting. You enjoy and are comfortable spending time on the floor with operators. You have experience in communicating and operating with engineers, technicians and workers at the heart of production processes. Autonomy: you tell your manager what you decided and why, not what you need decided. Fluency in English is required. Nice-to-have You have put automated lines, cells or special machines into service end to end: requirements, vendor selection, negotiation, integration, factory and site acceptance, ramp-up, budget. This doesn’t have to be in a lab environment : plant, food and fermentation, pharma or cosmetics are other examples of relevant experience. Automation in life-science or regulated environments: cell culture, biotech, food and fermentation, pharma, cleanroom or BSL-2 work. A working understanding of cell culture and what it demands: sterility, contamination risk, variability between samples, and steps governed by the biological pace. Liquid handling, plate-based workflows, incubators and imagers; laboratory scheduling software. Experience hiring and leading an automation team. What we offer You will be Orakl's first automation hire. You will have a unique degree of ownership and scope with a strong mandate to deliver. Short decision lines and fast execution. An interdisciplinary environment with a results-driven culture. Recruitment process Introductory call with Talent / People — 20 minutes Interview with the Lab Director, hiring manager — 45 minutes, including a 15-minute live mini-case on a small lab process Technical deep dive with the CTO and the Lab Director Case study on a real part of our lab: a take-home capped at four hours, then a half day on site with presentation, challenge round, lab walk. Cross-functional interviews with the technicians who run the culture, Platform Operations, the Senior Laboratory Engineers and the Data team — 60 minutes Reference calls: a former manager, a vendor or integrator you negotiated with, and an operator who ran a line you delivered Founder conversation — 45 minutes Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Chief Financial Officer
description: Most CFOs inherit a finance function. This one gets to build it. quinn is an app-based, managed payroll and employment-administration service. We run it for private households employing a cleaner, nanny, or caretaker, and for businesses that manage employment relationships at scale. The customer stays the legal employer — quinn registers the employment, runs payroll, and handles social insurance, taxes, and filings on their behalf, automated end to end. Where everyone else sells software, quinn sells the outcome. We hold the power of attorney for every customer, take decisions, do the work, and take legal responsibility for the result. The purpose behind it is simple: Fair employment. For all. That means making correct and fair employment simple and accessible for any employer and any employee, in any market quinn enters. Where we stand Thousands of clients rely on us. Last year alone, over CHF 200 million ran through our platform. We are at CHF 7 million ARR and growing. The Swiss business is profitable. We have acquired two new businesses in the last twelve months. A hungry team of over 50 people (and 5 dogs) in offices in Switzerland, Germany and the United Kingdom. And we are raising our next round. We do not have a finance function yet. We have an external accountant, a signed audit, and a CEO and COO who know exactly what they need to run this company — but cannot build it alone. That is the opening. Tasks What you will own Everything financial: Banking architecture across multiple currencies, countries, and entities. Monthly close that actually closes on time. Compliance in multiple jurisdictions via external partners you recruit and manage. The financial diligence in our roll-up strategy when we acquire — and the structuring of acquisition financing when deals need to be funded. A financial model that investors love to look at. The data room when we raise. You will report to David (CEO) and work closely with Lad (COO), who owns the P&L and will be your closest counterpart on the operational side. You will present to the board. You will be in the room for every capital allocation decision. There is no team. There is no process to maintain. There is a blank sheet and a business that is ready to run properly. The first year Your first year at quinn is one of the rare opportunities where you get to make every decision that matters. Which tools. Which banks. Which partners. How we report, how we model, how we show up to investors. All of it is yours to design. You will spend the first months getting under the hood — taking over the books, understanding the gaps, and fixing what needs fixing first. You will build the reporting infrastructure that gives leadership real visibility to steer the company across every product and revenue stream. You will analyze the first potential merger and acquisition targets and sit in rooms where the financial direction of the company gets decided, and you will be the person with the numbers. By the end of the year, you will have built something real: a finance function that works, a roll-up strategy that has financial legs, and a leadership team that trusts you completely. Most people at this level spend years waiting for that kind of ownership. Here it happens within months. Requirements Who we are looking for You have been CFO or Head of Finance at a scale-up — a SaaS, marketplace, or tech-enabled services company. You have worked across more than one international market. You are comfortable closing the books yourself, not just reviewing what others produce. You have built financial infrastructure before — not inherited it. You are equally at home in B2C and B2B — and you understand what it means to manage the unit economics, reporting, and compliance obligations for both within a single business. You think in MRR, ARR, NRR, CAC payback, and LTV:CAC ratio. You have worked with investors. You understand what a roll-up strategy looks like financially, and you have the accounting basics to back it up. You know the difference between managing a finance function and doing the finance — and you are built for the latter. Most importantly: You want this. Not a senior finance role at a large company. This one. The blank sheet, the multiple markets, the acquisitions to integrate, the round to prepare, the opportunity. The kind of thing you only get to do once. The Team We are a small, fast, direct team. We do not have a lot of process, a lot of hierarchy, or a lot of patience for people who need it. We do have a profitable core business, a clear strategy, an ambitious plan, and five values we actually mean: Be open, Own it, Speak up, Keep it simple, Bias for action The CFO is one of the most important hires we will make this year. We are not rushing it and we are not filling a seat. We are looking for the person who looks at this and thinks: Finally! Please apply exclusively via join — other forms of application will not be considered. Find Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

title: OEM Alliance Director
description: <p>Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. The Dell Global Alliance Director will also contribute to thought leadership initiatives, such as joint publications and joint customer events.</p> <p>Location: This role will be based remotely in AMER regions.</p> <h3><strong>The role entails</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Build and own the strategy and the development of the Alliance on a global level</li> <li>Expand strategic relationships and enable Dell teams on the partnership</li> <li>Grow business motions with Dell Technologies, across sell-to, sell-through and sell-with motions  </li> <li>Grow Dell’s awareness of open source capabilities on Canonical Ubuntu</li> <li>Manage, develop and grow a team of experienced business development managers</li> <li>Demonstrate a deep understanding of the Linux and cloud software ecosystem</li> <li>Deliver on targets, objectives and provide a voice of the partner</li> <li>Travel internationally - to drive partnerships in person</li> <li>Align and support internal canonical field teams - identify, support, grow, transact</li> <li>Expand existing footprint with Dell customers with an aim to upsell to broader portfolio</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What we are looking for in you</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Proven experience as an Alliance Manager/Director </li> <li>Solid experience in Linux, virtualization, containers, and other cloud technologies</li> <li>Excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to build strong relationships with executives at all levels.</li> <li>Strong business acumen and a strategic mindset, with a focus on driving revenue growth and market expansion.</li> <li>Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to effectively present complex ideas to a variety of audiences.</li> <li>Autonomous, disciplined, hands-on, get-it-done mentality</li> <li>Passionate about Canonical products and mission</li> <li>Comfortable in fast-paced and high pressure environments with measurable goals</li> <li>Team player with superior accountability and customer support skills</li> <li>Experience managing cross-functional teams and track record of operational excellence</li> </ul> <p><strong>What we offer colleagues</strong></p> <p>We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.</p> <ul> <li>Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person</li> <li>Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year</li> <li>Annual compensation review</li> <li>Recognition rewards</li> <li>Annual holiday leave</li> <li>Maternity and paternity leave</li> <li>Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform</li> <li>Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues</li> <li>Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events</li> </ul> <p><strong>About Canonical</strong></p> <p>Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.</p> <p><strong>Canonical is an equal opportunity employer</strong></p> <p>We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. title: Thermal Test and Modelling Engineer
description: Ready to make connectivity from space universally accessible, secure and actionable? Then you’ve come to the right place! E-Space is bridging Earth and space to enable hyper-scaled deployments of Internet of Things (IoT) solutions and services. We are building a highly-advanced low Earth orbit (LEO) space system that will fundamentally change the design, economics, manufacturing and service delivery associated with traditional satellite and terrestrial IoT systems. We’re intentional, we’re unapologetically curious and we’re 100% committed to innovate space-based communications and deliver actionable intelligence that will expand global economies, protect space and our planet and enhance our overall quality of life. What is the role: We are seeking a Thermal Engineer to own the thermal analysis and testing of our space products, such as sensors and actuators. The role centers on building thermal models and correlating them with test data, and on planning and running thermal test campaigns in house. It is a hands-on position: you will instrument and run tests yourself and use the results to improve both the design and our test infrastructure. This position is based in our Toulouse office. What you will do: Develop and maintain thermal models (analytical and numerical) of units such as sensors and actuators, from early design trades to flight predictions. Perform thermal analyses (steady-state, transient, worst-case hot and cold) to support design reviews and recommend design changes. Define thermal test campaigns : test plans, predictions, temperature profiles, instrumentation, and pass/fail criteria from requirements and qualification margins. Operate our in-house thermal test facility : run thermal cycling tests, coordinate thermal vacuum (TVAC) campaigns, and own the test reports. Correlate models with test data to refine predictions and margins and feed the results back into the design. Improve our test infrastructure : identify capability gaps, specify and procure equipment, design fixtures and thermal interfaces, and commission new setups. Act as the thermal point of contact for our units toward the spacecraft team: unit thermal budgets, interface boundary conditions, and unit models for the spacecraft thermal model. Support spacecraft Assembly, Integration, and Test (AIT) through system-level thermal balance testing. What you bring to this role: BS + 8 years / MS + 5 years in Mechanical, Aerospace, or Thermal Engineering, or equivalent, with professional experience in thermal engineering of space or electronic hardware. Solid grounding in space heat transfer : radiation in vacuum, conduction and contact conductance across bolted interfaces, and multi-layer insulation (MLI). Hands-on experience building thermal models with standard thermal analysis tools, running worst-case analyses, and correlating models with test data. Hands-on experience planning and running thermal tests (thermal cycling or TVAC) on space or electronic hardware, from test plan to test report. Ability to instrument a test article : thermocouple selection and bonding, heater sizing and placement, thermal interface materials, and data acquisition and real-time monitoring, with ESD-safe, clean handling of sensitive hardware. Excellent teamwork, communication, and documentation skills, with professional proficiency in English ; comfortable in a hands-on, fast-paced startup environment . Bonus points: Experience with Python to post-process test data and automate model correlation. Experience designing or specifying thermal test equipment such as TVAC chambers, thermal plates, or shrouds. Knowledge of spacecraft thermal control hardware : heat pipes, radiators, coatings, and heater circuits. Experience using AI/LLM tools to accelerate development, analysis, and documentation, with sound judgment about their limits. Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

description: Chez Exotec , nous mettons l’excellence technologique au service de la redéfinition des relations entre humains et robots. title: Automation / System Engineer IT/OT (m/w/d)
description: Du hast dein Studium der Elektrotechnik gerade abgeschlossen oder stehst kurz davor? Dich reizt die Schnittstelle zwischen Automation, Netzwerken und IT? Dann bist du bei EXCO genau richtig! Als Automation / System Engineer IT/OT steigst du direkt in spannende Projekte ein und kannst dein Wissen von Anfang an praktisch einsetzen. Deine Aufgaben Du arbeitest in Erweiterungs- und Modernisierungsprojekten mit – von der Spezifikation über die Netzwerkanbindung bis zur Inbetriebnahme. Du hilfst mit, technische IT/OT-Anforderungen und Architekturen zu definieren. Du suchst gemeinsam mit deinem Team Fehler auf System-, Applikations- und Netzwerkebene und behebst sie. Du betreust Server-, Netzwerk- und OT-Infrastrukturen, die moderne Produktionsanlagen am Laufen halten. Du unterstützt bei Wartungsaktivitäten (Patch-Management, Updates) und führst diese in Bezug auf alle lokalen IT/OT-Systeme durch. Du übernimmst Aufgaben im Monitoring, Incident Management und Lebenszyklusmanagement der Server-Infrastruktur (inkl. User Management / Active Directory, Backup Management und Audit Trail Reviews). Du erstellst technische Dokumentationen im regulierten Umfeld (GxP). Du unterstützt bei der Entwicklung von Digitalen Strategien und Konzepten. Dein Profil Abgeschlossenes oder kurz vor dem Abschluss stehendes Studium (BSc/MSc) in Elektrotechnik, vorzugsweise mit dem Schwerpunkt Automation und Robotik Begeisterung für die Schnittstelle von Automation, OT und IT Grundkenntnisse in Netzwerktechnik (TCP/IP, LAN, VLAN) sowie in Windows und Linux – ob aus Studium, Projekten, Praktikum oder dem eigenen Homelab Erste Erfahrungen mit SPS, Industrienetzwerken oder Virtualisierung sind von Vorteil Analytisches Denken, Hartnäckigkeit bei der Fehlersuche und Lust, Bestehendes zu hinterfragen Sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse Unsere Benefits Flexible Arbeitszeiten: Du kannst dir deine Arbeitszeit im Rahmen der Gleitzeit flexibel einteilen. Hybrides Arbeiten: Wir bieten dir einen modern ausgestatteten Arbeitsplatz und geben dir zusätzlich die Möglichkeit zum mobilen Arbeiten mit rund 20% Homeoffice. Work-Life-Balance: Familienfreundliche Unternehmenskultur und Massnahmen zur Vereinbarkeit von Beruf und Privatleben. Einstieg mit Onboarding-Programm: Du wirst von einem Paten begleitet und erhältst eine fundierte Einarbeitung. Erfahrene Kolleginnen und Kollegen stehen dir zur Seite, damit du dich schnell bei uns wohlfühlst und zurechtfindest. Individuelles Coaching: Stillstand ist Rückschritt. Deshalb fördern wir deine fachliche und persönliche Weiterentwicklung durch gezieltes Coaching und Weiterbildungen, die auf deine Interessen und Entwicklungsziele abgestimmt sind. Firmenevents: In regelmässigen Abständen veranstalten wir Freizeitevents, bei denen Spass und die Freude am Miteinander im Vordergrund stehen. Teamspirit erleben: Dich erwartet ein dynamisches Team mit flachen Hierarchien und kurzen Entscheidungswegen. Verantwortung und Gestaltungsspielraum: Bei uns übernimmst du von Anfang an Verantwortung in anspruchsvollen Produktionsumgebungen und kannst dein Wissen direkt in spannende Projekte einbringen. Warum du bei EXCO starten solltest EXCO Consulting GmbH in Root begleitet Pharma- und Medtech-Hersteller, LifeSciences-Unternehmen und Spitäler in der Schweiz. Unsere Schwerpunkte sind Qualifizierung, Validierung, sowie Automation und Systemintegration – von SPS-, HMIund SCADA-Engineering über MES-Anbindungen bis zu Industrial IoT und OPC UA. Wir sind ein dynamisches Team mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen und profitieren gleichzeitig von über 20 Jahren Erfahrung und dem internationalen Netzwerk der EXCO Gruppe. Bei uns übernimmst du als Berufseinsteiger früh Verantwortung und hast erfahrene Kolleginnen und Kollegen an deiner Seite, die dich unterstützen und fachlich weiterbringen. Weitere Informationen über EXCO als Arbeitgeber und deinen Einstiegs- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten findest du auf unserer Karriereseite. Interessiert? Auch wenn du dich noch im letzten Semester befindest, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung! Für Fragen vorab erreichst du uns unter 078 216 76 11. Wir freuen uns darauf dich kennenzulernen! Und aus Kreativität Performance. Qualifikation 2–5+ Jahre Erfahrung im kreativen Bereich (Design, Art Direction o.Ä.) Starkes Portfolio mit echten FMCG- oder Retail-Projekten und sichtbaren Resultaten Sehr gute Skills in Figma sowie Erfahrung in UI und Web Erfahrung in Packaging, Social Media, Web und Print Tiefes Verständnis für FMCG Design, Retail, Consumer Behavior und Kaufentscheidungen Du hinterfragst Dinge und entwickelst sie weiter Du denkst nicht nur in Ästhetik, sondern in Wirkung, Performance und Ergebnissen Du arbeitest selbstständig, schnell, hands-on und lösungsorientiert Du bringst Eigeninitiative mit und treibst Projekte aktiv voran Du übernimmst Verantwortung statt auf Briefings zu warten Du nutzt AI als sinnvolles Tool im kreativen Alltag Deutsch & English Was nicht zu der Rolle passt Rein ästhetisches Denken ohne Verständnis für Markt, Konsumenten und Wirkung Kreative ohne echtes Interesse an FMCG, Retail und marktorientiertem Design Sehr starre oder übermässig prozessgetriebene Arbeitsweisen Menschen, die primär auf Vorgaben warten statt selbst Verantwortung zu übernehmen Menschen, die Konzepte lieben, aber Schwierigkeiten mit Umsetzung und Geschwindigkeit haben Benefits Direktes Arbeiten mit dem Head of Brands Echten Einfluss auf Marken, Produkte und deren Erfolg im Markt Schnelle Entscheidungen statt endlosen Abstimmungsrunden Hohe Eigenverantwortung und viel Raum, Dinge wirklich zu bewegen Wenn du etwas bewegen willst, dann bist du hier richtig. title: Senior Projectmanager
description: Jouw Missie bij CCS Geen dag is hetzelfde in deze rol. Samen met je collega’s zorg je ervoor dat wij succesvol onze softwareoplossingen bij klanten implementeren en dat onze klanten een excellente dienstverlening krijgen! Voor deze complexe systeemimplementaties en integratieprojecten zoeken we een zeer ervaren projectmanager. Je leert de verzekeringsbranche kennen en klanten helpen. Dat doe je niet alleen: je werkt samen met enthousiaste collega’s in een projectteam. Voordelen voor de sollicitant Als projectmanager krijg je veel verantwoordelijkheid, help je klanten en samen met je projectteam zet je mooie resultaten neer. Je kunt deels thuiswerken, deels op ons kantoor in Woerden en bij verschillende klanten in Nederland. Tijdelijk werken vanuit het buitenland kan ook dankzij onze workation-regeling (maximaal 30 dagen aaneengesloten per jaar). Bij ons draait het om klantgericht werken én werkplezier. Daarom is er volop ruimte voor ontspanning en plezier. Denk aan een levend tafelvoetbaltoernooi, pubquiz en een bier- & wijnproeverij. Ons actieve Fun-team zorgt elke maand weer voor iets leuks. En als je reislust nog niet is gestild met 25 vakantiedagen en een workation, dan kun je zelfs tot 20 extra verlofdagen bijkopen. Genoeg redenen om verder te lezen en te ontdekken of deze functie iets voor jou is, toch? Een voorbeeld van je werkdag Opstarten: Aan het begin van je werkdag heb je een dagstart met zowel collega’s als projectteamleden van de klant. Hierin bespreken jullie de voortgang, resultaten en eventuele hulpvragen. Na de dagstart: Allereerst neem je nog wat tijd met een van de consultants naar aanleiding van de dagstart. Je coacht en begeleidt de consultant en helpt deze met een hulpvraag. Vervolgens ga je aan de slag met het opstellen van de voortgangsrapportage. Hiermee zorg je voor proactieve en transparante rapportage over het project aan de klant. De stuurgroep met de klant is volgende week, vandaag spreek je samen met de delivery manager deze stuurgroep voor. Wat zijn de belangrijkste punten voor de klant en voor CCS en hoe vliegen we die aan. Na de lunch: Je checkt nog een paar tickets qua voortgang op het planboard, waarbij je de samenhang met de planning checkt. Vervolgens ga je naar de werksessie met het CCS projectmanagement guild. Hier werken jullie aan tickets om de CCS Prince2Agile projectmethodiek verder te verbeteren. Hierna heb je nog een afspraak met je collega van sales voor afstemming over een mogelijk vervolgproject bij de klant. Wie jij bent De ideale kandidaat beschikt over daadkracht, doorzettingsvermogen, enthousiasme en drive om projecten succesvol te leiden en verbeteringen door te voeren om te komen tot nog efficiëntere en klantgerichte projecten. Daarbij ben je in staat om de klantverwachtingen helder te analyseren, te managen en actief bij te sturen waar nodig; · Je beheerst de Nederlandse en Engelse taal uitstekend in woord en geschrift; · Jouw persoonlijkheid kenmerkt zich door: gestructureerd, motiverend, communicatief sterk, duidelijk, open, tikje eigenwijs, enthousiast, relativerend, creatief en pragmatisch; · Je haalt energie uit het opstellen en bewaken van planningen, analyseren van gegevens en opstellen van duidelijke, gestructureerde rapportages en presentaties; · Je hebt minimaal een afgeronde bachelor, bij voorkeur richting bedrijfskunde, bedrijfseconomie en/of informatica. Wat bieden wij jou? Naast de genoemde leuke functie binnen een groeiend en innovatief bedrijf bieden wij: · Salaris : We bieden je een salaris tussen € 5.590 en € 7.958 per maand (o.b.v. 40 uur per week), afhankelijk van je ervaring en kennis; · Middelen : Leaseauto, laptop, telefoon; · Werkdagen : Je bent minimaal 4 dagen per week beschikbaar, al heeft 5 dagen onze voorkeur; · Vergoeding voor thuiswerken : Je kunt gedeeltelijk thuiswerken en krijgt een onkostenvergoeding van € 2,40 per thuiswerkdag. Ook krijg je een budget van € 750,- om thuis een ergonomische werkplek in te richten; · Workation : Je kunt tot 30 dagen aaneengesloten per jaar vanuit het buitenland werken; · Leuke teamactiviteiten : Leer je collega’s beter kennen door deel te nemen aan maandelijkse evenementen georganiseerd door ons energieke Fun-team, zoals een pubquiz, Zomer BBQ, wine & beer tastings en movie night; · Vakantiedagen : Je krijgt 25 vakantiedagen en de mogelijkheid om maximaal 20 extra dagen bij te kopen; · Groei en ontwikkelin g: De mogelijkheid om je vaardigheden en verantwoordelijkheden te ontwikkelen binnen de functie, middels opleidingen en Linkedin learning, of door te stromen naar een van de andere functies binnen CCS; · Vakantiegeld : Jaarlijks 8,33%; · Voordelen : Je krijgt een aantrekkelijke pensioenregeling met een lage eigen bijdrage en kunt gebruikmaken van collectieve verzekeringen met korting. Ook is er een bedrijfsfitnessregeling voor een gezonde levensstijl en een fietsregeling voor duurzaam vervoer. Waarom CCS? Omdat wij geloven dat werk meer is dan een baan. Het is een plek waar je jezelf kunt zijn, impact kunt maken en kunt groeien. Het is een omgeving waar je wordt geïnspireerd om het beste uit jezelf te halen en samen te werken aan een duurzame toekomst. title: HR Operations Specialist, Tokyo (12-months contract)
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. Act as a trusted liaison between employees and People/Payroll teams, resolving issues efficiently with empathy and accuracy.</li> <li><strong>Elevate the employee experience through cross-functional collaboration:</strong> Act as a proactive liaison between employees and specialized teams such as Payroll, Benefits, and Legal to address and resolve complex issues efficiently and effectively.</li> <li><strong>Ensure data integrity and governance: </strong>Maintain and update employee records across People/Payroll systems, performing regular and ad hoc audits to guarantee 100% data accuracy and compliance with regulatory requirements.</li> <li><strong>Drive continuous improvement and operational excellence:</strong> Analyze employee feedback and process metrics to identify opportunities for process enhancements. Partner with regional teams to implement scalable solutions that improve the overall People Operations function across APJC.</li> <li><strong>Support strategic HR initiatives and projects:</strong> Contribute to HR system implementations, vendor management, and regional programs such as annual performance and compensation cycles, benefits enrollment, and year-end Payroll preparation, making them easy to understand and navigate for our employees.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Skills/experience</strong> </p> <ul> <li>2+ years in HR administration and comfortable handling sensitive employee information with discretion.</li> <li>Highly organized with strong attention to detail, excellent problem-solving abilities, and effective time management skills. </li> <li>Proficient in working with data and skilled in Excel or Google Sheets for analysis and reporting.</li> <li>Customer-focused mindset with a genuine passion for supporting colleagues and delivering exceptional service.</li> <li>Effective communicator, able to clearly articulate information both verbally and in writing to employees across the APJC region.</li> <li>Adaptable and thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, with the ability to manage shifting priorities efficiently.</li> <li>Familiarity with Workday or Zendesk would be an advantage.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>

description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>Our Purpose<strong><br></strong></h3> <p>At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. As AI reshapes how organizations build, operate, and innovate, the responsibility to protect them becomes more critical than ever. When you join SentinelOne, your work helps protect global enterprises, critical infrastructure, and the technologies shaping tomorrow. If you are motivated by meaningful challenges and want your impact to be real, measurable, and global, you will find purpose here.</p> <h3>About Us<strong><br></strong></h3> <p>SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters.</p> <p>Our teams are builders, problem-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity.</p> <h3><strong>What Are We Looking For?</strong></h3> <p>We’re looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes.</p></div><p><span data-sheets-root="1">As a Windows Low Level Engineer - Endpoint security, you will design and develop advanced security features for SentinelOne’s Windows endpoint protection platform, operating across both user-mode and kernel-mode environments. You will build and optimize mission-critical components including anti-tampering protections, network sensors, and agent infrastructure while solving complex performance and stability challenges at massive scale. By researching Windows internals and debugging deep system issues, you will collaborate with distributed engineering teams to deliver high-impact security capabilities protecting millions of devices worldwide.</span></p> <p>We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Software Engineer with a strong background in low-level C++ programming and a deep understanding of Windows OS, to help us in developing our <strong>Endpoint Protection product</strong>, the core part of our business, and to join one of our Platform group teams. (<strong>We're currently growing multiple teams</strong> and are open to new colleagues with a wide variety of backgrounds within Windows development!).</p> <p>The <strong>Platform group</strong> teams are in charge of some of our most complex low-level areas, such as:</p> <ul> <li>Windows agent’s Anti-Tampering (self-protection from malware attempting to harm the agent), network sensors, device control, and other kernel-side features involving both research and development,</li> <li>usermode security & agent infrastructures - e.g. installers, logging, services such as communication layer & interfaces for our Windows agent, for improving the quality, performance & stability of the agent and making the user experience smoother.</li> </ul> <p><span data-sheets-root="1">By joining our group, you will collaborate with talented engineers who are leading a feature through the whole development lifecycle. In order to successfully deal with this challenge, you will continuously enrich your knowledge and experience with Windows OS internals & Kernel, Endpoint Protection, and Endpoint Detection & Response eco-system.</li> <li>Our teams design and execute significant new features, as well as rewrite and reimplement the existing ones from scratch. You will also deal with extraordinary performance & optimization challenges, given the scale of our cybersecurity SW (handling hundreds of billions of events every day).</li> <li>Your work will influence the security of tens of millions of Windows devices, that we protect at enterprise & government customers across the globe (incl. 4 of Fortune 10 and hundreds of Global 2000).</li> <li>You’ll also be encouraged to share knowledge within both Platform teams and the broader Windows group.</li> <li><strong>Working setup:</strong> Flexible working hours, this is a 100% remote role on full-time permanent employment based within France. We provide optional membership in major coworking chains. Currently for this role in France we are able to consider only candidates that are already eligible to work in the EU at the time of applying. Optionally for those willing to relocate to the Czech Republic relocation assistance is available for any candidates that are already eligible to work in the EU at the time of applying.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What skills & knowledge should you bring?</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Multiple years of experience as a software engineer in the area of lowlevel programming using modern C++ (or using C and a willingness to learn modern C++)</li> <li>Hands-on experience and in-depth understanding of Windows OS design & internals, Windows low-level development, with debugging of Windows applications and familiarity with related standard debugging and profiling tools</li> <li>Previous experience working on a production-grade product with a wide-scale deployment</li> <li>Great communication skills and the ability to work both independently and with peers from different time zones, problem-solving and out-of-the-box thinking</li> <li>Attention to detail and high coding standards</li> <li>An advantage: experience with Windows Kernel and Windows Drivers development, experience in security-oriented development, with reversing or malware analysis</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Why SentinelOne?</strong></h3> <p>AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. If you want to build where innovation and impact move together, this is that place.</p> <p>We invest in our Sentinels with comprehensive, competitive benefits designed to support you and your family:</p> <p><strong>Equity & Rewards</strong></p> <ul> <li>Restricted Stock Units (RSUs)</li> <li>Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)</li> </ul> <p><strong>Time Off & Wellbeing</strong></p> <ul> <li>Competitive leave benefits</li> <li>Gender-neutral parental leave</li> </ul> <p><strong>Insurance & Financial Security</strong></p> <ul> <li>Medical and insurance benefits</li> <li>Disability insurance</li> <li>Employee Assistance Program (EAP)</li> </ul> <p><strong>Work Perks & Flexibility</strong></p> <ul> <li>Global home office allowance</li> <li>Mobile phone reimbursement</li> <li>Work-from-home allowance</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><span style="font-weight: 400;">SentinelOne is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">SentinelOne participates in the E-Verify Program for all U.S. based roles. </span></p> <p data-pm-slice="1 1 []">To learn more about how we use AI in our hiring process, please review our <a href="https://assets.contentstack.io/v3/assets/blt53c99b43892c2378/bltca86b3b84e902400/AI-in-Hiring-SentinelOne.pdf">AI in Hiring Candidate Disclosure</a>.</p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Software Engineer, Simulation (Digital Twins)
description: Our Mission At Laelaps AI, we believe robotics is entering a transformative decade, much like the arrival of the internet. title: Research Scientist, Foundation Model (World Model & Site Memory)
description: Our Mission At Laelaps AI, we believe robotics is entering a transformative decade, much like the arrival of the internet. Advances in AI, cloud computing, and hardware are reshaping what autonomous systems can do. Our mission is to build the intelligent software that powers physical security in the real world - enabling robots and sensors to handle dangerous and critical tasks that humans shouldn't have to. We're a strong founding team based in Zurich, backed by visionary investors and advisors. We are engineering the future of security today! The Role You will own the research question at the centre of LEA, our foundation model of the physical world: can a model learn what normally happens on a site, by place, hour and weather, so that an anomaly is simply what it did not expect? The first version is a probabilistic memory of each site. The next is a world model across every site that predicts the next state in latent space, starting from open world-model weights and growing on field data nobody else holds. Our robots and cameras run on live security sites around the clock, and every event is kept with its clip, the model's verdict and the operator's outcome. That record is your dataset. You will work alongside our perception and model engineers, and your results go into production, not only into papers. What You'll Work On Site memory: a learned, probabilistic model of each site: which people, vehicles and robots are where, at what hour, in what weather, and how the scene usually unfolds. Anomaly as surprise: replace rule-based alerting with measured surprise, and work out how to evaluate it when real incidents are rare. World model: post-train open world-model weights on aligned multi-sensor field sequences, JEPA-style, predicting in latent space rather than pixels. Transfer: from one site's memory to a model of all of them, and representations that carry across sites and domains. Research direction: choose the questions, design the experiments, and decide what is true before it ships. title: Quantitative Researcher - 2027 Graduates
description: <p>At Graviton, we don't believe the best trading strategies come from following established playbooks. They come from asking better questions. Why does a pattern exist? What is driving it? Is it real or just noise? Can it be explained, modelled and turned into an edge?</p> <p>As a Quantitative Researcher, you'll work on those questions every day. You'll investigate market behaviour, develop quantitative models, build and test hypotheses and turn insights into trading strategies, working alongside researchers and technologists in an environment where an idea on a whiteboard can reach live trading quickly.</p> <p>This isn't a role where the answers are in a textbook. The problems are open-ended, the data is enormous, and finding the answers is the job.</p> <p>Ideal candidates are rigorous thinkers who genuinely enjoy mathematics, programming and figuring out things that aren't obvious, based in our Singapore, London, Amsterdam or US offices.</p> <h2>What You'll Work On</h2> <p>You'll work across quantitative research and systematic trading, taking ideas through the full lifecycle: question, hypothesis, experiment, model, validation, strategy, production. Depending on your team and research interests, your work would include:</p> <ul> <li>Discovering predictive patterns and sources of alpha from billions of market events</li> <li>Formulating hypotheses about market behaviour and designing experiments to test them</li> <li>Applying probability, statistics, optimization and machine learning to build predictive models and quantitative signals for systematic trading</li> <li>Designing robust backtests and statistical tests to distinguish genuine signals from noise</li> <li>Working with large and complex datasets to uncover patterns that aren't immediately visible</li> <li>Investigating market microstructure and how markets behave at different timescales</li> <li>Evaluating strategy performance, identifying weaknesses and continuously refining models</li> <li>Developing research infrastructure and AI-powered tools and agents that make experimentation faster and analysis deeper</li> <li>Working closely with technologists to translate research ideas into efficient, production-ready systems</li> <li>Exploring new techniques in machine learning, statistics and quantitative finance to uncover new sources of edge</li> </ul> <p>No two research problems are the same. Good research finds patterns. Great research understands why they exist.</p> <h2>What Success Looks Like</h2> <p>Successful researchers at Graviton discover new sources of alpha and turn them into robust trading strategies, build models that hold up under real market conditions and not only in backtests, develop a deep understanding of market behaviour, create research frameworks and tools that make the broader team more effective, work with technologists to take ideas from research into production, and communicate complex quantitative ideas clearly and rigorously. Your impact isn't measured by how many models you build. title: Infrastructure Software Engineer
description: Join our mission We're proud to work with many incredible companies, accelerating their ability to build their products. We've spent years watching talented engineering teams lose momentum to the same frustrating bottleneck: waiting. Waiting for CI to finish. Waiting for builds to complete. Waiting for tests to run. After experiencing this pain firsthand at companies of every size, we set out to build the developer infrastructure platform we'd always wanted to use. Something that would seamlessly integrate with our workflows and the tools teams already love—but make everything dramatically faster and more cost-effective. Today, we're already accelerating hundreds of companies around the world, helping them ship features instead of waiting for infrastructure. We've built something that feels almost magical in its simplicity: change your runs-on line, mount your toolchain cache directory and suddenly your builds are 5x faster. About the role Namespace's approach is low-friction, designed for immediate integration into existing developer toolchains, empowering teams to experience tangible results within just five minutes. With an end-to-end stack optimized for high performance—including compute, memory, storage, and networking—Namespace delivers capabilities and efficiencies unmatched by traditional cloud providers. Own the software that drives our hardware. You'll write the control planes, automation, and observability that keep our global fleet fast, efficient, and reliable, while charting a path to scale that continues to increase the number of "machines under management" per engineer. Our culture We're looking for people with grit—people who push through ambiguity, take ownership, and keep going when things get hard. You're deeply curious, driven to understand how things work and how they can be improved. Most importantly, you have a strong bias to execution: you don't wait for perfect conditions, you ship, learn, and iterate quickly. If you care about building, moving fast, and making real impact, you'll fit right in. What you'll do Manage and automate the fleet – build services for provisioning, health checks, upgrades, and incident remediation Uphold reliability – embed observability, graceful degradation, and rollback paths into every layer you touch Architect the network – design and evolve a high-throughput, low-latency fabric tailored to our high performance use-cases Ship software, not scripts – develop clean, testable code (mostly Go) that treats our fleet like a first-class API Drive efficiency – improve utilization and power-to-performance ratios so capacity grows slower than usage Partner across the stack – work with product, infra, and platform teams to scope and deliver features like storage-aware scheduling, cache volumes, and other developer-facing features What we're looking for Proven experience engineering large-scale infrastructure - writing the software that runs fleets, not just operating existing hyperscalers Depth in network architecture, data-center design, and performance tuning Hands-on time deploying and managing compute hardware at scale (servers, switches, etc) Fluency with modern orchestration and automation tooling (Kubernetes, Terraform, Ansible - plus the judgment to know when to build vs. buy) A track record of delivering reliable systems and measurable efficiency gains You can expect: Competitive salary and stock options Flexible working hours Market-leading parental leave Life at Namespace Labs: We pride ourselves in being a small team of experts that can achieve a lot. We balance our long-term vision with short-term pragmatism. We believe in being fully transparent internally on how decisions are made, on how the company is doing, and we use that information to drive our decisions. description: Gravis Robotics is a high-growth Series A start-up backed by SoftBank, bringing Physical AI to the construction industry, turning heavy construction machines into autonomous robots. Gravis began as an ETH Zurich spin-out, and our unique combination of learning-based automation and augmented remote control lets one operator safely conduct a fleet of earthmoving machines in a gamified environment. Backed by deep robotics research and now deployed across multiple countries with leading construction and equipment partners, our team is rapidly growing to bring this technology to a trillion-dollar industry. The Gravis RACK is a machine-agnostic retrofit kit that adds autonomy to excavators and wheel loaders from 10 to 100+ tonnes: LiDAR and camera sensing, GNSS RTK, networking hardware and rugged edge compute that works offline. Paired with the Slate tablet and our Copilot software, it lets an operator run a machine manually, with AI assistance, or fully autonomously. About the Job The autonomy team at Gravis builds autonomous systems for excavators operating in real construction environments. You will build control modules that run on many different machines , across many sites, with different soil conditions. We’re looking for a roboticist with data driven planning and/or control background, deep python expertise and good level of C++ proficiency. To be successful in this role you should have experience working with real robots, tackling the challenges of sim2real transfer, and deploying robotic systems in a production environment. What you will do Learning-Based Planning and Control for Real Systems Develop data driven planning and control systems for autonomous excavation that generalize across machine models and soil conditions Contribute to simulation improvements that reduce or address the sim2real gap Define data collection and curation pipelines for incorporating real data in policy training Design experiments focused on continuous performance and robustness improvements. Explore the usage of adaptive and online reinforcement learning in deployed systems Provide mentorship and supervision for junior team members, interns, and students. System Integration Integrate learned components into a larger software stack Collaborate with excavation and motion planning engineers Build tools for analysing and evaluating the behavior of learned components What we’re looking for We recognize that excellent candidates come from diverse backgrounds with various combinations of skills. If you meet most of the core qualifications below, we highly encourage you to apply. Core qualifications 2–5 years industry experience developing Reinforcement learning systems for control and/or planning and deploying them on real robots with a customer. If you only have experience with simulation, you’re most likely not a good fit for this position. Experience with GPU accelerated simulation environments (e.g. IsaacSim/IsaacLab, CARLA, MuJoCo) Strong Python skills and experience with PyTorch or similar libraries Proficiency in C++ Comfortable debugging real-world system behavior Ability and willingness to travel as required by business projects. Great-to-Have Skills & Experience Experience with hydraulic machinery Experience with supervised learning or imitation learning Research experience in reinforcement learning Experience deploying robotic systems at scale (e.g. hundreds of units) Familiarity with ROS or similar robotics frameworks Experience with feature-flagged deployments, staged rollouts, or long-lived platforms Experience with data curation for ML applications Experience guiding, mentoring, or leading junior colleagues, students, or project teams. Familiarity with or interest in utilizing AI coding tools. This Role is a Great Fit If You are passionate about building systems that work reliably in the real world You want to help build a long-lived excavation planning and control system intended to scale and positively impact the entire construction industry. You are comfortable working with the realities of imperfect data and noisy measurements. You have a keen interest in bridging the sim2real gap and understanding the differences between simulation and physical environments. You are excited to help drive technical direction in a growing team transitioning from prototyping to the product stage. You value a collaborative team culture rooted in thoughtful design, creative thinking, mutual respect, and pragmatism. Don't meet every requirement? If you're enthusiastic about this role but your experience doesn't match every qualification, we still encourage you to apply. You might be the perfect candidate for this or other positions. This is an opportunity to join a dynamic and versatile team, and to be part of a young startup that will revolutionize heavy construction. Gravis Robotics offers a fair market salary and a working location in the vibrant city of Zurich. As a forward-facing startup, we understand that work-life balance and flexibility are important considerations for many professionals: If you are a highly qualified candidate with the requisite skills and experience, we encourage you to apply and discuss your preferred working arrangement during the interview process. <p> </p> </div> <p style="text-align: justify;"><strong data-renderer-mark="true">What we are looking for:</strong></p> <p style="text-align: justify;"> </p> <ul> <li>Minimum of 5 years of B2B SaaS or outbound prospecting, partner engagement, and marketing collaboration (Required)</li> <li>Familiarity with a structured sales qualification methodology (e.g., MEDDPICC, MEDDIC, SPIN) and ability to title: Senior Paid Marketing Strategist

title: Chief Operating Officer COO
description: At Vio , we believe booking accommodation should feel fair and effortless, never overwhelming or unclear. As one of the world’s fastest-growing travel tech platforms, we help millions of users make smarter travel decisions by comparing stays across 100+ booking sites so that they can find the best place, at the best price, anywhere in the world. Our goal is to help travelers book like an insider. That means cutting through the noise and complexity of hotel booking and surfacing real value with clarity, transparency, and full support. No tricks. No confusion. Just great stays, booked with confidence. With operations in 100+ markets and growing fast, our mission is to reshape how people discover and book accommodation through technology that travelers can trust. Who we’re looking for We are looking for an experienced Chief Operating Officer (COO) to join our Leadership Team and help us scale our booking operations, drive efficiency and deliver a best-in-class experience for our travelers. Reporting to Oz , Our CEO, and joining Vio's Leadership Team, you'll be hired into the full organisation with a clear first focus: our booking (OTA) business. You'll lead Customer Support, OTA Finance, Payments and Legal, and work closely with our Product and Tech leads to optimise how we scale, simultaneously reducing our transactional and operational costs. What you will do: Scale our booking operations from ~4k bookings per day towards 20k–40k by 2028 Reduce our transactional and operational costs through continuous improvement, automation and smarter processes Raise the quality of our user experience to match the best in the industry Make sure our business operates smoothly across multiple jurisdictions Support the scaling of our booking operations while limiting our risk exposure Lead and develop your team: our Heads of Customer Support, OTA Finance and Payments and our Legal Counsel Who you are: A senior operations leader with experience scaling – not just operating at scale – ideally in a leadership position at a 500+ FTE organisation Highly structured and analytically strong; data-fluent and comfortable making complex decisions in ambiguous situations A proven track record of driving efficiency through continuous improvement, ideally in an online travel marketplace or accommodation distribution organisation A pragmatic, flexible problem solver who fits operations to business needs rather than following frameworks or 'what we've done before' Someone who simplifies for others, builds strong relationships and can hold critical lines Experienced working in founder-led organisations and stepping into new, previously unowned areas Travel industry experience is a big plus (especially flights / packages); B2C experience preferred, B2B welcome Experience collaborating with enterprise partners is a real plus Why join us now? We’re one of the fastest-growing accommodation booking platforms in the world today, having grown our bookings 30x between 2017 and 2025, and catering to the needs of millions of travelers each year. We do that by harnessing the power of advanced algorithms and an innovative suite of product features. In 2026, we underwent a company-wide rebrand and launched our first StoryTelling marketing campaign in the UK. This was the next step in our commitment to help travelers book like insiders, and to establish Vio as a consumer-facing, creative brand. The mobile applications ( iOS and Android ) we launched in 2023 have been a big success, reaching 5 million installs and earning strong customer reviews. We’re a passionate and diverse team of tech enthusiasts and creatives, with a commitment to the traveler above all else. We reward our employees for the value they create by granting Stock Appreciation Rights to all employees. What we offer: Plenty of chances to learn and grow within an open, diverse culture that promotes knowledge sharing, trust, and transparency. A great compensation package, perks, and benefits – including significant stock appreciation rights. Flexible time off, with as many holidays as you need, and a chance to work remotely. You’ll be part of an international team in one of the best office locations in Amsterdam We value good food and offer catered lunches from various cuisines, great coffee, and the occasional barbecue in our garden. We enjoy getting together to celebrate our wins, with company events in Amsterdam and abroad. A budget for your home office Access to free mental health support via OpenUp We encourage people from all ethnic groups, genders, sexualities, ages, and abilities to apply. title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer | Trading Infrastructure | Python/Linux
description: BlockTech is hiring a Senior Site Reliability Engineer to join its Tech department in Amsterdam. Crypto markets never close, and neither does our trading. Bare-metal hosts, cloud instances, exchange connectivity, messaging, and the trading services on top all have to work around the clock. In this role, you'll sit between infrastructure, engineering, and trading, and follow every problem wherever it leads. About BlockTech BlockTech is an algorithmic trading firm headquartered in Amsterdam, with a second office in Singapore. We specialize in market making and trade cryptocurrency derivatives and spot markets globally, using our own capital. We're growing fast and expanding into new markets. We trade options and delta one around the clock on the largest crypto venues. Our platform runs on a Linux bare-metal fleet alongside cloud deployments in the regions where exchanges run, with services written in Python and Rust. What will you do? You will make sure everything works, and works properly. Most problems don't stay inside one team's boundaries: a strange fill might come from a network issue, a config change, or an exchange that changed its behavior without telling anyone. You understand what each service does for trading, what it costs when it breaks, and which fix matters most right now. You own an issue from the first alert to the long-term fix that stops it coming back. You will: Own the live environment. Monitor trading across all our venues, take charge of incidents, and own both the immediate fix and the long-term one. Bridge infrastructure, engineering, and trading. Translate a trader's “something looks off” into a root cause, and a root cause into a priority the right team can act on. Partner with the desk. Work closely with traders and quants, so reliability work is driven by what actually matters for PnL and risk. Debug across the full stack. Linux and network performance, exchange connectivity, messaging and databases (Kafka, NATS, Redis, PostgreSQL/TimescaleDB, ClickHouse), and the Python and Rust trading services themselves. Own our hybrid infrastructure. Run the bare-metal fleet and cloud deployments, plus their configuration management and deployment pipelines across environments. Build observability. Use Prometheus/VictoriaMetrics, Grafana, Sentry, and Kibana to catch a problem before the trading desk does. Change things safely. Plan and run maintenance, upgrades, and releases without trading going dark. Raise the bar. Cut toil with automation, and spread SRE practices across Tech so every team builds reliable systems from the start. What we're looking for You'll need: 5+ years running production systems where uptime and correctness matter, in an SRE, DevOps, systems, or software engineering role. At least 2 years of that in a trading environment (a trading firm, exchange, or broker), working directly with live trading systems and traders. A working understanding of how trading systems operate: order and quote flow, positions and PnL, exchange connectivity, and why latency and correctness matter. A commercial mindset. You can weigh technical trade-offs against business impact and explain them clearly to traders and engineers alike. Strong Linux skills, including troubleshooting performance at the OS and kernel level. Solid networking fundamentals: TCP/IP, UDP, and multicast, plus comfort reading a packet capture. Hands-on experience running production workloads in a public cloud (AWS or similar): networking (VPCs, peering, cross-region latency), compute choices, and infrastructure as code (Terraform or similar). Proficiency in Python, and the ability to read and debug code you didn't write, including our Rust services. Hands-on experience with configuration management (Ansible or similar) and CI/CD. Experience operating at least some of our stack: Kafka, NATS, PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, Redis, Prometheus, or Grafana. Calm, structured incident handling, and clear communication in English under pressure. Bonus points for: Experience with options or crypto markets. Exchange connectivity experience (WebSocket or FIX APIs). Low-latency or market-making environments. Hands-on Rust experience. Much of our platform is written in it. Network hardware (Arista, Cisco), routing protocols, or packet capture tooling. Server hardware and kernel tuning for low latency. Running data-heavy systems such as time-series databases. Pay, location, and relocation Compensation: a competitive base salary plus a performance bonus based on individual and company results. Trading fund: outstanding performance is rewarded with the opportunity to buy into the trading fund. Location: On-site at our Amsterdam office Visa: BlockTech sponsors the Dutch highly skilled migrant visa. Relocation: All-in relocation package and Dutch classes for international hires. Eligible hires may qualify for the 30% ruling. Have an idea today, and it can ship tomorrow. The best idea wins, whoever it comes from. This role comes with a high degree of autonomy. You'll own hard problems from the first alert to the long-term fix and solve them your way. We promote reverse leadership, give everyone an equal playing field, and invest in personal and professional development. Ready to keep a 24/7 trading firm running? Make your move and apply! You can expect to hear back from us within 5 working days. Our culture At our core, we are a team of passionate trading and tech enthusiasts committed to revolutionizing trading through automation. Our collaborative approach ensures that everyone contributes to achieving our ambitious goals. In this role, you will be both challenged and stretched, with ample opportunities for growth and development, both within and beyond your main responsibilities. We invest in our people by offering competitive compensation and benefits, fostering innovation, and celebrating success.
