title: Infrastructure & Cybersecurity Project Manager (f/m/d)
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span data-teams="true">PHENOGY AG is a leading innovator of battery energy storage technologies and solutions for the green electrification of the planet. Our team members work on future-proof and sustainable battery systems that are powerful, safe, and robust – with circularity as a central principle. Our technology partner network spans leading battery research institutes. PHENOGY is an environmentally and socially conscious enterprise. We are committed to fostering prosperity for the people and our planet, ensuring sustainable growth – starting in the area of our greatest expertise and impact: energy storage solutions.</span></p> <p><span style="color: rgb(26, 0, 120);"><strong>We energize the future.</strong></span></p> <div class="content-intro"> <p><span style="color: rgb(26, 0, 120);">PHENOGY is seeking curious, entrepreneurial-minded energy pioneers to help shape our vision, systems, and growth; playing a key-role as we launch into our ambitious future. If you’re inspired by our mission, values, and drive to change how we energize the future — we’d love your application.</span></p> </div></div><p>Purpose/Mission - The role owns the infrastructure, network and cybersecurity workstream for</p> <ul> <li>PHENOGY's corporate IT infrastructure (cloud, network, endpoints, identities and access) and its interfaces with the Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) product environment. It translates business, product, operational, customer and regulatory requirements into secure, resilient and auditable infrastructure and security controls across the BESS lifecycle.</li> <li>Cybersecurity governance and the Information Security Management System (ISO/IEC 27001)</li> <li>Security architecture of BESS connectivity (EMS, BMS, gateways, IoT, APIs) and secure data exchange with partners such as Heidelberg</li> <li>Backup, business continuity and disaster recovery for critical systems (BESS/EMS, ERP, CRM)</li> <li>Project management of infrastructure and cybersecurity projects</li> </ul> <p>Your Tasks & Responsibilities</p> <ul> <li>Act as internal-facing and technical owner of the IT infrastructure and security landscape: network, firewalling and web filtering, Microsoft 365/Azure tenants, identity and access management, endpoints, backup, and secure remote/supplier access to BESS sites.</li> <li>Maintain the asset and configuration inventory, network and security architecture documentation, risk register, vulnerability backlog, security policies and the infrastructure/security roadmap.</li> <li>Run the risk management and vulnerability management cycle: periodic assessments, prioritisation, patching and remediation tracking across IT systems, applications, APIs and BESS connectivity.</li> <li>Define and operate security monitoring, incident response, escalation paths, maintenance windows and problem management, together with external service providers (MSP/MSSP).</li> <li>Define backup and retention policies (daily, monthly, yearly; 10+ years for critical data), offline/immutable backups, disaster-recovery runbooks and regular restore and DR tests.</li> <li>Define secure segmentation between corporate IT and the OT/BESS environment and secure remote access for O&M and field service, aligned with IEC 62443 concepts.</li> <li>Provide infrastructure, system-integration and cybersecurity support to the After Sales & Service framework once operational responsibility moves to the Service Manager.</li> <li>Support B2B customer and audit requests: security questionnaires, tender requirements and compliance evidence.</li> <li>Hands on when required: configure firewall rules, endpoint and identity policies, backup jobs and cloud security settings.</li> </ul> <p>Key Projects (2027 portfolio)</p> <ul> <li>Risk Management & Vulnerability Assessment (Jan–Feb 2027): assess risks and vulnerabilities across all systems and deliver a prioritised remediation plan.</li> <li>BESS Security Architecture II (Jan–Mar 2027): secure the BESS architecture and data exchange with Heidelberg, building on the current BESS security baseline.</li> <li>Business Continuity & Recovery System (Feb–Apr 2027): offline backup and disaster recovery for critical systems such as BESS/EMS, ERP and CRM.</li> <li>Network Improvements (Feb–Jun 2027): introduce firewalling and web filtering, which are not yet in place.</li> <li>Advanced Threat Protection – ISO 27001 (Mar–May 2027): protect network and application traffic, including APIs and IP-based access.</li> <li>ISO 27001 Enhancements (ongoing): close control gaps, maintain policies and evidence, and prepare for audits.</li> <li>Take over operation of granular backup and advanced endpoint management, and provide security input to the PHENOGY IoT solution POC (BMS/EMS communication and REST APIs).</li> </ul> <p>Core Competencies</p> <ul> <li>Lead assigned infrastructure and cybersecurity projects from initiation through closure, using structured scope, schedule, budget, dependency, risk, issue, decision and change control.</li> <li>Create project charters, work breakdown structures, delivery plans, security requirements, test and DR-test plans, cutover plans, acceptance records and handover packages to operations.</li> <li>Coordinate external suppliers (MSP/MSSP, network and firewall vendors, cloud providers, BESS/EMS partners) to resolve cross-functional blockers and escalate material decisions to the Head of IT and relevant governance bodies.</li> <li>Provide concise status reporting on progress, milestones, risk posture, vulnerabilities, incidents, suppliers and compliance.</li> </ul> <p>Required Qualifications & Experience</p> <ul> <li>Degree or equivalent professional experience in information technology, computer science, information security, engineering or a related discipline.</li> <li>Demonstrated experience in IT infrastructure and cybersecurity management, including responsibility for delivering projects, ideally in an international mid-sized company.</li> <li>Practical experience with network security (firewalls, VPN, segmentation, web filtering, IDS/IPS), Microsoft 365 / Entra ID / Intune / Defender, and backup and disaster recovery.</li> <li>Experience running risk assessments, vulnerability management and security incident response.</li> <li>Hands-on experience implementing or maintaining an ISMS according to ISO/IEC 27001.</li> <li>Experience coordinating technical suppliers and multidisciplinary stakeholders across business, IT and engineering.</li> <li>Ability to understand operational technology and industrial-system boundaries without assuming ownership of safety engineering or embedded-control design.</li> <li>Strong documentation, risk management and executive-status reporting skills.</li> <li>Professional English; German or another relevant operating language is an advantage.</li> </ul> <p>Strongly preferred</p> <ul> <li>Experience securing Battery Energy Storage Systems, EMS, BMS, SCADA, PLC, PCS/inverters, industrial gateways, IoT or energy-data platforms.</li> <li>Working knowledge of IEC 62443, NIS2 and the EU Cyber Resilience Act in mixed IT/OT environments.</li> <li>Experience with Azure networking and security, Microsoft Sentinel / Defender XDR and enterprise firewall platforms (e.g. Fortinet, Palo Alto, Check Point).</li> <li>Familiarity with industrial protocols and secure integration patterns, including Modbus TCP, OPC UA, MQTT, REST APIs, API gateways and certificate/PKI management.</li> <li>Experience with backup and DR solutions for cloud and hybrid environments, including immutable and offline backups.</li> <li>Recognized credentials such as CISSP, CISM, ISO 27001 Lead Implementer/Auditor, GICSP, PMP, PRINCE2 or ITIL are advantageous</li> </ul> <p>Decision-making authority: Approves infrastructure and security changes, firewall and access rules and security exceptions within the agreed policy framework and budget; may isolate systems or accounts during a security incident; escalates risk acceptance and major investments to the Head of IT.</p> <p>Reporting Line: Reporting to Head of IT Direct reports: none (functional lead of external infrastructure and security providers)</p> <p>Workload: 100% - Hybrid</p> <p>Travel: approx. 10% – PHENOGY offices, BESS customer sites and partner/supplier sites as required</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><span style="color: rgb(26, 0, 120);"><strong>We offer you:</strong></span></p> <ul> <li style="color: rgb(26, 0, 120);"><span style="color: rgb(26, 0, 120);">Join a high-caliber environment that enables you to develop your full potential, shape your job, and take ownership.</span></li> <li style="color: rgb(26, 0, 120);"><span style="color: rgb(26, 0, 120);">Participate in the development of PHENOGY and inspire the world to transition to sustainable energy.</span></li> <li style="color: rgb(26, 0, 120);"><span style="color: rgb(26, 0, 120);">Become part of our eco-passionate expert team - a first-class team all around. </span></li> <li style="color: rgb(26, 0, 120);"><span style="color: rgb(26, 0, 120);">Benefit from flexible work hours as well as remote and on-site working in a modern sustainable office</span></li> <li style="color: rgb(26, 0, 120);"><span style="color: rgb(26, 0, 120);">Enjoy various events, an amazing coffee machine, and the occasional coffee from our CEO (acting Barista)</span></li> </ul> <p><span style="color: rgb(26, 0, 120);">At PHENOGY, we highly value diversity, equality, and inclusion. It makes our company stronger. <strong>Our philosophy: one mindset, many minds.</strong></span></p> <p> </p> <h6><span style="color: rgb(26, 0, 120);"><span data-olk-copy-source="MessageBody">For recruitment and staffing agencies: PHENOGY works exclusively with selected recruitment partners under formal agreements. </span></span><span style="color: rgb(26, 0, 120);"><span data-olk-copy-source="MessageBody">We do not accept unsolicited candidate submissions from agencies and assume no liability for claims made by unauthorized recruiters regarding our recruitment processes.</span></span></h6></div> Find Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

title: Technical Marketing Engineer
description: The role Neural Concept is looking for a Technical Marketing Engineer to turn emerging engineering technologies into compelling demonstrations, technical content and joint partner stories. You will explore how Neural Concept can work with technologies from partners, primarily NVIDIA, and prototype new engineering workflows. You will then translate that work into strong demos, videos and articles that make our technical depth tangible to the market. Your content work will also extend beyond partner initiatives. You will stay close to our Research, Frontier, Vertical Solutions and Product teams to understand what they are building, identify stories worth taking to market and produce technical content independently. You will turn the work into a technically credible article explaining the method, findings and implications. This role sits within Marketing and works closely with Product Marketing, Partner Marketing, Research, Product, Engineering and our Vertical Solutions teams. Your mission Make Neural Concept’s technical capabilities visible and understandable. You will combine hands-on engineering work with strong market judgement. You will start with the audience and the story we want to tell, then build the right prototype or content to prove it. The goal is to create credible and visually strong demonstrations of what becomes possible when Neural Concept connects with emerging AI and engineering technologies. These are marketing prototypes, not production-ready integrations. They must communicate the concept clearly and remain technically accurate. What you will do Drive technical co-builds with partners Explore partner technologies and identify where they can create new engineering workflows with Neural Concept. Lead technical co-build initiatives, with an initial focus on the NVIDIA ecosystem, including technologies such as PhysicsNeMo, Warp, Omniverse and agentic frameworks. Build prototypes that combine Neural Concept capabilities with partner products and infrastructure. Work directly with partner technical and marketing teams to shape joint stories. Turn technical exploration into demos, videos, event content and other co-marketing assets. Identify new opportunities for joint content, launches and market visibility. Produce technical marketing content Write technically grounded articles, explainers and demo narratives. Create and present demos for partners, events, campaigns and executive conversations. Develop demo scripts and work with design or video specialists to produce polished assets. Repackage internal prototypes and engineering work into content that external audiences can understand and remember. Help Product and Partner Marketing communicate technical mechanisms precisely, without unnecessary complexity. Build for the audience Define the audience, message and desired outcome before starting technical work. Make deliberate choices about what needs to work end to end and what can remain a prototype. Prioritise a clear story, strong visual execution and market relevance. Simplify the experience without oversimplifying the technology. Validate technical claims with the relevant internal experts before publication. What we are looking for A strong engineering background The ability to build technical prototypes independently. Experience with Python and AI or engineering software is strongly preferred. Knowledge of one or more relevant areas: machine learning, physics AI, simulation, CAD/CAE, geometry processing, engineering software or agentic systems. Evidence that you can explain technical subjects through writing, demos or video. A marketing-first mindset. You think about the audience and the intended reaction, not only the technical implementation. Strong visual and product judgement. You care about how a demo looks and how clearly it communicates value. Comfort working with external technology partners and coordinating across technical and marketing teams. The ability to move quickly through ambiguity and build enough to prove a concept. Excellent written and spoken English. This role may suit you if You are an engineer who has repeatedly moved towards storytelling, demos, content or developer marketing. You enjoy experimenting with new technologies and immediately think about how to show their value. You want to influence how a deep-tech company presents its capabilities to the market. You prefer building a convincing prototype and narrative over maintaining production systems. You can challenge a technically impressive idea when it does not serve the audience or the message. This role is probably not for you if Your primary interest is delivering reliable customer implementations or maintaining production integrations. You optimise technical work without considering how an external audience will understand it. You see writing, storytelling and visual presentation as tasks to hand over after the engineering work is complete. You are uncomfortable making pragmatic trade-offs when building exploratory prototypes. How the role complements Product Marketing Our Product and Technology Marketing function owns the broader product narrative, positioning and business value. The Technical Marketing Engineer brings deeper hands-on engineering capacity. The two roles work together: Product Marketing defines the story and market context; the Technical Marketing Engineer explores the technology, builds the proof and contributes the technical content. What success looks like Within the first year, you will have: Established a repeatable technical co-build motion with NVIDIA and other priority partners. Produced partner demonstrations that create concrete content, event and relationship opportunities. Built a steady flow of high-quality technical articles, demos and videos. Made complex Neural Concept capabilities easier to understand without weakening their technical substance. Become the bridge between Marketing, Engineering and partner technical teams. We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and we're committed to building a diverse and inclusive environment where you can thrive. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Territory Account Executive, Bengaluru
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p class="p2"><strong>Please note: This role will require you to be based in Bengaluru.<br><br></strong></p> <div>About the Department Account Executives, Channel Account Managers, Business Development Representatives, Solution Engineers, Customer Success, and Sales Operations - all working together help our customers adopt Cloudflare and create great Internet-enabled experiences. The sales team at Cloudflare helps customers solve real, technical problems while creating the revenue streams that help the company provide free service to millions in our community.</div> <div> </div> <div>Based in Bengaluru, you will drive sales into commercial and enterprise accounts across Karnataka and South India for Cloudflare’s solutions. Your strategic selling activities will include "hunter" type activities to proactively penetrate target named accounts, detailed account planning, focused relationship building and leading effective sales campaigns to successful closure of high-value, multi-product architectural transformations.</div> <div>The ideal candidate will possess both a major account sales background in technology solutions, primarily software and cloud-based, that enables them to drive engagement with senior level decision makers (CISOs, CTOs, VPs of Engineering) within Cloudflare’s target customers. Industry experience selling into Digital Natives, IT/ITES, SaaS scale-ups, and other Enterprise verticals is desired in this role. You must be capable of orchestrating complex six-figure ($100K+) expansions encompassing Zero Trust/SASE, Developer Platforms (Workers/R2), and Application Security.</div> <div> </div> <div>As an Account Executive, you'll be responsible for developing and executing against a Sales strategy/plan for assigned vertical or accounts, as well as driving large account sales into India markets to achieve revenue targets. Therefore, you must have a strong network of contacts with decision makers in enterprise accounts across the region, and have experience selling complex solutions to these accounts. YYou will have an intuitive understanding and experience with the key business and technical needs of these large accounts and will create and deliver compelling value propositions to them for Cloudflare solutions, specifically targeting competitive displacements</div> <div> </div> <div>Additional responsibilities will include</div> <ul> <li> <div>Manage complex contract negotiations for high-AOV, multi-product enterprise deals</div> </li> <li> <div>Maintain a robust sales pipeline through proactive outbound targeting and whitespace mining within your installed base</div> </li> <li> <div>Develop long-term strategic relationships with key accounts to convert variable usage into committed enterprise contracts</div> </li> <li> <div>Collaborate closely with the regional partner ecosystem (e.g., Tech Data, Softcell) to accelerate deal velocity</div> </li> <li> <div>< 50% travel</div> </li> </ul> <div>Examples of desirable skills, knowledge and experience</div> <ul> <li> <div>Bachelor's degree required</div> </li> <li> <div>Fluent in English</div> </li> <li> <div>Relevant direct experience, track record, and relationships within corporate enterprise accounts in the India market (specifically Karnataka and South India)</div> </li> <li> <div>Minimum 10 years of direct B2B selling experience, preferably managing internet, cloud, and security accounts</div> </li> <li> <div>Direct experience selling network security, Zero Trust/SASE (Cloudflare One), and/or CDN / Application Security solutions preferred</div> </li> <li> <div>Proven track record of executing competitive takeout campaigns against legacy hardware and cloud point solutions</div> </li> <li> <div>Prior experience being part of an early sales team helping drive traction in India market for a US-based SaaS company highly preferred</div> </li> <li> <div>Experience managing longer, complex sales cycles and cross-functional evaluations</div> </li> <li> <div>Basic understanding of computer networking, cloud architectures, and “how the internet works”</div> </li> <li> <div>Aptitude for learning technical concepts/terms (Technical background in engineering, computer science, or MIS a plus)</div> </li> <li> <div>Strong interpersonal communication (verbal and written) and organisational skills</div> </li> <li> <div>Self-motivated; entrepreneurial spirit</div> </li> <li> <div>Comfortable working in a fast paced dynamic environment</div> </li> </ul> <p class="p2"> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>

title: Candidate Experience Specialist, Team Lead (APJ)
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2>An overview of this role</h2> <p>As the Candidate Experience Team Lead for [Region], you'll own how candidates experience GitLab across your region by raising the capability of the specialists around you. You'll set the quality bar, balance workloads, onboard and develop specialists, and serve as the first escalation point when a process breaks down or a candidate situation needs judgment. You'll stay hands-on with interview coordination, background checks, and offers, while spending most of your time making the regional function run well. You'll use candidate experience data to surface patterns and risks to the Director, Talent Acquisition and Enablement, and partner with leads in other regions to maintain one global process. At GitLab, our mission is simple: to enable everyone to contribute to and co-create the software that powers our world.</p> <h2>What you’ll do</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Lead Candidate Experience Specialists in [Region], setting and modeling standards for interview coordination, candidate communication, contract and offer accuracy, and data hygiene in the applicant tracking system.</li> <li value="2">Balance coordination work across the regional team, monitor capacity against hiring volume, and flag resourcing gaps to the Director, Talent Acquisition and Enablement before they affect candidates.</li> <li value="3">Resolve escalated scheduling conflicts, candidate issues, and process gaps, bringing clear recommendations to leadership when further support is needed.</li> <li value="4">Own onboarding, ramp, and ongoing development for new specialists through documentation, shadowing, and direct feedback on work quality.</li> <li value="5">Coordinate interviews, prepare offers and employment contracts, manage background and reference checks, and partner with People Operations on the handoff to onboarding.</li> <li value="6">Build and maintain reporting on candidate satisfaction, specialist response times, scheduling turnaround, and data accuracy to identify patterns, bottlenecks, and risks.</li> <li value="7">Partner with leads in other regions to maintain one global coordination process, contribute regional evidence to process and tooling improvements, implement agreed changes, and keep documentation accurate in the applicant tracking system and GitLab repositories.</li> <li value="8">Collaborate with recruiters, hiring managers, Talent Acquisition leadership, Information Technology, and People Operations across time zones to keep hiring moving, modeling GitLab's values, culture, and all-remote approach in every interaction.</li> </ul> <h2>What you’ll bring</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Substantial experience in candidate experience or recruiting coordination, covering interview scheduling, offer and contract preparation, background checks, and onboarding handoffs, including serving as a senior or go-to team member.</li> <li value="2">Ability to lead and develop team members without formal authority through mentoring, onboarding, direct feedback, and influence.</li> <li value="3">Attention to detail in scheduling, contracts, and candidate data, with a record of professionalism, responsiveness, sound judgment under pressure, and maintaining confidentiality.</li> <li value="4">Experience anticipating risks, resolving scheduling and process problems early, prioritizing competing demands, and setting clear expectations about timelines, next steps, and trade-offs.</li> <li value="5">Experience building and maintaining candidate experience or scheduling reports, using data to identify bottlenecks and make a case for change.</li> <li value="6">Experience working across regions or functions to standardize processes, with the judgment to distinguish genuine regional requirements from inconsistent practices.</li> <li value="7">Clear written and verbal communication with candidates and stakeholders at all levels, including executives, and the ability to build collaborative relationships across functions and time zones.</li> <li value="8">Proficiency with an applicant tracking system or interview tool for scheduling, tracking, and stage management, plus Google Workspace and scheduling tools, and a willingness to learn additional tools. Greenhouse and ModernLoop experience is beneficial but not required.</li> </ul> <h2>About the team</h2> <p>Our Candidate Experience team supports candidates through interview coordination, offers and contracts, background and reference checks, and the transition to onboarding. As regional leads and specialists, we partner with recruiters, hiring managers, Talent Acquisition leadership, Information Technology, and People Operations to deliver a consistent global candidate experience. We work across time zones, using transparent documentation in the applicant tracking system and GitLab repositories to collaborate asynchronously. Our regional leads work together to resolve process differences and bring regional evidence into global improvements.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off </a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a> </li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/company/culture/inclusion/#examples-of-select-underrepresented-groups">underrepresented groups</a> are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.</p> <hr> <p><strong>Country Hiring Guidelines: </strong>GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.  </p> <p><strong>Privacy Policy: </strong>Please review our <a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/candidate-faq/recruitment-privacy-policy/" target="_blank">Recruitment Privacy Policy.</a> Your privacy is important to us.</p> <p>GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. See also <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/people-policies/inc-usa/#equal-employment-opportunity-policy" target="_blank">GitLab’s EEO Policy</a> and <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/labor-and-employment-notices/#eeoc-us-equal-employment-opportunity-commission-notices" target="_blank">EEO is the Law</a>. If you have a disability or special need that requires <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/people-policies/inc-usa/#reasonable-accommodation" target="_blank">accommodation</a>, please let us know during the <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/interviewing/#adjustments-to-our-interview-process" target="_blank">recruiting process</a>.</p></div>

title: Director, Global Operations Excellence
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Why Sony Interactive Entertainment?</strong></p> <p>Sony Interactive Entertainment isn’t just the Best Place to Play — it’s also the Best Place to Work. title: Stage Consumentengedrag
description: Waarom pak je in de supermarkt het ene product wel uit het schap en het andere niet? Ligt het aan de verpakking? De prijs? Smaak? Gemak? Of simpelweg omdat het precies op de juiste plek staat? Bij Growy telen we verse sla, kruiden en microgreens in Amsterdam in onze vertical farm. Vertical farming klinkt misschien ingewikkeld, maar het idee is simpel: we telen planten in lagen boven elkaar, midden in de stad en helemaal los van het weer buiten. Nu onze producten in steeds meer Nederlandse supermarkten te vinden zijn, willen we onze consumenten nóg beter leren begrijpen. Daarom zoeken we een nieuwsgierige en commercieel ingestelde stagiair die zich wil verdiepen in consumentengedrag en inzichten kan vertalen naar echte commerciële kansen. En nee, dit wordt geen stageproject wat ergens in een lade verdwijnt en niemand ooit nog bekijkt, jouw stage gaat voor ons echt een verschil maken! 🌱 Wat ga je doen? Hoe zorgen we ervoor dat meer consumenten Growy ontdekken, proberen én opnieuw kopen? Tijdens je stage ga je bijvoorbeeld: consumenten interviewen en/of focusgroepen organiseren; onderzoeken wat mensen belangrijk vinden bij het kopen van verse salades en kruiden; ontdekken welke drempels consumenten ervan weerhouden een product te proberen; onderzoeken wat juist zorgt voor een herhaalaankoop; kijken naar kansen rondom prijs, assortiment, verpakking, positionering, promoties en zichtbaarheid; kwantitatief onderzoek, zoals enquêtes, opzetten om ideeën te testen; jouw inzichten vertalen naar concrete commerciële en marketingaanbevelingen. Aan het einde van je stage presenteer je jouw belangrijkste inzichten en aanbevelingen aan ons Sales & Marketing team. En als het binnen je stage past, kun je misschien zelfs één van je ideeën in de praktijk testen. De precieze inhoud stemmen we af op de duur van je stage en de eisen vanuit jouw opleiding. Goed om te weten; onze farm is nog volop in ontwikkeling, we zitten nog in onze start-up/scale-up fase. Dit betekent dat je naast je onderzoek ook tijd zult besteden aan andere zaken in onze farm. Dit geldt niet alleen voor jou als stagiair maar voor ons hele team. Zo draait iedereen uit kantoor maandelijks een shift in de farm, waarbij we helpen met zaaien, oogsten of verpakken. 🌱 Wat kun je van ons verwachten? Een unieke stageplek; wij bouwen aan de toekomst van voedselproductie; Je wordt onderdeel van een klein team, er wordt naar je ideëen en input geluisterd; We werken fulltime vanaf onze farm in Amsterdam; Een maandelijkse stagevergoeding van 500 euro, we vergoeden geen andere zaken; Veel ruimte en tijd voor creativiteit en een ‘ga het maar proberen!' mentaliteit Een gezellige werksfeer waarin we graag samen na werk nog leuke dingen ondernemen 🌱 Wat breng jij? Je volgt een HBO of WO opleiding in Nederland en staat daar ingeschreven gedurende de hele stage periode. Qua studies denken wij in de richting marketing, bedrijfskunde of (commerciële) psychologie, maar wie weet volg jij een andere studie die ook goed aansluit 🙂 Fulltime beschikbaar voor 4 of 5 maanden, startdatum december 2026 of januari of februari 2027 Je hebt je rijbewijs B; je zult veel op pad zijn om supermarkten te bezoeken Een flinke portie nieuwsgierigheid Je bent sociaal; je stapt makkelijk op mensen af en maakt een praatje met ze Je spreekt vloeiend Nederlands en kunt je ook goed redden in het Engels Je bent een zelf-starter; we zullen je uiteraard begeleiden tijdens je stage, maar het initiatief voor de invulling en aanpak ligt bij jou Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Product Manager Insurance P&C
description: Insify is looking for a smart, ambitious and relentlessly driven Insurance Product Manager to join our team. In this role you’ll be a driving force behind our product expansions and building the digital platform for SME insurance. A rare opportunity to take real ownership in a fast-scaling European insurtech and shape outcomes that matter. At Insify, we build insurance for entrepreneurs because we are entrepreneurs ourselves. We know what it’s like to build something from scratch, to take risks, and to carry responsibility that doesn’t switch off at 5 pm. Our mission is simple but ambitious: to make business insurance 10x simpler, faster, and fairer for entrepreneurs and SMEs across Europe . No paperwork. No fine print. No legacy complexity. Just modern software, smart automation, and a relentless focus on the customer. We are a high-growth European scale-up , backed by €43M from world-class investors , on a mission to become a global leader in digital insurance for entrepreneurs and SMEs. Starting in the Netherlands, we’ve expanded into France and Germany, and we’re only accelerating from here. At our core, we’re a tech company . We build our own insurtech platform and rely heavily on data, automation, and AI to redesign the end-to-end insurance experience: from underwriting to claims. Combined with a fully digital customer portal and strong UX, we’re turning insurance into something surprisingly simple, transparent, and fair. We’re led by seasoned entrepreneurs who’ve built and scaled companies before, and we bring that same ambition, urgency, and ownership mindset to everything we do. What you'll be doing: Insify is looking for an entrepreneurial and analytical Product Manager to drive the growth and evolution of our Property & Casualty (P&C) portfolio . This role focuses on the essential "bread and butter" products for SMEs: including General Liability, Professional Indemnity, and Property insurance. Unlike traditional PM roles, you won't just be managing features; you will be the "CEO" of your products. You will bridge the gap between complex insurance logic and a seamless digital user experience. You use your deep understanding of our customers and data native approach to translate technical policy wordings and insurance products into automated underwriting flows and digital-first customer journeys taking away the complexity for our customers. This is a perfect role for someone with a background in business operations, consulting, or insurance who wants to move into a high-growth tech environment and take tangible ownership of a product's performance. What you’ll be up to (some examples): Drive Product Strategy: Manage the roadmap for your products, ensuring they remain competitive, compliant, and easy to purchase online. Optimize the Funnel: Use data to identify friction points in the application process and work with Design and Tech to improve conversion rates. Scale New Markets: Support the launch of our digital proposition into new European markets, adapting local requirements into our scalable core platform. Stakeholder Management: Coordinate between Insurance, Tech, Marketing, and Customer Ops to ensure a unified product vision and smooth execution. Monitor Performance: Track loss ratios, retention, and customer feedback to iterate on the product and pricing strategy. This role is a strong fit if you are a "doer" who loves to solve puzzles. You can dive deep into the fine print of an insurance policy one hour and brainstorm a new UI flow with a developer the next. Specifically, you bring: 2–4 years of experience in a high-growth startup or strategy consulting (Insurance, Fintech, or E-commerce preferred). Analytical Rigor: You are comfortable with Excel/data tools and use metrics to back up your decisions. Product Curiosity: You don't need to be a coder, but you should be excited about how APIs, automated underwriting, and LLMs can transform insurance. Bias for Action: You prefer "shipping and iterating" over "analyzing and waiting." Communication: Excellent English skills (Dutch, German, or French is a major plus given our European footprint). Educational Background: A degree in Business, Economics, Engineering, or a related field. Who this is not for: You prioritize a 40-hour work week : We operate in a high-intensity 'startup-plus' environment. This isn't a standard 9-to-5; driving global impact here requires a level of dedication and 'always-on' spirit that goes well beyond the typical 40-hour work week. You prefer your comfort zone : We operate at the edge of our capabilities; if you aren't comfortable with constant change and being challenged, you won’t thrive here. You prefer to stay high-level : While this is a strategic role, no task is too small. If you aren't willing to roll up your sleeves and get into the "weeds" of execution, this isn't the right fit. A steep learning curve feels daunting : We move fast and use cutting-edge AI; you need to be an aggressive self-learner who can master new domains in days, not months. What we offer: Competitive compensation - we want to attract and retain the best so we are offering a compensation package that aligns with that. In-office - come join us in our HQ in the center of Amsterdam. Grow in a growing company - there’s no better place to develop your talents and learn new skills. Help us show the world that insurance can be simple, transparent and trustworthy. Experienced entrepreneurs - work with experienced and dedicated entrepreneurs as part of an international team. Energetic environment - as a start-up, we’re different from your usual insurers. We scale rapidly and you can pick your own initiatives, helping us grow as we help more and more customers across Europe. Our culture (read this carefully) We’re not just building a company, we’re building a category leader . That comes with ambition, responsibility, and pace. Our culture is defined by three things: High ownership People own problems end-to-end. If something is unclear or broken, we don’t wait - we step in and fix it. High pace Priorities shift, and decisions are made quickly. We value momentum and learning over perfection. High standards Outcomes matter more than optics. We care about results, quality, and follow-through. At the same time, you won’t be doing this alone . We believe great work happens through close collaboration . We work in-person, challenge each other’s ideas, and expect contributions from everywhere, regardless of title or tenure. The best ideas often come from unexpected places, and we create space for them to surface. This is a human-sized company . You’ll know the people you work with, you’ll be able to walk over to anyone to ask a question or test an idea, and you’ll be part of the day-to-day energy of building together: from whiteboard discussions to shared lunches, dogs in the office, and moments to pause and reset. We hire smart, ambitious people who think like owners, value intellectual honesty, and are motivated by impact rather than comfort. If you enjoy challenge, responsibility, and building something meaningful with others, you’ll likely thrive here. If you’re looking for predictability, narrow scopes, or a guaranteed 9-to-5, this likely won’t be the right fit - and that’s okay. We’d rather be honest upfront. description: About Insify We are a start-up offering an end-to-end digital insurance platform focussing solely on European entrepreneurs and SMEs. At Insify, our Insurance crew is all about making sure the right coverages are available, affordable, and actually make sense for today’s entrepreneurs. We’re the bridge between customer needs and carrier capabilities—constantly exploring, negotiating, and building better insurance solutions. From partnering with top carriers to developing our own products, we ensure our platform delivers complete, seamless coverage. Whether it’s a roofer in Rotterdam or a freelance designer in Berlin, we’re here to make sure no one’s left out. Our team includes insurance pros, actuaries, and product ops experts working hand-in-hand with product, legal, and compliance to reshape insurance from the inside out. About the Role This is your chance to work in a dynamic company where innovation and precision go hand in hand to disrupt the insurance industry. You'll be part of our Insurance team, as lead to ensure the scalability and sustainability of our portfolio optimizing both the bottom and top lines. What you will be doing Pricing and Underwriting: Develop and refine pricing models, ensuring accurate underwriting and profitability while optimizing for growth. Dig for and leverage internal and external data to develop predictive models that enhance pricing strategies and improve portfolio performance. Evaluate and propose new ideas and collaborate with the team to develop and push in production innovative solutions (pricing elasticity and optimisation, behaviour and fraud scoring, exposure-based dynamic pricing…), Work with internal stakeholders to integrate actuarial insights into product, tech, regulatory compliance, and overall company strategy. Follow market trends to recommend adjustments to pricing and products. Lead relationships with risk carriers to drive impactful results. Be part, with the pricing team, of the development of our End-to-end, fully automated, pricing and analytics platform leveraging on data and innovative in-house proprietary solutions to scale in a sustainable and efficient way and always stay ahead of competition. What you'll need Actuarial diploma (or equivalent). 2–3+ years of experience in pricing and underwriting within Property & Casualty insurance or Life Insurance. Strong data analytics skills and a passion for leveraging data to drive innovation. A global mindset with exposure to developed insurance markets (e.g., UK, Germany, France) with a desire to disrupt a slow-moving industry. Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities with a desire to build new things. Strong interpersonal skills—smooth communication and collaboration are key! Fluent in English Bonus points if you: Have experience with both risk and commercial price modeling. +2 points if you also have experience with survival models. Master in Python and/or R and/or SQL What we offer Competitive compensation - we want to attract and retain the best so we are offering a compensation package that aligns with that. Pension plan - participation to Insify’s Pension Plan, with 6% employer contribution. Travel reimbursement - we help travelers with their commute. Quickly develop your career - there’s no better place to develop. We are growing and you can grow with us! description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. title: Innovation Internship
description: About the role At SkyNRG, we’re on a mission leading the change in the energy transition by producing and supplying high‑integrity Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF). Our Innovation team plays a key role in this mission by scouting, assessing and developing technologies that can scale SAF production and strengthen the industry’s sustainability performance. As an Intern within the Innovation team, you will perform research focused on the sustainability performance of innovative technology routes to SAF. During this internship, you will build a framework for Life Cycle Analysis of various SAF production routes and evaluate the GHG reduction potential and fit with European Policy frameworks for selected routes. You will work closely with a technically skilled and experienced Innovation team and report directly to our Senior Analyst, Dusita de Hoop. This internship offers the opportunity to apply academic knowledge in a real‑world context, collaborate with industry experts, and contribute to innovation at the forefront of sustainable aviation. Your Responsibilities: Life Cycle Assessment: Build a framework to assess life cycle performance of various innovative SAF production routes. GHG reduction calculation : Calculate the GHG reduction potential of selected SAF production routes Policy Fit : asses the fit of selected SAF production routes with European SAF policy such as REFUELEU Aviation. Team collaboration: Work closely with external partners, contributing findings, insights and ideas to ongoing research and development activities. Your profile You recognize yourself in the following: Master’s student with a background in science or engineering (enrolled for the full duration of the internship) Strong interest in renewable fuels, energy transition or sustainable technologies Experience or academic exposure with Life Cycle Analysis and GHG reduction calculations is a must. Able to work independently, strong analytical skillset and a structured approach to complex technical questions Comfortable working with Excel, Word and PowerPoint Fluent in English, both written and spoken Full-time availability for a 6-month internship starting 15th of February 2027 About SkyNRG Since 2009, SkyNRG has been a change maker in the aviation industry. We are dedicated to supplying and producing high-integrity Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF), making sustainable aviation a reality. Collaboration is fundamental to achieving our ambition. We nurture genuine relationships with global partners in our drive to make SAF the alternative to fossil jet fuel. Our in-house team of SAF experts have helped over 60 airlines and corporates reduce their climate impact using the Book & Claim mechanism; the most transparent and traceable way to support aviation sustainability with real emission reductions. Sustainability is woven into the fabric of our company. We maintain an independent Sustainability Board, which advises the company on feedstocks and provides strategic guidance on wide-ranging sustainability issues. SkyNRG operations are certified against the RSB EU RED, CORSIA, and Book & Claim standards. At SkyNRG, you’ll find: An innovation-driven culture – where big ideas turn into real impact Growth opportunities – in a fast-scaling, industry-changing company A collaborative team – where your ideas and expertise are valued A mission that matters – leading the change in the energy transition by producing and supplying high-integrity SAF What we offer We offer a brand-new office in the heart of Amsterdam, designed for collaboration and creativity. Most importantly, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute to a truly game-changing green initiative, making a real impact on the aviation industry and the planet. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? You will build your own pipeline through outbound prospecting, community engagement, and ecosystem presence, convert developer-led adoption into commercial new logo wins, and position Cloudflare as the infrastructure partner of choice for the next generation of technology companies. </p> <p>Above all, we are looking for true team players. We win together, not as lone wolves with sharp elbows. You share what works, ask for help when you need it, and celebrate your colleagues' wins as much as your own. You see your BDR, Solutions Engineers and specialists as real partners, not as support functions, and you bring the same care to working with your colleagues as you do to working with your customers. If you believe the best results come from people who make each other better, you'll feel right at home on our team. </p> <p>Critically, you will use AI tools as an active and integral part of how you sell. Many of your buyers build AI products themselves and speaking their language is the key to being successful. In line with Cloudflare's AI-native culture, you are expected to leverage AI tools daily as a genuine force multiplier across your prospecting, pipeline, and preparation and not as an occasional aid.</p> <h2><span style="color: rgb(230, 126, 35);"><strong>Responsibilities</strong></span></h2> <hr> <ul> <li>Account strategy: For each key account, work out where the customer could be with Cloudflare in 6 to 18 months, and build a plan with them to get there. Look for the bigger infrastructure changes we can support, such as consolidating vendors or moving workloads to our network, rather than the next single product sale.</li> <li>New customers: Win new digital native customers, both from your named list of high-potential accounts and from companies that don't work with Cloudflare yet. Bring new logos onto the platform every quarter and hit or beat your targets.</li> <li>Pipeline generation: Own your pipeline. Build it through direct outreach, VC and accelerator networks, partners, and the startup and developer communities across DACH. Spot buying signals early and get to the right people quickly.</li> <li>Account growth: Grow existing customers by finding new teams, use cases and products where Cloudflare can help. Make sure new customers get off to a strong start, so they're set up to grow with us.</li> <li>Product-led growth: Find accounts where developers or teams already use Cloudflare on their own, and turn that usage into a commercial relationship before a competitor does.</li> <li>Technical buyers: Build trusted relationships with CTOs, VPs of Engineering, platform leads and technical founders. Talk confidently about infrastructure, APIs, cloud architecture and security. Explain what Cloudflare changes for their business in a way that makes sense to engineers and to the people who sign the budget.</li> <li>AI infrastructure: Position AI Gateway, Workers AI, Vectorize and our security products for AI workloads with companies building AI products. Understand the problems they face, such as securing AI APIs and keeping inference costs under control as they scale.</li> <li>Teamwork: Work closely with your BDR, Customer Engineers and product specialists. Plan accounts together, bring them into customer conversations at the right moment and keep everyone up to date on where each deal stands. Work with Sales Ops and Deal Desk to keep deals moving.</li> <li>Full-cycle sales: Run the whole sales process across deals of different sizes and lengths. Qualify carefully, involve the right people and close with confidence, whether a deal takes two weeks or six months.</li> <li>Pipeline and forecasting: Keep your pipeline accurate and up to date, and give sales leadership forecasts they can rely on.</li> <li>AI in your daily work: Use AI tools every day for account research, personalised outreach, meeting prep, pipeline management and follow-ups. In the interview, we'll ask you how AI helps you get better results.</li> <li>Market insight: Share what you learn in the field with the wider team, such as how digital native companies build, buy and scale. This helps Cloudflare keep pace with a fast-moving market.</li> </ul> <h2><span style="color: rgb(230, 126, 35);"><strong>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</strong></span></h2> <p><strong>Sales experience</strong></p> <ul> <li>3 to 5 years in B2B technology sales with a quota, for example in SaaS, cloud, security or developer tools</li> <li>Met or beat your annual quota in at least two of the last three years</li> <li>Closed deals worth six-seven figures a year, with sales cycles of several months</li> <li>Won new customers through your own outbound work, and grown existing accounts with additional products or usage</li> <li>Sold usage-based contracts and kept growing them after signature by selling developer-centric use cases. Working directly with engineering teams to bring new applications, workloads and products onto the platform, so spend grows from real adoption.</li> <li>Built multi-year account plans together with customers</li> <li>Sold to CTOs, VPs of Engineering or technical founders, ideally at digital native companies, startups or scale-ups</li> <li>Worked with a structured sales method such as MEDDPICC</li> </ul> <p><strong>Technical knowledge</strong></p> <ul> <li>You can explain the basics of how the internet works: DNS, CDN, TLS, HTTP and APIs</li> <li>You understand common threats such as DDoS attacks, bots and API abuse, and how companies protect themselves</li> <li>You know the basics of modern cloud setups, such as public cloud, Kubernetes and serverless</li> <li>You have solid public cloud know-how. You understand how companies use AWS, GCP, Azure, including Kubernetes and serverless. title: Software Engineer, Mobile SDK
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: </strong>Austin, TX</p> <h4><strong>What you'll do</strong></h4> <p>We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our WARP Mobile SDK team to help build the future of our mobile security SDKs.</p> <h4><strong>Responsibilities</strong></h4> <p>In this role, you will define the client architecture and public APIs for native iOS and Android SDKs, working from deep expertise in at least one of those ecosystems. You will establish foundations that are testable, well-documented, lightweight, and straightforward for customer engineering teams to integrate and operate.</p> <p>As a senior software engineer, you will set standards for compatibility, diagnostics, performance, and release quality across mobile platforms. You will work closely with product and engineering partners to turn a security problem into a dependable developer product, mentor native mobile engineers, and help resolve complex customer integration issues. You will be successful in this role if you combine strong native engineering judgment and a track record of carrying distributed software from design through production operation.</p> enough familiarity with the other ecosystem to guide shared architectural decisions</li> <li>Experience designing or <strong>owning customer-distributed SDKs</strong>, libraries, or similarly constrained developer-facing products</li> <li>Experience with <strong>mobile platform security concepts</strong>, including app and device integrity, secure key storage, application signing, authentication, and secure communications</li> <li>Familiarity with native <strong>mobile networking stacks</strong>, HTTP APIs, and the integration challenges introduced by different application architectures and networking libraries</li> <li>Experience <strong>diagnosing production issues</strong> that cross application, SDK, network, and service boundaries, while designing safe diagnostics that do not expose sensitive data</li> <li>Understanding of mobile package distribution, source and binary compatibility, dependency management, and reliable release practices</li> <li>Experience <strong>writing technical designs and aligning decisions</strong> across product, client, backend, edge, and security teams</li> <li>Experience <strong>mentoring engineers</strong> and raising a team's technical bar through design review, code review, and knowledge sharing</li> <li>Empathetic, proactive, and constructive <strong>written and verbal communication skills</strong></li> <li>Proven ability to operate within strict mobile performance budgets, including binary size, battery use, startup time, and main-thread overhead</li> </ul> <h4>Bonus Points:</h4> <ul> <li>Familiarity with how native SDKs are consumed by cross-platform frameworks such as <strong>React Native and Flutter</strong> is a plus</li> <li>Familiarity with lower-level languages like <strong>C++ or Rust for high-performance</strong>, cross-platform security modules is a plus</li> </ul> <p><strong>Compensation</strong></p> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <p><strong>Equity</strong></p> <p>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.</p> <p><strong>Benefits</strong></p> <p>Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family.  Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun!  The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.</p> <p><strong>Health & Welfare Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li>Medical/Rx Insurance</li> <li>Dental Insurance</li> <li>Vision Insurance</li> <li>Flexible Spending Accounts</li> <li>Commuter Spending Accounts</li> <li>Fertility & Family Forming Benefits</li> <li>On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program</li> <li>Global Travel Medical Insurance</li> </ul> <p><strong>Financial Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li>Short and Long Term Disability Insurance</li> <li>Life & Accident Insurance</li> <li>401(k) Retirement Savings Plan</li> <li>Employee Stock Participation Plan</li> </ul> <p><strong>Time Off</strong></p> <ul> <li>Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave</li> <li>Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. title: Principal Software Engineer (f/m/d)
description: <p><strong>The role</strong></p> <p>Reporting directly to the VP Technology, you'll build new capability for Awin with AI at the core, free from the constraints of our established delivery model. You'll take ideas from concept to production quickly, prove what works, and turn the best of it into patterns the wider engineering organisation can adopt.</p> <p>You'll work closely with product and commercial leaders to find where AI changes the economics of our affiliate marketing platform: what we can build, how fast, and at what cost. You'll be hands-on most of the time, writing code, shipping and measuring results, rather than coordinating others.</p> <p>You'll know enough of our existing platform to connect new things to it safely, but you won't be absorbed into running it. Your job is to show what modern, AI-native engineering looks like at Awin, and make it real.</p> <p><strong>This is a step-up opportunity.</strong> We're looking for a bright, self-starting engineer who is ready for more scope than their current role allows. You might not have held a principal title yet. What matters is that you're already building this way, you learn fast, and you want the room to prove it. You'll have direct access to senior leadership, real problems with commercial weight, and the freedom to choose how you solve them.</p> <p><strong>Key tasks and accountabilities</strong></p> <p><strong>Build and ship</strong></p> <ul> <li>Design, build and run AI-powered products, tools and services from prototype to production</li> <li>Own outcomes end to end: problem framing, architecture, implementation, evaluation, release and operation</li> <li>Run fast, time-boxed experiments; scale what works and stop what doesn't, with the evidence to back either call</li> <li>Set up and evolve the AI infrastructure these builds rely on: model access, evaluation tooling, observability and guardrails</li> </ul> <p><strong>Shape direction</strong></p> <ul> <li>Work with the VP Technology to set Awin's engineering-specific AI direction, grounded in what has actually been built and measured</li> <li>Scope strategic opportunities early with product and commercial leaders, with effort, cost and value made explicit</li> <li>Make clear recommendations on build vs buy, model and vendor choice, and where AI should not be used</li> </ul> <p><strong>Architecture and design</strong></p> <ul> <li>Design new capability so it connects safely to the existing platform: APIs, events, data and identity</li> <li>Select tools and technologies, and define the patterns and practices for AI-native development at Awin</li> <li>Weigh long-term maintainability, economic viability and reuse against speed, and document the trade-offs</li> </ul> <p><strong>Spread what works</strong></p> <ul> <li>Turn proven builds into reusable patterns, templates and internal tools, and share them so other teams can adopt them without hand-holding</li> </ul> <p><strong>Ways of working</strong></p> <ul> <li>Works autonomously, guided by the VP Technology's priorities rather than team-level delivery processes</li> <li>Engages directly with engineering, product, data, security and commercial stakeholders as each build requires</li> </ul> <p><strong>Skills & Expertise</strong></p> <p><strong>AI-native engineering</strong></p> <ul> <li>Builds with coding agents (e.g. Claude Code, Cursor, Codex) as the default way of working. tool use and function calling, structured outputs, retrieval (RAG) and multi-step agent workflows</li> <li>Builds evaluations first: test sets, automated evals and regression checks for non-deterministic behaviour, with quality measured before and after release</li> <li>Connects models to enterprise systems and data safely, e.g. MCP servers, internal APIs and event streams, with clear permissions and audit trails</li> <li>Understands model selection, token economics, latency, caching and fallback strategies, and can explain cost and benefit trade-offs to commercial stakeholders</li> <li>Designs for AI-specific security and privacy risks: prompt injection, data leakage, PII handling under GDPR, and guardrails on what models can do</li> </ul> <p><strong>Engineering foundations</strong></p> <ul> <li>Expert in at least one modern language (Python or TypeScript ideal), and able to work in our existing Java, PHP and JavaScript estate when integrating</li> <li>Strong cloud-native and serverless architecture on AWS, with infrastructure as code (Terraform)</li> <li>Experience with event-driven and distributed systems (Kafka/MSK, SQS/SNS) and with relational and non-relational data stores</li> <li>Builds observability into everything: tracing, logging and monitoring, including LLM-specific telemetry</li> <li>Treats automated testing, CI/CD and secure-by-default design as standard, and automates as much of the delivery loop as possible</li> </ul> <p><strong>Ways of building</strong></p> <ul> <li>Takes an idea to a working prototype in days, then hardens it for production, and knows when to stop</li> <li>Leaves behind reusable patterns, templates and internal tools, not one-off solutions</li> </ul> <p><strong>Soft skills</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Bias to action:</strong> ships, measures and iterates rather than waiting for perfect requirements</li> <li><strong>Comfortable with ambiguity:</strong> frames value</li> <li><strong>Intellectually honest:</strong> kills their own ideas when the evidence says so, and says plainly where AI is not the answer</li> <li><strong>Clear communicator:</strong> Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: Austin, TX</strong></p> <ul> <li>Work onsite in the office 5 days a week (Monday–Friday)</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About the Role</strong></h2> <p>The <strong>Places Team</strong> at Cloudflare is seeking a skilled, operationally rigorous <strong>Workplace Operations Manager</strong> to lead daily onsite workplace operations for our Austin hub. You will partner with regional leadership, cross-functional partners (IT, Physical Security, People Operations, Legal, and Executive Briefing Centers), and local service partners to maintain a highly functional workplace for our distributed team. Balancing local site ownership with regional alignment, you bring practical expertise in facilities coordination, vendor oversight, and day-to-day budget tracking, combined with a hospitality mindset that reflects Cloudflare’s values and culture.</p> <h2><strong>Responsibilities</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Lead Onsite Hub Operations & Space Readiness:</strong> Oversee day-to-day workplace operations across the Austin hub—directing front-of-house services, shipping and receiving, routine building maintenance, and space readiness to ensure a welcoming, functional, and organized environment.</li> <li><strong>Vendor Coordination & Service Quality:</strong> Oversee local vendor performance and daily service delivery across janitorial, culinary/catering, and maintenance partners.
