title: Internship DACH - Social Media & Marketing at International Baby- and Kids Brand (Jan / Feb 27)
description: Petite Amélie is a fast-growing and youthful brand, cherished by young parents and influencers across Europe. We design and produce beautiful children's furniture, accessories, and toys. Our webshops are available in the Netherlands, Belgium, France, Germany, and the UK, and we have three concept stores in these countries. Our office, where approximately 30 people work, is conveniently located next to the Weesp train station, just 15 minutes from Amsterdam. We are excited to offer several internship opportunities within our international Marketing & E-commerce team. This team manages our webshops and marketing channels, including Google, Facebook, TikTok, and Instagram. Content management is a crucial component of our marketing strategy, and as a brand with our own products, we have the ability to create stunning content. You can be a part of this exciting journey! Tasks We will involve you in many things. As social media intern, your main tasks can be: Create content (visuals, video and copy) for Instagram, Facebook, TikTok and Pinterest Schedule & publish content Create landing pages Competitor and inspirational research Help writing catchy texts with our training in SEO practices Together with our social media expert, replying on messages and comments in our social media pages Analyze results of social media posts Community Management Create Emails and Newsletters learn all about CRM Requirements Are you: Student (Creative business) Living in Holland (or can relocate easily - this is a must) You are fluent in German. (Also fluent in English is beneficial) Fulltime available Proactive, curious and go-getter A good eye for style, design and creativity Excellent writing in the German language Teamplayer … then we’d love to hear more about you! Benefits What we have to offer: A full-time internship of minimum 6 months Be a real part of an enthusiastic and warm team The opportunity to learn a lot Great guidance from our team Monthly compensation, refund of transportation costs and a laptop FUN! title: Software Engineer - Platforms & Productivity
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3>About the Team and Role</h3> <p>The Developer Productivity team builds internal tools and platforms that improve the velocity and developer experience of Cloudflare's engineering teams. We own developer productivity (code commit to production), developer insights and ADLC metrics, developer infrastructure (CI/CD, build systems), AI-assisted development, and Cloudflare-on-Cloudflare dogfooding.</p> <p>This team is responsible for AI-assisted development across all of Cloudflare engineering. Adoption has grown 4–6x in the last year. It's a small team, so you'll have a big surface area and real ownership from day one.</p> <p>As a Software Engineer, you will help build and operate internal platforms that help Cloudflare engineers develop, deploy, and run software safely and efficiently. You’ll work across developer tooling, CI/CD, GitOps, and AI-assisted development, including MCP servers, agents, evals, and context engineering.</p> <p>You’ll also help govern and enforce Cloudflare’s Engineering Codex by turning engineering standards into automated guardrails, paved paths, and actionable feedback.</p> <h3>What You’ll Do</h3> <p><strong>Exp</strong>: 4-12yrs</p> <p>- Build developer productivity tools, MCP servers, and AI agents.</p> <p>- Automate Engineering Codex controls through CI/CD checks, templates, and policy-as-code.</p> <p>- Monitor Codex adoption, improve controls, and support remediation and exception workflows.</p> <p>- Improve GitOps, developer experience, platform security, and reliability.</p> <p>- Partner with product teams on architecture and platform adoption.</p> <p>- Respond to and prevent incidents affecting internal platforms.</p> <h3>What We’re Looking For</h3> <p>- Experience with TypeScript, Go, or Bash.</p> <p>- Strong debugging and source-control skills.</p> <p>- Experience with CI/CD, GitOps, or developer platforms.</p> <p>- Ability to break down complex problems and evaluate trade-offs.</p> <p>- Clear communication and a strong focus on developer experience.</p> <h3>Bonus Points</h3> <p>- Experience with AI agents, MCP, evals, or LLM-based tooling.</p> <p>- Experience with policy-as-code or compliance automation.</p> <p>- Background in platform engineering or developer productivity.</p> <p>- Experience operating distributed or Kubernetes-based systems.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>

title: Principal, Customer Storytelling & Advocacy
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations:</strong></p> <ul> <li>San Francisco, CA</li> <li>Austin, TX</li> <li>London, UK</li> </ul> <p><strong>Role summary</strong></p> <p>We’re looking for a visionary, hands-on storyteller to reinvent how Cloudflare brings customer impact to life. This person will combine the narrative instincts of an exceptional writer and editor, the technical fluency of a product marketer, the relationship skills of a customer advocate, and the creative eye of a producer. You'll interview customers and their executives, find out what was at stake for them, and explain what they built on Cloudflare in language a CFO and a developer can both follow.</p> <p>We welcome ideas no one has tried yet. You'll own the creative standard for video and content. You will raise the creative and production bar across video, case studies, campaigns, executive content, and onstage moments, helping make Cloudflare more relatable without sacrificing technical credibility. You will also build repeatable, AI-enabled workflows that enable us to discover, produce, and amplify distinctive customer stories at scale.</p> <p><strong>Role responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Interview customers and find the story: </strong>Work directly with customers and their executives to learn what problem they had and what changed after they solved it. </li> <li><strong>Explain the technology in simple terms: </strong>Turn topics like Zero Trust or Workers AI into stories that business and technical readers can both follow, and keep the technical details right.</li> <li><strong>Lead a few big moments each year:</strong> Own a few major storytelling projects a year, such as a film, a campaign, or a customer segment in a Cloudflare Connect keynote.</li> <li><strong>Come up with ideas that get noticed: </strong>Pitch creative concepts that make people stop scrolling, such as a surprising angle or a format no one else has tried.</li> <li><strong>Try new formats:</strong> Pilot formats beyond the case study, such as documentary-style series, live builds, short social video, interactive data stories, customer takeovers, and podcasts.</li> <li><strong>Set the quality standard: </strong>Decide what good looks like for customer stories in every format, and hold agencies, freelancers, and internal teams to it.</li> <li><strong>Supply executives with stories:</strong> Give Cloudflare leaders the customer stories and proof points they use in keynotes, briefings, social posts, and customer meetings.</li> <li><strong>Work across teams to get stories approved: </strong>Source stories with Sales and Product, and work with Marketing, Communications, and Legal to get approvals.</li> <li><strong>Use AI to scale: </strong>Build repeatable AI workflows for spotting story candidates, preparing interviews, drafting, and cutting one story into versions for each channel.</li> <li><strong>Track results: </strong>Decide how we measure story impact (sales usage, pipeline influence, reach, advocate engagement) and use the numbers to choose what to make next.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Desirable skills, knowledge, and experience </strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Technical fluency</strong>: You can read a product doc or architecture diagram and explain in plain language what a customer built and why it matters.</li> <li><strong>Reporter and editor instincts</strong>: You ask the follow-up question and find the detail other people missed. You can read a draft and say what's missing, and you write copy that works for a CISO and for a developer.</li> <li><strong>Creative judgment and taste</strong>: You can tell quickly whether a story will get attention or build credibility. You know good film, editorial, design, and social work when you see it, and you borrow ideas from outside tech, including media, sports, and entertainment.</li> <li><strong>Production experience</strong>: You've had some experience directing or producing customer video, documentary, podcast, or live content, and you can manage crews and agencies.</li> <li><strong>Executive presence and influence</strong>: You're comfortable interviewing a customer's C-suite and briefing a Cloudflare executive before a keynote. You can get Sales, Product, Marketing, Comms, IT, and Legal moving in the same direction, and you push back when a story isn't ready.</li> <li><strong>AI in your daily work: </strong>You already use AI tools for writing, research, interview prep, or production, and you can show us how.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>10-15 years of experience </strong>in one or more of the following: Developer Relations, Product Marketing, Customer Marketing, Journalism, or Video Production. B2B technology experience is strongly preferred.</li> <li>Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.</li> <li><strong>Option to include customer stories</strong>, video, campaigns, or stage content you created or led, with a short note on what made each one work. Original creative concepts or formats that performed well, with results you can point to (for example reach, press coverage, or sales impact).</li> <li><strong>Experience producing stories with enterprise customers </strong>and their executives, including getting them through customer, Legal, and Comms approval.</li> <li><strong>Experience explaining complex technical products </strong>(infrastructure, security, developer platforms, or AI) to business and technical audiences.</li> <li>Experience producing video and live or stage content from start to finish.</li> <li>Experience building a content program or production workflow that other people could run is preferred</li> </ul> <div id="model-response-message-contentr_8ad1215988914a70" class="markdown markdown-main-panel md-content enable-luminous-fast-follows enable-updated-hr-color tutor-markdown-rendering"> <h3 class="" data-path-to-node="0"><strong data-path-to-node="0" data-index-in-node="0">Compensation</strong></h3> <ul data-path-to-node="1"> <li> <div> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location</p> <div> <ul> <li>For San Francisco Bay Area based hires: Estimated annual salary of $221,000 - $304,000.</li> </ul> </div> </div> </li> </ul> <h3 class="" data-path-to-node="2"><strong data-path-to-node="2" data-index-in-node="0">Equity</strong></h3> <ul data-path-to-node="3"> <li> <div>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare's equity plan.</div> </li> </ul> <h3 class="" data-path-to-node="4"><strong data-path-to-node="4" data-index-in-node="0">Benefits</strong></h3> <ul data-path-to-node="5"> <li> <div> <p><span class="citation-1006 citation-1007 citation-1008 citation-end-1008">Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family. title: Senior Product Marketing Manager
description: Optics11 is a fast-growing high-tech company based in Amsterdam, developing advanced fiber optic sensing solutions for the most demanding environments. Our technology detects the earliest signs of failure in critical assets – from high-voltage energy infrastructure to subsea and defense applications – and gives our customers precise, real-time data they can act on. As Senior Product Marketing Manager you will build a deep understanding of the end-to-end solutions (hardware and software) across all of Underwater Security (our OptiBarrier and OptiArray product lines and our software platform), and of the markets and customers they serve. You turn that understanding into clear positioning, compelling value propositions and go-to-market plans that help our sales teams win. Optics11 is in its scale-up phase, and product marketing in Underwater Security is starting from a basic level. You will build the product marketing function from the ground up: you set up the frameworks, processes and tools it needs, while delivering tangible commercial results along the way. You start as an individual contributor, with the opportunity to grow a small product marketing team over time. You will be part of the Product team in Underwater Security and work closely with our solutions Product Managers for hardware and software, Sales, Business Development, Marketing, Application Engineering, Customer Projects and R&D teams. No two weeks will look the same. You might analyze a competitor’s new seabed monitoring system, sharpen the value proposition for an anti-submarine warfare (ASW) tender, work on the launch of a new software release, train the sales team on a new product narrative, or help prepare a customer demo for a tradeshow such as UDT or Euronaval. You will own how our products are positioned, launched and sold in the market, support pricing decisions, and make sure your market insights support Optics11 product decision making. Within your first 6–12 months, you will have evolved the foundations of product marketing in Underwater Security: clearly defined target segments and buyer personas, a positioning and messaging framework per product line, a competitive intelligence baseline, a repeatable launch process and a first sales enablement toolkit. Your work will sharpen our market focus, improve our win rate and help Optics11 scale its solutions commercially in demanding, high-stakes markets. Responsibilities: Build the product marketing function by setting up the frameworks, processes, templates and tools for positioning, launches, competitive intelligence, sales enablement and product marketing analytics, tracking pipeline contribution and win rates, and scaling them as the organization grows. Define target markets and commercialization plans by analyzing market size, trends, buying contexts and customer needs across mission profiles such as anti-submarine warfare (ASW), intelligence, surveillance and reconnaissance (ISR) and critical underwater infrastructure (CUI) protection, prioritizing segments and use cases with Product Management and Business Development, and defining go-to-market approaches, channels and partnerships per segment (e.g. with prime contractors and system integrators). Lead competitive intelligence and market monitoring by tracking competitors, technologies, programs and tenders, running win/loss analyses, and sharing actionable insights with Product Management to shape strategy, roadmap and business cases. Enable sales and ensure commercial readiness by creating sales narratives, pitch decks, battlecards, objection handling and training, preparing customer demos, collateral and tender input with Tech Sales & Bid Management and Application Engineering, and supporting Sales, Business Development and Marketing in key opportunities, tenders and trade shows. Demonstrable experience in defining value propositions, positioning and go-to-market plans, and executing them through launches and sales enablement. Ability to quickly understand complex technology and translate it into clear, credible customer value. Strong cross-functional leadership and stakeholder management skills at operational and management level. Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English, capable of presenting to technical, commercial and executive audiences. Proficiency in CRM and marketing automation tools such as HubSpot, and in analytics for funnel and performance reporting. Willingness to travel, including to customers and international trade shows; driver’s license B (or international equivalent). Ability to pass a background / security screening by the Dutch AIVD/MIVD, as you will be working with clients in the defense industry. Nice to Have : Experience in ASW, ISR or CUI-related defense technology markets, or with underwater acoustics, is a big plus. Experience with defense procurement, tenders and export-controlled products. Understanding of pricing and packaging for hardware, software and recurring-revenue (license or subscription) models. Experience working with prime contractors and system integrators. Proficiency in tools such as Jira Product Discovery, Confluence, Miro, PowerBI. You will initially focus on the Submarine and Special Warfare Support Vessel (SSV) domain, working closely with the Product Manager UxV, and build a deep understanding of the towed array systems and solutions we supply to our defense partners and clients, and of the anti-submarine warfare (ASW) and intelligence, surveillance and reconnaissance (ISR) missions they support. You are responsible, from a product point of view, for bringing towed array solutions for your domain to market end to end from the in-water array to dry-end interrogator hardware, edge processing and integration on the host platform. You own the product strategy, roadmap and lifecycle for your domain within the shared towed array roadmap and shape the end-to-end solution together with the Product Manager UxV Solutions and the Senior Product Manager Software Solutions, who owns the software and platform capabilities that support it. You apply and further strengthen our product discovery and delivery ways of working for your domain. You will be part of the Product team in Underwater Security and work closely with the Product Managers for UxV, Software, OptiBarrier and Deployment Solutions, Product Marketing, System Architecture, R&D, Engineering, Data Science, Sales, Customer Projects and Application Engineering teams. Within your first 6–12 months, you will have defined a clear, evidence-based SSV strategy and roadmap aligned with the overall towed array roadmap, assumed full Product ownership of SSV-related programs, and aligned hardware, software and commercial teams on the most important capabilities. Your work will expand our capacity to serve customers and programs in parallel, reduce uncertainty and strengthen investment decisions, helping Optics11 bring scalable, commercially strong solutions to customers operating in demanding, high-stakes defense environments. Responsibilities: Own the SSV domain strategy by defining the direction for towed array solutions in your domain, aligned with the overall towed array product group strategy, identifying customer problems and market opportunities, and balancing near-term opportunities with long-term company goals. Lead customer and market discovery by developing a deep understanding of operational use cases, mission profiles and buying contexts, validating direction with navies, primes, partners and system integrators, and synthesizing feedback from trials and deployed systems. Own the SSV roadmap and end-to-end solution definition within the shared towed array roadmap by defining the capabilities required to address validated needs, balancing improvements, new functionality and technology evolution, and aligning software and platform requirements with the Senior Product Manager Software. Provide product design authority by ensuring hardware concepts, architecture choices and development decisions remain aligned with the Underwater Security product vision and strategy throughout the product lifecycle, together with System Architecture team. Develop business cases and commercial input by defining success measures, commercial objectives and pricing for your domain, providing evidence for portfolio investment decisions, and working with Product Marketing on market insights, positioning, value propositions and launch readiness. Bring solutions to market end to end by driving productization, defining qualification and certification requirements at product and solution level (with Systems Engineering and System Architects defining them at engineering level), integration on host platforms and market introduction, including service and through-life support concepts together with Customer Projects and Application Engineering. Coordinate the product core team by working with Systems Engineering on requirements and feasibility, Product Ownership and Technical Project Managers on executable increments, and Project Management on customer integrations and delivery; align priorities, platform choices and shared components with the Product Manager UxV; and align Sales, Business Development, Customer Projects and Engineering around progress, quality and outcomes to ensure we deliver on our roadmap commitments. Requirements: Master’s degree in engineering (e.g. electrical, mechanical, physics or acoustics), product development or a related technical field. 5+ years of experience in hardware product management, with a proven track record of bringing hardware-based systems or end-to-end solutions to market in defense or another industrial high-tech / high-compliance environment. Strong understanding of complex systems combining sensors, electronics and software, and of how hardware, edge processing and software platforms come together in one solution. Experience with the full hardware lifecycle: from requirements and development through qualification, production and market introduction to through-life support and ILS. In-depth knowledge of product management and strategy methodologies, with demonstrable experience in defining product strategy and creating complete business cases. Strong cross-functional leadership and stakeholder management skills at operational and management level. Critical thinking, adaptability and a problem-solving mindset to creatively address user and customer pain points. Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English, capable of conveying product decisions and roadmaps to technical and non-technical stakeholders. Willingness to travel, including to customers and sea trials; driver’s license B (or international equivalent). Ability to pass a background / security screening by the Dutch AIVD/MIVD, as you will be working with clients in the defense industry. Nice to Have : Experience with sonar, towed arrays or underwater acoustics, ideally in ASW or ISR applications, is a big plus. Experience with naval surface vessel programs, ideally submarine or special warfare support missions. Experience with defense procurement, naval platform integration and export-controlled products. Experience with fiber optic sensing technology. Proficiency in tooling such as Jira / Jira Product Discovery, Confluence, BigPicture, JAMA Connect, Siemens Polarion, Miro and PowerBI. Proficiency in Dutch language is a plus. Screening You will work with clients in the defense and security sectors. Obtaining a Certificate of No Objection issued by the AIVD, the Dutch General Intelligence and Security Service, is mandatory. This means you will need to undergo a security screening. We will explain the process and guide you through the applicable requirements. Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Stage E-commerce & Influencer Marketing (NL/BE), fulltime, start januari/februari 2027
description: Wil je zien wat jouw ideeën doen voor een merk waar jonge ouders dol op zijn? Bij Petite Amélie zie je meteen het resultaat van je werk. Dit maakt je een goede match: Je pakt dingen zelf op, bent nieuwsgierig en denkt commercieel. Je vindt het leuk om mensen te benaderen en relaties op te bouwen. Je hebt oog voor design, interieur en esthetiek. Je werkt nauwkeurig en graag samen. Herken je jezelf niet in elk punt? Solliciteer toch. Enthousiasme en leergierigheid wegen voor ons zwaar. Stuur je CV en vertel ons kort wie je bent. Je kunt een motivatie schrijven, maar je mag jezelf ook voorstellen met een reel, story of een ander creatief format. Dat vinden we leuk, maar het is niet verplicht. Zo verloopt het: binnen een week hoor je van ons. Daarna volgt een (video)kennismaking met je toekomstige begeleider, en je hoort snel of je in januari of februari kunt starten. Vragen? title: Senior Sales Manager, Central Eastern Europe - Digital Natives
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Location: Hybrid - </strong><strong>London, United Kingdom or Amsterdam, Netherlands</strong></p> <hr> <p><strong>About the Department</strong></p> <p>Account Executives, Business Development Representatives, Solution Engineers, and Customer Success - all working together to help our customers adopt Cloudflare and build great Internet-enabled experiences. The sales team at Cloudflare helps customers take on real, technical problems while building the revenue streams that help the company provide free service to millions in our community.</p> <p><strong>About the Role</strong></p> <p>Based out of our hub in London, you will help scale our new business revenues across the Digital Natives segment in the Central and Eastern Europe region (CEE) by leading a team of Account Executives. As a first line manager you will i) coach AEs and act as the first line of support on pipeline generation, deal execution strategy and day-to-day matters, ii) work with Sales Ops, Management, title: QHSE Coordinator (m/f/d)
description: Who We Are Thermoheat B.V. has over 40 years of experience in refractory solutions and is part of the LOEWE Group, a third-generation family-owned business founded in 1962. From our locations in the Netherlands and Portugal, we supply refractory products, thermal seals, pre-shaped components and passive fire protection solutions to a wide range of industries, including petrochemicals, steel, aluminium, energy and glass. We are VCA** and ISO 9001:2015 certified and audited in accordance with NEN 4400-1. As a family-owned company, we value open communication, mutual respect and strong teamwork. Your Role You help make safety and quality part of everyday work – not just paperwork. Working closely with our QHSE Manager, you'll be the hands-on contact for QHSE matters in the workshop, on construction sites and across our projects. What You'll Do Safety inspections: Carry out inspections in the workshop and on construction sites, identify risks and take action when needed. QHSE meetings: Organise toolbox talks and safety meetings, share information and follow up on agreed actions. Documentation: Prepare and maintain risk assessments (RI&E/TRA), work instructions and QHSE records. Follow-up: Track corrective actions and ensure issues are resolved. Incident reporting: Record incidents and near misses and support investigations together with the Safety Officer. Audits: Support internal audits, supplier checks and preparations for VCA, ISO and NEN audits. Coordination: Act as a contact person for project managers, technicians and subcontractors, and coordinate occupational health appointments. What You Bring A completed technical or commercial education. Ideally, a safety qualification (VCA VOL, MVK/HVK) or experience in a similar role. Good MS Office skills and confidence using digital tools. A valid driving licence (B) and willingness to visit construction sites. Very good Dutch (C1) and good English (B2). A practical, independent and organised approach, with a good eye for safety. Clear communication skills and a proactive attitude. What We Offer Attractive salary and benefits , including exclusive employee discounts. A permanent position in a growing, international family-owned company. Opportunities for training and professional development. Flexible working conditions and a supportive, motivated team. Join Us! Thermoheat B.V. – A Member of the LOEWE Group Where tradition meets innovation. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Software Engineer - Cloud Partner Integrations
description: About the team Most providers make customers migrate their data to them. We're doing the opposite: bringing ClickHouse Cloud into the environments our customers already trust, so their data stays useful right where it lives. Those environments come in a few shapes. Some are major cloud data platforms that run ClickHouse as a native service, so customers get it without leaving the tool they already use. Some are BI and visualization tools that need ClickHouse to show up as a fast, first-class data source behind their dashboards. And some are developer and data platforms we connect through marketplaces and identity federation with a couple of clicks or agentic calls. Every integration is unique, but the goal is the same every time: ClickHouse should feel like a first-class citizen in every environment. The craft is finding the patterns underneath different integrations. As one of the first backend engineers, you'll help shape the technical defaults for this team. You'll have end-to-end ownership, but you'll also work inside the constraints of platforms you don't own: thin documentation, unfamiliar deployment topologies, and timelines governed by partner approval cycles. A lot of the challenge is engineering across trust boundaries you don't fully control. You won't be doing it alone. You'll work closely with your engineering manager, the product manager, a growing team, and experienced engineers across the broader org. If that sounds like your kind of challenge, let's talk. What you'll do You'll own an integration end to end: the design, the code, and the production system that keeps running after launch. The patterns you set there become defaults the rest of the team builds on. Knowledge of payment systems , merchant risk, fraud typologies, and relevant regulatory requirements. Proficiency with fraud monitoring tools , case management systems, or relevant dashboards. Clear and effective communication skills to articulate complex scenarios and mitigation strategies to cross-functional and external teams. You'll get regular feedback and performance reviews to support your development, with fair and transparent salary reviews along the way. No matter if you're aiming for promotion, exploring a different career path or building new skills, you'll be supported with the tools, trust and opportunities to grow your way. title: Senior HR Business Partner
description: Legal AI is zo goed als de kennis erachter. Bij Lefebvre Sdu bouwen we al 200 jaar aan die kennis. Dag in, dag uit. Wet voor wet. Woord voor woord. Andere legal AI-tools draaien op onze data en software. Meer dan 75.000 professionals werken er dagelijks mee, goed voor ruim 100 miljoen euro ARR in Europa. We zoeken een Senior HR Business Partner die ons team door een verandertraject begeleidt en adviseert. HOE JIJ ONS VERDER BRENGT Lefebvre Sdu transformeert van uitgever naar techbedrijf. Nergens is dat zo voelbaar als in ons product team. De mensen die hier werken bouwen het platform waarop onze AI-revolutie draait, en ze doen dat terwijl de organisatie om hen heen verandert. 70 mensen nu, vacatures open, en een opdracht die elke maand groter wordt. Jij bent de HR Adviseur die dit team begeleidt. Niet op afstand, maar als iemand die begrijpt wat er speelt, de juiste vragen stelt en mensen vooruit helpt. Dit ga je doen: Jij bent de HR-partner van het team dat onze transformatie mogelijk maakt. Wat hier speelt is direct voelbaar in de hele organisatie. Je begeleidt managers en medewerkers in het content, tech- en IT-team op alle HR vraagstukken, van instroom tot ontwikkeling. Je signaleert wat er speelt in het team en vertaalt dat naar concrete HR-interventies die werken. Je adviseert managers bij veelvoorkomende thema’s rondom leiderschap, performance en talent development. Je draagt actief bij aan de cultuurverandering die bij deze transformatie hoort. Je werkt nauw samen met je collega HR Adviseurs en de Head of People aan de verdere opbouw van het people team. Je bent niet bang om moeilijke gesprekken te voeren en weet hoe je mensen vooruit helpt zonder ze te verliezen. Je bent praktisch, direct en houdt van een omgeving die nog niet af is. Je hebt meegebouwd aan een salarishuis of vergelijkbare HR-structuur en snapt hoe je dat bespreekbaar maakt in een organisatie. Je hebt affiniteit met cultuurtrajecten en leiderschapsprogramma's en denkt mee over hoe die eruit moeten zien bij Lefebvre Sdu. Je spreekt vloeiend Nederlands en Engels. description: About Vitestro Founded in 2017 in Utrecht, Vitestro is pioneering the future of blood collection with the Aletta® Autonomous Robotic Phlebotomy Device™ (ARPD™) . This groundbreaking medical device combines advanced multi-modal imaging (near-infrared, ultrasound, and Doppler ultrasound) with robotics and AI to perform the entire diagnostic blood draw procedure autonomously. By addressing critical healthcare staffing shortages and improving patient experience, Vitestro is transforming one of the most common and essential medical procedures. With more than 130 team members and growing rapidly, we are scaling our impact. As we placed our first devices with customers, we are now expanding our team to ensure successful implementation and long-term reliability. At Vitestro, we are committed to continuous innovation and improvement. We are looking for a Cloud Architect to shape and implement Vitestro's cloud platform with a clear, pragmatic technical direction. Our infrastructure runs on AWS and supports mission-critical, regulated medical device software. Vitestro is also realizing its first integration with Laboratory Information System (LIS) over the cloud, and delivering that connection is a core part of this role. We need someone who translates real operational and business constraints into working systems — someone whose first instinct is "what does this actually need to do, reliably and affordably," not "what's the most sophisticated way to solve this." You will join the Platform & Connectivity team and build alongside its cloud, backend, and DevOps engineers. This is an individual-contributor technical leadership role, not a people-management position — you carry the architectural vision and build it hands-on with the team, rather than designing something for others to execute. If you'd rather ship a solid, working solution than iterate endlessly toward a theoretically ideal one, and you have a track record of keeping cloud costs under control at scale, you'll thrive in this role. First months at Vitestro In your first months, you get to know our cloud platform, the device connectivity and the team. You review the current architecture, its costs and its production-readiness, and identify where the biggest risks and quick wins are. You take ownership of the cloud architecture for our first LIS integration, and you agree with the team on the first architectural standards for observability, logging and infrastructure as code. This is what success looks like: After 12 months, our first LIS integration runs reliably in production, with monitoring, alerting and failure handling in place. Cloud costs are predictable and under control, and key architectural decisions and trade-offs are recorded. The team uses shared patterns instead of reinventing solutions, and is confident running production systems as we move from pre-market to post-market. Key Responsibilities: Set the technical direction for our AWS-based cloud platform and build it hands-on with the team — weighing cost, operability, and production-readiness as first-class concerns, not afterthoughts Own the cloud architecture of Vitestro's first LIS integration over the cloud: secure, reliable, and traceable data exchange between our platform and the hospital laboratory Choose solutions on their merits rather than defaulting to the most AWS-native option — including other clouds, self-hosted tooling, or dedicated infrastructure when that's genuinely the better fit Take implementations from a working prototype to something that's production-ready — monitoring, alerting, and failure handling included. You bring experience with production systems and advise the team on how to navigate from pre-market to post-market stages. Establish architectural standards and patterns so similar problems (e.g. observability, logging, data pipelines) get solved consistently instead of reinvented each time Keep cloud costs in check as part of everyday engineering decisions, catching expensive mistakes before they show up on an invoice Balance short-term solutions driven by business needs and deadlines against the long-term architecture: make each trade-off explicit, record it, and plan the path from the tactical fix to the durable solution Diagnose and resolve production issues across the cloud platform from logs, metrics, and traces What You’ll Bring: Deep, hands-on production experience with AWS at scale — not certification-level familiarity, but real experience with what breaks and what gets expensive as usage grows Proven experience running production systems end to end, from design and release through monitoring and incident response, and the ability to advise a team that is new to production Genuine experience building outside an AWS-only mindset — another cloud, self-hosted/open-source alternatives, or dedicated/on-premise infrastructure — enough to make an informed trade-off, not just AWS as the only tool you reach for A track record of finishing what others started: turning a partial or unstable implementation into something genuinely reliable in production Strong Infrastructure as Code practice (Terraform, OpenTofu, Pulumi, or AWS CDK) as the authoritative source of environment configuration Comfortable operating in a regulated, security-conscious environment where architecture decisions have compliance implications Familiarity with AWS cost structure, along with the ability to factor in cost-related considerations when designing infrastructure Professional English; Dutch is a plus Nice to have: Experience specifically with observability/logging platforms at scale (e.g. OpenSearch, Grafana/Loki stacks, or equivalent) — bringing an implementation to production-hardened state, not just standing it up Experience in medical device, healthcare, or another regulated industry Familiarity with multi-tenant, per-customer cloud architectures (e.g. isolated accounts or workloads per client/region) Experience in a startup or scale-up environment How We Work At Vitestro, ownership is not a slogan - it is an expectation. We trust people to take responsibility, make decisions, and drive work forward. We believe breakthroughs happen when talented people combine dedication, accountability, and teamwork. That means: We take initiative rather than wait for direction. We focus on execution and delivering results. We proactively remove blockers and help each other succeed. We challenge ideas, not people. We continuously learn, improve, and raise the bar. We celebrate team success over individual heroics. We move fast, but we do so thoughtfully. We care deeply about quality because the technology we build ultimately impacts patients and healthcare professionals. If you are looking for an environment where you can make a significant contribution, take ownership of meaningful work, and be surrounded by highly motivated colleagues, we'd love to meet you. What we offer Competitive salary including a pension plan 25 days of annual leave (full-time position) A high-skilled team based in Utrecht Frequent out-of-work team activities and an annual company weekend away A training budget The chance to help shape the new niche of autonomous medical robotics We’re big fans of working from the office – this is where team spirit comes alive. At the same time, we offer flexibility, allowing up to two (out of 5) days of working from home for those who prefer it. Are you excited? We totally understand that and so are we! By joining us, you can play an active role in changing the future of health care. Excited to join our revolution? Then we’d love to hear from you! If you think you've got what it takes, but you don't meet all the requirements - we still recommend you apply. We would love to learn about your interest and experience and consider if you can be a good fit for Vitestro. Nobody is a perfect fit, and we welcome applications with imperfections. We offer a learning environment where we grow together! Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Engineering Manager, Customs
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>About Flexport: </strong></h2> <p>At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year. </p> <p>The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.</p></div><h3><strong>Why Customs Matters More Than Ever</strong></h3> <p>International trade is under more pressure than ever before. With tariffs, shifting regulations, and geopolitical uncertainty, customs has gone from a back-office function to a boardroom priority. The recent trade crisis — sparked by Trump-era tariffs — has made customs the single most complex challenge for global businesses. For many, it’s the difference between keeping supply chains moving or grinding them to a halt.</p> <p>That’s where we come in. The <strong>Customs Technology team</strong> at Flexport is leading the charge. We are building the systems that help entrepreneurs and global brands navigate complexity, stay compliant, and keep the world’s goods flowing.</p> <h3><strong>The Opportunity</strong></h3> <p>Customs brokerage is one of the largest, most under-innovated opportunities in logistics. Legacy customs brokers are stuck with outdated systems and manual processes—they simply can’t adapt fast enough.</p> <p>Flexport is growing fast because we’re different. We are the only big tech company in the space, and the only freight forwarder that got founded after the launch of Netscape. Being a tech company, we can move much faster than our competitors, and give our customers the service they expect in this day and age. We can deploy things like LLM agents at scale, in an industry that is ripe to be disrupted by this technology.</p> <h3><strong>What You’ll Do</strong></h3> <p>As an Engineering Manager in the Customs Technology team, you’ll lead a group of exceptional engineers to:</p> <ul> <li>Build world class tools like our Tariff Simulator, the only tool that gives businesses a real view of landed costs before they ship.</li> <li>Automate customs processes to an unprecedented level. Most customs are text based work, which is what agents excel at. </li> <li>Design scalable systems that automate classification, compliance, and filings—turning weeks of work into seconds.</li> <li>Partner with product, design, and operations to deliver technology that gives clients clarity, cost savings, and risk control.</li> <li>Mentor and grow a world-class 8-10 member engineering team that thrives on solving the hardest problems in logistics.</li> <li>Shape the future of customs into a transparent, efficient, and strategic advantage for businesses worldwide.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Things We ❤️</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Leveraging AI in a safe way to eliminate mundane work for customs brokers and automate customs every step of the way</li> <li>Modeling complex and ambiguous domains into fully automated workflows</li> <li>Building highly performant and reliable Kotlin services on our cutting-edge infrastructure platform</li> <li>Collaborating with end users across the globe to create the best possible product: removing toil and surfacing interesting cases</li> </ul> <h3><strong>You Should Have</strong></h3> <ul> <li>3–5 years of experience leading software engineering teams</li> <li>Ability to break down complex problems into actionable plans. You need to go deep into details in a domain completely unfamiliar to you, and come out with an end to end understanding to automate it.</li> <li>Founder Mentality & Ownership: An entrepreneurial instinct. You operate like an owner, thrive in ambiguity, and take ideas from 0 to 1 without needing a predetermined playbook.</li> <li>A love of simple, well-tested code that is easy to extend and hard to break</li> <li>Excellent communication skills with both technical and non-technical audiences</li> <li>A bias for action — you see problems and solve them</li> <li>An aptitude for learning quickly (non-optional)</li> </ul> <h3><strong>How We Work</strong></h3> <ul> <li>The latest and greatest hardware and software to support you, including all AI tools.</li> <li>Agile ways of working — without being tied to a single doctrine like Scrum</li> <li>A modern stack: moving from a React/Flow + Ruby on Rails monolith to React/Typescript, Kotlin microservices on Kubernetes. We also use and love GraphQL, gRPC, Postgres, Kafka, and Snowflake.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What’s in It for You?</strong></h3> <ul> <li>An opportunity to contribute to one of the fastest-growing companies, with global impact</li> <li>Daily catered lunches (vegetarian options included), breakfast, snacks, coffee/tea and soft drinks in our office</li> <li>Covered commute expenses for employees living outside Amsterdam</li> <li>25 vacation days per year (full-time)</li> <li>Fully paid health insurance (basic and additional packages) through a collective plan</li> <li>A defined pension contribution scheme</li> <li>Equity program: become a shareholder in a multi-trillion-dollar industry disruptor</li> <li>Employee Assistance Program (Aetna Resources for Living)</li> <li>Parental leave benefit for both mothers and partners</li> </ul> <p><br><br></p><div class="content-conclusion"><div id="1704749847.557549" class="c-virtual_list__item" data-qa="virtual-list-item" data-item-key="1704749847.557549"> <div class="c-message_kit__background p-message_pane_message__message c-message_kit__message" data-qa="message_container" data-qa-unprocessed="false" data-qa-placeholder="false"> <div class="c-message_kit__hover" data-qa-hover="true"> <div class="c-message_kit__actions c-message_kit__actions--default"> <div class="c-message_kit__gutter"> <div class="c-message_kit__gutter__right" data-qa="message_content"> <div class="c-message_kit__blocks c-message_kit__blocks--rich_text"> <div class="c-message__message_blocks c-message__message_blocks--rich_text" data-qa="message-text"> <div class="p-block_kit_renderer" data-qa="block-kit-renderer"> <div class="p-block_kit_renderer__block_wrapper p-block_kit_renderer__block_wrapper--first"> <div class="p-rich_text_block"> <h4>Commitment to Equal Opportunity</h4> <p>At Flexport, our ability to fulfill our mission of making global commerce easy and accessible relies on having a diverse, dedicated and engaged workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, physical and mental disability, health status, marital and family status, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, military and veteran status, and any other characteristic protected by applicable law.</p> <h4>Global Data Privacy Notice for Job Candidates and Applicants</h4> <p>Depending on your location, the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) may regulate the way we manage the data of job applicants. By submitting your application, you are agreeing to our use and processing of your data as required. Please see our Privacy Notice available at <a href="http://www.flexport.com/privacy" target="_blank" data-saferedirecturl="https://www.google.com/url?q=http://www.flexport.com/privacy&source=gmail&ust=1613840050053000&usg=AFQjCNHD63svlkD-hWHlGuGOM_bSYVrnpw">www.flexport.com/privacy</a> for additional information.</p> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div></div> Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Junior Product Manager
description: Introductie Ben jij analytisch sterk, commercieel ingesteld en heb je affiniteit met techniek en productmanagement? Weet jij marktontwikkelingen te vertalen naar kansen voor producten en diensten? En krijg jij energie van het optimaliseren van een productportfolio en het succesvol introduceren van nieuwe producten? Bij FAAC Technologies zoeken we een Junior Product Manager die verantwoordelijk wordt voor de positionering en ontwikkeling van ons productportfolio. In deze rol vorm je de verbindende schakel tussen Sales, Marketing, Techniek en de internationale productmanagementteams van FAAC Group. Door marktontwikkelingen te volgen en klantbehoeften te analyseren, zorg je ervoor dat onze producten aansluiten op de behoeften van de markt en de strategische doelstellingen van de organisatie. We zoeken iemand die aan het begin van zijn of haar carrière staat en zich verder wil ontwikkelen binnen productmanagement. Of je nu net bent afgestudeerd en klaar bent voor een eerste uitdaging, of al circa 1 tot 3 jaar werkervaring hebt opgedaan: enthousiasme, analytisch vermogen, commerciële interesse en de motivatie om je te ontwikkelen vinden we minstens zo belangrijk als ruime werkervaring. In deze veelzijdige hybride functie komen marktinzichten, commerciële analyses en technische kennis samen om onze producten en diensten continu te verbeteren. Je krijgt de ruimte om je kennis en ervaring verder uit te bouwen en te groeien in de rol. Je rapporteert rechtstreeks aan de Manager Techniek. title: Account Executive Tender (Non-profit) & RFPs

Zo'n 30% van onze commerciële inflow komt binnen via tenders en RFPs — en dat aandeel groeit. RFPs komen daarbij vaak van grotere enterprise-klanten en worden in samenwerking met andere Account Executives voorbereid en opgepakt. Veel salesmensen begrijpen dat proces onvoldoende. Je bouwt offertes en proposities die aansluiten bij EMVI-criteria en publieke waarden. Je beoordeelt en onderhandelt contractvoorwaarden, en schakelt waar nodig met legal. Je werkt samen met andere Account Executives aan RFPs voor grotere enterprise-klanten. Je werkt samen met interne teams zodat de klant de beste ervaring krijgt – van tender tot implementatie. Je monitort je pijplijn, stuurt bij en zorgt dat je targets realistisch maar ambitieus zijn. Who you are We zoeken geen standaard salesprofiel. Je bent een consultative seller: je luistert goed, stelt de juiste vragen en geeft oprecht advies. Je bent relationeel sterk en bouwt liever langdurige partnerships dan snelle deals. title: Analytics Engineer – Client Reporting
description: Studytube makes professional development accessible. Over the coming year we are moving from Snowflake to Databricks, and you help bring client reporting to the new platform. What you'll do Build and maintain the dbt models behind client reporting, following our layered structure from source to report. Develop Looker reporting end to end: LookML views and explores, dashboards embedded in our platform, and the client-specific logic behind them. Turn client and Customer Success requests into reports, and push back when a definition or requirement is unclear. description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Some customers want to debug applications and investigate security events in Cloudflare. Others want that data in a stack they already trust, such as Splunk, Datadog, Grafana, or their own data lake. Many want both.</p> <p>We're hiring one Senior Product Manager for each of two areas. You apply once, and we'll work out together which role fits you best.</p> <p><strong>Observability Platform</strong> brings logs, traces, analytics, alerts, and dashboards together in one place, so customers can see what's happening and why. Today most observability ends with a notification, and the customer does the rest. We want a platform that understands the problem, takes action where it can, and asks before doing anything risky.</p> <p><strong>Telemetry Export</strong> delivers Cloudflare's data to the tools customers choose. Logpush handles most of that delivery today, and Workers Observability sends logs and traces over the OpenTelemetry Protocol (OTLP). Customers want OTLP for the rest of Cloudflare's data, metrics pushed to their own tools, and a way to send us telemetry from workloads that run elsewhere.</p> <p><strong>Your mission is to make reliability and security something customers rarely have to worry about, with the data they need in Cloudflare or in the tools they already use.</strong></p> <h3>What You'll Do</h3> <ul> <li>Talk with customers every day and deeply understand their needs. They include developers building on Cloudflare, security teams who feed our logs into a SIEM, and platform teams who run OpenTelemetry pipelines.</li> <li>Own the strategy, roadmap, and execution for your area, and make hard trade-offs between speed, retention, reliability, and cost.</li> <li>Build on open standards like OpenTelemetry, W3C Trace Context, and SQL so teams can keep using the tools they already have.</li> <li>Own the business, including pricing, packaging, and revenue. Measure progress by adoption and reliability.</li> </ul> <h3>In <strong>Observability Platform</strong>, you'll also:</h3> <ul> <li>Bring every Cloudflare product into one observability experience, so customers can follow a problem from one product to the next without switching tools.</li> <li>Move beyond notifications to workflows that investigate, roll back, or fix problems, with guardrails customers control.</li> <li>Give people and their agents the context they need to act safely, including how services connect and depend on each other.</li> <li>Own the experience end to end, from first setup to the middle of an incident or an audit.</li> </ul> <h3>In <strong>Telemetry Export</strong>, you'll also:</h3> <ul> <li>Bring Logpush, Workers Logpush, and the OpenTelemetry destinations in Workers Observability together as one product, and keep existing integrations working.</li> <li>Ship metrics export and extend OTLP delivery to more of our datasets. Own the intake path for telemetry from outside Cloudflare; Observability Platform will store and query it.</li> <li>Make delivery something customers can trust, so they can see whether their data arrived, get a useful alert when it didn't, and know how to recover.</li> <li>Help customers filter and transform data before it's sent, so they export only what they need.</li> </ul> <h3>Who You Are</h3> <ul> <li>You've shipped products people depend on, as a PM, engineer, engineering manager, SRE, or founder, and you can point to what changed because of your work.</li> <li>You move fast and own outcomes. You find the most important problem, get the team behind it, ship, and measure.</li> <li>You are a builder at heart. You love getting to a deep understanding of customer needs, and shipping things that help them accomplish their goals. You are passionate about the Observability industry and want to be on the forefront of innovating what it can turn into.</li> <li>You understand how telemetry systems fail, whether that's a delivery pipeline under backpressure or a query that scans far more data than it needs, and you can explain the reliability and cost trade-offs to engineers and to customers.</li> <li>AI is already central to how you work. You use it to prototype ideas and dig through data, and you have a view on how agents will produce telemetry and act on it.</li> </ul> <h3>Examples of Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</h3> <ul> <li>You've relied on observability yourself, on call during an outage or in a security investigation, and you know where today's tools fall short.</li> <li>You've run or built on telemetry pipelines such as the OpenTelemetry Collector, Vector, Fluent Bit, or Kafka, or you've ingested someone else's data at scale at a vendor.</li> <li>You notice friction, like a confusing error message or a query that takes too many steps, and you fix it.</li> <li>You've priced a usage-based product, and you know what happens when existing customers start paying for something that used to be included.</li> <li>You're comfortable with enterprise customers, whether you're talking about compliance with a security team or OTLP with a platform engineer.</li> <li>You write clearly enough to get teams across Cloudflare to agree on a plan, and you can translate between what customers need and what engineering builds.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Compensation</strong><br>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <ul> <li>For <strong>Colorado</strong> based hires: Estimated annual salary of $156,000 - $195,000</li> <li>For <strong>San Francisco / Bay Area </strong>based hires: Estimated annual salary of $179,000 - $224,000</li> <li>For <strong>New York City/Seattle </strong>based hires: Estimated annual salary of $172,000 - $215,000</li> <li>For <strong>Lisbon</strong> based hires: Estimated annual salary of €68,000 to €85,000</li> </ul> <p><strong>Equity</strong><br>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.</p> <p><strong>Benefits</strong><br>Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family.  Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun!  The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.</p> <p><strong>Health & Welfare Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li>Medical/Rx Insurance</li> <li>Dental Insurance</li> <li>Vision Insurance</li> <li>Flexible Spending Accounts</li> <li>Commuter Spending Accounts</li> <li>Fertility & Family Forming Benefits</li> <li>On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program</li> <li>Global Travel Medical Insurance</li> </ul> <p><strong>Financial Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li>Short and Long Term Disability Insurance</li> <li>Life & Accident Insurance</li> <li>401(k) Retirement Savings Plan</li> <li>Employee Stock Participation Plan</li> </ul> <p><strong>Time Off</strong></p> <ul> <li>Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave</li> <li>Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We are architecting a system to continuously measure CPU, network bandwidth, memory, and storage utilization across the entire global fleet without sampling—attributing resource consumption both to the underlying system service and to the specific product, account, and zone being served.</p> <p><br>The data MAPS produces serves two critical functions at Cloudflare:</p> <ol> <li>Real-Time Control Plane: MAPS is the primary telemetry input for Cloudflare’s next-generation global load balancer, shifting traffic management from open-loop heuristics to closed-loop routing driven by real-time, per-service resource capacity and consumption (within seconds).</li> <li>Fleet Economics & Capacity Planning: MAPS provides the long-term analytical dataset in ClickHouse used to map product demand forecasts to physical hardware requirements, calculate true cost-to-serve per product, and drive multi-year infrastructure investments.</li> </ol> <h2>What You’ll Do</h2> <p>You will work across the full lifecycle of a greenfield, high-throughput telemetry system running on every machine at the Cloudflare edge:</p> <ul> <li>Host-Level Instrumentation ("Outside View"): Build and maintain low-overhead Linux daemons (netacctd, maps_collector) in Rust and C that use eBPF (cgroup_skb) and cgroup v2 accounting to measure per-service resource consumption directly from the kernel.</li> <li>High-Performance Client Libraries ("Inside View"): Architect non-blocking, zero-allocation reporting SDKs in Rust and Go used by Cloudflare’s highest-throughput data-plane services to report per-request resource usage and product attribution over local Unix domain sockets.</li> <li>Edge Aggregation & Streaming: Build the per-machine collector daemon that ingests millions of events per second, performs bounded in-memory time-window aggregation, serves low-latency gRPC streams to the global load balancer, and flushes batch rollups to ClickHouse.</li> <li>Reconciliation & Correctness: Solve complex attribution problems—such as reconciling kernel-level cgroup measurements against application-reported metrics, and attributing resource usage when one multi-tenant service executes work on behalf of another.</li> <li>Cross-Team Architecture: Partner directly with the engineering teams behind Cloudflare’s core proxies, runtimes, and storage engines to instrument their critical paths without degrading tail latency.</li> </ul> <h2>What We’re Looking For</h2> <ul> <li>Strong systems programming experience in Rust, Go, or C, with a solid grasp of memory layout, concurrency, and performance-critical code paths.</li> <li>Experience designing and operating latency- and resource-sensitive server infrastructure or high-throughput data pipelines at scale.</li> <li>Strong fundamentals in Linux systems internals—processes, cgroups, sockets, and how the kernel accounts for compute, memory, and I/O.</li> <li>Proven ability to work across organizational boundaries: reading unfamiliar codebases, aligning with other infrastructure teams, and driving complex integrations to completion.</li> <li>A pragmatic approach to owning outcomes—from kernel-level data collection and wire protocols (protobuf/Cap'n Proto) all the way to the analytical tables consumers query.</li> </ul> <h2>Bonus Points</h2> <ul> <li>Hands-on experience writing and verifying eBPF programs, or deep familiarity with the Linux networking stack and scheduler.</li> <li>Experience designing schemas and query patterns for distributed columnar databases (particularly ClickHouse) at high ingestion rates.</li> <li>Background in profiling, benchmarking, and debugging performance bottlenecks in production Linux environments (perf, PMU counters, flamegraphs).</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. title: Release Engineer, Salesforce
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2><strong>An Overview of this role</strong></h2> <p>We are looking for a Senior Release Engineer to help design, standardize, and operate reliable enterprise application delivery across the Enterprise Technology & AI team.
